ar:HB1362.title: TO MAKE TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS TO TITLE 24 OF THE ARKANSAS CODE CONCERNING RETIREMENT AND PENSIONS.
ar:HB1362.summary: Makes technical corrections to Title 24 of the Arkansas Code (retirement and pensions), including repealing an obsolete rule deadline and a duplicate vacation pay section. The bill states it makes only technical, not substantive, changes.

ar:HB1363.title: TO MAKE TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS TO TITLE 25 OF THE ARKANSAS CODE CONCERNING STATE GOVERNMENT.
ar:HB1363.summary: Makes technical corrections to Title 25 of the Arkansas Code (state government), including updating provisions on state technology and cybersecurity policy and the Department of Human Services. The bill states it makes only technical, not substantive, changes.

ar:HB1364.title: TO MAKE TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS TO TITLE 27 OF THE ARKANSAS CODE CONCERNING TRANSPORTATION.
ar:HB1364.summary: Makes technical corrections to Title 27 of the Arkansas Code (transportation), including disability parking, license plate and school bus provisions, and repeals a subchapter codified elsewhere. The bill states it makes only technical, not substantive, changes.

ar:HB1365.title: TO REMOVE RACIAL AND GENDER QUOTAS AND QUALIFICATIONS OF MEMBERSHIP FOR CERTAIN BOARDS, COMMITTEES, COUNCILS, AND COMMISSIONS.
ar:HB1365.summary: Removes racial, ethnic and gender membership requirements for certain boards and commissions, including the Financial Education Commission and the Commission on Closing the Achievement Gap.

ar:HB1367.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS TITLE INSURANCE ACT; AND TO REGULATE ACCESS TO PUBLIC RECORDS BY A TITLE AGENT AND A TITLE COMPANY.
ar:HB1367.summary: Requires governments that keep real property records electronically to give title insurance agents electronic copies without watermarks, for a fee of up to $150 per month.

ar:HB1368.title: TO AMEND THE LIST OF MUSICIANS HONORED ON ARKANSAS MUSIC APPRECIATION DAY.
ar:HB1368.summary: Adds J.R. Rogers, Frank "Son" Seals, Royal Wade Kimes, Justin Moore and Albert King to the list of musicians honored on Arkansas Music Appreciation Day.

ar:HB1369.title: CONCERNING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE MAXIMUM CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTION LIMIT BY THE ARKANSAS ETHICS COMMISSION; AMENDING PORTIONS OF LAW RESULTING FROM INITIATED ACTS; AND DECLARING AN EMERGENCY.
ar:HB1369.summary: Has the Ethics Commission set the maximum campaign contribution limit by publishing it on its website, effective on publication and retroactive to the federal inflation-adjustment certification date, instead of by rule.

ar:HB1370.title: CONCERNING MAKING UP MISSED SCHOOL DAYS; AND TO REQUIRE A PUBLIC SCHOOL DISTRICT TO INCLUDE ADDITIONAL DAYS OR HOURS, AS APPLICABLE, IN ITS SCHOOL CALENDAR FOR THE PURPOSE OF MAKING UP MISSED SCHOOL DAYS.
ar:HB1370.summary: Requires districts to add seven days to the school calendar for closures; after those are used, the commissioner may approve up to three alternative-instruction days (down from ten), which count toward the 178-day requirement for teacher raise funding.

ar:HB1374.title: CONCERNING A REPORT BY THE DIRECTOR OF THE ARKANSAS ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION CONCERNING CONTRACTS AWARDED TO BUSINESSES IN OPERATION LESS THAN FIVE YEARS.
ar:HB1374.summary: Requires the Economic Development Commission director to report annually to the Governor and legislative committees on state contracts awarded to businesses open under five years, with recommendations to improve access; the first report is due January 1, 2027.

ar:HB1378.title: TO AMEND THE COMPOSITION AND MEETING REQUIREMENTS OF THE STATE BOARD OF FINANCE; AND TO REPEAL THE REQUIREMENTS FOR THE EMPLOYMENT OF A CHIEF COMPLIANCE OFFICER BY THE STATE BOARD OF FINANCE.
ar:HB1378.summary: Replaces the Securities Commissioner with the Secretary of Transformation and Shared Services on the State Board of Finance, lets the Governor send a designee, lowers the quorum from seven to six, and repeals chief compliance officer employment rules.

ar:HB1379.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE SPECIAL AUTHORIZATION FOR REIMBURSEMENT FOR MEALS AND LODGING WHILE TRAVELING ON OFFICIAL BUSINESS OF THE STATE.
ar:HB1379.summary: Lets the cabinet-level secretary, director, chief executive or chief fiscal officer of the agency, rather than the state's Chief Fiscal Officer, authorize state travel meal and lodging reimbursement above the federal per diem rates.

ar:HB1382.title: TO REQUIRE CERTAIN REPORTING BY THE DESIGNATED PROTECTION AND ADVOCACY AGENCY FOR THE STATE AND THE DESIGNATED CLIENT ASSISTANCE PROGRAM FOR THE STATE.
ar:HB1382.summary: Requires the state's protection and advocacy agency and client assistance program to submit biannual reports to a legislative subcommittee and the Governor on advocacy for people with developmental disabilities living in community settings, and applies the Freedom of Information Act to them.

ar:HB1383.title: TO AMEND THE PETROLEUM STORAGE TANK TRUST FUND ACT; AND TO MODIFY THE AMOUNT OF THE PAYMENT FOR CORRECTIVE ACTION.
ar:HB1383.summary: Raises the cap on interim corrective-action payments under the Petroleum Storage Tank Trust Fund Act from 90 percent of $1.5 million to 90 percent of $2 million per occurrence.

ar:HB1384.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE GRADUATE MEDICAL EDUCATION RESIDENCY EXPANSION BOARD; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:HB1384.summary: Replaces the Graduate Medical Education Residency Expansion Board's planning grants with implementation grants for in-state entities, covering start-up costs of new or expanded programs, awarded annually in the fourth quarter on plans with timelines and budgets. Repeals planning grants for additional residency years.

ar:HB1385.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE OIL AND GAS COMMISSION; AND TO REQUIRE THE OIL AND GAS COMMISSION TO NOTIFY MEMBERS OF THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY CONCERNING CERTAIN PERMITS.
ar:HB1385.summary: Requires the Oil and Gas Commission to send written notice, which may be by email, of public hearings on Class II injection disposal well permits to each legislator representing the well's district, including how to access the application and the hearing details.

ar:HB1386.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE ASSESSMENT OF PROPERTY; TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING SUBSTANTIAL IMPROVEMENTS TO REAL PROPERTY; AND TO AMEND THE METHOD OF VALUATION FOR REAL PROPERTY UNDER ARKANSAS CONSTITUTION, ARTICLE 16, § 5.
ar:HB1386.summary: Defines "substantial improvement" as an improvement raising assessed value by 25% or more, and limits residential property valuation comparisons to in-state property, with out-of-state comparisons for commercial property only if no in-state comparable exists.

ar:HB1387.title: TO REQUIRE MEMBERS OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF A PUBLIC WATER AUTHORITY TO PUBLISH THEIR CONTACT INFORMATION UNDER THE WATER AUTHORITY ACT.
ar:HB1387.summary: Requires public water authorities to post board members' names and phone numbers on their website and the Natural Resources Commission's, and to update changes within ten business days.

ar:HB1389.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF HUMAN SERVICES - DIVISION OF DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES SERVICES - JONESBORO HUMAN DEVELOPMENT CENTER APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:HB1389.summary: Appropriates $20 million from cash funds to the Department of Human Services for fiscal year 2025-2026 for planning, demolition, construction, and renovation of facilities under the Jonesboro Human Development Center master plan.

ar:HB1390.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF HUMAN SERVICES - DIVISION OF AGING, ADULT, AND BEHAVIORAL HEALTH SERVICES REAPPROPRIATION.
ar:HB1390.summary: Carries forward unspent 2024 capital funds for the Department of Human Services aging and behavioral health division: $2,000,000 for an Arkansas Health Center warehouse and $1,175,065 for Arkansas State Hospital roof repair or replacement, effective July 1, 2025.

ar:HB1391.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF HUMAN SERVICES - DIVISION OF DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES SERVICES REAPPROPRIATION.
ar:HB1391.summary: Carries forward unspent federal-fund appropriations for the Division of Developmental Disabilities Services: $5,686,139 for Booneville Human Development Center housing and $7,382,597 for master-plan construction at the state's human development centers.

ar:HB1392.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF CORRECTIONS - DIVISION OF COMMUNITY CORRECTION REAPPROPRIATION.
ar:HB1392.summary: Carries forward unspent capital appropriations for the Division of Community Correction, including $671,398 for facility maintenance and construction and cash-funded projects such as elevators and roofs at SWACCC, effective July 1, 2025.

ar:HB1393.title: AN ACT FOR THE INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION REAPPROPRIATION.
ar:HB1393.summary: Carries forward unspent 2024 capital appropriations for state colleges and universities, covering construction, renovation, equipment, and maintenance projects at many campuses, effective July 1, 2025.

ar:HB1394.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF PARKS, HERITAGE, AND TOURISM - DIVISION OF HERITAGE REAPPROPRIATION.
ar:HB1394.summary: Carries forward unspent funds for the Division of Heritage: $750,000 for special maintenance and $14,317,956 for acquiring or preserving state-owned lands and historic sites.

ar:HB1395.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF PARKS, HERITAGE, AND TOURISM - STATE PARKS AND TOURISM DIVISIONS REAPPROPRIATION.
ar:HB1395.summary: Carries forward $16,520,000 in unspent Natural and Cultural Resources Grant and Trust Fund money for the State Parks and Tourism divisions to acquire, manage, or preserve state-owned lands and historic sites.

ar:HB1396.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF CORRECTIONS - DIVISION OF CORRECTION REAPPROPRIATION.
ar:HB1396.summary: Carries forward unspent 2024 capital appropriations for the Division of Correction, including $74,862,550 for prison expansion, effective July 1, 2025.

ar:HB1397.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC SAFETY REAPPROPRIATION.
ar:HB1397.summary: Carries forward $207,318,105 in unspent funds for the Arkansas State Crime Laboratory facility project, effective July 1, 2025.

ar:HB1398.title: TO REQUIRE SCHOOLS TO SUPPORT, ESTABLISH, AND IMPLEMENT A CARDIAC EMERGENCY RESPONSE PLAN THAT INTEGRATES NATIONALLY RECOGNIZED ELEMENTS.
ar:HB1398.summary: Requires each school, by the 2026-2027 school year, to add a cardiac emergency response plan to its emergency operations plan, with a response team, defibrillator placement and signage, and staff CPR and defibrillator training.

ar:HB1399.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE ISSUANCE OF DONATION DEEDS AND HOMESTEAD DONATION DEEDS BY THE COMMISSIONER OF STATE LANDS.
ar:HB1399.summary: As introduced, repeals the Commissioner of State Lands Urban Homestead Act, which lets cities and community organizations obtain donated tax-forfeited urban land, and amends related land-recovery and fee statutes.

ar:HB1400.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE REDEMPTION OF A TAX-DELINQUENT PARCEL; AND TO EXEMPT DISABLED VETERANS FROM CERTAIN PENALTIES WHEN REDEEMING A TAX-DELINQUENT PARCEL.
ar:HB1400.summary: Exempts disabled veterans from the 10 percent per-year penalty when redeeming their tax-delinquent parcels from the Commissioner of State Lands, if they submit the required letter and meet other redemption requirements.

ar:HB1403.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS HEALTH AND OPPORTUNITY FOR ME ACT OF 2021 TO ALLOW NONHOSPITAL ENTITIES TO BE COMMUNITY BRIDGE ORGANIZATIONS.
ar:HB1403.summary: Lets nonhospital entities, as well as hospitals, administer community bridge organizations under the Arkansas Health and Opportunity for Me Act, if they meet conditions and criteria set by the Department of Human Services.

ar:HB1405.title: TO AMEND THE STATUTES CONCERNING PROCURERS; AND TO ADD ADDITIONAL REGULATIONS REGARDING THE USE OF A PROCURER BY A LICENSED CHIROPRACTIC PHYSICIAN.
ar:HB1405.summary: Bars chiropractors and their procurers from soliciting injured accident victims within 14 days of a motor vehicle accident without a prior relationship, limits what procurers may say when soliciting, and adds a $500 board fine and a private civil action for violations.

ar:HB1406.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF THE MILITARY REAPPROPRIATION.
ar:HB1406.summary: Carries forward unspent 2024 appropriations for the Department of the Military, including a machinegun range and readiness centers at Camp Joseph T. Robinson and Fort Chaffee, plus armory repairs, effective July 1, 2025.

ar:HB1407.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE STATE ADMINISTRATION OF JUSTICE FUND.
ar:HB1407.summary: Removes the Arkansas District Judges Council, Inc. from the recipients of State Administration of Justice Fund distributions, leaving the remaining listed state programs and agencies to receive monthly installments.

ar:HB1410.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING PROHIBITED ACTIVITIES BY PUBLIC SERVANTS.
ar:HB1410.summary: Bars public employees from knowingly giving advance notice of an inspection to evade detection or give the inspected party an unfair advantage, with discipline including suspension or termination. Exempts legally required scheduling disclosures, public safety notices and necessary official communications.

ar:HB1411.title: TO CLARIFY THE REGULATION OF CARBON CAPTURE AND SEQUESTRATION; AND TO ESTABLISH THE CARBON DIOXIDE STORAGE FUND.
ar:HB1411.summary: Specifies Oil and Gas Commission powers over underground carbon dioxide storage, sets fees (permit up to $50,000, $1,000 yearly per injection well, 10 cents per ton injected), and creates a Carbon Dioxide Storage Fund.

ar:HB1412.title: TO CLARIFY REGULATION OF PIPELINE SAFETY AUTHORIZATION FOR TRANSPORTATION OF HAZARDOUS LIQUIDS OR CARBON DIOXIDE.
ar:HB1412.summary: Authorizes the Oil and Gas Commission to seek state certification and adopt rules to take over federal safety standards and reporting for hazardous liquid and carbon dioxide pipelines, then enforce them.

ar:HB1413.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING BRINE PRODUCTION; AND TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE FORMATION OF BRINE PRODUCTION UNITS.
ar:HB1413.summary: Lets a brine production unit operator ask the Oil and Gas Commission to remove tracts from the unit, or transfer tracts to an adjacent unit, if listed well, drainage, ownership and royalty conditions are met.

ar:HB1414.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING CLAIMS FOR FIRE SERVICES; AND TO UPDATE THE SCHEDULE OF EQUIPMENT RATES USED IN CLAIMS FOR FIRE SERVICES.
ar:HB1414.summary: Requires boards setting fire service claims to use the current FEMA Schedule of Equipment Rates instead of the version in effect on January 1, 2013.

ar:HB1416.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING FIRE DEPARTMENTS; AND TO ALLOW A VOLUNTEER FIRE DEPARTMENT SERVICING UNINCORPORATED AREAS OF THE COUNTY TO LEVY DUES.
ar:HB1416.summary: Limits county collection of volunteer fire department dues to departments whose fire protection district covers an unincorporated area of the county, changing who may ask the quorum court to authorize a county official to collect and remit them.

ar:HB1417.title: TO DESIGNATE THE OFFICIAL DUCK OF THE STATE OF ARKANSAS.
ar:HB1417.summary: Designates the mallard as Arkansas's official state duck, without requiring agencies to reprint publications or giving the mallard protected status.

ar:HB1418.title: TO PROHIBIT LOCAL GOVERNMENT REGULATION OF KNIVES OR KNIFE-MAKING COMPONENTS.
ar:HB1418.summary: Bars cities, counties and other local governments from regulating the ownership, transfer, transport, carrying or possession of knives or knife-making components, adding them to the existing state preemption covering firearms, ammunition and firearm components.

ar:HB1422.title: TO CREATE THE ONLY CITIZENS VOTE ACT; TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE DRIVER'S LICENSES AND IDENTIFICATION CARDS OF CERTAIN NONCITIZENS; AND TO AMEND ARKANSAS CONSTITUTION, AMENDMENT 51, SECTION 13.
ar:HB1422.summary: Removes concealed handgun licenses, college employee badges and public assistance cards from accepted voter ID, and excludes noncitizen licenses. Requires monthly checks of noncitizen license holders against voter rolls, with matches cancelled and referred to the Attorney General for prosecution.

ar:HB1424.title: TO MANDATE COVERAGE FOR SEVERE OBESITY TREATMENTS.
ar:HB1424.summary: Requires Medicaid and, from January 1, 2026, other health plans to cover medically necessary treatment of severe obesity (BMI 40, or 35 with a comorbidity), including listed bariatric surgeries and related care, without requiring Medicaid to cover weight-loss drugs.

ar:HB1426.title: TO AMEND THE HEALTHCARE CONTRACTING SIMPLIFICATION ACT.
ar:HB1426.summary: Adds third-party administrators of self-insured plans to "healthcare insurer," bars enforcing policies with the effect of an all-products clause, extends the ban on leasing or selling provider networks to all contracting entities, and bars waiving these provisions by contract.

ar:HB1427.title: TO CREATE THE HEALTHY MOMS, HEALTHY BABIES ACT; AND TO AMEND ARKANSAS LAW TO IMPROVE MATERNAL HEALTH IN THIS STATE.
ar:HB1427.summary: Requires Medicaid to pay separately for prenatal, delivery and postpartum care, cover home blood pressure monitoring, remote ultrasounds and doula and community health worker home visits, and make presumptive eligibility decisions for pregnant women; sets a fifth-birthday deadline for childbirth-injury claims by minors.

ar:HB1428.title: TO AMEND THE LAW REGARDING PUBLIC LODGING; AND TO PROVIDE A BED HEIGHT REQUIREMENT FOR MOBILITY ACCESSIBLE ROOMS.
ar:HB1428.summary: Requires mobility accessible rooms in new lodging establishments to have a bed no more than 23 inches high, floor to top of mattress; existing establishments must comply only when the room is upgraded or reaches the end of its life cycle.

ar:HB1429.title: TO INCREASE ACCESSIBILITY WHILE ENSURING QUALITY FOR CERTAIN FACILITIES PERFORMING MAMMOGRAPHY SERVICES; AND TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE QUALITY STANDARDS FOR ACCREDITATION OF FACILITIES FOR MAMMOGRAPHY.
ar:HB1429.summary: Allows the interpreting physician for diagnostic mammography to be available by telecommunication instead of on site, requires a patient waiver and same-visit results, and directs the Department of Health to change its rules.

ar:HB1433.title: TO REQUIRE A LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICER WHO IS EXECUTING OR SERVING AN ORDER OF PROTECTION TO SERVE ANY OUTSTANDING CRIMINAL WARRANTS RELATED TO DOMESTIC VIOLENCE OR OFFENSES INVOLVING THE PETITIONER AS THE VICTIM.
ar:HB1433.summary: Requires law enforcement assisting in the execution or service of an order of protection to check for active arrest warrants for the person being served before serving the order.

ar:HB1437.title: TO PROHIBIT A PERSON REQUIRED TO REGISTER AS A SEX OFFENDER FROM ENTERING A WATER PARK, SWIMMING AREA, OR CHILDREN'S PLAYGROUND OF A PUBLIC PARK.
ar:HB1437.summary: Extends the bar on Level 3 and 4 registered sex offenders entering a swimming area or children's playground in state parks to all public parks, adds water parks, covers coming within 100 feet, and repeals the separate local water park ban.

ar:HB1439.title: TO REMOVE THE CERTIFICATION PROCESS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF HUMAN SERVICES FROM LICENSURE AS A PRIVATE CARE AGENCY.
ar:HB1439.summary: Defines a private care agency as one licensed by the Department of Health, instead of certified by the Division of Provider Services and Quality Assurance, limits it to agencies seeking Medicaid reimbursement for in-home care, and removes the regional-office requirement.

ar:HB1440.title: TO AMEND THE MASSAGE THERAPY ACT; AND TO ESTABLISH REGISTRATION FOR MASSAGE THERAPY ESTABLISHMENTS.
ar:HB1440.summary: Amends the Massage Therapy Act to require massage therapy establishments, such as clinics, spas and entities sending therapists to other locations, to register with the Department of Health.

ar:HB1441.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE ARKANSAS COORDINATE SYSTEM OF 1983.
ar:HB1441.summary: Renames the Arkansas Coordinate System 1983 the Arkansas Plane Coordinate System, defines it by reference to the National Geodetic Survey's State Plane Coordinate System and its successors, and repeals the statutory North and South zone definitions.

ar:HB1442.title: TO SET RESTRICTIONS ON PHARMACY CONTRACTING AND CONFLICTS OF INTEREST; AND TO ESTABLISH PHARMACEUTICAL PATIENT FREEDOM OF CHOICE.
ar:HB1442.summary: Bars hospitals and health centers that own pharmacies from financially steering patients to those pharmacies or limiting pharmacy networks, with Pharmacy Board exemptions, and gives patients freedom to choose their pharmacy.

ar:HB1444.title: TO AMEND THE SALES AND USE TAX EXEMPTION FOR DATA CENTERS.
ar:HB1444.summary: Amends the data center sales and use tax exemption: adds a qualified large data center category (at least $2 billion invested within ten years), sets qualified data centers at $500 million, and excludes facilities primarily engaged in virtual currency transactions.

ar:HB1447.title: TO EXEMPT A SEPTIC SYSTEM INSTALLER LICENSED UNDER THE ARKANSAS SEWAGE DISPOSAL SYSTEMS ACT FROM LICENSURE AS A PLUMBER.
ar:HB1447.summary: Exempts septic system installers licensed under the Sewage Disposal Systems Act from needing a plumber's license to install pipe from the stub-out to the septic tank.

ar:HB1449.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING REPORTS OF CONTRIBUTIONS FOR A CANDIDATE FOR STATE OR DISTRICT OFFICE; TO EXTEND THE DEADLINE FOR FINAL REPORTS; AND TO AMEND PORTIONS OF LAW RESULTING FROM INITIATED ACT 1 OF 1990.
ar:HB1449.summary: Extends the deadline for state and district candidates' final campaign finance report to 20 days after the end of the month following the election month, and conforms the monthly-report provision to it.

ar:HB1450.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING REPORTS BY THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE.
ar:HB1450.summary: Repeals annual report requirements for the State Plant Board, farm-to-school program, Buffalo River watershed plan, State Meat Inspection Program and commodity promotion boards, and changes the Agriculture Department's annual report to cover its activities and programs.

ar:HB1451.title: TO AMEND THE DEFINITION OF A STUDENT UNDER THE ARKANSAS CONCURRENT CHALLENGE SCHOLARSHIP PROGRAM.
ar:HB1451.summary: Adds ninth graders to the Arkansas Concurrent Challenge Scholarship Program, allowing up to $250,000 in total scholarship awards for grade nine students.

ar:HB1452.title: CLARIFYING THE LAW ON THE USE OF MEDICAL MARIJUANA IN CERTAIN PLACES; AND TO PROHIBIT THE POSSESSION OF AN UNSEALED CONTAINER OF CERTAIN FORMS OF MEDICAL MARIJUANA IN A MOTOR VEHICLE.
ar:HB1452.summary: Moves the ban on smoking or vaping medical marijuana in prohibited places into a new section listing them, such as school buses, public places and, for smoking, vehicles, and bars uncontained smokable medical marijuana within a driver's reach on public highways.

ar:HB1454.title: TO AMEND THE LAWS CONCERNING CRIMINAL HISTORY RECORDS CHECKS FOR EMPLOYEES OF SERVICE PROVIDERS; TO ALLOW THIRD-PARTY EMPLOYEE EVALUATION SERVICES TO PERFORM CRIMINAL HISTORY RECORDS CHECKS; AND TO INCLUDE INDEPENDENT CONTRACTORS.
ar:HB1454.summary: Extends criminal history check requirements for care service providers to independent contractors, and lets providers use an independent third-party evaluation service, rather than only the licensing or certifying agency, to determine eligibility.

ar:HB1455.title: TO AUTHORIZE CERTAIN PRIVATE CLUBS TO PURCHASE CERTAIN PRODUCTS DIRECTLY FROM A SMALL BREWERY PERMIT HOLDER UNDER AN EXCLUSIVE AGREEMENT.
ar:HB1455.summary: Allows private clubs in entertainment districts to buy alcoholic beverages brewed by a small brewery permit holder in an adjacent county under an exclusive one-club agreement, and removes the requirement that club drinks come from members' private stocks.

ar:HB1456.title: TO AMEND THE STATE KIDNEY DISEASE COMMISSION TO BE AN ADVISORY COUNCIL TO THE DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH.
ar:HB1456.summary: Turns the State Kidney Disease Commission into an advisory council to the Department of Health, cutting membership from ten to seven and shifting appointment from the Governor with Senate confirmation to the State Board of Health.

ar:HB1458.title: TO AMEND THE DEFINITION OF "CREDENTIALING INFORMATION" WHEN THE ARKANSAS STATE MEDICAL BOARD IS PROVIDING INFORMATION TO CREDENTIALING ORGANIZATIONS.
ar:HB1458.summary: Removes the status of a physician's U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration certificate from the credentialing information the Arkansas State Medical Board may give to credentialing organizations.

ar:HB1460.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING APPOINTMENTS TO CERTAIN BOARDS, COMMISSIONS, AND COUNCILS BASED ON CONGRESSIONAL DISTRICT.
ar:HB1460.summary: Changes the congressional-district residency rule for members of four state boards and commissions so that districts are measured as they exist at the time of appointment, not as of earlier fixed dates.

ar:HB1465.title: CONCERNING DIRTBIKE USE ON PRIVATE PROPERTY; AND TO ESTABLISH THE LIABILITY OF AN OWNER OF PRIVATE PROPERTY.
ar:HB1465.summary: Provides that people who ride dirtbikes on private property assume the inherent risks, and owners of that property are not liable for resulting injury or death, except for intentional harm, gross negligence, unsafe bikes provided, or failure to use ordinary care.

ar:HB1466.title: TO AMEND THE FAIR MORTGAGE LENDING ACT.
ar:HB1466.summary: Changes the Fair Mortgage Lending Act to set net worth, capital, liquidity, governance and audit standards for mortgage servicers, add surety bond terms and information-security requirements, and let the Securities Commissioner waive or temporarily suspend certain requirements.

ar:HB1467.title: TO AMEND THE UNIFORM MONEY SERVICES ACT.
ar:HB1467.summary: Adds rules to the Uniform Money Services Act for virtual currency kiosks: risk and transaction disclosures, daily limits of $2,000 for new and $7,500 for existing customers, refunds of fraudulent transactions for new customers, calls with new elder customers, and a fraud warning.

ar:HB1468.title: TO AMEND ARKANSAS LAW CONCERNING CLAIMS AGAINST HOME IMPROVEMENT CONTRACTORS, RESIDENTIAL BUILDING CONTRACTORS, AND SUPPLIERS.
ar:HB1468.summary: Requires a dwelling's owner or tenant to give a contractor or window or door supplier 28 days' written notice of a construction defect found within one year of completion, and a chance to repair it, before suing; the contractor must respond within 14 days.

ar:HB1471.title: TO AMEND THE EXPIRATION DATE OF ALL LICENSES OF THE BOARD OF EXAMINERS IN SPEECH-LANGUAGE PATHOLOGY AND AUDIOLOGY.
ar:HB1471.summary: Removes the June 30 expiration date for speech-language pathology and audiology licenses, keeping annual renewal, and moves the no-late-fee renewal window from July 15 to 15 days after the expiration date.

ar:HB1474.title: CONCERNING THE PREVENTION OF HUMAN TRAFFICKING; AND TO REQUIRE THE DISPLAY OF INFORMATION ABOUT THE NATIONAL HUMAN TRAFFICKING HOTLINE.
ar:HB1474.summary: Changes the list of establishments required to post National Human Trafficking Hotline information: adds nail salons and massage businesses licensed by the Department of Health and removes abortion facilities. Posters must also go in restrooms.

ar:HB1475.title: TO AUTHORIZE THE USE OF GREEN LIGHTS; TO AMEND THE RESTRICTIONS ON LAMP COLORS; TO AMEND THE COLORS OF LIGHTS THAT MAY BE USED BY EMERGENCY VEHICLES; AND TO DEFINE A ROADWAY CONSTRUCTION OR MAINTENANCE VEHICLE.
ar:HB1475.summary: Lets roadway construction and maintenance vehicles use green flashing or rotating lights along with amber and white, and exempts them from the ban on green lights visible from the front; they are not emergency vehicles unless so designated.

ar:HB1476.title: TO AMEND THE DIRECT SHIPMENT OF VINOUS LIQUOR ACT; AND TO ESTABLISH A WINE DIRECT SHIPPER LICENSE.
ar:HB1476.summary: Replaces winery registration with a wine direct shipper license, with a $50 application fee and $25 annual renewal, for wineries, suppliers and importers shipping wine directly to consumers in wet counties.

ar:HB1477.title: TO ALLOW THE GOVERNING BODY OF AN OPEN-ENROLLMENT PUBLIC CHARTER SCHOOL TO SUBMIT AN APPLICANT FOR CONSIDERATION FOR THE ARKANSAS TEACHER OF THE YEAR.
ar:HB1477.summary: Adds open-enrollment public charter schools to the Arkansas Teacher of the Year process, letting each submit one applicant by April 1 with paid-leave and reimbursement duties like school districts, and removes the limit of sixteen finalists.

ar:HB1478.title: TO REPEAL THE REGISTRATION OF DISEASE INTERVENTION SPECIALISTS.
ar:HB1478.summary: Repeals the state's registration of disease intervention specialists (Arkansas Code Title 17, Chapter 98).

ar:HB1479.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING SCRIVENER'S AFFIDAVITS; AND TO ALLOW A LICENSED ENGINEER, SURVEYOR, OR NOTARY PUBLIC TO EXECUTE AND RECORD A SCRIVENER'S AFFIDAVIT IN CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES.
ar:HB1479.summary: Lets a licensed engineer or surveyor who prepared a survey or plat, or a notary who witnessed an instrument containing an error, execute and record a scrivener's affidavit to correct it.

ar:HB1483.title: TO ALLOW A PUBLIC SCHOOL DISTRICT TO USE STATE FUNDS TO PAY FOR AN ADULT EDUCATION PROGRAM WITH WHICH IT CONTRACTS.
ar:HB1483.summary: Allows a public school district to use state funds, including foundation funding aid, to pay an adult education program such as GED that it contracts with to serve 16- and 17-year-old students.

ar:HB1484.title: TO LIMIT THE NUMBER OF CREDITS A STUDENT MAY OBTAIN IN A COURSE CREDIT RECOVERY PROGRAM.
ar:HB1484.summary: Limits a high school student to 10 total credits earned through course credit recovery programs in grades 9-12, starting with the 2025-26 ninth-grade class, with exceptions for students in foster care, with an IEP, homeless, pregnant, and others.

ar:HB1485.title: TO CREATE A SALES AND USE TAX EXEMPTION FOR SALES TO CERTAIN ORGANIZATIONS THAT SUPPORT VETERANS' FACILITIES.
ar:HB1485.summary: Exempts from sales and use tax sales to the Arkansas Veterans Cemetery Foundation and to qualifying nonprofits that support state veterans' cemeteries, veterans' homes, or Department of Veterans Affairs facilities.

ar:HB1486.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE MARKET VALUE OF CERTAIN SURPLUS PROPERTY ACQUIRED BY THE STATE HIGHWAY COMMISSION.
ar:HB1486.summary: Reduces from three to two the number of appraisers required to set the market value when the State Highway Commission sells back a surplus remnant of right-of-way.

ar:HB1487.title: TO AMEND THE NUMBER OF COMMISSIONERS ON THE ARKANSAS FORESTRY COMMISSION'S COMMITTEE.
ar:HB1487.summary: Sets the Arkansas Forestry Commission's advisory committee as three of the commission's registered forester members, the University of Arkansas at Monticello representative, and at least three registered foresters appointed by the chair who are not commission members.

ar:HB1488.title: TO AMEND THE STANDARD NONFORFEITURE LAW FOR LIFE INSURANCE; AND TO REQUIRE AN INSURER TO PAY INTEREST ON DEFERRED PAYMENT OF ANY CASH SURRENDER VALUE UNDER CERTAIN POLICIES.
ar:HB1488.summary: Requires life insurers that defer paying a policy's cash surrender value to keep the death benefit in force, and to pay interest at the Wall Street Journal prime rate if payment is not made within 30 days of the surrender demand.

ar:HB1489.title: TO AMEND THE METHOD OF EXECUTION TO INCLUDE NITROGEN GAS.
ar:HB1489.summary: Adds nitrogen gas as a method of execution alongside lethal injection in Arkansas, with the Division of Correction director notifying the condemned prisoner in writing of the method within seven days of receiving the Governor's execution warrant.

ar:HB1491.title: CONCERNING THE EXCISE TAX ON CERTAIN BEER AND SAKE; TO CREATE AN EXCISE TAX CREDIT FOR CERTAIN BEER AND SAKE PRODUCED USING ARKANSAS RICE; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.
ar:HB1491.summary: Creates an excise tax credit for beer and sake made with at least 20% Arkansas rice by weight of the grain, equal to the rice percentage multiplied by the excise tax due.

ar:HB1493.title: AN ACT FOR THE INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT APPROPRIATION.
ar:HB1493.summary: Appropriates money from the Development and Enhancement Fund to 22 two-year colleges for construction, renovation, maintenance, technology, and equipment and library holdings.

ar:HB1495.title: CONCERNING THE TRANSFER OF A STUDENT'S PERMANENT SCHOOL RECORD.
ar:HB1495.summary: Requires a student's permanent school record, including discipline such as suspensions and expulsions, to transfer with the student, and requires receiving schools to obtain it before accepting a student who was expelled or faces expulsion.

ar:HB1496.title: TO AMEND PROVISIONS OF THE ARKANSAS CODE TO ENSURE ARKANSAS STUDENTS ARE TAUGHT BY QUALIFIED TEACHERS.
ar:HB1496.summary: Limits teaching assignments to licensed subjects or a division-approved licensure plan (initially up to three years, one extension of up to two), replacing the list of permit exceptions, and removes professional-development credit for graduate courses and AP training.

ar:HB1497.title: TO ADD THE DEPARTMENT OF THE MILITARY TO THE LIST OF CLAIMANT AGENCIES FOR PURPOSES OF THE SETOFF AGAINST STATE TAX REFUNDS; AND TO AMEND THE DEFINITION OF "DEBT" FOR PURPOSES OF THE SETOFF AGAINST STATE TAX REFUNDS.
ar:HB1497.summary: Adds the Department of the Military to the agencies that can claim state tax refunds to collect debts, and adds fines under certain military code sections as collectible debts.

ar:HB1498.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING MILITARY-TYPE CANTEENS AND EXCHANGES.
ar:HB1498.summary: Lets the Adjutant General contract with military-focused nonprofits to buy canteen inventory, applies the canteen funds and post-exchange agreement provisions to all National Guard military properties instead of two named training centers, and deletes the car-rental contracting provision.

ar:HB1499.title: TO AMEND THE SALE AND PURCHASE PROCEDURE FOR PUBLIC PROPERTY.
ar:HB1499.summary: Requires state agencies to get Building Authority Division approval of a land sale or purchase proposal before an appraisal, then submit the appraisal to it for assessment. Agencies consult that division, not the Economic Development Commission's database, before buying property.

ar:HB1502.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE REGISTRATION AND LICENSING OF A HISTORIC OR SPECIAL INTEREST VEHICLE; AND TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING ANTIQUE MOTOR VEHICLE SPECIAL LICENSE PLATES.
ar:HB1502.summary: Lowers from 45 to 30 years the vehicle age required to register as a historic or special interest vehicle, and likewise for reproduction vehicles and antique license plates.

ar:HB1503.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING MUNICIPAL REGULATIONS; AND TO PROHIBIT CERTAIN RESTRICTIONS ON THE REGULATION OF ACCESSORY DWELLING UNITS.
ar:HB1503.summary: Bars cities from restricting at least one accessory dwelling unit by right on a lot with a single-family home, capped at 75% of the home's floor area or 1,000 square feet, and limits parking, owner-occupancy and impact fee requirements.

ar:HB1504.title: TO CREATE THE OFFENSE OF MANUFACTURING, MODIFYING, SELLING, TRANSFERRING, OR OPERATING A ROBOTIC DEVICE OR AN UNCREWED AIRCRAFT THAT IS EQUIPPED OR MOUNTED WITH A WEAPON.
ar:HB1504.summary: Makes it a violation, with a fine of $5,000 to $25,000, to knowingly make, modify, sell, transfer or operate a ground robotic device or uncrewed aircraft equipped with a weapon, or to reprogram a robot to harm people or property.

ar:HB1505.title: TO REQUIRE A PUBLIC EMPLOYER TO OFFER AND PROVIDE COVERAGE FOR LICENSED COUNSELING FOR A PUBLIC SAFETY EMPLOYEE WHO HAS EXPERIENCED A TRAUMATIC EVENT; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:HB1505.summary: Requires public employers to cover licensed counseling for police officers, firefighters and other public safety employees after a traumatic event, up to 12 visits a year (18 with carryover), with the employee choosing the provider.

ar:HB1507.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING ENVIRONMENTAL, SOCIAL JUSTICE, OR GOVERNANCE SCORES; AND TO CLARIFY THE EXEMPTIONS FROM DIVESTMENT FOR CERTAIN INVESTMENTS.
ar:HB1507.summary: Extends the divestment exemption for investments locked into a maturity date, where early sale would bring a penalty and negative financial impact, to investments of a public entity as well as the state.

ar:HB1508.title: TO RECODIFY TITLE 19 OF THE ARKANSAS CODE CONCERNING PUBLIC FINANCE; AND TO AMEND LAWS RESULTING FROM INITIATED ACTS 2000, NO. 1; AND TO MAKE CONFORMING CHANGES TO THE ARKANSAS CODE.
ar:HB1508.summary: Repeals and recodifies Arkansas Code Title 19 on public finance, which the bill says makes only technical changes, keeping the Tobacco Settlement Proceeds Act, a cash-fund exemption section and the Title 19 appendix.

ar:HB1510.title: TO REPEAL THE AUTHORITY FOR A MUNICIPALITY TO EXERCISE TERRITORIAL JURISDICTION OVER AN UNINCORPORATED AREA OF A COUNTY.
ar:HB1510.summary: Repeals the authority of cities of 8,000 or more to enforce planning ordinances one to three miles beyond their limits, and repeals related annexation and platting provisions for that territorial jurisdiction.

ar:HB1512.title: TO CREATE THE ARKANSAS ACCESS ACT; AND TO AMEND VARIOUS PROVISIONS OF THE ARKANSAS CODE AS THEY RELATE TO EDUCATION IN THE STATE OF ARKANSAS.
ar:HB1512.summary: Creates the Arkansas ACCESS Act, rewriting or repealing many education laws. Bars public colleges from compelling people to affirm specified beliefs or treating students differently by race, sex or ethnicity; creates a direct admissions program and an Arkansas Heroes Scholarship.

ar:HB1514.title: TO AMEND THE UNIFORM ATTENDANCE AND LEAVE POLICY ACT; AND TO AMEND THE DEFINITION OF A "CRITICAL-NEED EMPLOYEE".
ar:HB1514.summary: Adds the Department of the Military to the state agencies whose round-the-clock employees count as critical-need employees under the state attendance and leave policy.

ar:HB1515.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE AUTHORITY TO ORDER THE ARKANSAS NATIONAL GUARD INTO SERVICE; AND TO AUTHORIZE THE USE OF THE ARKANSAS NATIONAL GUARD FOR MATTERS RELATED TO MILITARY JUSTICE AND TO ADDRESS STAFFING SHORTAGES.
ar:HB1515.summary: Lets the Adjutant General, with the Governor's approval, order National Guard members into state active duty for military-justice proceedings when federal Title 32 duty orders are unavailable, and for voluntary support addressing critical staffing shortages in security and essential military operations.

ar:HB1516.title: TO AMEND VARIOUS LAWS CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE.
ar:HB1516.summary: Replaces the State Forestry Fund with a Department of Agriculture Law Enforcement Fund for forestry-law fines, sets a fine up to $300 for ignoring animal disease rules, and lets the secretary award a retiring or deceased officer's pistol to the officer or eligible spouse.

ar:HB1517.title: TO ESTABLISH THE EARNED WAGE ACCESS SERVICES ACT.
ar:HB1517.summary: Creates the Earned Wage Access Services Act, setting rules for providers that advance earned but unpaid wages, including fee disclosure, a no-cost option and no cancellation fee, in exchange for not being treated as lenders or money transmitters.

ar:HB1519.title: TO ALLOW THE SECRETARY OF THE DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE TO PARTICIPATE IN THE HIRING AND CONTRACTING OF EMPLOYEES FOR THE STATE INSURANCE DEPARTMENT, STATE BANK DEPARTMENT, AND STATE SECURITIES DEPARTMENT.
ar:HB1519.summary: Limits the requirement that the Secretary of Commerce delegate hiring to the Insurance, Bank and Securities Commissioners to the extent needed to comply with state or federal law, and adds an exception to the secretary's authority to serve as head of department agencies.

ar:HB1522.title: TO AMEND THE LAW TO ALLOW FOR THE DISTRIBUTION OF FUNDS IN THE MUNICIPAL AID FUND, TURNBACK FUNDS, AND COUNTY SALES AND USE TAX REVENUES TO NEWLY INCORPORATED MUNICIPALITIES; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:HB1522.summary: Requires the state GIS Office to calculate the population of any newly incorporated municipality from the latest decennial census until new census data is available, not only in census years, for municipal aid, local sales tax and highway revenue distribution. Takes effect immediately.

ar:HB1523.title: CONCERNING MISSING PERSONS ALERTS; TO CODIFY THE ARKANSAS AMBER ALERT SYSTEM; TO CODIFY THE ARKANSAS SILVER ALERT SYSTEM; AND TO CREATE THE MISSING ENDANGERED ADULT ADVISORY SYSTEM.
ar:HB1523.summary: Creates in law the Arkansas Amber Alert System for abducted children, the Silver Alert System for missing seniors and adults with cognitive disorders, and an advisory system for missing adults with certain disabilities, all coordinated by the Arkansas State Police.

ar:HB1524.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE BIDDING PROCEDURE FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF BUILDINGS AND FACILITIES.
ar:HB1524.summary: Exempts state parks repair, alteration or maintenance projects of $150,000 or less, funded by Amendment 75 tax revenue, from state building plan and specification requirements.

ar:HB1525.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING REAL PROPERTY; AND TO ADDRESS AGRICULTURAL IMPACT REMEDIATION AGREEMENTS.
ar:HB1525.summary: Requires commercial wind and solar facility owners to sign an agreement with the landowner before building on agricultural land, setting construction and removal standards and a deconstruction plan, with a copy to the Department of Agriculture 45 days before notice to proceed.

ar:HB1526.title: TO AUTHORIZE THE DEPARTMENT OF THE MILITARY TO ENTER INTO PUBLIC-PRIVATE PARTNERSHIPS; AND TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING GIFTS RECEIVED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF THE MILITARY.
ar:HB1526.summary: Allows the Department of the Military to enter public-private partnerships and accept volunteer services and property from private entities to support National Guard recruiting and retention, under rules and Legislative Council review.

ar:HB1527.title: TO AMEND THE PERMISSIBLE INVESTMENTS A GUARDIAN OF THE ESTATE MAY MAKE ON BEHALF OF A WARD.
ar:HB1527.summary: Adds the Arkansas Brighter Future Fund Plan to the investments a guardian of an estate may make for a ward without a court order.

ar:HB1531.title: TO PROHIBIT PHARMACEUTICAL MANUFACTURERS FROM RESTRICTING OR LIMITING PRESCRIPTION MEDICATIONS TO A LIMITED DISTRIBUTION NETWORK OF OUT-OF-STATE PHARMACIES.
ar:HB1531.summary: Bars drug makers seeking state and public plan coverage from limiting a new drug to a restricted pharmacy network for more than three months after launch unless in-state pharmacies, including local independents, can also get access; requires a wholesale distributor permit.

ar:HB1534.title: TO INCREASE THE HOMESTEAD PROPERTY TAX CREDIT.
ar:HB1534.summary: Raises the homestead property tax credit from $500 to $600, for assessment years beginning on or after January 1, 2025.

ar:HB1536.title: TO WITHHOLD STATE TRANSPORTATION FUNDING FROM A SCHOOL DISTRICT THAT DOES NOT REQUIRE PASSENGER RESTRAINT SYSTEMS IN SCHOOL BUSES UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS.
ar:HB1536.summary: As introduced, withholds a school district's state transportation funding until it either puts a bus passenger restraint proposal on the next school election ballot or buys, installs and maintains restraint systems on newly purchased buses.

ar:HB1537.title: TO REPEAL THE LOCATION ACT FOR COMMUNITY HOMES FOR INDIVIDUALS WITH INTELLECTUAL AND DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES.
ar:HB1537.summary: Repeals Arkansas's Location Act for Community Homes for Individuals with Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities, and removes its reference in the child welfare agency licensing law.

ar:HB1543.title: TO ESTABLISH THE WORKFORCE EXPERIENCE OPPORTUNITIES ACT OF 2025.
ar:HB1543.summary: Requires state-funded entities with a public physical address to accept SNAP recipients who volunteer there to meet work requirements and to certify their physical presence to the monitoring agency, from January 1, 2026, with exemptions.

ar:HB1544.title: AN ACT TO MAKE AN APPROPRIATION FOR STATE TURNBACK FOR COUNTIES AND MUNICIPALITIES BY THE OFFICE OF THE TREASURER OF STATE SUPPLEMENTAL APPROPRIATION.
ar:HB1544.summary: Appropriates $25 million from the Property Tax Relief Trust Fund to the Treasurer of State for distribution to counties as property tax relief, supplemental to the 2024-2025 fiscal year appropriation.

ar:HB1545.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS MILITARY CHILD SCHOOL TRANSITIONS ACT OF 2021.
ar:HB1545.summary: Amends the Arkansas Military Child School Transitions Act to remove the one-year limit for children of Gold Star and medically separated or retired families, let schools apply it to all enrolling students, and provide for a Purple Star School Program.

ar:HB1546.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF CORRECTIONS - DIVISION OF CORRECTION SUPPLEMENTAL APPROPRIATION.
ar:HB1546.summary: Appropriates $19.5 million for Department of Corrections medical contracts and $6.5 million for county jail reimbursement for state inmates, supplemental to existing 2024-2025 fiscal year appropriations.

ar:HB1548.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE DIVISION OF INFORMATION SYSTEMS; AND TO ABOLISH THE DATA AND TRANSPARENCY PANEL.
ar:HB1548.summary: Repeals the Data and Transparency Panel and sets duties for the Division of Information Systems' statewide data program, including a longitudinal data system, a shared data hub, access and privacy policies, a public data portal and agency data stewards.

ar:HB1549.title: TO CREATE THE ARKANSAS CYBERSECURITY ACT OF 2025.
ar:HB1549.summary: Creates the Arkansas Cybersecurity Act of 2025, giving a State Cybersecurity Office power to set statewide cybersecurity standards and audit agency compliance, with agency cybersecurity staff functionally reporting to it and closed reports to a legislative committee at least twice yearly.

ar:HB1551.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING CRIMINAL ABORTION; AND TO CREATE THE OFFENSE OF COERCED CRIMINAL ABORTION BY MEANS OF FRAUD.
ar:HB1551.summary: Creates the Class B felony of coerced criminal abortion by fraud: knowingly giving a pregnant woman an abortion-inducing drug without her knowledge or consent, with the purpose of causing an abortion.

ar:HB1552.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING CERTAIN INCHOATE OFFENSES RELATED TO FENTANYL; AND TO ESTABLISH THE CLASSIFICATION FOR A CRIMINAL ATTEMPT, SOLICITATION, OR CONSPIRACY FOR CERTAIN FENTANYL RELATED OFFENSES.
ar:HB1552.summary: Makes attempt, solicitation or conspiracy to commit aggravated death by delivery, predatory marketing of fentanyl to minors, or fentanyl trafficking a Class Y felony.

ar:HB1555.title: TO ESTABLISH UNIFORM PROCEDURES FOR FILLING A VACANCY IN A MUNICIPAL OFFICE.
ar:HB1555.summary: Sets one process for municipal vacancies: at its first meeting after the vacancy, the governing body elects a replacement or calls a special election, and a mayor cannot veto an appointment.

ar:HB1556.title: TO AMEND ARKANSAS MUSIC APPRECIATION DAY; AND TO CHANGE THE DATE ON WHICH ARKANSAS MUSIC APPRECIATION DAY IS CELEBRATED.
ar:HB1556.summary: Moves Arkansas Music Appreciation Day from September 1 to March 1 each year, and changes the date for the Governor's annual proclamation to match.

ar:HB1557.title: TO AMEND THE DUTIES AND POWERS OF THE DIVISION OF INFORMATION SYSTEMS CONCERNING INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY.
ar:HB1557.summary: Redefines "information technology" for the Division of Information Systems, requires a unified biennial statewide IT plan, sets division duties including statewide minimum IT standards, and bars state agencies from IT purchases or custom software without the director's approval, except low-cost listed items.

ar:HB1558.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE ARKANSAS REAL ESTATE COMMISSION; TO CREATE A PROPERTY MANAGEMENT BROKER AND PROPERTY MANAGEMENT ASSOCIATE LICENSE; AND TO AMEND THE REAL ESTATE LICENSE LAW.
ar:HB1558.summary: Creates property management broker and property management associate licenses under the Arkansas Real Estate Commission, separate from real estate broker licenses.

ar:HB1559.title: TO REQUIRE THE DEPARTMENT OF HUMAN SERVICES TO SEEK A WAIVER TO THE ARKANSAS MEDICAID PROGRAM FOR COVERAGE FOR INPATIENT TREATMENT SERVICES FOR SUBSTANCE USE DISORDERS.
ar:HB1559.summary: Requires the Department of Human Services to seek a federal Section 1115 Medicaid waiver covering inpatient substance use disorder treatment in institutions for mental diseases, including expanded opioid medication-assisted treatment and intensive outpatient services, and to report annually to the legislature.

ar:HB1560.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING PUBLIC WORKS CONTRACTS; AND TO REQUIRE PRICING INFORMATION FOR LIGHTING COMPONENTS FOR PUBLIC WORKS PROJECTS.
ar:HB1560.summary: Bars the state, counties, cities and school districts from contracting for a project designed by an electrical engineering firm unless the design allows three-bid specification by three separate lighting agencies. Exempts municipal electric utilities; permits specialty-fixture exceptions.

ar:HB1561.title: TO ESTABLISH THE RESEARCH AND EDUCATION PROTECTION ACT OF 2025.
ar:HB1561.summary: Creates the Research and Education Protection Act of 2025: higher education institutions must disclose gifts and contracts of $250,000 or more from foreign adversaries, and governing boards decide within 30 days on future ones, rejecting them absent an overwhelming state or national interest.

ar:HB1562.title: CONCERNING THE TERMINATION OF AN ORAL LEASE OF FARMLANDS; AND TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING NOTICE OF TERMINATION.
ar:HB1562.summary: Lets a farmland owner end an oral lease for the next calendar year by giving the tenant written notice by any service method allowed under Arkansas civil procedure Rule 4 by June 30, instead of only by certified mail.

ar:HB1563.title: TO ADD A FELONY OFFENSE THAT FALLS UNDER THE DEFINITION OF RESTRICTED RELEASE FELONY WITH RESPECT TO RELEASE ELIGIBILITY AND PROCEDURES FOR OFFENSES COMMITTED ON OR AFTER JANUARY 1, 2025.
ar:HB1563.summary: Adds knowingly exposing another person to fentanyl in the first degree to the list of "restricted release felonies," which have their own release eligibility rules, for offenses committed on or after January 1, 2025.

ar:HB1568.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING EXAMINATIONS, INVESTIGATIONS, AND POSTMORTEM EXAMINATIONS; AND TO AMEND THE LAW REQUIRING A POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION WHEN A DEATH IS BY APPARENT DRUG, ALCOHOL, OR POISON TOXICITY.
ar:HB1568.summary: Removes the "significant interval" requirement from the exception to sending apparent drug, alcohol or poison toxicity deaths to the State Crime Laboratory for postmortem exam; defines "hospitalized" as admitted for inpatient treatment.

ar:HB1571.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS ADULT DIPLOMA PROGRAM ACT.
ar:HB1571.summary: Sets Adult Diploma Program payments to providers at $250 per half high-school credit, employability certification or short workforce credential, $500 or $750 for longer credentials, and $1,000 per diploma; requires improvement plans from providers on probation.

ar:HB1572.title: TO CREATE A TECHNICAL FEASIBILITY STUDY ON NEW NUCLEAR ENERGY GENERATION; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:HB1572.summary: Directs the Department of Energy and Environment to hire an outside consulting firm within 60 days of funding to conduct a technical feasibility study on new nuclear energy generation in Arkansas.

ar:HB1574.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING PAID CANVASSERS; AND TO REQUIRE DOMICILE IN ARKANSAS.
ar:HB1574.summary: Bars anyone who is not an Arkansas resident (and domiciled in the state, for statewide petitions) from working as a paid petition canvasser, and fines sponsors or their agents $2,500 for each canvasser they knowingly hire in violation.

ar:HB1575.title: TO PROHIBIT A PERSON THAT IS EMPLOYED OR HAS A DIRECT OR INDIRECT INTEREST IN AN ORGANIZATION THAT OWNS, OPERATES, REPRESENTS, OR APPLIES FOR A SOLID WASTE LICENSE OR PERMIT FROM SERVING AS A MEMBER ON CERTAIN BOARDS.
ar:HB1575.summary: Bars members of the Pollution Control and Ecology Commission and regional solid waste boards from working for, or holding a financial interest in, a firm that owns, operates, represents or seeks a solid waste permit; required city and county representatives on regional boards are exempt.

ar:HB1576.title: TO PROHIBIT A SOLID WASTE LANDFILL TO BE PLACED OVER A KARST TOPOGRAPHY.
ar:HB1576.summary: Makes it illegal to build or operate a solid waste landfill that did not exist when the act took effect in the outcrop area of geologic formations, including karst topography. Exempts transfer stations, recycling and composting facilities.

ar:HB1579.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING SEX OFFENDER REASSESSMENT; AND TO PROHIBIT AN INCARCERATED PERSON FROM BEING ELIGIBLE FOR RISK LEVEL REASSESSMENT.
ar:HB1579.summary: Makes an incarcerated sex offender ineligible to request a risk level reassessment until released from incarceration.

ar:HB1580.title: TO REQUIRE SCHOOLS TO PROVIDE CERTAIN INFORMATION ON TYPE 1 AND TYPE 2 DIABETES WHEN OTHER HEALTH INFORMATION IS PROVIDED.
ar:HB1580.summary: Requires school districts that send parents health information on immunizations, infectious diseases or medications to also include information on Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes, including risk factors, warning signs and screening.

ar:HB1581.title: TO ADD TRAFFICKING OF PERSONS TO THE LIST OF OFFENSES INCLUDED IN THE DEFINITION OF SEX OFFENSE FOR RIGHTS OF VICTIMS OF A CRIME.
ar:HB1581.summary: Adds trafficking of persons and grooming a minor for future sex trafficking to the offenses counted as "sex offenses" under the crime victims' rights law.

ar:HB1582.title: TO REQUIRE CERTAIN ACTIONS AND ENCOURAGE CERTAIN ACTIONS FOR AN INDIVIDUAL TO BE ELIGIBLE FOR BENEFITS UNDER THE DIVISION OF WORKFORCE SERVICES LAW.
ar:HB1582.summary: Requires unemployment claimants to create a state job board account and report their five weekly work search contacts. The board matches claimants to open jobs whose requirements they meet at least 75 percent, and claimants are encouraged to apply. Takes effect January 1, 2026.

ar:HB1583.title: TO MANDATE COVERAGE FOR ACQUIRED BRAIN INJURY.
ar:HB1583.summary: Requires health plans to cover medically necessary treatment for acquired brain injury starting January 1, 2026, including cognitive rehabilitation, inpatient, outpatient and residential services, with no lifetime limit or unreasonable annual limits.

ar:HB1585.title: TO PROVIDE AN EXCEPTION FROM LICENSURE AS A HOME HEALTHCARE SERVICE TO AN ENTITY THAT SOLELY PROVIDES THERAPY SERVICES THAT ARE NOT REIMBURSED BY MEDICARE PART A.
ar:HB1585.summary: Exempts entities that solely provide therapy services not reimbursed by Medicare Part A, using licensed professionals, from home healthcare service licensure.

ar:HB1586.title: TO AMEND THE MEDICAID WAIVER FOR AUTISM SPECTRUM DISORDER TO CLARIFY THE NUMBER AND TYPE OF QUALIFIED PROFESSIONALS TO DIAGNOSE AUTISM SPECTRUM DISORDER.
ar:HB1586.summary: Requires the two professionals who diagnose autism spectrum disorder for the Medicaid waiver to be of different types from the list of qualified professionals, and for each to conclude that a child fully meets the diagnostic criteria.

ar:HB1587.title: CONCERNING THE ANY WILLING PROVIDER LAWS; AND TO AMEND THE PATIENT PROTECTION ACT OF 1995.
ar:HB1587.summary: Adds pharmacies to the definition of "healthcare provider" under the Patient Protection Act of 1995 and the any-willing-provider laws, alongside pharmacists.

ar:HB1589.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE FINANCIAL OPERATIONS OF A COUNTY; AND TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE ANNUAL COUNTY FINANCIAL REPORT.
ar:HB1589.summary: Revises county financial rules: replaces "moneys" with "revenues," drops warrants in favor of checks, and requires the annual county financial report to be a statement of revenues, expenditures and fund-balance changes for each fund.

ar:HB1590.title: TO COMBINE THE OFFICES OF TREASURER AND TAX COLLECTOR IN WOODRUFF COUNTY.
ar:HB1590.summary: Combines the offices of treasurer and tax collector in Woodruff County into one office on January 1, 2027, filled by a single official elected in the 2026 general election.

ar:HB1591.title: TO COMBINE THE OFFICES OF TREASURER AND TAX COLLECTOR IN ARKANSAS COUNTY.
ar:HB1591.summary: Merges the offices of county treasurer and tax collector in Arkansas County into one elected office starting January 1, 2027, with the officer chosen at the 2026 general election.

ar:HB1593.title: CONCERNING THE REPORTS MADE TO THE GOVERNOR AND THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY BY THE BOARD OF CORRECTIONS, DIVISION OF CORRECTION, AND DIVISION OF COMMUNITY CORRECTION; AND TO COMBINE REPORTING REQUIREMENTS.
ar:HB1593.summary: Requires the Board of Corrections to report annually, instead of every two years, on both the Division of Correction and the Division of Community Correction, including inmate discipline, programming, bed space and sentencing numbers by offense class and race.

ar:HB1594.title: TO CREATE A FARMER SALES TAX IDENTIFICATION CARD; AND TO RELIEVE A SELLER OF SALES TAX REMITTANCE LIABILITY UPON GOOD FAITH ACCEPTANCE OF A FARMER SALES TAX IDENTIFICATION CARD.
ar:HB1594.summary: Requires the Secretary of Finance and Administration to issue eight-year farmer sales tax identification cards ($20 fee, $10 renewal) to eligible farmers, which sellers may accept in place of exemption certificates, with the same seller liability relief, effective January 1, 2026.

ar:HB1595.title: TO ENACT THE STATE INSURANCE DEPARTMENT'S GENERAL OMNIBUS AMENDMENT OF ARKANSAS INSURANCE CODE.
ar:HB1595.summary: Drops the Arkansas-office requirement for the workers' compensation plan administrator, extends hospital and medical service corporation examinations from every three to five years, applies the attorney-bond rule to foreign reciprocal insurers, and repeals the Comprehensive Health Insurance Pool Act.

ar:HB1596.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING MOVING TRAFFIC VIOLATIONS IN A HIGHWAY WORK ZONE; TO CREATE MOBILE WORK ZONES; AND ASSESS A FINE FOR A MOVING TRAFFIC VIOLATION IN A MOBILE WORK ZONE.
ar:HB1596.summary: Extends the doubled fine for moving violations in highway work zones to mobile work zones, makes the doubled fine discretionary for the judge, and bars it in a mobile zone unless warning signs are on the work equipment.

ar:HB1597.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE ADMINISTRATION OF THE OATH OF OFFICE.
ar:HB1597.summary: Adds federal justices and judges to those who may swear in municipal officers, the Governor and other officers, and adds former circuit, chancery, municipal and district judges with four years' service for municipal and other officers.

ar:HB1598.title: TO REQUIRE THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION TO ESTABLISH A NEW ACCOUNTABILITY SYSTEM FOR PUBLIC SCHOOLS; AND TO REMOVE PUBLIC SCHOOLS FROM SCHOOL RATINGS FOR CERTAIN SCHOOL YEARS.
ar:HB1598.summary: Directs the Department of Education to skip new school letter grades for 2023-24, create a new accountability system, and issue 2024-25 letter grades under it. Schools whose grade does not improve or hold may request review. Expires June 30, 2026.

ar:HB1600.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING MUNICIPAL LAW ENFORCEMENT; AND TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING HOLIDAY COMPENSATION, ANNUAL VACATION LEAVE, AND SICK LEAVE FOR LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS.
ar:HB1600.summary: Specifies that municipal holiday pay, vacation leave and sick leave provisions for law enforcement officers in first- and second-class cities and incorporated towns apply to full-time officers, and replaces "police" with "full-time law enforcement" officer in sick leave payout.

ar:HB1601.title: TO REQUIRE STATE-SUPPORTED INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION TO PROVIDE CAREER COUNSELING AND OTHER RESOURCES TO CERTAIN STUDENTS.
ar:HB1601.summary: Requires state-supported colleges and the Division of Higher Education to post links to career counseling and trade and technical training resources, and keep career services available for up to six months, on request, to students who left without graduating.

ar:HB1602.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS PHARMACY BENEFITS MANAGER LICENSURE ACT; TO ESTABLISH FEES UNDER THE ARKANSAS PHARMACY BENEFITS MANAGER LICENSURE ACT; AND TO REQUIRE REPORTING OF CERTAIN INFORMATION BY A PHARMACY BENEFITS MANAGER.
ar:HB1602.summary: Sets a $20,000 initial and annual renewal license fee for pharmacy benefits managers, defines "clean pharmacy claim" and related terms, and requires pharmacy benefits managers to report certain information.

ar:HB1603.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING INSTALLMENT PAYMENTS BY A CRIMINAL DEFENDANT IN CIRCUIT COURT.
ar:HB1603.summary: Changes how criminal defendants' installment payments in circuit court are applied: payments are allocated under the general priority statute (Ark. Code 5-4-208) instead of going first to court costs.

ar:HB1604.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING PROHIBITED CONTRACTS BY STATE AGENCIES; AND TO PROHIBIT THE USE OF PUBLIC FUNDS BY STATE AGENCIES TO PURCHASE PROMOTIONAL ITEMS MADE IN CHINA.
ar:HB1604.summary: Bars state agencies from spending public funds on promotional items, such as pens, mugs, and clothing, that are made in China, and renames the subchapter on prohibited contracts to "Prohibited Actions by State Agencies."

ar:HB1605.title: TO AMEND THE CONSTRUCTION MANAGER-GENERAL CONTRACTOR METHOD OF PROCUREMENT PILOT PROGRAM TO TO MAKE THE CONSTRUCTION MANAGER-GENERAL CONTRACTOR METHOD OF PROCUREMENT PROGRAM PERMANENT FOR THE STATE HIGHWAY COMMISSION.
ar:HB1605.summary: Makes the State Highway Commission's construction manager-general contractor procurement program permanent instead of a pilot, removing project-count limits and the June 30, 2026 end date, allowing projects up to $300 million, and repealing the independent cost study requirement.

ar:HB1606.title: TO ALLOW A LOCAL GOVERNMENT TO AUTHORIZE THE OPERATION OF A UTILITY TASK VEHICLE ON A DESIGNATED PUBLIC STREET OR HIGHWAY WITHIN THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT'S JURISDICTION SUBJECT TO CERTAIN REQUIREMENTS.
ar:HB1606.summary: Lets cities and counties designate public streets open to utility task vehicles. Operators need a driver's license, registration and insurance, and vehicles need two headlamps, turn signals, a brake light and seatbelts.

ar:HB1607.title: TO CREATE THE OFFICE OF OUTDOOR RECREATION WITHIN THE DEPARTMENT OF PARKS, HERITAGE, AND TOURISM.
ar:HB1607.summary: Creates the Office of Outdoor Recreation within the Department of Parks, Heritage, and Tourism to administer the FUN Parks Grants Program and write its grant rules; its director, whom the secretary may employ, reports annually to the State Parks, Recreation, and Travel Commission.

ar:HB1608.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE MANAGEMENT OF PUBLIC RECORDS AND ARCHIVES; AND TO REQUIRE APPROVAL OF THE ARKANSAS STATE ARCHIVES PRIOR TO THE DESTRUCTION OF CERTAIN DOCUMENTS.
ar:HB1608.summary: Limits the bar on destroying paper originals of recorded documents to those over 50 years old, handwritten and judged historically valuable by State Archives; requires Archives approval before destroying handwritten county records over 50 years old after transfer to other media.

ar:HB1609.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING HUMAN TRAFFICKING; TO CREATE AN ENHANCED PENALTY FOR RECRUITING TRAFFICKED PERSONS FROM CERTAIN PLACES; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:HB1609.summary: Allows an added prison term of up to five years for human trafficking offenses where the person recruited or obtained the victim from a shelter, correctional facility, foster or adoptive home, childcare institution, or juvenile detention facility.

ar:HB1610.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS HUMAN LIFE PROTECTION ACT AND THE ARKANSAS UNBORN CHILD PROTECTION ACT.
ar:HB1610.summary: Defines "reasonable medical judgment"; in two abortion laws, excludes psychological or emotional conditions, conditions treatable without ending the pregnancy, and diagnoses based on the woman's claim or presumed conduct from "medical emergency"; makes accidental harm to the unborn child during physician treatment not a violation.

ar:HB1611.title: TO AMEND THE DEFINITION OF ANIMAL FIGHTING WITH RESPECT TO THE OFFENSE OF UNLAWFUL ANIMAL FIGHTING; AND TO CREATE THE OFFENSE OF UNLAWFUL ROOSTER FIGHTING.
ar:HB1611.summary: Removes roosters and other birds from the definition of animal fighting and creates unlawful rooster fighting: a Class D felony to organize, promote, profit or take admission, and a Class A misdemeanor to pay to attend or take part.

ar:HB1612.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION - EDUCATIONAL TELEVISION DIVISION CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT APPROPRIATION.
ar:HB1612.summary: Appropriates up to $8,000,000 from the Development and Enhancement Fund to the Educational Television Division of the Department of Education for an upgrade to the Next Gen TV (ATSC 3.0) broadcast standard.

ar:HB1613.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION - DIVISION OF HIGHER EDUCATION - NORTHWEST TECHNICAL INSTITUTE CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT APPROPRIATION.
ar:HB1613.summary: Appropriates up to $1,000,000 from the Development and Enhancement Fund to Northwest Technical Institute for construction, renovation, major maintenance and equipment for capital projects.

ar:HB1614.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING DESIGNATIONS RELATED TO CERTAIN CRIMINAL JUSTICE GRANT PROGRAMS.
ar:HB1614.summary: Adds the sexual assault services program to the federal grants the Governor-designated agency administers with Grant Advisory Board review, adds a Child Abuse/Rape/Domestic Violence Commission seat to the board, and requires an annual board report to legislative committees.

ar:HB1616.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT - OIL AND GAS COMMISSION CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT APPROPRIATION.
ar:HB1616.summary: Appropriates $275,274 in federal funds and $296,552 in cash funds to the Oil and Gas Commission for roof repair of its Education Center/Warehouse.

ar:HB1617.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF CORRECTIONS - DIVISION OF CORRECTION CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT APPROPRIATION.
ar:HB1617.summary: Appropriates cash funds to the Division of Correction for capital projects: up to $3.8 million for a camera project at the Wrightsville Unit and $300,000 for flooring at the McPherson Unit.

ar:HB1618.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE ELECTION, APPOINTMENT, AND CONTRACTING OF A MUNICIPAL ATTORNEY.
ar:HB1618.summary: Requires an elected or appointed municipal attorney in second-class cities and towns to reside there, lets those cities instead contract with an attorney who need not reside there, and repeals city attorney statutes for mayor-council first-class cities under 10,000 population.

ar:HB1619.title: TO SET ADMINISTRATION FEES UNDER THE ARKANSAS MEDICAID PROGRAM FOR IMMUNIZATIONS AND MONOCLONAL ANTIBODIES FOR RESPIRATORY SYNCYTIAL VIRUS DISEASE; AND TO PROVIDE CIVIL IMMUNITY.
ar:HB1619.summary: Requires Arkansas Medicaid to pay a 100% administration fee, matching the Vaccines for Children maximum, for RSV immunizations and monoclonal antibodies for infants and toddlers, and adds liability immunity for those who prescribe or give them.

ar:HB1620.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING PHARMACY BENEFITS MANAGERS; AND TO REGULATE PROCESSING AND PAYMENT OF PHARMACY CLAIMS.
ar:HB1620.summary: Requires pharmacy benefits managers to pay clean pharmacy claims within 7 to 14 days (electronic) or 30 days (paper) from 2026, with a 12 percent monthly late penalty; applies the pharmacy audit law to Medicaid and treats certain prescription validation requests as audits.

ar:HB1622.title: TO AMEND THE MEDICAID FAIRNESS ACT; TO MODIFY THE DEFINITION OF "ADVERSE DECISION" UNDER THE MEDICAID FAIRNESS ACT; AND TO PROVIDE FOR ADMINISTRATIVE RECONSIDERATION UNDER THE MEDICAID FAIRNESS ACT.
ar:HB1622.summary: Adds imposition of corrective action plans to the Medicaid Fairness Act's definition of "adverse decision," removes the requirement of a direct monetary consequence, and lets providers request administrative reconsideration and appeal to the Office of Medicaid Provider Appeals.

ar:HB1624.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS LAW CONCERNING THE MEMBERSHIP OF COUNTY LAW LIBRARY BOARDS.
ar:HB1624.summary: Adds a circuit court judge and a district court judge, each serving two-year terms, to county law library boards, alongside three to five attorneys appointed by the county court.

ar:HB1625.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING INSURANCE REQUIREMENTS FOR LICENSED HOME INSPECTORS.
ar:HB1625.summary: Requires home inspectors to carry professional liability or errors and omissions insurance approved by the State Insurance Department, instead of general liability insurance.

ar:HB1627.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING PROPERTY TAX RELIEF; AND TO REQUIRE COUNTIES TO PROVIDE NOTICE TO TAXPAYERS CONCERNING CERTAIN PROPERTY TAX RELIEF OFFERED UNDER ARKANSAS LAW.
ar:HB1627.summary: Requires property tax statements to carry a bold or highlighted notice, or an insert, describing the property tax relief for seniors over 65 and people with disabilities under Amendment 79 and the eligibility requirements.

ar:HB1628.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING AN EXTENDED POST-CONVICTION NO CONTACT ORDER; AND TO ADD SEXUAL ASSAULT IN THE SECOND DEGREE TO THE OFFENSES FOR WHICH A COURT MAY ISSUE AN EXTENDED POST-CONVICTION NO CONTACT ORDER.
ar:HB1628.summary: Adds second-degree sexual assault to the offenses for which a court may issue an extended post-conviction no contact order at a prosecutor's request.

ar:HB1629.title: TO PERMIT A RETIRING PROSECUTING ATTORNEY TO BE AWARDED HIS OR HER SERVICE FIREARM UPON RETIREMENT.
ar:HB1629.summary: Allows a retiring prosecuting attorney or deputy prosecuting attorney authorized to carry a firearm to be awarded a firearm carried during his or her tenure.

ar:HB1630.title: TO ADD A MISDEMEANOR CONTROLLED SUBSTANCE OFFENSE TO THE PREDICATE OFFENSES FOR CAPITAL MURDER, MURDER IN THE FIRST DEGREE, AND MANSLAUGHTER.
ar:HB1630.summary: Extends the actual-delivery controlled substance predicate for capital murder to any violation, not only felonies, and adds such violations to the predicate offenses for first-degree murder and manslaughter.

ar:HB1632.title: TO REQUIRE REIMBURSEMENT TO THE ARKANSAS STATE GAME AND FISH COMMISSION FOR FREE OR DISCOUNTED HUNTING AND FISHING LICENSES.
ar:HB1632.summary: Requires the state to reimburse the Game and Fish Commission, subject to appropriation, for revenue lost to free or discounted annual resident combination hunting and fishing licenses, or license exemptions, created by statute after the act takes effect.

ar:HB1633.title: TO AMEND ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS FOR PARTICIPATING IN EXTRACURRICULAR ACTIVITIES FOR CERTAIN STUDENTS WHO TRANSFER SCHOOLS; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:HB1633.summary: Sets a June 1 deadline for students entering grades 7 to 10 who are homeschooled or transfer schools to be immediately eligible for athletics; students who miss it are ineligible for varsity athletics for up to 365 days.

ar:HB1634.title: TO ESTABLISH THE ARKANSAS SPORTS RAFFLE ACT; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:HB1634.summary: Creates the Arkansas Sports Raffle Act, letting Arkansas higher-education institutions and affiliated nonprofits run one raffle per game against another college, online or in person. Bars buyers under 18 and limits credit card payments to $250 per transaction.

ar:HB1636.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS SOFT DRINK TAX ACT, AS AFFIRMED BY REFERRED ACT 1 OF 1994; AND TO PHASE OUT THE SOFT DRINK TAX BASED ON SALES TAX COLLECTIONS FROM SALES OF SOFT DRINKS.
ar:HB1636.summary: Phases down the soft drink syrup tax from $1.26 per gallon to 96 cents and then lower, as state sales tax revenue from soft drinks reaches thresholds starting at $16 million; requires an annual revenue estimate.

ar:HB1637.title: CONCERNING THE DEVELOPMENT AND PRESENTATION OF FISCAL IMPACT STATEMENTS CONCERNING THE FISCAL IMPACT OF STATEWIDE INITIATIVE AND REFERENDUM MEASURES AND LEGISLATIVELY REFERRED CONSTITUTIONAL AMENDMENTS.
ar:HB1637.summary: Has the Attorney General refer initiated measures with a financial impact to the Department of Finance and Administration, which writes a fiscal impact statement for election boards and the ballot (200 words maximum there); also requires one for legislatively referred amendments.

ar:HB1638.title: TO MODERNIZE REFERENCES TO THE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES; AND TO AMEND ARMED FORCES AND UNIFORMED SERVICES LISTINGS TO INCLUDE THE UNITED STATES SPACE FORCE.
ar:HB1638.summary: Adds the U.S. Space Force to Arkansas statutes listing the armed forces and uniformed services, defines "United States Armed Forces" in several statutes, and replaces generic "armed forces" wording in them.

ar:HB1639.title: AN ACT FOR THE UNIVERSITY OF ARKANSAS FOR MEDICAL SCIENCES - SEXUAL ASSAULT NURSE EXAMINER PROGRAM APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:HB1639.summary: Appropriates $950,780 from cash funds to the University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences for fiscal year 2025-2026 personal services and operating expenses of its Sexual Assault Nurse Examiner Program.

ar:HB1640.title: TO AMEND THE DEFINITION OF "ADMINISTRATOR" AS IT RELATES TO ETHICAL GUIDELINES AND PROHIBITIONS; AND TO AMEND THE RESTRICTIONS ON EMPLOYMENT SPECIFIC TO PUBLIC SCHOOL ADMINISTRATORS.
ar:HB1640.summary: Adds principals, assistant principals and curriculum directors to the definition of "administrator" under public school ethics rules, adds public schools to "public educational entity," and requires district board and commissioner approval for administrators to work for contracting parties.

ar:HB1641.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING HARASSMENT; AND TO INCLUDE THE USE OF A TRACKING DEVICE IN THE OFFENSE OF HARASSMENT.
ar:HB1641.summary: Adds using a tracking device to follow a person's location or movement without their consent, with purpose to track and no good cause or legal authority, to the offense of harassment. Parents or guardians tracking a minor are exempt.

ar:HB1642.title: TO AMEND THE MEASURES CONSIDERED WHEN CALCULATING A SCHOOL RATING; AND TO ENSURE A STUDENT IS NOT COUNTED AS A DROPOUT FOR PURPOSES OF CALCULATING A SCHOOL-LEVEL GRADUATION RATE IF THE STUDENT PASSES A GED TEST.
ar:HB1642.summary: Provides that a student who passes a GED test in the year they dropped out is not counted as a dropout in a school's five-year graduation rate used for school ratings.

ar:HB1643.title: TO ALLOW A CURRENT OR FORMER EMPLOYER TO DISCLOSE SUBSTANTIATED ALLEGATIONS OF SEXUAL ABUSE OR HARASSMENT BY THE CURRENT FOR FORMER EMPLOYEE TO A PROSPECTIVE EMPLOYER UPON WRITTEN CONSENT.
ar:HB1643.summary: Allows a current or former employer, with the employee's written consent, to tell a prospective employer about a substantiated sexual abuse or harassment allegation, or a resignation during a pending investigation of one.

ar:HB1644.title: CONCERNING THE COMPENSATION OF A RETIRED JUDGE APPOINTED AS A SPECIAL JUDGE; TO CLARIFY THAT A RETIRED JUDGE MAY SERVE AS A SPECIAL JUDGE IMMEDIATELY UPON RETIREMENT; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:HB1644.summary: Clarifies that a retired judge may serve as a special judge immediately upon leaving office, applying retroactively to January 1, 2025. Declares an emergency.

ar:HB1645.title: TO AMEND THE LAW REGARDING ADVERTISING BY A MICROBREWERY-RESTAURANT PRIVATE CLUB.
ar:HB1645.summary: Allows a microbrewery-restaurant private club to advertise its name only, and to use social media or a website to give information such as its location, events and menu, despite the general ban on advertising alcohol.

ar:HB1647.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE DIVISION OF INFORMATION SYSTEMS; TO CHANGE THE NAME OF THE DIVISION OF INFORMATION SYSTEMS; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:HB1647.summary: Renames the Division of Information Systems the Office of State Technology and updates references throughout Arkansas law. Declares an emergency.

ar:HB1648.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING MUNICIPAL FIRE DEPARTMENTS; TO ALLOW A MEMBER OF A MUNICIPAL FIRE DEPARTMENT BOMB SQUAD TO MAKE ARRESTS UNDER CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:HB1648.summary: Allows municipal fire department bomb squad members who complete the part-time law enforcement officer course to make arrests for explosives-related offenses or when assisting law enforcement.

ar:HB1652.title: T0 AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING SELF-SERVICE STORAGE FACILITIES; TO ENFORCE AN UNSIGNED SELF-SERVICE FACILITY STORAGE RENTAL AGREEMENT; AND TO CREATE A TERMINATION PROCEDURE FOR A SELF-SERVICE FACILITY STORAGE RENTAL AGREEMENT.
ar:HB1652.summary: Allows self-service storage rental agreements to be delivered and signed electronically, treats 30 days' continued use after delivery as acceptance, and sets notice rules for termination or nonrenewal, with 14 days to remove property before disposal.

ar:HB1653.title: TO SET STANDARDS FOR LICENSING AND REGULATION OF PSYCHIATRIC RESIDENTIAL TREATMENT FACILITIES; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:HB1653.summary: Defines psychiatric residential treatment facilities as long-term care facilities; adds up to 900 permitted beds as an exception to the bed moratorium, requires approval for new construction or renovations over $250,000, and requires Legislative Council approval of bed-count changes.

ar:HB1654.title: TO AUTHORIZE THE ISSUANCE OF A SPECIAL LICENSE PLATE FOR THE MAKE-A-WISH FOUNDATION OF THE MID SOUTH; AND TO ADDRESS THE INVENTORY OF THE MID-SOUTH COMMUNITY COLLEGE EDUCATION SPECIAL LICENSE PLATE.
ar:HB1654.summary: Creates a Make-A-Wish Foundation of the Mid South special license plate with a $30 contribution to the foundation and a $10 handling fee. Stops production of the Mid-South Community College plate once the existing supply runs out.

ar:HB1656.title: TO AMEND THE LAW REGARDING OIL AND GAS PRODUCTION AND CONSERVATION.
ar:HB1656.summary: Sets a minimum royalty of one-eighth of net proceeds from gas sales, defines "net proceeds," lets mineral owners negotiate higher royalties, and requires reimbursement within 30 days of deductions the lease does not allow.

ar:HB1657.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS WOOD ENERGY PRODUCTS AND FOREST MAINTENANCE INCOME TAX CREDIT.
ar:HB1657.summary: Changes the wood energy products tax credit: raises the required project investment from $50 million to $1 billion and the required new jobs from 100 to 400, and extends the closing deadline to June 30, 2028.

ar:HB1658.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE PAYMENT OF PROPERTY TAXES; AND TO DEFINE "DEPLOYMENT" FOR PURPOSES OF THE EXCEPTION TO THE ASSESSMENT OF PENALTIES RELATED TO PROPERTY TAXES.
ar:HB1658.summary: Defines "deployment" as out-of-state Title 10 active-duty assignment for the property tax penalty exemption for service members, who must give the county collector a DD Form 214 within a year after deployment ends.

ar:HB1661.title: TO AMEND THE LAWS CONCERNING STATE DISTRICT COURTS; TO ELIMINATE THE OBLIGATION OF CITIES AND COUNTIES TO PAY THE SALARIES OF STATE DISTRICT COURT JUDGES; AND TO AMEND THE LAWS CONCERNING DISTRICT COURT CLERKS.
ar:HB1661.summary: Ends city and county payments toward state district court judges' salaries, with the state paying salary and benefits, and changes administration-of-justice fund transfers, installment payment rules and court technology fees.

ar:HB1662.title: TO PROHIBIT LOBBYING FOR A COVERED FOREIGN ENTITY.
ar:HB1662.summary: Bars people paid to lobby from lobbying for a covered foreign entity, defined to include parties on federal screening or entity lists and those based in or controlled by China or Russia, with penalties escalating from a fine to a felony.

ar:HB1666.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE ARKANSAS SELF-FUNDED CYBER RESPONSE PROGRAM.
