ar:HB1965.summary: Creates the Healthy Food Retailer Program, in which the Economic Development Commission, as funds allow, gives competitive grants and loans to retailers such as grocery stores and farmers' markets that sell fresh produce in underserved communities.

ar:HB1966.title: TO AUTHORIZE AN INCORPORATED TOWN OR A CITY OF THE SECOND CLASS TO PETITION THE STATE BOARD OF EDUCATION FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A LOCAL PUBLIC ELEMENTARY SCHOOL OR SATELLITE SCHOOL UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS.
ar:HB1966.summary: Lets a town or second-class city, and parents in a school district consolidated within the past 20 years, appeal to the receiving district board for a local elementary or satellite school; if the board approves, both appeal to the State Board of Education.

ar:HB1967.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE UNLAWFUL DISTRIBUTION OF SEXUAL IMAGES OR RECORDINGS.
ar:HB1967.summary: Changes the unlawful distribution offense to cover purposely distributing an identifiable person's intimate image without consent, removing the requirements of intent to harass and a family or dating relationship, with felony penalties for repeat offenses or aggravating factors.

ar:HB1969.title: TO IMPROVE THE QUALITY OF HEALTHCARE ACCESS; TO AMEND THE ASSESSMENT FEES ON HOSPITALS; AND TO CREATE THE HOSPITAL DIRECTED PAYMENT ASSESSMENT.
ar:HB1969.summary: Creates a hospital directed payment assessment on hospitals, with proceeds deposited in a Medicaid account to fund managed care hospital payments up to the federal limit, and creates a Graduate Medical Education Expansion Account.

ar:HB1974.title: TO PROHIBIT STATE ENTITIES FROM EMPLOYING UNAUTHORIZED ALIENS; TO ESTABLISH THE E-VERIFY REQUIREMENT ACT; AND TO REQUIRE STATE ENTITIES TO USE E-VERIFY TO CONFIRM EMPLOYMENT ELIGIBILITY.
ar:HB1974.summary: Requires state agencies and political subdivisions to verify new hires through E-Verify, bars employing unauthorized aliens, and lets the Department of Labor and Licensing request verification records, with a 30-day cure period for noncompliance starting July 1, 2026.

ar:HB1975.title: TO CREATE THE CHILD CONTENT CREATION PROTECTION ACT.
ar:HB1975.summary: Requires parents who earn at least $15,000 in 12 months from paid online content featuring their minor child in 30% or more of it to keep records and set aside a share of earnings in a trust; lets minors sue and seek content removal.

ar:HB1976.title: CONCERNING VERTIPORTS; AND TO CREATE THE OPEN ACCESS TO PUBLIC-USE VERTIPORTS ACT.
ar:HB1976.summary: Creates the Open Access to Public-Use Vertiports Act: bars local governments from using zoning to grant exclusive rights to vertiport operators, requires vertiport designs to follow FAA standards, and bars operations until the FAA approves the layout plan.

ar:HB1979.title: AN ACT TO AMEND ARKANSAS LAW TO ALLOW WARRANTLESS SEARCHES BY A LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICER OF A PERSON PLACED ON SUSPENDED IMPOSITION OF SENTENCE; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.
ar:HB1979.summary: Adds people given a suspended imposition of sentence to those required to waive warrantless searches of their person, residence, vehicle and devices by certified law enforcement or Division of Community Correction officers, without requiring suspicion.

ar:HB1981.title: TO AMEND THE DEFINITIONS OF "OUTDOOR RECREATION OPERATOR" AND "TRAMWAY OPERATOR UNDER THE LAW CONCERNING RECREATIONAL TRAMWAYS".
ar:HB1981.summary: Excludes political subdivisions of the state from the definitions of outdoor recreation operator and tramway operator under the recreational tramway law.

ar:HB1982.title: TO AMEND THE USED TIRE RECYCLING AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT; TO CREATE THE TIRE MANAGEMENT AND RECYCLING ACT; TO REPEAL THE USED TIRE RECYCLING FUND; AND TO CREATE THE WASTE TIRE ABATEMENT FUND.
ar:HB1982.summary: Renames the used tire law the Tire Management and Recycling Act, replaces the rim-removal, commercial-generator and import fees with a $1.50 per-new-tire retailer fee, and replaces the Used Tire Recycling Fund with a Waste Tire Abatement Fund.

ar:HB1984.title: TO CREATE A DESIGNATION FOR A REGISTERED SEX OFFENDER ON A DRIVER'S LICENSE OR IDENTIFICATION CARD.
ar:HB1984.summary: Requires driver's license and ID card applicants to disclose whether they must register as sex offenders and their Level 3 or 4 classification, and adds a law-enforcement-identifiable designation to cards of those required to register and classified Level 3 or 4.

ar:HB1986.title: CONCERNING EXCUSED ABSENCES FOR CHILDREN OF FALLEN SERVICE MEMBERS AND CHILDREN OF FALLEN FIRST RESPONDERS.
ar:HB1986.summary: Excuses absences of children of fallen service members or first responders for mental health concerns or grief-support events, if the student is in good academic standing and not absent on a testing day; parents document events in writing.

ar:HB1987.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE STATE BOARD OF EMBALMERS, FUNERAL DIRECTORS, CEMETERIES, AND BURIAL SERVICES; AND TO INCREASE THE CIVIL PENALTY FOR VIOLATIONS BY A LICENSEE.
ar:HB1987.summary: Raises from $500 to $1,000 per violation the maximum civil penalty the State Board of Embalmers, Funeral Directors, Cemeteries, and Burial Services may impose on a licensee.

ar:HB1988.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE DISTRIBUTION OF AUTO AUCTION FEES FOR SALVAGE-TITLED OR PARTS-ONLY TITLED VEHICLES; AND TO AMEND THE PURPOSE FOR WHICH AUTO AUCTION FEES MAY BE USED.
ar:HB1988.summary: Changes the use of the 50 percent of auto auction fee revenue from salvage-titled or parts-only vehicles that goes to the State Police, from inspection and oversight of auto auctions to operations of the Division of Arkansas State Police.

ar:HB1991.title: TO PROVIDE FOR CERTAIN EXCEPTIONS RELATED TO A RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT UNDER THE ARKANSAS FIRE PREVENTION CODE.
ar:HB1991.summary: Bars the Arkansas Fire Prevention Code from requiring two or more separate fire apparatus access roads for a residential development outside cities and towns in which every lot is at least one acre.

ar:HB1994.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING SELF-SERVICE STORAGE FACILITIES; AND TO REQUIRE NOTIFICATION BY A SELF-SERVICE STORAGE FACILITY TO AN OCCUPANT WHEN THE OCCUPANT'S LEASED SPACE IS COMPROMISED.
ar:HB1994.summary: Requires a self-service storage operator to contact a tenant by phone, email or mail within five business days of learning the tenant's unit was forced open, had property taken, or was damaged; it creates no duty to safeguard the property.

ar:HB1995.title: TO SEPARATE THE OFFICES OF SHERIFF AND TAX COLLECTOR IN PERRY COUNTY.
ar:HB1995.summary: Separates the offices of sheriff and tax collector in Perry County effective January 1, 2027, with both offices elected at the 2026 general election and pay set by the quorum court.

ar:HB2001.title: TO CREATE THE ARKANSAS TOWING AND RECOVERY REFORM AND EFFICIENCY ACT OF 2025; TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE ARKANSAS TOWING AND RECOVERY BOARD; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:HB2001.summary: Replaces the Towing and Recovery Board's members with a nine-member board including the State Police director, a police chief or sheriff, and trucking, insurance, consumer and emergency-response members; bars towing liens on cargo when the owner pays a fee up to 20% of the invoice.

ar:HB2003.title: TO AMEND THE REVENUE STABILIZATION LAW; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:HB2003.summary: Amends the Revenue Stabilization Law to set how general revenues are divided monthly among state funds and agencies for fiscal 2025-2026 and later, with the first allocation tier capped at about $6.49 billion. Declares an emergency.

ar:HCR1006.title: TO PROVIDE FOR AN EXTENSION OF THE REGULAR SESSION OF THE NINETY-FIFTH GENERAL ASSEMBLY; AND TO PROVIDE FOR A RECESS OF THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY.
ar:HCR1006.summary: Extends the 2025 regular legislative session, recessing April 16 and allowing reconvening until noon May 5 to consider vetoes, correct errors and finish proposed constitutional amendments; the session ends that day if not reconvened.

ar:HJR1004.title: APPLYING TO THE UNITED STATES CONGRESS FOR AN ARTICLE V CONVENTION OF THE STATES FOR THE PURPOSE OF PROPOSING AN AMENDMENT TO THE UNITED STATES CONSTITUTION TO IMPOSE TERM LIMITS OF MEMBERS FOR THE UNITED STATES CONGRESS.
ar:HJR1004.summary: Applies to Congress for an Article V convention limited to proposing a constitutional amendment that sets term limits for members of the U.S. House and Senate.

ar:HJR1018.title: THE CITIZENS ONLY VOTING AMENDMENT.
ar:HJR1018.summary: Proposes a constitutional amendment allowing only U.S. citizens who meet the state's elector qualifications to vote in any state or local election in Arkansas.

ar:SB1.title: AN ACT FOR THE ARKANSAS SENATE APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB1.summary: Appropriates money for personal services and operating expenses of the Arkansas Senate for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, and sets its maximum staff positions and salary rates.

ar:SB10.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE - DIVISION OF WORKFORCE SERVICES APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB10.summary: Appropriates money for personal services and operating expenses of the Department of Commerce - Division of Workforce Services for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, and sets its maximum staff positions and salary rates.

ar:SB100.title: TO AUTHORIZE THE ARKANSAS MEDICAID PROGRAM TO RECOGNIZE A PHYSICIAN ASSISTANT AS A PRIMARY CARE PROVIDER.
ar:SB100.summary: Requires Arkansas Medicaid to recognize physician assistants, with their supervising physician's written authorization, as primary care providers, and to reimburse them at no less than the current rate.

ar:SB101.title: TO ESTABLISH THE PHYSICIAN ASSISTANT LICENSURE COMPACT.
ar:SB101.summary: Enters Arkansas into the Physician Assistant Licensure Compact, which lets physician assistants licensed in member states obtain a compact privilege to practice in Arkansas, and Arkansas-licensed physician assistants to practice in other member states.

ar:SB102.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING CANVASSERS FOR LOCAL OPTION ELECTIONS; AND TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING COMPENSATION OF PAID CANVASSERS FOR LOCAL OPTION ELECTIONS.
ar:SB102.summary: Changes local option election petition rules: sponsors must obtain state police criminal history checks on paid canvassers and certify none has a disqualifying offense, canvassers must be U.S. citizens and state residents, and paying by signature count is a Class A misdemeanor.

ar:SB103.title: TO CREATE THE PHARMACY NONDISCRIMINATION ACT; TO REQUIRE PHARMACY BENEFITS MANAGERS TO ACCEPT ANY PHARMACY OR PHARMACIST WILLING TO ACCEPT RELEVANT AND REASONABLE TERMS OF PARTICIPATION; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB103.summary: Creates the Pharmacy Nondiscrimination Act, barring pharmacy benefits managers from denying network participation to licensed pharmacies or pharmacists that accept relevant and reasonable terms, and adds pharmacies to the any-willing-provider lists of healthcare providers.

ar:SB104.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS PHARMACY BENEFITS MANAGER LICENSURE ACT; TO PROTECT PATIENTS' RIGHTS AND ACCESS TO MEDICATIONS; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB104.summary: Bars health payors, pharmacy benefits managers and their affiliates from practices such as requiring enrollees to use an affiliate, unreasonably restricting pharmacy choice, or sharing prescription data with affiliates without written consent, and bars ghost and carve-out pharmacy networks.

ar:SB105.title: AN ACT FOR THE UNIVERSITY OF ARKANSAS COMMUNITY COLLEGE AT BATESVILLE APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB105.summary: Caps regular employees at 243 and appropriates up to $5,444,486 for state operations and $16,126,000 in cash funds for University of Arkansas Community College at Batesville in fiscal 2025-26.

ar:SB106.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB106.summary: Appropriates money to the Department of Agriculture for personal services and operating expenses for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2026, and sets maximum staff counts and salary grades.

ar:SB107.title: AN ACT FOR THE SOUTHEAST ARKANSAS COLLEGE APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB107.summary: Caps regular employees at 375 and appropriates up to $7,640,437 for state operations and $39,700,000 in cash funds for Southeast Arkansas College in fiscal 2025-26.

ar:SB108.title: AN ACT FOR THE SAU-TECH APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB108.summary: Caps regular employees at 333 and appropriates up to $6,144,362 for state operations and $13,868,000 in cash funds for SAU-Tech in fiscal 2025-26. Also funds its fire and environmental training academies.

ar:SB109.title: AN ACT FOR THE SOUTH ARKANSAS COLLEGE APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB109.summary: Caps regular employees at 302 and appropriates up to $7,614,223 for state operations and $22,032,222 in cash funds for South Arkansas College in fiscal 2025-26.

ar:SB11.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH - ARKANSAS MINORITY HEALTH COMMISSION APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB11.summary: Appropriates money for personal services and operating expenses of the Department of Health - Arkansas Minority Health Commission for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, and sets its maximum staff positions and salary rates.

ar:SB111.title: TO ESTABLISH THE DENTIST AND DENTAL HYGIENIST COMPACT.
ar:SB111.summary: Enacts the Dentist and Dental Hygienist Compact in Arkansas, creating a compact privilege that lets dentists and hygienists licensed in one participating state practice in other participating states without obtaining a separate license.

ar:SB112.title: AN ACT FOR THE ARKANSAS STATE UNIVERSITY - BEEBE APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB112.summary: Caps regular employees at 502 and appropriates up to $15,169,817 for state operations and $38,158,145 in cash funds for Arkansas State University - Beebe in fiscal 2025-26.

ar:SB113.title: AN ACT FOR THE ARKANSAS STATE UNIVERSITY - NEWPORT APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB113.summary: Caps regular employees at 341 and appropriates up to $8,262,763 for state operations and $35,610,000 in cash funds for Arkansas State University - Newport in fiscal 2025-26.

ar:SB114.title: AN ACT FOR THE ARKANSAS STATE UNIVERSITY THREE RIVERS APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB114.summary: Caps regular employees at 261 and appropriates up to $4,729,128 for state operations and $25,886,000 in cash funds for Arkansas State University Three Rivers in fiscal 2025-26.

ar:SB115.title: AN ACT FOR THE UNIVERSITY OF ARKANSAS COMMUNITY COLLEGE AT MORRILTON APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB115.summary: Caps regular employees at 289 and appropriates up to $6,683,318 for state operations and $29,000,000 in cash funds for University of Arkansas Community College at Morrilton in fiscal 2025-26.

ar:SB116.title: AN ACT FOR THE UNIVERSITY OF ARKANSAS - SYSTEM AND VARIOUS DIVISIONS APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB116.summary: Sets maximum staffing, salary rates, extra help and appropriations for the University of Arkansas System and its various divisions for fiscal year 2025-2026.

ar:SB117.title: TO CREATE THE NATUROPATHIC PHYSICIAN PRACTICE ACT; TO PROVIDE FOR LICENSURE OF NATUROPATHIC PHYSICIANS IN ARKANSAS; AND TO CREATE THE ARKANSAS STATE BOARD OF NATURAL MEDICINE.
ar:SB117.summary: Creates a licensing system for naturopathic physicians overseen by a new Arkansas State Board of Natural Medicine, defining their scope of practice, education requirements, background checks, and unlicensed-practice prohibition.

ar:SB118.title: TO AMEND THE DEFINITION OF "AUDIOLOGY" RELATING TO THE PRACTICE OF AUDIOLOGISTS.
ar:SB118.summary: Revises the definition of audiology to add externally fitting sound processors, health screenings, removing earwax or foreign bodies, and ordering certain tests, and to exclude surgery, including implant surgery.

ar:SB119.title: TO ESTABLISH THE INTERSTATE MEDICAL LICENSURE COMPACT.
ar:SB119.summary: Enters Arkansas into the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact, which sets up an expedited process for eligible physicians to get licenses in multiple member states, administered by an interstate commission.

ar:SB12.title: AN ACT FOR THE ARKANSAS ETHICS COMMISSION APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB12.summary: Appropriates money for personal services and operating expenses of the Arkansas Ethics Commission for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, and sets its maximum staff positions and salary rates.

ar:SB120.title: TO REQUIRE LICENSURE FOR ALL PRIVATE CARE AGENCIES IN THIS STATE; AND TO ENSURE CONSUMER PROTECTION FOR VULNERABLE AGING ADULTS.
ar:SB120.summary: Requires the State Board of Health to license all private care agencies providing personal care services, with a $1,000 annual fee, staff background checks and 40 hours of training; Medicaid reimbursement still requires Division of Provider Services and Quality Assurance certification.

ar:SB121.title: TO AMEND THE AUTOMATIC OCCUPATIONAL LICENSURE FOR OUT-OF-STATE LICENSURE ACT; TO APPLY THE AUTOMATIC OCCUPATIONAL LICENSURE FOR OUT-OF-STATE LICENSURE ACT TO PHYSICIAN ASSISTANTS.
ar:SB121.summary: Applies the Automatic Occupational Licensure for Out-of-State Licensure Act to physician assistants, which were previously exempt as a medical profession.

ar:SB122.title: TO AMEND THE AUTOMATIC OCCUPATIONAL LICENSURE FOR OUT-OF-STATE LICENSURE ACT; TO APPLY THE AUTOMATIC OCCUPATIONAL LICENSURE FOR OUT-OF-STATE LICENSURE ACT TO PHYSICIANS.
ar:SB122.summary: Applies the Automatic Occupational Licensure for Out-of-State Licensure Act to physicians licensed under the Arkansas Medical Practices Act, which were previously exempt as a medical profession.

ar:SB123.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING COVERAGE FOR MAMMOGRAMS AND BREAST ULTRASOUNDS.
ar:SB123.summary: Defines "supplemental breast examination," including breast MRI, ultrasound, and contrast-enhanced mammography, and prohibits health plans from imposing cost-sharing on diagnostic and supplemental breast examinations for breast cancer.

ar:SB124.title: AN ACT FOR THE UNIVERSITY OF ARKANSAS - DIVISION OF AGRICULTURE APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB124.summary: Appropriates fiscal 2025-26 funds for the University of Arkansas Division of Agriculture: $85,373,773 for operations, $119,540,000 from cash funds, and $3,113,000 for soil testing and research.

ar:SB126.title: AN ACT FOR THE UNIVERSITY OF ARKANSAS AT PINE BLUFF APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB126.summary: Caps regular employees at 880 and appropriates up to $25,663,402 for state operations and $92,899,520 in cash funds for the University of Arkansas at Pine Bluff in fiscal 2025-26.

ar:SB128.title: AN ACT FOR THE UNIVERSITY OF ARKANSAS FOR MEDICAL SCIENCES APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB128.summary: Appropriates funds to the University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences for fiscal year 2025-2026, including about $149.4 million for operations and $2.52 billion in cash funds, plus programs such as poison control and cancer research.

ar:SB129.title: AN ACT FOR THE UNIVERSITY OF ARKANSAS AT MONTICELLO APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB129.summary: Caps regular employees at 632 and appropriates up to $15,197,712 for state operations and $27,581,000 in cash funds for the University of Arkansas at Monticello in fiscal 2025-26. Also funds its McGehee and Crossett campuses and a forest business center.

ar:SB130.title: AN ACT FOR THE ARKANSAS STATE UNIVERSITY APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB130.summary: Appropriates about $302.9 million for fiscal 2025-26 for Arkansas State University from state and cash funds, and sets maximum employee counts and salary rates.

ar:SB133.title: TO AMEND THE UNIFORM COMMERCIAL CODE; TO DEFINE "CENTRAL BANK DIGITAL CURRENCY" UNDER THE UNIFORM COMMERCIAL CODE; AND TO MODIFY THE UNIFORM COMMERCIAL CODE DEFINITIONS OF "MONEY" AND "DEPOSIT ACCOUNT".
ar:SB133.summary: Defines "central bank digital currency" in the Uniform Commercial Code and excludes it from the definitions of "money" and "deposit account."

ar:SB134.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE PUBLIC SCHOOL EMPLOYEE HEALTH BENEFIT ADVISORY COMMISSION; AND TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE STATE EMPLOYEE HEALTH BENEFIT ADVISORY COMMISSION.
ar:SB134.summary: Changes the public school and state employee health benefit advisory commissions from monthly to quarterly meetings (four per year) and limits the stipend to appointed members who are not active employees, lowering it from $500 to $100 per month.

ar:SB135.title: TO AMEND ELECTION REQUIREMENTS IN THE CASE OF AN UNCHANGED RATE OF AN ANNUAL AD VALOREM PROPERTY TAX LEVIED BY A PUBLIC SCHOOL DISTRICT BOARD OF DIRECTORS.
ar:SB135.summary: Lets county election boards, at a school district's request, cut polling places, hold only absentee and early voting, or have one designated voter cast the ballot, among other options, when the district's annual property tax rate is unchanged in an odd-numbered year.

ar:SB136.title: TO CREATE THE RIGHT TO TRY INDIVIDUALIZED INVESTIGATIONAL TREATMENT ACT; AND TO ENSURE THAT PATIENTS HAVE ACCESS TO INDIVIDUALIZED INVESTIGATIONAL TREATMENT.
ar:SB136.summary: Creates the Right to Try Individualized Investigational Treatment Act, letting patients with life-threatening or severely debilitating illnesses use treatments made for their own genetic profile, with physician documentation and written informed consent, and no insurer obligation to pay.

ar:SB137.title: TO PERMIT HEALTHCARE PROVIDERS TO MAINTAIN MEDICAL RECORDS IN AN ELECTRONIC FORMAT.
ar:SB137.summary: Lets healthcare providers create, store and convert medical records in electronic format at their discretion, without keeping separate paper copies, provided the records stay legible and retrievable with adequate data backup.

ar:SB139.title: TO CLARIFY THAT A COVENANT NOT TO COMPETE AGREEMENT IS UNENFORCEABLE FOR CERTAIN LICENSED MEDICAL PROFESSIONALS.
ar:SB139.summary: Voids covenants not to compete that restrict a physician from practicing medicine within the physician's scope of practice.

ar:SB14.title: AN ACT FOR THE ARKANSAS STATE GAME AND FISH COMMISSION APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB14.summary: Appropriates money for personal services and operating expenses of the Arkansas State Game and Fish Commission for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, and sets its maximum staff positions and salary rates.

ar:SB142.title: TO CREATE THE BELL TO BELL, NO CELL ACT; AND TO AMEND THE REQUIREMENTS FOR PUBLIC SCHOOL DISCIPLINE POLICIES WITH REGARD TO STUDENT USE OF PERSONAL ELECTRONIC DEVICES.
ar:SB142.summary: Creates the Bell to Bell, No Cell Act, requiring each public and charter school to adopt a policy, approved by the state education division, prohibiting student personal electronic device use during the school day, with exemptions including emergencies, IEP or 504 plans, and school-issued devices.

ar:SB146.title: TO AMEND THE DEFINITION OF "RECREATIONAL PURPOSE" AS USED IN RELATION TO THE LIABILITY OF A PROPERTY OWNER WHO MAKES LAND AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC FOR RECREATIONAL PURPOSES.
ar:SB146.summary: Adds rock climbing, cycling, mountain biking, horseback riding, paddling, skateboarding and hoverboarding to the list of "recreational purposes" under the law limiting a landowner's liability for people using land.

ar:SB147.title: TO AMEND ARKANSAS LAW CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF TRANSFORMATION AND SHARED SERVICES; AND TO CHANGE THE NAME OF THE DEPARTMENT OF TRANSFORMATION AND SHARED SERVICES; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB147.summary: Renames the Department of Transformation and Shared Services the Department of Shared Administrative Services and updates the statutes that refer to it, effective July 1, 2025.

ar:SB148.title: TO ESTABLISH THE CREATING AN INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITY FOR EARLY CHILDHOOD WORKERS ACT OF 2025.
ar:SB148.summary: Lets early childhood workers at licensed child care providers receiving state or federal funding voluntarily join the Arkansas Teacher Retirement System through an approved nonprofit fiscal agent, with no state matching contributions.

ar:SB149.title: TO AMEND PUBLIC SCHOOL FUNDING AMOUNTS UNDER THE PUBLIC SCHOOL FUNDING ACT OF 2003.
ar:SB149.summary: Sets per-student foundation funding at $8,162 for 2025-26 and $8,037 from 2026-27, with $333 for state insurance paid directly to the state; raises other per-student amounts; and cuts teacher salary equalization funding from $185 to $100, then $50.

ar:SB15.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING NEGLIGENT DISCHARGE OF FIREARMS WHILE HUNTING DEER; AND TO REPEAL § 15-43-205.
ar:SB15.summary: Repeals the law making it a crime to negligently discharge a firearm while hunting deer in a way that endangers others, punishable by a $100 to $1,000 fine, 30 days to six months in jail, or both.

ar:SB150.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE STATE AND PUBLIC SCHOOL LIFE AND HEALTH INSURANCE PROGRAM; AND TO AMEND THE POWERS AND DUTIES OF THE DIRECTOR OF THE EMPLOYEE BENEFITS DIVISION.
ar:SB150.summary: Allows the Director of the Employee Benefits Division to cooperate with the federal government on federally funded programs related to the division, including Medicare.

ar:SB153.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING VARIOUS PROVISIONS OF TITLE 24 OF THE ARKANSAS CODE; AND TO AMEND THE LAW REGARDING THE PAYMENT OF RETIREMENT BENEFITS TO VARIOUS CITY OFFICIALS.
ar:SB153.summary: Removes the requirement that retirement payments to city attorneys, clerks, deputy clerks, mayors, and treasurers come from the city's general fund, providing instead that the city pays them.

ar:SB157.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING BENEFITS UNDER THE STATE PUBLIC EMPLOYEE RETIREMENT SYSTEMS.
ar:SB157.summary: Lets the public employees, highway employees, State Police, teacher, judicial, and local police and fire retirement systems provide a life insurance benefit to a deceased member's beneficiary, with each board setting rules.

ar:SB16.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE DISCHARGE OF A FIREARM AT A TRAIN; AND TO INCREASE THE FINE THAT MAY BE IMPOSED FOR THE DISCHARGE OF A FIREARM AT A TRAIN OR FOR THROWING OTHER OBJECTS AT A TRAIN.
ar:SB16.summary: Makes knowingly discharging a firearm at, or throwing objects at, a locomotive, railroad car or street car a Class A misdemeanor, replacing the current $25-$250 fine and up-to-three-month jail term and the "wantonly, maliciously, or mischievously" standard.

ar:SB160.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING ADMINISTRATION OF THE ARKANSAS PUBLIC EMPLOYEES' RETIREMENT SYSTEM.
ar:SB160.summary: Adds the Arkansas Development Finance Authority as a participating employer in the state public employees' retirement system, and adds the Secretary of the Department of Shared Administrative Services and the Bank Commissioner to the system's board of trustees.

ar:SB164.title: TO AUTHORIZE A PUBLIC SCHOOL TO EMPLOY OR ACCEPT AS A VOLUNTEER A CHAPLAIN.
ar:SB164.summary: Allows public schools to employ or accept as volunteers chaplains who support students, staff and parents. Sets no state credential, requires background checks paid by the school, and limits lawsuits against chaplains over their duties.

ar:SB165.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING COMPETITIVE SEALED PROPOSALS UNDER THE ARKANSAS PROCUREMENT LAW.
ar:SB165.summary: Adds an option for a bidder responding to a best-and-final-offer request on a state contract to revise its responses to one or more specifications of the request for proposals, and ties such requests to discussions that clarify requirements needing material revisions.

ar:SB166.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING EMERGENCY PROCUREMENTS; AND TO INCLUDE A STATE OF DISASTER EMERGENCY IN THE DEFINITION OF "CRITICAL EMERGENCY" FOR PURPOSES OF AN EMERGENCY PROCUREMENT.
ar:SB166.summary: Adds a declared state of disaster emergency to the definition of a critical emergency for purposes of emergency procurements under the Arkansas Procurement Law.

ar:SB167.title: TO AMEND THE DATES BY WHICH CERTAIN REQUESTS TO TRANSFER PUBLIC SCHOOLS OR PUBLIC SCHOOL DISTRICTS SHALL BE SUBMITTED.
ar:SB167.summary: Moves the deadline for school choice and foster-child public school transfer requests from May 1 to June 1.

ar:SB168.title: TO ESTABLISH A STATE EXAMINATION FOR LICENSURE OF MASSAGE THERAPISTS.
ar:SB168.summary: Requires the Department of Health to offer an optional 100-question state licensing exam for massage therapists, with a 70% passing score, open to graduates of approved schools and apprentices, alongside the national exam.

ar:SB169.title: TO MAKE TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS TO THE ARKANSAS CONSTITUTION; AND TO AMEND ARKANSAS CONSTITUTION, AMENDMENT 51.
ar:SB169.summary: Makes punctuation and grammar corrections to Amendment 51 of the Arkansas Constitution (voter registration forms, eligibility and cancellation of registrations), stating that it makes only technical, not substantive, changes.

ar:SB170.title: TO MAKE TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS TO TITLE 1 OF THE ARKANSAS CODE CONCERNING GENERAL PROVISIONS.
ar:SB170.summary: Makes technical corrections to Title 1 of the Arkansas Code (general provisions), including repealing an expired section on electronic document submissions. The bill states it makes only technical, not substantive, changes.

ar:SB171.title: TO MAKE TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS TO TITLE 4 OF THE ARKANSAS CODE CONCERNING BUSINESS AND COMMERCIAL LAW.
ar:SB171.summary: Makes technical corrections to Title 4 of the Arkansas Code (business and commercial law), including ratifying a Code Revision Commission wording fix in the digital currency law. The bill states it makes only technical, not substantive, changes.

ar:SB172.title: TO MAKE TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS TO TITLE 6 OF THE ARKANSAS CODE CONCERNING EDUCATION.
ar:SB172.summary: Makes technical corrections to Title 6 of the Arkansas Code (education), including repealing the expired Smart Core Incentive Funding Program and obsolete education service cooperative language. The bill states it makes only technical, not substantive, changes.

ar:SB173.title: TO MAKE TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS TO TITLE 7 OF THE ARKANSAS CODE CONCERNING ELECTIONS.
ar:SB173.summary: Makes technical corrections to Title 7 of the Arkansas Code (elections), ratifying Code Revision Commission wording changes to provisions on ballot duplication, independent expenditure reports and initiative petitions. The bill states the changes are technical, not substantive.

ar:SB174.title: TO MAKE TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS TO TITLE 8 OF THE ARKANSAS CODE CONCERNING ENVIRONMENTAL LAW.
ar:SB174.summary: Makes technical corrections to Title 8 of the Arkansas Code (environmental law), including a wording change in the used tire program law and a clarified reference in the nuclear recycling program findings. The bill states it makes only technical, not substantive, changes.

ar:SB175.title: TO MAKE TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS TO TITLE 11 OF THE ARKANSAS CODE CONCERNING LABOR AND INDUSTRIAL RELATIONS.
ar:SB175.summary: Makes a technical correction to Title 11 of the Arkansas Code (labor and industrial relations), ratifying a Code Revision Commission wording change concerning Division of Workforce Services personnel. The bill states it makes only technical, not substantive, changes.

ar:SB176.title: TO MAKE TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS TO TITLE 15 OF THE ARKANSAS CODE CONCERNING NATURAL RESOURCES AND ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT.
ar:SB176.summary: Makes technical corrections to Title 15 of the Arkansas Code (natural resources and economic development), updating provisions on the Parks, Heritage, and Tourism department, tourism development and Great Places. The bill states it makes only technical, not substantive, changes.

ar:SB177.title: TO MAKE TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS TO TITLE 17 OF THE ARKANSAS CODE CONCERNING PROFESSIONS, OCCUPATIONS, AND BUSINESSES.
ar:SB177.summary: Makes technical corrections to Title 17 of the Arkansas Code (professions and occupations), including repealing obsolete language for dentists, nurses, pharmacists, physicians, podiatrists and psychologists. The bill states it makes only technical, not substantive, changes.

ar:SB18.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT - LIQUEFIED PETROLEUM GAS BOARD APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB18.summary: Appropriates money for personal services and operating expenses of the Department of Energy and Environment - Liquefied Petroleum Gas Board for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, and sets its maximum staff positions and salary rates.

ar:SB180.title: TO EXEMPT PROVIDERS IN THE PROGRAM OF ALL-INCLUSIVE CARE FOR THE ELDERLY FROM THE LICENSING REQUIREMENTS FOR HOME HEALTHCARE SERVICES.
ar:SB180.summary: Exempts licensed, certified Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly providers in good standing from the state's home healthcare services licensing requirements when serving enrolled participants under their care plans.

ar:SB181.title: TO AMEND THE LIBRARY LAW; TO AMEND THE REQUIREMENTS FOR THE STATE LIBRARIAN; AND TO AMEND THE REQUIREMENTS FOR REGIONAL LIBRARY SYSTEM DIRECTORS.
ar:SB181.summary: Lets work experience in library science substitute for the required master's degree for the State Librarian or a regional library director, if the board approves, without disqualifying the library from state funds.

ar:SB182.title: TO REQUIRE A LOCAL GOVERNMENT TO CONTINUE TO OPERATE UNDER THE ANNUAL APPROPRIATION ORDINANCE FOR THE PREVIOUS YEAR UNTIL A NEW APPROPRIATION ORDINANCE IS ADOPTED; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB182.summary: Readopts a county's prior-year appropriation ordinance if none passes by January 1, withholding the county judge's salary and justices of the peace per diem; lets cities and towns keep paying operational expenses under the prior year's budget.

ar:SB183.title: TO AMEND THE UNIVERSAL ACT ASSESSMENT PROGRAM ACT; AND TO AMEND THE TYPES OF ASSESSMENTS PUBLIC SCHOOLS MAY PROVIDE TO STUDENTS.
ar:SB183.summary: Requires schools to let students choose one assessment such as the PreACT or PSAT in grade 9 or 10 and one of the ACT, SAT or CLT in grade 11, and to offer the military aptitude battery on request.

ar:SB184.title: TO TRANSFER THE POWERS AND DUTIES OF THE ARKANSAS EDUCATIONAL TELEVISION COMMISSION AND THE STATE LIBRARY BOARD TO THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION.
ar:SB184.summary: Abolishes the Arkansas Educational Television Commission and the State Library Board and transfers their powers, duties, staff, property and funds to the Department of Education.

ar:SB185.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS COMPUTER AND ELECTRONIC SOLID WASTE MANAGEMENT ACT.
ar:SB185.summary: Replaces the Department of Finance and Administration with the Department of Transformation and Shared Services in setting sale prices for surplus computer equipment sold to agency employees and in establishing statewide electronics recycling contracts.

ar:SB186.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING FINANCIAL STATEMENTS REQUIRED TO BE SUBMITTED BY A LICENSEE OF THE CONTRACTORS LICENSING BOARD.
ar:SB186.summary: Raises from $750,000 to $1,500,000 the single commercial project cost below which a contractor applicant may submit a compiled rather than reviewed financial statement to the Contractors Licensing Board.

ar:SB187.title: TO AMEND THE COMPOSITION OF THE ARKANSAS MEDICAID DRUG UTILIZATION REVIEW BOARD TO INCLUDE PHYSICIAN ASSISTANTS.
ar:SB187.summary: Adds physician assistants to the practitioners, alongside physicians and advanced practice registered nurses, who may be appointed to the Arkansas Medicaid Drug Utilization Review Board.

ar:SB188.title: TO AMEND ARKANSAS LAW CONCERNING INITIATIVE PETITIONS AND REFERENDUM PETITIONS; AND TO REQUIRE PUBLIC POSTING OF STATEWIDE INITIATIVE PETITIONS AND REFERENDUM PETITIONS.
ar:SB188.summary: Requires initiative and referendum sponsors to give the Secretary of State the measure text, ballot title, popular name and Attorney General letter within five business days of starting signature gathering; requires the Secretary to post the text, title and name online.

ar:SB189.title: TO AUTHORIZE IVERMECTIN FOR HUMAN USE TO BE SOLD WITHOUT A PRESCRIPTION OR CONSULTATION WITH A HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONAL.
ar:SB189.summary: Allows ivermectin suitable for human use to be sold and bought over the counter in Arkansas without a prescription or consultation with a health care professional.

ar:SB190.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION - DIVISION OF HIGHER EDUCATION - NORTHWEST TECHNICAL INSTITUTE REAPPROPRIATION.
ar:SB190.summary: Carries forward unspent 2024 capital appropriations for Northwest Technical Institute, totaling $1,546,708, for construction, renovation, equipment, and an Industrial Technology Center, effective July 1, 2025.

ar:SB191.title: AN ACT FOR THE SECRETARY OF STATE REAPPROPRIATION.
ar:SB191.summary: Carries forward unspent 2024 Secretary of State appropriations, including $15,000,000 for replacing voting machines and $6,500,000 for a State Capitol HVAC upgrade, plus other Capitol repairs and a $4,000,000 business services system update.

ar:SB192.title: AN ACT FOR THE ARKANSAS PUBLIC DEFENDER COMMISSION REAPPROPRIATION.
ar:SB192.summary: Carries forward $233,629 in unspent funds for the Public Defender Commission to cover resentencing of juveniles previously sentenced to mandatory life without parole, effective July 1, 2025.

ar:SB193.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF TRANSFORMATION AND SHARED SERVICES - BUILDING AUTHORITY DIVISION REAPPROPRIATION.
ar:SB193.summary: Carries forward unspent 2024 capital appropriations for the Building Authority Division, including $537,976 for hydronic piping abatement at 501 Woodlane, $324,198 for maintenance of state buildings, and $364,585 for state-owned lands and historic sites.

ar:SB194.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE - STATE INSURANCE DEPARTMENT REAPPROPRIATION.
ar:SB194.summary: Carries forward $101,000 in unspent funds for the State Insurance Department to maintain insolvent perpetual care cemeteries in receivership and to make grants for historic cemeteries, effective July 1, 2025.

ar:SB195.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE REAPPROPRIATION.
ar:SB195.summary: Carries forward unspent Department of Commerce funds, including $28,000,000 and $40,000,000 for workforce development programs and $3,000,000 for grants and loans for public works, water and sewer, and similar economic development projects.

ar:SB196.title: AN ACT FOR THE INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION REAPPROPRIATION.
ar:SB196.summary: Carries forward unspent 2024 capital appropriations for state colleges and universities, covering construction, renovation, deferred maintenance, and equipment at many campuses, effective July 1, 2025.

ar:SB197.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION - DIVISION OF ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY EDUCATION REAPPROPRIATION.
ar:SB197.summary: Carries forward unspent funds for the Division of Elementary and Secondary Education: $629,613 for computer science initiatives and $5,000,000 for maintaining four Education Department buildings in the Capitol Complex.

ar:SB198.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION - ARKANSAS SCHOOL FOR THE BLIND AND ARKANSAS SCHOOL FOR THE DEAF REAPPROPRIATION.
ar:SB198.summary: Carries forward $15,000,000 each for capital improvements at the Arkansas School for the Blind and the Arkansas School for the Deaf, effective July 1, 2025.

ar:SB199.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE REAPPROPRIATION.
ar:SB199.summary: Reappropriates $69,563 to the Department of Agriculture from the Livestock and Poultry Special Revenue Fund, effective July 1, 2025, for the Necropsy Room renovation at the Livestock and Poultry Diagnostic Lab.

ar:SB2.title: TO REPEAL THE STATEWIDE FLUORIDATION PROGRAM; AND TO REMOVE THE MANDATE FOR WATER SYSTEMS TO MAINTAIN A FLUORIDE CONTENT.
ar:SB2.summary: Repeals Arkansas's statewide fluoridation program, ending the requirement that water systems serving 5,000 or more people maintain a Department of Health-set fluoride level.

ar:SB20.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF HUMAN SERVICES - DIVISION OF MEDICAL SERVICES APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB20.summary: Appropriates money for personal services and operating expenses of the Department of Human Services - Division of Medical Services for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, and sets its maximum staff positions and salary rates.

ar:SB200.title: TO INCLUDE TEXTBOOKS AND OTHER INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS THAT ARE LEASED IN THE EXEMPTION FROM THE GROSS RECEIPTS TAX.
ar:SB200.summary: Extends the gross receipts tax exemption for textbooks, library books and instructional materials to items leased as well as purchased, and limits it to public school districts and public schools.

ar:SB202.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING STATUTORY BONDING REQUIREMENTS FOR CONSTRUCTION PROJECTS OF THE STATE HIGHWAY COMMISSION.
ar:SB202.summary: Removes the one-fourth-of-contract-price minimum for State Highway Commission contractors' surety bonds and the personal-bond option with 25% escrowed collateral. Requires bonds that ensure each contract is completed and fully cover the state's exposure.

ar:SB203.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING OUTDOOR RECREATION ACTIVITIES AND RECREATIONAL TRAMWAYS; AND TO CREATE A RECREATIONAL TRAMWAY SYSTEM FOR STATE PARKS AND FOR OTHER LOCATIONS IN THE STATE.
ar:SB203.summary: Creates a recreational tramway and outdoor recreation law: sets safety duties for participants, tramway operators (annual ANSI-code inspection) and recreation operators, and defines risks participants assume and limits on operator liability.

ar:SB206.title: TO AMEND THE RIGHT TO READ ACT; AND TO AMEND THE AMOUNT OF THE LITERACY TUTORING GRANT AWARDED UNDER THE RIGHT TO READ ACT.
ar:SB206.summary: Changes the Right to Read Act, including raising the literacy tutoring grant from $500 to $1,500 per eligible student per year and removing outdated start-date wording from reading instruction and professional development requirements.

ar:SB207.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING INITIATIVE AND REFERENDUM PETITIONS; TO REQUIRE A CANVASSER TO DISCLOSE THAT PETITION FRAUD IS A CRIMINAL OFFENSE; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB207.summary: Bars petition canvassers from obtaining a signature without first telling the signer that petition fraud is a crime, verbally or, if that is impossible, in a separate written notice, and makes failing to do so a canvasser violation.

ar:SB208.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING INITIATIVE AND REFERENDUM PETITIONS; TO VIEW A CANVASSER TO REQUEST PHOTO IDENTIFICATION BEFORE OBTAINING A SIGNATURE; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB208.summary: Requires petition canvassers to view a copy of a signer's photo identification to verify identity before obtaining a signature, and bars obtaining it if identity cannot be verified; a canvasser's affidavit without compliance counts as a false statement.

ar:SB209.title: TO DISQUALIFY SIGNATURES OBTAINED BY A CANVASSER UNDER CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB209.summary: Requires the Secretary of State not to count petition signatures gathered by a canvasser found, by a preponderance of the evidence, to have violated canvassing, perjury, forgery or fraud laws during the current election cycle. Takes effect immediately.

ar:SB210.title: TO REQUIRE THE SIGNER TO READ THE BALLOT TITLE OF THE PETITION IN THE PRESENCE OF A CANVASSER; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB210.summary: Requires a person to read the ballot title, or hear it read aloud, in the canvasser's presence before signing an initiative or referendum petition, and makes it a misdemeanor for a canvasser to knowingly accept a signature without that. Takes effect immediately.

ar:SB213.title: TO CREATE THE HEALTHY MOMS, HEALTHY BABIES ACT; AND TO AMEND ARKANSAS LAW TO IMPROVE MATERNAL HEALTH IN THIS STATE.
ar:SB213.summary: Requires Medicaid to pay separately for prenatal, delivery and postpartum care, cover home blood pressure monitoring, remote ultrasounds and doula and community health worker home visits, and make presumptive eligibility decisions for pregnant women; sets a fifth-birthday deadline for childbirth-injury claims by minors.

ar:SB214.title: TO ADD SECOND DEGREE MURDER TO THE LIST OF OFFENSES THAT ARE INELIGIBLE FOR MERITORIOUS FURLOUGH.
ar:SB214.summary: Adds second-degree murder to the list of offenses that make an inmate ineligible for the Division of Correction's meritorious furlough programs.

ar:SB217.title: TO REQUIRE THE DEPARTMENT OF HUMAN SERVICES TO REQUEST A WAIVER TO EXCLUDE CANDY AND SOFT DRINKS FROM ELIGIBLE FOODS UNDER THE SUPPLEMENTAL NUTRITION ASSISTANCE PROGRAM.
ar:SB217.summary: Requires the Department of Human Services to ask the U.S. Department of Agriculture for a waiver excluding candy and soft drinks from foods purchasable with SNAP benefits, and to ban those purchases if granted or re-request the waiver yearly until it is.

ar:SB218.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS SMALL BUSINESS INNOVATION RESEARCH MATCHING GRANT PROGRAM.
ar:SB218.summary: Extends the Small Business Innovation Research Matching Grant Program to federal Small Business Technology Transfer grants, has the Economic Development Commission rather than its Science and Technology division administer it, and removes the three-grant limit per business.

ar:SB219.title: TO REPEAL THE SUNSET PROVISION OF THE ARKANSAS MEDICAL MARIJUANA SPECIAL PRIVILEGE TAX ACT OF 2017; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB219.summary: Repeals the July 1, 2025 sunset of the Arkansas medical marijuana special privilege tax, so the tax continues. Takes effect immediately as an emergency measure.

ar:SB22.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF INSPECTOR GENERAL APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB22.summary: Appropriates about $15.2 million for fiscal year 2025-2026 to the Department of Inspector General, covering shared services, the Office of Medicaid Inspector General, the Fair Housing Commission, Office of Internal Audit and Independent Tax Appeals Commission, and sets their staffing.

ar:SB220.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS SECURITIES ACT; AND TO CLARIFY EXEMPT TRANSACTIONS UNDER THE ARKANSAS SECURITIES ACT.
ar:SB220.summary: Updates the intrastate securities offering exemption: raises the offering cap from $1 million to $10 million and the non-accredited purchaser limit from $5,000 to $100,000, and requires proof of exemption filed 10 days before sales and investor funds held in an Arkansas-authorized bank.

ar:SB222.title: TO AMEND THE MEDICAID PROVIDER-LED ORGANIZED CARE ACT; TO CLARIFY MARKETING BY PROVIDERS UNDER THE MEDICAID PROVIDER-LED ORGANIZED CARE ACT; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB222.summary: Allows direct service providers to tell Medicaid enrollees whether they are in network with a risk-based provider organization without it counting as a marketing violation, and requires providers to follow the federal managed care marketing rule. Declares an emergency.

ar:SB223.title: TO CREATE THE RELIGIOUS RIGHTS AT PUBLIC SCHOOLS ACT OF 2025.
ar:SB223.summary: Creates the Religious Rights at Public Schools Act of 2025, listing religious activities students may engage in at public schools (prayer, religious clubs, religious viewpoints in assignments) and requiring districts to give students and employees a copy each year.

ar:SB224.title: TO REPEAL THE LAW CONCERNING NATURAL ORGANIC FERTILIZERS.
ar:SB224.summary: Repeals the state law on "100% natural organic fertilizers," which sets a definition, guaranteed nutrient analysis, and regulation, fees and penalties for them.

ar:SB226.title: TO AMEND THE SUDDEN CARDIAC ARREST PREVENTION ACT; AND TO MODIFY THE REQUIREMENTS FOR PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT IN SCHOOL DISTRICTS RELATED TO SUDDEN CARDIAC ARREST.
ar:SB226.summary: Extends sudden cardiac arrest training, every three years, to licensed teacher coaches, registered volunteers and spirit coaches, and requires those coaches and athletics coaches to maintain Basic Life Support certification in CPR and automated external defibrillation.

ar:SB227.title: TO AMEND THE FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT OF 1967; AND TO AMEND THE PROVISIONS OF THE FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT OF 1967 CONCERNING PUBLIC MEETINGS.
ar:SB227.summary: Rewrites the Freedom of Information Act's public meeting rules: defines deliberation and polling, bars members from deliberating outside public meetings, requires agendas, notice and recordings, limits remote attendance, and lets courts invalidate actions taken in violation.

ar:SB228.title: CONCERNING A WAIVER FOR A RENEWED BACKGROUND CHECK GRANTED BY A BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF AN EDUCATIONAL ENTITY TO AN APPLICANT FOR A NONLICENSED STAFF POSITION.
ar:SB228.summary: Provides that a background-check waiver granted by an educational entity's board for a nonlicensed employee stays valid only while the employee has no break in employment and no new disqualifying conviction.

ar:SB229.title: TO CREATE THE DEPARTMENT OF FINANCIAL SERVICES WITHIN THE DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE.
ar:SB229.summary: Creates a Department of Financial Services within the Department of Commerce, made up of the State Bank Department and the State Securities Department, with the Bank Commissioner as its director.

ar:SB23.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF HUMAN SERVICES - DIVISION OF YOUTH SERVICES APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB23.summary: Appropriates money for personal services and operating expenses of the Department of Human Services - Division of Youth Services for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, and sets its maximum staff positions and salary rates.

ar:SB230.title: TO REPEAL THE ARKANSAS TRUST INSTITUTIONS ACT; AND TO CREATE THE ARKANSAS TRUST INSTITUTIONS ACT OF 2025.
ar:SB230.summary: Repeals the Arkansas Trust Institutions Act and replaces it with the Arkansas Trust Institutions Act of 2025, rewriting the chapter on how the Bank Commissioner supervises trust companies and other trust institutions.

ar:SB231.title: TO CONFER LAW ENFORCEMENT AUTHORITY ON SELECT EMPLOYEES OF THE OFFICE OF THE ARKANSAS LOTTERY.
ar:SB231.summary: Gives agents of the Office of the Arkansas Lottery assigned to investigate lottery violations law enforcement officer status and statewide law enforcement authority, and requires regular investigation reports to the Attorney General and State Police.

ar:SB232.title: TO AMEND VARIOUS PROVISIONS OF THE ARKANSAS SCHOLARSHIP LOTTERY ACT; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB232.summary: Repeals the $20 million Scholarship Shortfall Reserve Trust Account, changes the lottery "net proceeds" definition, removes payments to the Division of Higher Education from operating expenses, and limits lottery net-asset reporting to the last ten fiscal years.

ar:SB234.title: CONCERNING THE NINETEENTH JUDICIAL DISTRICT-WEST; TO CREATE AN ADDITIONAL CIRCUIT JUDGESHIP; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB234.summary: Creates an additional circuit judgeship in the Nineteenth Judicial District-West effective April 1, 2025, filled at the 2026 election for a six-year term. The county provides courtroom and office facilities; a court reporter and trial court administrator are provided as for other circuit courts.

ar:SB236.title: TO AMEND THE INSURANCE HOLDING COMPANY REGULATORY ACT.
ar:SB236.summary: Updates the Insurance Holding Company Regulatory Act to add an annual group capital calculation filing and the NAIC liquidity stress test framework for insurers, along with changes to subsidiary, registration and confidentiality provisions.

ar:SB237.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE LICENSING AND REGULATION OF CAPTIVE INSURERS.
ar:SB237.summary: Lets the Insurance Commissioner issue provisional captive insurer licenses when in the public's best interest, limitable or revocable by order; changes minimum paid-in capital for several captive types; and removes the one-year existence requirement from "association."

ar:SB238.title: TO AMEND THE USED TIRE RECYCLING AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT.
ar:SB238.summary: Replaces the tire rim removal and used tire import fees with a $3 recycling fee on each new small tire sold or equipped on a new vehicle or trailer, and lets retailers charge up to $5 for large and $30 for extra-large tires.

ar:SB24.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF HUMAN SERVICES - DIVISION OF DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES SERVICES APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB24.summary: Appropriates money for the Division of Developmental Disabilities Services for 2026-27, including about $201.6 million for operations, plus Special Olympics, community programs, grants to providers and children's medical services.

ar:SB240.title: TO AMEND THE CREDIT REPORTING DISCLOSURE ACT OF 1989; AND TO CLARIFY THE CONTENT REQUIRED FOR A NOTICE OF ADVERSE ACTION.
ar:SB240.summary: Removes the requirement that an adverse-action notice under the Credit Reporting Disclosure Act include the consumer's Social Security number.

ar:SB241.title: TO AMEND THE UNIFORM ATTENDANCE AND LEAVE POLICY ACT; AND TO GRANT PAID LEAVE TO PUBLIC EMPLOYEES IN THE EVENT OF THE DEATH OF A PUBLIC EMPLOYEE'S FAMILY MEMBER OR CHILD.
ar:SB241.summary: Lets a catastrophic leave program grant state employees up to 40 hours of paid leave a year, within four weeks, after the death of an immediate family member, including parents, grandparents, siblings, spouse, in-laws and children (unborn, step, adopted and foster included).

ar:SB242.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING LOANS INVOLVING THE STOCK OF A STATE BANK.
ar:SB242.summary: Lets a state bank acquire and keep loans secured by its own or its holding company's stock in a merger, and loans secured by securities accounts holding that stock, under conditions including no increase in the committed amount.

ar:SB244.title: CONCERNING POSTPONEMENT OF JUDGMENT IN DISTRICT COURT; AND TO PERMIT A SUSPENDED IMPOSITION OF SENTENCE IN CERTAIN DISTRICT COURT CASES.
ar:SB244.summary: Extends district courts' power to postpone judgment up to one year from misdemeanor traffic cases to criminal or traffic division cases, bars it for most commercial license holders, and lets courts dismiss a case after probation when a conditional guilty plea is withdrawn.

ar:SB245.title: AN ACT FOR THE INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT APPROPRIATION.
ar:SB245.summary: Appropriates money from the Development and Enhancement Fund to 11 universities, including $4 million for an Arkansas State University veterinary medicine facility, for construction, renovation, maintenance and equipment.

ar:SB246.title: TO CREATE THE ARKANSAS ACCESS ACT; AND TO AMEND VARIOUS PROVISIONS OF THE ARKANSAS CODE AS THEY RELATE TO EDUCATION IN THE STATE OF ARKANSAS.
ar:SB246.summary: Creates the Arkansas ACCESS Act, rewriting or repealing many education laws. Bars public colleges from compelling people to affirm specified beliefs or treating students differently by race, sex or ethnicity; creates a direct admissions program and an Arkansas Heroes Scholarship.

ar:SB249.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING VIOLATIONS AND PENALTIES RELATED TO FORESTRY; AND TO AMEND THE POWERS OF THE ARKANSAS FORESTRY COMMISSION.
ar:SB249.summary: Lets the Arkansas Forestry Commission impose civil penalties of up to $5,000 on unregistered people who practice forestry or claim to be certified foresters, in addition to the existing Class A misdemeanor charge.

ar:SB250.title: TO AMEND THE PEST CONTROL LAW; AND TO REASSIGN CERTAIN DUTIES OF THE STATE PLANT BOARD.
ar:SB250.summary: Amends the Pest Control Law to move licensing, registration and inspection duties from the State Plant Board to the Department of Agriculture, and removes the definition of "director" of the board.

ar:SB251.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE EXECUTIVE SECRETARY OF THE ARKANSAS TRAILS COUNCIL; AND TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE PARTICIPATION OF THE DEPARTMENT OF PARKS, HERITAGE, AND TOURISM ON THE ARKANSAS TRAILS COUNCIL.
ar:SB251.summary: Changes the Arkansas Trails Council so the Department of Parks, Heritage, and Tourism designates a representative to serve on the council, removing the provision making its representative the council's executive secretary.

ar:SB252.title: TO INFORM THE PUBLIC OF HEALTH RISKS CAUSED BY VAPOR PRODUCTS AND E-LIQUID PRODUCTS; AND TO ENSURE THE SAFETY OF ARKANSAS YOUTH.
ar:SB252.summary: Creates a directory of vapor and e-liquid products kept by Arkansas Tobacco Control. From September 1, 2025, they may be sold only if the manufacturer certifies pending or granted FDA marketing status; selling unlisted products after the directory opens brings $1,000 civil penalties per product.

ar:SB253.title: TO AMEND THE DEFINITION OF A MANUFACTURED HOME UNIT.
ar:SB253.summary: Removes "office, or classroom" from the definition of a manufactured home unit, leaving structures built for use as a dwelling that are over 8 feet wide or 60 feet long and movable on highways.

ar:SB254.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING RURAL COMMUNITY PROJECTS; TO AMEND THE DEFINITION OF "PROPERTY IN KIND"; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.
ar:SB254.summary: Redefines "property in kind" as "in-kind donations," including property, labor, equipment, materials, services and money, for the community pledge of one-fourth of project cost required for state-funded rural community projects.

ar:SB255.title: TO AMEND THE DEFINITION OF "DRUG" WITHIN THE FOOD, DRUG, AND COSMETIC ACT; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB255.summary: Adds food, other than meat, that contains a vaccine or vaccine material to the definition of "drug" in the state Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act and defines "vaccine or vaccine material."

ar:SB257.title: TO AMEND THE MEDICAID FAIRNESS ACT; TO EXTEND THE APPEAL PERIOD FOR PROVIDERS IN THE ARKANSAS MEDICAID PROGRAM; AND TO REQUIRE COMPREHENSIVE INFORMATION IN NOTICES OF ADVERSE DECISIONS.
ar:SB257.summary: Requires the Department of Human Services to give Medicaid providers at least 65 days to appeal adverse decisions, cite specific policies in notices, publish its protocols online, and not enforce unpublished requirements; applies to contracted vendors.

ar:SB258.title: TO CREATE THE ARKANSAS DIGITAL RESPONSIBILITY, SAFETY, AND TRUST ACT.
ar:SB258.summary: Sets consumer data privacy rules for larger businesses effective July 1, 2026, letting consumers access, correct, delete and opt out of sale of their personal data; the Attorney General enforces and no private lawsuits are allowed.

ar:SB259.title: TO TRANSFER APPOINTMENT AUTHORITY FOR THE DIRECTOR OF THE ARKANSAS WATERWAYS COMMISSION TO THE GOVERNOR.
ar:SB259.summary: Makes the Arkansas Waterways Commission director a Governor appointee who serves at the Governor's pleasure, subject to Senate confirmation, and reports to the Secretary of the Department of Commerce.

ar:SB26.title: AN ACT FOR THE UNIVERSITY OF CENTRAL ARKANSAS APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB26.summary: Appropriates money for personal services and operating expenses of the University of Central Arkansas for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, and sets its maximum staff positions and salary rates.

ar:SB260.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE COLLECTION OF COURT FINES, FEES, OR COSTS AFTER DEFAULT.
ar:SB260.summary: Adds fees to the fines and costs courts can collect after a default, and lets a court, on its own motion, collect them by intercepting the defendant's state income tax return, in addition to civil-judgment collection methods.

ar:SB261.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE OPERATION OF AN ALL-TERRAIN VEHICLE ON CERTAIN ROADS; AND TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE ACCESS OF ALL-TERRAIN VEHICLES TO UNPAVED ROADS.
ar:SB261.summary: Allows all-terrain vehicles on unpaved public roads if the driver is licensed and the vehicle carries liability insurance of at least $25,000 for injury to one person and $25,000 for property damage per accident; county quorum courts may prohibit this by a two-thirds vote.

ar:SB262.title: TO AMEND THE CORPORATE PRACTICE OF MEDICINE DOCTRINE; AND TO AUTHORIZE A LICENSED MEDICAL PROFESSIONAL WHO OWNS A MEDICAL CORPORATION TO MAINTAIN OWNERSHIP UPON AN INACTIVE LICENSE OR RETIREMENT.
ar:SB262.summary: Lets a person who acquired ownership of a medical corporation while holding an active medical license keep ownership and control after the license becomes inactive or is surrendered, if all medical services are provided by licensed individuals and the license was in good standing.

ar:SB263.title: TO INCREASE THE HOMESTEAD PROPERTY TAX CREDIT.
ar:SB263.summary: Raises the homestead property tax credit from $500 to $600, for assessment years beginning on or after January 1, 2025.

ar:SB264.title: TO ESTABLISH THE ARKANSAS PRIMARY CARE PAYMENT IMPROVEMENT WORKING GROUP.
ar:SB264.summary: Creates a nine-member working group to define primary care, study how much Arkansas Medicaid and commercial insurers spend on it, and assess the adequacy of primary care delivery.

ar:SB265.title: TO REDUCE AND MODIFY THE MEMBERSHIP OF THE LICENSING COMMITTEE RELATING TO WASTEWATER AND THE LICENSING COMMITTEE RELATING TO SOLID WASTE; AND TO AMEND THE APPRENTICESHIP LICENSES IN SOLID WASTE LICENSING.
ar:SB265.summary: Cuts the wastewater licensing committee from eight to five members (dropping the faculty seat) and the solid waste licensing committee from seven to five voting members, and gives each committee a formal name.

ar:SB267.title: TO REPEAL THE ARKANSAS ALTERNATIVE MOTOR FUEL DEVELOPMENT ACT; AND TO REPEAL THE ALTERNATIVE MOTOR FUEL DEVELOPMENT FUND.
ar:SB267.summary: Repeals the Arkansas Alternative Motor Fuel Development Act and the Alternative Motor Fuel Development Fund.

ar:SB270.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE FILING PERIODS OF CERTAIN NONPARTISAN SCHOOL BOARD AND MUNICIPAL CANDIDATES.
ar:SB270.summary: Specifies that the one-week candidate filing period, which ends at noon 90 days before the election, also begins at noon, for school board candidates in November elections and petition candidates in mayor-council, city manager and city administrator cities.

ar:SB271.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING A COUNTY CLERK'S CERTIFICATION OF SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES TO THE COUNTY BOARD OF ELECTION COMMISSIONERS.
ar:SB271.summary: Changes when a county clerk certifies to the county election commissioners the names of school board candidates who qualified by petition, setting it to the certification deadlines for primary or general elections rather than the day after the filing deadline.

ar:SB272.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING VOTER REGISTRATION; TO PROHIBIT PRE-FILLED FIELDS ON A VOTER REGISTRATION FORM IN CERTAIN INSTANCES; AND TO AMEND PROVISIONS OF ARKANSAS CONSTITUTION, AMENDMENT 51, § 6.
ar:SB272.summary: Requires voter registration application forms to be delivered with the party affiliation field blank, with no pre-filled party affiliation.

ar:SB275.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE REGULATION OF LIQUEFIED PETROLEUM GASES.
ar:SB275.summary: Repeals the requirements that liquefied petroleum gas be odorized and that dealers hold annual employee safety meetings, and lets the Liquefied Petroleum Gas Board require initial, recurring and annual training for permit holders' employees.

ar:SB276.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING SURPLUS LINES INSURANCE; AND TO CLARIFY THAT SURPLUS LINES INSURANCE IS ACCEPTABLE COVERAGE FOR FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITY OF MOTOR VEHICLE INSURANCE COVERAGE.
ar:SB276.summary: Adds insurers "eligible" to do business in Arkansas, not only those authorized, to the companies whose motor vehicle liability policies or bonds count as proof of financial responsibility.

ar:SB277.title: TO AMEND THE COMPREHENSIVE CRIMINAL RECORD SEALING ACT OF 2013; AND TO PERMIT THE FILING OF A NEW UNIFORM PETITION TO SEAL A MISDEMEANOR VIOLATION OF THEFT OF PROPERTY AFTER TEN YEARS HAVE ELAPSED SINCE THE THEFT.
ar:SB277.summary: Bars filing a new uniform petition to seal a misdemeanor theft of property conviction until ten years have passed since the offense.

ar:SB278.title: TO REPEAL THE STATUTES CONCERNING THE OCCUPATIONAL AUTHORIZATION AND LICENSURE OF CERTAIN EMPLOYMENT OFFICES AND AGENCIES; AND TO REPEAL THE ARKANSAS PRIVATE EMPLOYMENT AGENCY ACT OF 1975.
ar:SB278.summary: Repeals Arkansas Code Title 11, Chapter 11, including the licensing requirements for foreign labor agents and employment agencies and the Arkansas Private Employment Agency Act of 1975.

ar:SB279.title: TO ASSIST THE DIVISION OF LABOR WITH ENFORCING THE FAIR AND PROMPT PAYMENT OF WAGES TO ARKANSAS CITIZENS; AND TO CLARIFY THE MANNER IN WHICH WAGE AND HOUR COMPLAINTS ARE INVESTIGATED.
ar:SB279.summary: Lets the Division of Labor director investigate unpaid-wage complaints over the two years before filing, extendable if a violation hindered the investigation, and tolls the director's limitations period while a complaint is pending.

ar:SB280.title: TO DESIGNATE THE OIL AND GAS COMMISSION AS THE CUSTODIAN OF ALL PROPERTY AND THE DISBURSING AGENT OF ALL FUNDS OF THE OFFICE OF THE STATE GEOLOGIST.
ar:SB280.summary: Makes the Director of Production and Conservation, rather than the State Geologist, custodian of the Office of State Geologist's property and, in consultation with the Energy and Environment secretary, disbursing agent of its funds.

ar:SB282.title: AMENDING THE LAW CONCERNING PUBLIC WATER SYSTEMS; AND TO ALLOW VOTERS TO ELECT "FOR" OR "AGAINST" WATER FLUORIDATION.
ar:SB282.summary: Lets customers of public water systems serving 5,000 or more people hold county fluoridation elections, called by petition of 5% of county judge votes cast or a quorum court vote; a majority in a majority of counties ends fluoridation within 30 days.

ar:SB29.title: AN ACT FOR THE OFFICE OF THE LIEUTENANT GOVERNOR APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB29.summary: Appropriates money for salaries and operating expenses of the Office of the Lieutenant Governor for the 2026-27 fiscal year.

ar:SB290.title: TO PROHIBIT A MORATORIUM ON THE ISSUANCE OF PERMITS IN WATERSHEDS AND OTHER BODIES OF WATER.
ar:SB290.summary: Bars state agencies from imposing permit moratoriums in watersheds or bodies of water unless adopted by rule and approved by legislative review; approved moratoriums expire after four years unless the Legislative Council approves renewal.

ar:SB291.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING COMPLAINTS OF ELECTION LAW VIOLATIONS; AND TO AMEND THE DEADLINES FOR COMPLAINTS OF ELECTION LAW VIOLATIONS.
ar:SB291.summary: Changes the window to file election law complaints with the State Board of Election Commissioners to 49 days before through 49 days after an election, and changes when investigation records become public.

ar:SB292.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE DATE OF AN ANNUAL SCHOOL ELECTION; TO MOVE THE ANNUAL SCHOOL ELECTION IF THE ANNUAL SCHOOL ELECTION IS SCHEDULED ON A STATE HOLIDAY IN CERTAIN INSTANCES; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB292.summary: Moves an annual school election held in odd-numbered years to the third Tuesday of the month when its second Tuesday (November or May) falls on a state holiday. Declares an emergency.

ar:SB293.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE REQUIRED POSTINGS AT A POLLING SITE; AND TO AMEND THE LIST CONCERNING REQUIRED POSTING OF NOTICES, INFORMATION, AND MATERIAL AT A POLLING SITE ON ELECTION DAY.
ar:SB293.summary: Requires polling sites to also post poll watcher rights, a voter-assistance notice, an electioneering notice, the measure abstract and, in primaries, a crossover-voting warning, and changes the posted Attorney General hotline information to refer to its Election Integrity Unit.

ar:SB294.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING ELECTION AUDITS; AND TO ALLOW THE STATE BOARD OF ELECTION COMMISSIONERS TO AUDIT A COUNTY IN THE PRECEDING ELECTION IN CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES.
ar:SB294.summary: Requires the State Board of Election Commissioners to audit again, in the next primary or general election, any county found below 100% accuracy in its prior audit, rather than choosing audited counties only by lot.

ar:SB295.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING APPROPRIATION FOR ELECTION EXPENSES; AND TO ALLOW COMPENSATION FOR A CERTIFIED ELECTION MONITOR AS AN ELECTION EXPENSE.
ar:SB295.summary: Allows state election expense appropriations to pay for election monitoring, including compensation for certified election monitors of the State Board of Election Commissioners.

ar:SB297.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING MUNICIPALITIES CHOOSING TO ELECT COUNCIL MEMBERS; AND TO REQUIRE FILING OF THE ORDINANCE DESCRIBING THE ELECTION OF CITY COUNCIL MEMBERS WITH THE COUNTY CLERK.
ar:SB297.summary: Requires first- and second-class cities electing council members by ward to file the ordinance with the county clerk by August 31 of the year before the election (January 1, 2026 for existing ordinances); cities that do not file elect council members at large.

ar:SB298.title: TO REPEAL THE LAW CONCERNING THE SETTING ASIDE OF A DECREE TO QUIET TITLE TO LAND TO ALLOW FOR FINALITY IN QUIET TITLE ACTIONS.
ar:SB298.summary: Repeals the law letting a person set aside a quiet-title decree within three years, or within three years after a disability ends for minors and people with mental illness or intellectual disabilities.

ar:SB299.title: TO REQUIRE A STAFF MEMBER TO WITNESS AN ADMINISTRATOR ASSISTING A RESIDENT OF A LONG-TERM RESIDENTIAL CARE FACILITY WITH ABSENTEE VOTING.
ar:SB299.summary: Requires at least one long-term care or residential care facility staff member to witness an administrator assisting a voter by marking an absentee ballot on the voter's behalf, and conforms the administrator's required acknowledgment statement.

ar:SB3.title: TO PROHIBIT DISCRIMINATION OR PREFERENTIAL TREATMENT BY THE STATE OF ARKANSAS AND OTHER PUBLIC ENTITIES.
ar:SB3.summary: Bars the state, cities, counties, public schools and colleges from discriminating or giving preferential treatment based on race, sex, color, ethnicity or national origin in employment, education or procurement. Removes minority-specific provisions from education and contracting law and allows civil suits for injunctions and fees.

ar:SB30.title: AN ACT FOR THE OFFICE OF THE GOVERNOR APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB30.summary: Appropriates money for the Governor's Office personal services and operating expenses for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, sets its staff positions and salary rates, and funds the Governor's response to public emergencies.

ar:SB300.title: TO CREATE THE CRIMINAL OFFENSE OF ORGANIZED RETAIL THEFT.
ar:SB300.summary: Creates the felony of organized retail theft: acting with others to steal consumer goods, with felony class set by value, from Class D above $1,000 to Class B at $25,000 or more, aggregated over 120 days.

ar:SB301.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THEFT OF PROPERTY; TO CREATE AN ENHANCED PENALTY FOR THEFT OF CARGO; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB301.summary: Defines "cargo" as commercial freight shipments (excluding direct-to-consumer goods) and lets a prosecutor, with written notice to the defendant, seek up to 10 additional years, served consecutively, for stealing cargo.

ar:SB302.title: TO CREATE THE CRIMINAL OFFENSE OF GIFT CARD FRAUD; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB302.summary: Creates the crime of gift card fraud: acquiring or using gift cards or redemption codes by deception to deprive the owner. Penalty depends on value, from a Class A misdemeanor under $1,000 to a Class B felony at $25,000 or more.

ar:SB303.title: TO ALLOW A RESIDENT SCHOOL DISTRICT TO PERMIT A PRIVATE SCHOOL STUDENT TO PARTICIPATE IN AN INTERSCHOLASTIC ACTIVITY AT THE RESIDENT SCHOOL DISTRICT UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS.
ar:SB303.summary: Lets a school district or open-enrollment charter school allow a private school student to join an interscholastic activity there when the student's private school lacks that activity approved by the Arkansas Activities Association.

ar:SB304.title: TO ALLOW A CLASS OF REGISTERED VOTERS THAT HAVE CHANGED THEIR COUNTY OF RESIDENCE TO CAST A VALID BALLOT; AND TO AMEND PROVISIONS OF ARKANSAS CONSTITUTION, AMENDMENT 51.
ar:SB304.summary: Changes the deadline for a voter who moved to a new county to have updated registration received by the county clerk and vote in the new precinct, from four days before an election to before the polls close.

ar:SB305.title: TO REQUIRE CERTAIN TESTING OF PROCESSED MARIJUANA PRODUCTS SOLD AS MEDICAL MARIJUANA.
ar:SB305.summary: Requires processed medical marijuana products, such as edibles, oils and tinctures, to be tested as finished products for pesticides, heavy metals, microbes, residual solvents and THC and CBD levels, following Department of Health rules.

ar:SB307.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING PUBLIC UTILITIES; TO CREATE THE GENERATING ARKANSAS JOBS ACT OF 2025; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB307.summary: Creates the Generating Arkansas Jobs Act of 2025, letting investor-owned electric and gas utilities and electric cooperatives recover costs of approved strategic investments through rate riders, and authorizing special rate contracts.

ar:SB308.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING A WRITE-IN CANDIDATE; AND TO REMOVE REFERENCES TO A WRITE-IN CANDIDATE.
ar:SB308.summary: Removes write-in references from five election-law provisions, including the separate write-in count of absentee ballots, the political practices pledge for write-in candidates, and the write-in filing deadline in vacancy-election calls.

ar:SB309.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS HEALTH CARE CONSUMER ACT; TO REVISE THE DEFINITION OF "PSYCHIATRIC COLLABORATIVE CARE MODEL"; AND TO INCLUDE CERTAIN CLINICAL PSYCHIATRIC PHARMACIST SERVICES IN THE PSYCHIATRIC COLLABORATIVE CARE MODEL.
ar:SB309.summary: Allows the primary care team in the psychiatric collaborative care model to include a clinical psychiatric pharmacist who meets set degree and licensing requirements, and updates the model's federal references to those in effect on January 1, 2025.

ar:SB311.title: TO CREATE THE END ORGAN AND GENOMIC HARVESTING ACT; TO PROHIBIT COVERAGE OF CERTAIN HUMAN ORGAN TRANSPLANT OR POST-TRANSPLANT CARE; AND TO PROHIBIT CERTAIN GENETIC SEQUENCERS AND GENETIC ANALYSIS TECHNOLOGIES.
ar:SB311.summary: Bars medical and research facilities from putting new genetic sequencers or software from foreign-adversary companies into service after October 1, 2025, requires genetic data stored outside adversary countries, and bars health plans covering transplants done in, or with organs from, designated forced-organ-harvesting countries.

ar:SB313.title: CONCERNING FORENSIC MENTAL HEALTH EVALUATIONS AND TREATMENT; AND TO PROMOTE AND IMPROVE EFFICIENCIES AND QUALITY IN THE DEPARTMENT OF HUMAN SERVICES.
ar:SB313.summary: Revises procedures for mental fitness-to-proceed evaluations in criminal cases, defines jail-based restoration services, and allows them in county jails through telehealth or, with the sheriff's or jail administrator's consent, other methods.

ar:SB314.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING SEXUAL SOLICITATION; AND TO AMEND THE PENALTIES FOR THE OFFENSE OF SEXUAL SOLICITATION.
ar:SB314.summary: Reclassifies sexual solicitation penalties: a first offense becomes a Class A misdemeanor and a second or later offense a Class D felony, replacing the current maximums of 90 days and $2,000, and one year and $3,500.

ar:SB317.title: TO PROHIBIT AN INSTITUTION OF HIGHER EDUCATION FROM PARTICIPATING IN CERTAIN ACTIVITIES WITH A PROHIBITED FOREIGN PARTY.
ar:SB317.summary: Bars institutions of higher education from conducting classified research, conducting contracted agricultural research, selling or producing agricultural products, or entering nondisclosure agreements with a prohibited foreign party.

ar:SB319.title: TO AMEND THE UNIFORM LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY ACT; AND TO CLARIFY CHARGING ORDERS UNDER THE UNIFORM LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY ACT.
ar:SB319.summary: Bars foreclosure of a charging order lien on an LLC membership interest, limits a judgment creditor to receiving distributions, and makes the charging order the exclusive remedy for single-member as well as multiple-member LLCs.

ar:SB320.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS JUVENILE CODE OF 1989.
ar:SB320.summary: Repeals and re-enacts the Arkansas Juvenile Code of 1989, stating that the changes are technical rather than substantive.

ar:SB321.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE STATE ADMINISTRATION OF JUSTICE FUND.
ar:SB321.summary: Removes the Arkansas District Judges Council executive director from the first-priority allocations of the State Administration of Justice Fund and adds Administrative Office of the Courts county reimbursements for jurors.

ar:SB322.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING CONSTRUCTION AND DEVELOPMENT; AND TO ALLOW THIRD PARTIES TO PERFORM PLAN REVIEWS AND SITE INSPECTIONS.
ar:SB322.summary: Lets permit applicants use private engineers, architects or licensed inspectors for plan review at the local government's expense when it cannot act within 60 days, or by choice at their own expense, and for inspections at their own expense.

ar:SB323.title: TO AMEND THE HORIZONTAL PROPERTY ACT.
ar:SB323.summary: Amends the Horizontal Property Act to redefine "apartment" as a unit designated in a master deed, add declarant and development-right definitions, change required master deed contents, and let master deeds set ownership and expense percentages.

ar:SB324.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE MEMBERSHIP OF A COUNTY PLANNING BOARD.
ar:SB324.summary: Requires a majority of a county planning board's voting members to live in an unincorporated area of the county.

ar:SB325.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS JUVENILE CODE OF 1989; TO AMEND THE CHILD MALTREATMENT ACT; TO AMEND THE LAW REGARDING REINSTATEMENT OF PARENTAL RIGHTS; AND TO AMEND THE LAW REGARDING THE CHILD MALTREATMENT CENTRAL REGISTRY.
ar:SB325.summary: Changes how a parent whose rights were terminated can seek resumed services and reinstatement: shortens the waiting period from three to two years and the services period before a reinstatement petition from 180 to 90 days, and changes who may file.

ar:SB326.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS JUVENILE CODE OF 1989 AND THE CHILD MALTREATMENT ACT; TO MODIFY GUIDELINES FOR A JUDGMENT MADE IN THE BEST INTEREST OF A CHILD; AND TO AMEND PROCEDURES AROUND REPORTING CHILD MALTREATMENT.
ar:SB326.summary: Amends the juvenile code to add family-integrity language to the child's best-interest standard, revise the definition of neglect, change who may file dependency-neglect petitions, allow 72-hour holds in family-in-need-of-services cases, and change child maltreatment reporting procedures.

ar:SB327.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING PAYMENTS TO LOCALITIES.
ar:SB327.summary: Extends through fiscal year 2035 the annual $887,908 payments to the Arkansas State Fair and Livestock Show Association or its bond trustee from state assistance to cities and counties.

ar:SB328.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING COMPUTER CRIMES AGAINST MINORS.
ar:SB328.summary: Raises the age in Arkansas computer-crimes-against-minors law from under 17 to under 18, including for the age-belief defense, and requires the trier of fact to determine age using listed methods.

ar:SB329.title: TO CREATE THE ONLINE MARKETPLACE GUARANTEES ACT.
ar:SB329.summary: Creates the Online Marketplace Guarantees Act, requiring providers of guarantees sold through online platforms to register with the Insurance Commissioner, publish guarantee terms, give purchase records, and back obligations by reimbursement insurance, $200 million market capitalization, or $50 million net worth.

ar:SB331.title: CONCERNING COVERAGE FOR GENETIC TESTING FOR INHERITED CANCER MUTATIONS; AND TO CREATE THE GENETIC TESTING ACT.
