ar:SB331.summary: Requires health plans issued or renewed from 2026 to cover genetic testing for inherited cancer mutations for people with personal or family cancer history, and guideline-recommended cancer imaging for higher-risk people, with no cost-sharing.

ar:SB332.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION - DIVISION OF ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY EDUCATION SEXUAL RISK AVOIDANCE EDUCATION PROGRAM APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB332.summary: Appropriates $4,000,000 for fiscal 2025-26 to the Department of Education for the Sexual Risk Avoidance Education Program.

ar:SB333.title: AN ACT FOR THE UNIVERSITY OF ARKANSAS AT PINE BLUFF - POLICE STATION FACILITY CONSTRUCTION APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB333.summary: Appropriates $3,000,000 in cash funds for fiscal year 2025-2026 for construction of a police station facility at the University of Arkansas at Pine Bluff.

ar:SB334.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION - DIVISION OF ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY EDUCATION CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT APPROPRIATION
ar:SB334.summary: Appropriates up to $5 million from the Educational Buildings Maintenance Fund to the Division of Elementary and Secondary Education for maintenance, renovation and repairs of four department-owned Capitol Complex buildings.

ar:SB335.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION - ARKANSAS SCHOOL FOR THE DEAF CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT APPROPRIATION.
ar:SB335.summary: Appropriates up to $35 million from the Development and Enhancement Fund to the Arkansas School for the Deaf for maintenance, renovation, construction, equipment and repair of its facilities.

ar:SB337.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF TRANSFORMATION AND SHARED SERVICES - BUILDING AUTHORITY DIVISION CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT APPROPRIATION.
ar:SB337.summary: Appropriates up to $800,000 in cash funds to the Building Authority Division for abatement of hydronic piping at the state-owned building at 501 Woodlane.

ar:SB339.title: CONCERNING THE MEMBERSHIP OF THE CHILD MALTREATMENT INVESTIGATIONS OVERSIGHT COMMITTEE.
ar:SB339.summary: Changes the Child Maltreatment Investigations Oversight Committee's election of its legislative chair from annually to every two years.

ar:SB340.title: TO AMEND ARKANSAS LAW CONCERNING CERTAIN FEES, EXPENSES, AND COSTS IMPOSED ON A JUVENILE OR THE PARENT, GUARDIAN, OR CUSTODIAN OF A JUVENILE.
ar:SB340.summary: As introduced, bars fees, court costs and public-defender charges against juveniles and their parents in juvenile matters, voids existing such judgments, and presumes a juvenile is indigent for appointed counsel.

ar:SB342.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING INJURIES TO CERTAIN ANIMALS BY DOGS TO AUTHORIZE TREBLE DAMAGES.
ar:SB342.summary: Authorizes courts to award treble damages when a dog kills or injures a domesticated animal such as livestock or poultry.

ar:SB343.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING STATE-OWNED MOTOR VEHICLES; TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING PUBLIC PROPERTY; AND TO AMEND THE AUTOMOBILE AND PICKUP TRUCK ACQUISITION ACT FOR THE STATE OF ARKANSAS.
ar:SB343.summary: Sets a 100-passenger-vehicle limit for the Department of Shared Administrative Services, shifts state vehicle record duties to its Secretary, and requires GPS devices on cabinet-level departments' non-law-enforcement vehicles by January 1, 2028.

ar:SB344.title: TO TRANSFER THE HEALTHY EMPLOYEE LIFESTYLE PROGRAM FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH TO THE DEPARTMENT OF TRANSFORMATION AND SHARED SERVICES; AND TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE HEALTHY LIFESTYLE PROGRAM.
ar:SB344.summary: Transfers the Healthy Employee Lifestyle Program from the Department of Health to the Department of Transformation and Shared Services, requires state entities to allow participation by July 1, 2026, and allows rewards of up to 24 hours of leave yearly.

ar:SB345.title: TO PROMOTE TOURISM AND ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT BY IMPROVING EFFICIENCY OF THE PRIVATE CLUB PERMITTING PROCESS OF HOTELS, RESTAURANTS, AND LARGE-EVENT FACILITIES; AND TO REMOVE AN OVERLY BURDENSOME TAX REQUIREMENT.
ar:SB345.summary: Lets a corporation, partnership, individual or LLC get a private club permit for a hotel, restaurant or large-event facility in certain areas without forming a nonprofit corporation, while still meeting other permit requirements.

ar:SB346.title: AN ACT FOR THE ARKANSAS SENATE APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB346.summary: Sets the 2025-26 fiscal-year staffing limits, pay grades, and appropriation for the Arkansas Senate's staff services, with a maximum of 19 regular employees and two extra-help positions.

ar:SB347.title: TO REQUIRE THE ARKANSAS MEDICAID PROGRAM TO INCREASE REIMBURSEMENT RATES FOR CERTAIN DENTAL SERVICES AND TO SET AN ANNUAL REIMBURSEMENT CAP FOR ADULT DENTAL SERVICES.
ar:SB347.summary: Requires Arkansas Medicaid, starting September 1, 2025, to raise reimbursement for oral surgeon, pediatric and special-needs adult dental services to 60% of the national median fee, and doubles the annual adult special-needs dental cap from $500 to $1,000.

ar:SB348.title: TO AMEND THE ANNUAL CAP FOR DIAGNOSTIC LABORATORY SERVICES WITHIN THE ARKANSAS MEDICAID PROGRAM; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB348.summary: Raises the Medicaid annual cap for diagnostic laboratory services to at least $1,800, from at least $500, for beneficiaries diagnosed with chronic pain or being treated for pain management.

ar:SB352.title: TO PROHIBIT ANTISEMITISM IN PUBLIC ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY SCHOOLS; AND TO PROHIBIT ANTISEMITISM IN STATE-SUPPORTED INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION.
ar:SB352.summary: Requires K-12 school districts to address antisemitic discrimination like other prohibited discrimination and adopt policies using a defined meaning of antisemitism; the Department of Education designates a Title VI Coordinator to monitor discrimination complaints at schools and colleges.

ar:SB353.title: TO AMEND ARKANSAS LAW CONCERNING THE DATES FOR ELECTIONS; TO AMEND THE DATES OF PRIMARY ELECTIONS, SCHOOL ELECTIONS, AND CERTAIN SPECIAL ELECTIONS; AND TO CHANGE THE DATE OF THE FISCAL SESSION OF THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY.
ar:SB353.summary: Moves the preferential primary in gubernatorial-election years from May to the first Tuesday after the first Monday in March, as in presidential years, shifts the filing period, moves May school and special elections to March, and adjusts related ballot and legislative-session dates.

ar:SB354.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF CORRECTIONS - DIVISION OF CORRECTION DEVELOPMENT AND ENHANCEMENT CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT APPROPRIATION
ar:SB354.summary: Appropriates up to $750,000,000 from the Development and Enhancement Fund to the Division of Correction for prison construction.

ar:SB355.title: TO AMEND THE CRIMINAL OFFENSE OF OBSTRUCTING GOVERNMENTAL OPERATIONS.
ar:SB355.summary: Adds to the offense of obstructing governmental operations knowingly failing to appear and testify at a criminal trial or hearing after being personally served a subpoena, a Class C misdemeanor.

ar:SB357.title: TO AMEND THE UNIFORM ATTENDANCE AND LEAVE POLICY ACT; AND TO APPLY MILITARY SERVICE CREDIT TO A PUBLIC EMPLOYEE'S TOTAL SERVICE TIME FOR ANNUAL LEAVE ACCRUAL CALCULATION.
ar:SB357.summary: Gives state employees credit for prior military, Arkansas National Guard, or reserve service when setting their annual leave accrual rate, if they retired or were honorably discharged or currently serve, upon written documentation.

ar:SB359.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION - DIVISION OF ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY EDUCATION OUT-OF-SCHOOL TIME PROGRAM GRANTS APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB359.summary: Appropriates $3,900,000 for the 2025-26 fiscal year to the state education division for out-of-school time program grants, limited to eligible entities running programs for school-aged children.

ar:SB36.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB36.summary: Appropriates money for personal services and operating expenses of the Department of Agriculture for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, and sets its maximum staff positions and salary rates.

ar:SB361.title: TO CREATE THE INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES EXPANSION ACT; AND TO PROVIDE FOR THE CREATION OF INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES TO SECURE AND DEVELOP INDUSTRY AND FOSTER ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT.
ar:SB361.summary: Creates the Industrial Development Authorities Expansion Act, letting counties and cities petition a circuit court to establish an industrial development authority, a public benefit corporation run by a board, to secure industry and foster economic development, including by issuing bonds.

ar:SB362.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION - DIVISION OF ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY EDUCATION YOUTH ORGANIZATION GRANTS APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB362.summary: Appropriates $4 million for fiscal 2025-2026 for Department of Education youth-organization grants, limited to groups that do not compel a person to adopt ideas in violation of federal civil rights law or based on diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives.

ar:SB364.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING VIOLATIONS AND PENALTIES RELATED TO CONTRACTORS.
ar:SB364.summary: Lets a contractor in violation of licensing law sue for unjust enrichment or quantum meruit if the contractor pays all board-assessed fines and properly applies for a contractor's license; otherwise suits on such contracts remain barred.

ar:SB365.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS SMALL BREWERY ACT TO AUTHORIZE THE OPERATION OF THREE SMALL BREWERY TAPROOMS BY A HOLDER OF A SMALL BREWERY LICENSE.
ar:SB365.summary: Raises from two to three the number of small brewery taprooms a small brewery license holder may operate.

ar:SB366.title: TO CREATE THE STRENGTHEN ARKANSAS HOMES ACT; AND TO CREATE THE STRENGTHEN ARKANSAS HOMES PROGRAM FUND.
ar:SB366.summary: Creates the Strengthen Arkansas Homes Program within the State Insurance Department, funded by a new program fund, to give grants to property owners and nonprofits for upgrading single-family homes to FORTIFIED wind-damage construction standards.

ar:SB367.title: TO REPEAL THE SMALL BUSINESS REVOLVING LOAN FUND FOR POLLUTION CONTROL AND PREVENTION TECHNOLOGIES ACT; AND TO REPEAL THE SMALL BUSINESS REVOLVING LOAN FUND.
ar:SB367.summary: Repeals the Small Business Revolving Loan Fund for Pollution Control and Prevention Technologies Act, which let the Division of Environmental Quality make loans to small businesses for pollution control and prevention projects, and repeals the fund itself.

ar:SB368.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING MINERAL, TIMBER, AND OTHER RESOURCES ON STATE LANDS; TO REDUCE MEMBERSHIP OF THE NATURAL RESOURCES COMMITTEE; AND TO AMEND THE NOTIFICATION RELATED TO LEASES AND PERMITS.
ar:SB368.summary: Replaces three members (Oil and Gas production director, State Geologist, Environmental Quality director) of the Natural Resources Committee with the Energy and Environment secretary, allows designees, and replaces three agencies in the state-land lease notice list with that department.

ar:SB369.title: TO REPEAL THE COMPUTER AND ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT RECYCLING GRANTS; AND TO REPEAL THE COMPUTER AND ELECTRONIC RECYCLING FUND.
ar:SB369.summary: Repeals the Computer and Electronic Recycling Fund and recycling grants, and changes the split of surplus computer sale proceeds among the owning agency and the Marketing and Redistribution Section.

ar:SB37.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF LABOR AND LICENSING - WORKERS' COMPENSATION COMMISSION APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB37.summary: Appropriates money for personal services and operating expenses of the Department of Labor and Licensing - Workers' Compensation Commission for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, and sets its maximum staff positions and salary rates.

ar:SB370.title: TO TRANSFER THE ARKANSAS WINE PRODUCERS COUNCIL FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE TO THE DEPARTMENT OF PARKS, HERITAGE, AND TOURISM; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB370.summary: Transfers the Arkansas Wine Producers Council from the Department of Commerce to the Tourism Division of the Department of Parks, Heritage, and Tourism, with its duties, records, property and funds, and declares an emergency.

ar:SB371.title: TO ESTABLISH A STANDARDIZED SYSTEM TO AID IN THE SEARCH OF MISSING CHILDREN WHO DO NOT MEET THE CRITERIA FOR ACTIVATION OF THE ARKANSAS AMBER ALERT SYSTEM.
ar:SB371.summary: Creates a missing endangered child advisory system, run by State Police, for children under 18 who do not meet Amber Alert criteria, such as unexplained disappearances, suspected abductions, disabilities, or other danger.

ar:SB372.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE SIGNAL LEGEND OF TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICES; AND TO ALLOW A VEHICLE DRIVER TO ENTER AN INTERSECTION WHILE A RED LIGHT IS INDICATED ON A TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE IN CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES.
ar:SB372.summary: Lets a driver cautiously enter an intersection on a red light after a full stop, if no other traffic is approaching or in the intersection. Other traffic must yield to a vehicle that has entered this way.

ar:SB373.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS FINANCIAL EDUCATION COMMISSION.
ar:SB373.summary: Changes the Arkansas Financial Education Commission board by replacing the Bank Commissioner and Securities Commissioner seats with one member designated by the Secretary of State.

ar:SB374.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE CIVIL SERVICE SYSTEM.
ar:SB374.summary: Lets fire and police department chiefs, instead of fixed April and October dates, set when civil service entrance exams are held, and limits the civil service commission to observing rather than interviewing or proctoring.

ar:SB375.title: TO CREATE THE OFFENSE OF CAPITAL RAPE; AND TO AMEND A PORTION OF ARKANSAS CODE WHICH RESULTED FROM INITIATED ACT 3 OF 1936.
ar:SB375.summary: Creates capital rape: sexual intercourse or deviate sexual activity with a child 13 or younger involving serious injury or threat, a deadly weapon, certain other felonies, or a prior child rape conviction; punishable by death or life without parole for defendants 18 or older.

ar:SB376.title: TO AMEND THE FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT OF 1967; AND TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING PUBLIC MEETINGS UNDER THE FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT OF 1967.
ar:SB376.summary: Limits Freedom of Information Act public meetings to gatherings of more than two members of a governing body, and bars two members who discuss a matter outside a public meeting from relaying another member's position on it to other members.

ar:SB378.title: TO REPEAL THE REQUIREMENT THAT THE ARKANSAS ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION SUBMIT A QUARTERLY REPORT CONCERNING THE TRAINING ACTIVITIES OF THE ARKANSAS INDUSTRY TRAINING PROGRAM.
ar:SB378.summary: Repeals the requirement that the Economic Development Commission submit a quarterly report on Arkansas Industry Training Program activities to the Governor and Legislative Council.

ar:SB379.title: TO REPEAL THE LAW REQUIRING THE TAX ADVISORY COUNCIL TO SUBMIT A REPORT.
ar:SB379.summary: Repeals the requirement that the Tax Advisory Council submit a report to the House and Senate revenue and taxation committees.

ar:SB38.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH -LICENSING AND REGULATION BOARDS APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB38.summary: Appropriates funds for fiscal year 2025-2026 operations of Department of Health professional licensing boards (such as nursing, medical, dental, pharmacy and chiropractic examiners) and the Spinal Cord Commission, and sets staffing for some of them.

ar:SB380.title: TO REPEAL THE LAW REQUIRING THE OFFICE OF CHILD SUPPORT ENFORCEMENT TO SUBMIT A REPORT CONCERNING THE CHILD SUPPORT ENFORCEMENT PROGRAM.
ar:SB380.summary: Repeals the requirement that the Office of Child Support Enforcement file a semiannual performance report on the child support enforcement program with the Legislative Council.

ar:SB381.title: TO REPEAL THE LAW REQUIRING THE DEPARTMENT OF FINANCE AND ADMINISTRATION TO SUBMIT A REPORT CONCERNING THE ACTIVITIES OF THE MULTISTATE TAX COMMISSION AND ARKANSAS'S PARTICIPATION IN THE ACTIVITIES OF THE COMMISSION.
ar:SB381.summary: Repeals the requirement that the Department of Finance and Administration file an annual report on the Multistate Tax Commission and Arkansas's participation in its activities.

ar:SB382.title: TO REPEAL THE REQUIREMENT THAT THE ARKANSAS DEVELOPMENT FINANCE AUTHORITY SUBMIT A REPORT CONCERNING THE CAPITAL ACCESS FUND.
ar:SB382.summary: Repeals the requirement that the Arkansas Development Finance Authority report at least annually on the financial condition of the Capital Access Fund and the results of the programs it supports.

ar:SB383.title: TO REPEAL THE ANNUAL REPORT REQUIRED UNDER THE VENTURE CAPITAL INVESTMENT ACT OF 2001.
ar:SB383.summary: Repeals the annual report required of the designated investor group under the Venture Capital Investment Act of 2001.

ar:SB384.title: TO REPEAL THE REQUIREMENT THAT THE ARKANSAS DEVELOPMENT FINANCE AUTHORITY SUBMIT A PROGRAM FACT SHEET TO THE LEGISLATIVE COUNCIL AND ARKANSAS LEGISLATIVE AUDIT FOR EACH NEW BOND ISSUE.
ar:SB384.summary: Repeals the requirement that the Arkansas Development Finance Authority submit a program fact sheet on each new bond issue to the Legislative Council and Legislative Audit.

ar:SB385.title: TO REPEAL THE REQUIREMENT THAT THE RURAL SERVICES DIVISION OF THE ARKANSAS ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION SUBMIT A BIENNIAL REPORT CONCERNING THE ACTIVITIES OF THE DIVISION.
ar:SB385.summary: Repeals the requirement that the Rural Services Division of the Economic Development Commission submit a biennial report on its activities.

ar:SB387.title: TO REPEAL THE LAW REQUIRING OCCUPATIONAL LICENSING ENTITIES TO SUBMIT A REPORT CONCERNING THE NUMBER OF INDIVIDUALS GRANTED AUTOMATIC OCCUPATIONAL LICENSURE AND EXPEDITED OCCUPATIONAL LICENSURE.
ar:SB387.summary: Repeals the requirement that occupational licensing entities report annually to a House committee on the number of people granted automatic or expedited licensure under military member licensing laws.

ar:SB388.title: TO REPEAL THE ANNUAL REPORTING REQUIREMENT RELATED TO THE PROGRESS OF FOREIGN OFFICES OF THE ARKANSAS ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION.
ar:SB388.summary: Repeals the requirement that the Economic Development Commission report annually on the progress of its foreign offices to the Legislative Council, Joint Auditing Committee and Governor.

ar:SB389.title: TO REPEAL THE LAW REQUIRING THE SECRETARY OF THE DEPARTMENT OF FINANCE AND ADMINISTRATION TO SUBMIT A REPORT CONCERNING ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES.
ar:SB389.summary: Repeals the requirement that the Secretary of the Department of Finance and Administration make a biennial report to the Governor and General Assembly on alcoholic beverage activity, taxes and fees.

ar:SB390.title: TO ESTABLISH THE STATE APPRENTICESHIP AGENCY ACT.
ar:SB390.summary: Creates the State Apprenticeship Agency within the Office of Skills Development to register apprenticeship programs and resolve disputes, requires an application for federal recognition by December 31, 2025, and repeals the existing apprenticeship training subchapter.

ar:SB391.title: TO CREATE THE ROBOTICS COMPETITION GRANT PROGRAM FOR ELIGIBLE ROBOTICS TEAMS IN PUBLIC OR PRIVATE SCHOOLS FOR THE PURPOSE OF ENCOURAGING STUDY IN THE FIELDS OF SCIENCE, TECHNOLOGY, ENGINEERING, AND MATHEMATICS.
ar:SB391.summary: Creates a Department of Education grant program, subject to appropriation, for school robotics teams in grades 6-12, requiring a 25% match, an adult mentor and a sponsor, business or college partner, and capping mentor stipends at $1,500 per school year.

ar:SB392.title: TO AMEND ARKANSAS LAW CONCERNING THE CLASSIFICATION AND COMPENSATION OF STATE EMPLOYEES; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB392.summary: Creates a state employee student loan repayment program paying up to $10,000 per employee, and changes state employee classification and compensation law, including Office of Personnel Management duties.

ar:SB393.title: TO AMEND THE SEX OFFENDER REGISTRATION ACT OF 1997.
ar:SB393.summary: Requires lifetime sex offender registration for an offender who was more than 24 years old at the time of the offense when the victim was under 15. Names the act "Maighen's Law."

ar:SB397.title: TO PROTECT CONFIDENTIAL PERSONAL INFORMATION OF RAIL EMPLOYEES IN REPORTS INVOLVING RAILROAD FATALITIES.
ar:SB397.summary: Requires custodians to keep railroad crew members' personal information confidential in public records on railroad fatalities and redact it on release, except to the employing railroad, law enforcement, state attorneys, transportation staff, federal rail investigators or by court order.

ar:SB4.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH - LICENSING AND REGULATION BOARDS APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB4.summary: Appropriates money for salaries, extra help and operations of Department of Health licensing boards, including the medical, nursing, pharmacy, optometry, psychology and social work boards, for the 2026-27 fiscal year.

ar:SB400.title: TO AMEND THE FAIR-FUNDING PROGRAM.
ar:SB400.summary: Replaces the fair-funding program with Department of Agriculture financial assistance to livestock shows and fairs, adding annual operating plan and good-standing certificate requirements, allowing audits at any time, and barring state funds for association dues.

ar:SB401.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS UNDERGROUND FACILITIES DAMAGE PREVENTION ACT.
ar:SB401.summary: Exempts an operator's hand-tool excavation on its own right-of-way, to a depth of no more than 12 inches within 12 inches of its terminal, for purposes other than system maintenance and leak detection, from One Call Center notice requirements.

ar:SB402.title: TO PROHIBIT A PUBLIC SCHOOL DISTRICT AND AN EDUCATIONAL SERVICE COOPERATIVE FROM REQUIRING OR TAKING CERTAIN ACTIONS RELATED TO EMPLOYEE ORGANIZATIONS AND PROFESSIONAL ASSOCIATIONS.
ar:SB402.summary: Bars school districts and education service cooperatives from requiring employees to meet with an employee organization or professional association, distributing its membership solicitations, or giving such a group or a corporation more favorable access to their facilities and resources than others.

ar:SB403.title: TO CREATE THE THE 2030 ARKANSAS COMPLETE COUNT COMMITTEE; AND TO PLAN AND CONDUCT STATEWIDE EDUCATIONAL AND OUTREACH INITIATIVES TO INCREASE COMMUNITY AWARENESS AND PARTICIPATION IN THE 2030 FEDERAL DECENNIAL CENSUS.
ar:SB403.summary: Creates a 30-member 2030 Arkansas Complete Count Committee that advises state agencies and works to raise the state's response to the 2030 federal census, and recommends outreach appropriations, with reports due in 2026 and 2030.

ar:SB404.title: TO REQUIRE NOTIFICATION TO THE DEPARTMENT OF FINANCE AND ADMINISTRATION OF THE PROBATE OF AN ESTATE IF THE DEPARTMENT OF FINANCE AND ADMINISTRATION HAS FILED A CERTIFICATE OF INDEBTEDNESS AGAINST THE DECEDENT.
ar:SB404.summary: Requires notice of a decedent's estate probate to go to the Department of Finance and Administration if the department filed a certificate of indebtedness against the decedent.

ar:SB405.title: TO AMEND THE ONLINE MARKETPLACE CONSUMER INFORM ACT.
ar:SB405.summary: Amends the Online Marketplace Consumer Inform Act: gives online marketplaces ten days instead of 24 hours to collect bank, contact and tax information from high-volume third-party sellers, and ten days instead of three to verify it.

ar:SB406.title: TO REQUIRE A COUNTY RECORDER TO VERIFY CERTAIN INFORMATION BEFORE RECORDING A DEED TO REAL ESTATE.
ar:SB406.summary: Bars county recorders from accepting a real estate deed unless the grantor, or someone signing for the grantor, appears in person with a valid photo ID, with exceptions for deeds presented by attorneys, real estate brokers, lenders, title agents, and government representatives.

ar:SB407.title: TO REPEAL THE ARKANSAS CATFISH PROCESSOR FAIR PRACTICES ACT OF 1987.
ar:SB407.summary: Repeals the Arkansas Catfish Processor Fair Practices Act of 1987, which regulates payment and registration practices between catfish processors and producers.

ar:SB408.title: TO PROVIDE AN INCOME TAX EXEMPTION FOR CERTAIN PAYMENTS BY THE UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE.
ar:SB408.summary: Adds U.S. Department of Agriculture payments under programs in Division B, Title I, of the American Relief Act of 2025 to the payments exempt from Arkansas income tax, for tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2025.

ar:SB409.title: TO PROHIBIT DISCRIMINATION OF AGRICULTURAL PRODUCERS BY FINANCIAL SERVICES PROVIDERS; AND TO ESTABLISH THE FARMER PROTECTION ACT.
ar:SB409.summary: Adds agricultural producers (those growing crops or raising livestock or dairy) to the groups that financial services providers may not refuse to do business with based solely on their status, and to the state Treasurer's list of providers found to discriminate.

ar:SB41.title: AN ACT FOR THE UNIVERSITY OF ARKANSAS - FAYETTEVILLE APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB41.summary: Appropriates money for personal services and operating expenses of the University of Arkansas - Fayetteville for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, and sets its maximum staff positions and salary rates.

ar:SB410.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING PUBLIC OFFICERS AND EMPLOYEES; AND TO REQUIRE DISCLOSURE OF EMPLOYMENT FOR FORMER STATE EMPLOYEES AND FORMER ELECTED OFFICIALS.
ar:SB410.summary: Requires former state employees and elected officials, for four years after leaving, to disclose to the Ethics Commission work for or sales to entities that held contracts with their agency, filed within 30 days and then quarterly.

ar:SB411.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE HEIGHT OF VEHICLES; AND TO CREATE AN OFFENSE FOR THE OPERATION OF A VEHICLE WITH A MODIFIED BUMPER.
ar:SB411.summary: Makes it a violation to drive a car, pickup, SUV or panel truck on public roads with a modified suspension that puts the front bumper at least four inches higher than the rear, with $250 and $500 fines and license suspension on a third offense.

ar:SB412.title: TO AUTHORIZE THE DEPARTMENT OF FINANCE AND ADMINISTRATION TO SET THE PER-MILE AMOUNT FOR THE INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR TRAVEL AND TRANSPORTATION EXPENSES BY PROCLAMATION.
ar:SB412.summary: Has the Department of Finance and Administration Secretary set the income tax per-mile travel deduction by proclamation, capped at $1.00 per mile and set near the IRS rate, exempt from rulemaking requirements; updates cross-references.

ar:SB413.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING A SCHOOL DISTRICT BOARD OF DIRECTORS; AND TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE CERTIFICATION OF AN OATH FOR A SCHOOL BOARD DIRECTOR.
ar:SB413.summary: Changes the school board director oath process: the certification deadline runs ten days from notice rather than a date the clerk sets, and the county clerk commissions the director on receipt without accepting or rejecting the certification.

ar:SB414.title: TO AMEND THE ELECTION LAWS OF THE STATE OF ARKANSAS; AND TO AMEND ARKANSAS LAW CONCERNING NOTICES RELATED TO THE ELECTION PROCESS.
ar:SB414.summary: Lets county clerks notify new election commissioners of the oath requirement in writing instead of by registered mail; changes the clerk's notice to party committees from registered to certified mail, or email with read receipt if party chairs agree in writing.

ar:SB416.title: TO REPEAL THE ELECTRIC VEHICLE INFRASTRUCTURE GRANT PROGRAM; AND TO REPEAL THE ELECTRIC VEHICLE INFRASTRUCTURE FUND.
ar:SB416.summary: Repeals the Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Grant Program, which awards grants for Level 2 and Level 3 charging facilities, and the Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Fund.

ar:SB417.title: TO AMEND VARIOUS LAWS RELATED TO HIGHER EDUCATION.
ar:SB417.summary: Repeals several higher education requirements, including affirmative action plans and reports, written agreements between nearby colleges to avoid duplicating services, and the energy research committee, and changes which colleges are exempt from some state construction rules.

ar:SB42.title: AN ACT FOR THE OFFICE OF THE LIEUTENANT GOVERNOR APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2025-2026 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB42.summary: Appropriates $572,911 for fiscal year 2025-2026 to the Office of the Lieutenant Governor for salaries and operating expenses, and sets a maximum of five employees.

ar:SB420.title: TO EXPAND ELIGIBILITY FOR WATER DEVELOPMENT STATE PROGRAMS; TO AMEND THE WATER AUTHORITY ACT; AND TO AMEND THE USES OF THE CONSTRUCTION ASSISTANCE REVOLVING LOAN FUND.
ar:SB420.summary: Expands which water providers, including governmental entities and investor-owned water utilities, can form or convert to water authorities, lets a converting entity keep its corporate existence, and adjusts how the Construction Assistance Revolving Loan Fund defines eligible environmental projects and owners.

ar:SB421.title: TO AUTHORIZE THE ARKANSAS NATURAL RESOURCES COMMISSION TO ISSUE GENERAL OBLIGATION BONDS FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF WATER, WASTE DISPOSAL, AND POLLUTION ABATEMENT PROJECTS.
ar:SB421.summary: Authorizes the Natural Resources Commission to issue up to $500 million in general obligation bonds for water, waste disposal, pollution abatement and irrigation projects, subject to voter approval at the 2026 general election or a special election.

ar:SB422.title: TO ALLOW NONPROFIT ORGANIZATIONS TO CONTRIBUTE TO A NEW OR EXISTING ARKANSAS BRIGHTER FUTURE FUND PLAN ACCOUNT; AND TO REQUIRE THE TREASURER OF STATE TO FACILITATE CONTRIBUTIONS BY A NONPROFIT ORGANIZATION.
ar:SB422.summary: Allows 501(c)(3) nonprofit organizations to open and contribute to accounts in the Arkansas Brighter Future Fund college savings plan.

ar:SB424.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE ACCOUNTABILITY AND TRANSPARENCY OF A MUNICIPAL IMPROVEMENT DISTRICT.
ar:SB424.summary: Requires municipal improvement district boards to allow public comment on each agenda item before acting and to send the meeting agenda to property owners with the meeting notice, and rewords the quarterly-meeting requirement as meeting in each calendar quarter.

ar:SB425.title: TO AMEND VARIOUS PROVISIONS OF THE ARKANSAS CODE CONCERNING ENHANCED TRANSPORTATION; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB425.summary: Sets enhanced transportation funding amounts that the state education division distributes to each school district, for the 2025-2026 school year.

ar:SB426.title: TO CREATE THE DEFENSE AGAINST CRIMINAL ILLEGALS ACT; AND TO ESTABLISH ENHANCED PENALTIES FOR ILLEGAL ALIENS WHO COMMIT SERIOUS FELONIES INVOLVING VIOLENCE.
ar:SB426.summary: Adds up to 4, 10 or 20 years to sentences for serious violent felonies by people unlawfully in the U.S.; directs the Division of Correction and county jail sheriffs to apply to ICE's Warrant Service Officer Program; extends the sanctuary-policy ban to all local governments.

ar:SB428.title: CONCERNING A CIVIL CAUSE OF ACTION FOR VICTIMS OF HUMAN TRAFFICKING; AND TO PROVIDE A STATUTE OF LIMITATION PERIOD OF TEN YEARS FOR A VICTIM OF HUMAN TRAFFICKING.
ar:SB428.summary: Requires a human trafficking victim's civil lawsuit to be filed within 10 years of the date the plaintiff discovers the incident and that the defendant caused, was responsible for, or benefited from it.

ar:SB429.title: TO EXPAND THE SEALING OF CRIMINAL RECORDS FOR VICTIMS OF HUMAN TRAFFICKING; TO PROVIDE THAT VICTIMS OF HUMAN TRAFFICKING HAVE CERTAIN RIGHTS; AND TO PROVIDE A MANDATORY NO-CONTACT ORDER IN A HUMAN TRAFFICKING CASE.
ar:SB429.summary: Lets human trafficking victims petition to seal convictions from offenses committed as minors, or for prostitution as adults; extends crime-victim rights to human trafficking victims; requires a no-contact order when a defendant is charged under the Human Trafficking Act of 2013.

ar:SB43.title: AN ACT FOR THE UNIVERSITY OF ARKANSAS - DIVISION OF AGRICULTURE APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB43.summary: Appropriates money for personal services and operating expenses of the University of Arkansas - Division of Agriculture for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, and sets its maximum staff positions and salary rates.

ar:SB430.title: AN ACT TO REQUIRE MANDATORY RESTITUTION TO BE AWARDED TO A VICTIM OF HUMAN TRAFFICKING; AND TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS CRIME VICTIMS REPARATIONS ACT.
ar:SB430.summary: Requires courts to order people convicted of human trafficking to pay restitution to victims, covering medical and psychological care, transportation, housing, child care, property loss, relocation and prosecution costs, and extends the crime victims reparations claim deadline from one year to five.

ar:SB431.title: TO AMEND THE HUMAN TRAFFICKING ACT OF 2013; TO ELIMINATE THE STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS FOR CERTAIN OFFENSES; TO CREATE SAFE HARBORS FOR VICTIMS; AND TO PROHIBIT CERTAIN SEXUALLY EXPLICIT PRODUCTS THAT RESEMBLE A CHILD.
ar:SB431.summary: Removes the statute of limitations for trafficking of persons and related offenses, makes possessing, transporting, distributing or manufacturing a child sex doll a felony, and revises the trafficking affirmative defense.

ar:SB432.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING ACCOUNTANTS; AND TO AMEND THE DEFINITION OF SUBSTANTIAL EQUIVALENCY FOR THE PRACTICE OF ACCOUNTANCY.
ar:SB432.summary: Revises accountancy law: waives exam fees at application for applicants in certain board programs, lets the Board of Public Accountancy set substantial-equivalency rules for out-of-state CPAs, and changes license reinstatement and practice review rules.

ar:SB433.title: REGARDING THE DISPLAY OF THE NATIONAL MOTTO AND THE TEN COMMANDMENTS.
ar:SB433.summary: Adds a Ten Commandments poster or framed copy, at least 16 by 20 inches, to the national motto display in public school and college classrooms and libraries and taxpayer-funded public buildings, using donations or voluntary contributions.

ar:SB435.title: TO CREATE THE CRIMINAL OFFENSE OF AGGRAVATED ASSAULT UPON A HEALTHCARE WORKER; AND TO DEFINE "HEALTHCARE WORKER" REGARDING ASSAULT AND BATTERY.
ar:SB435.summary: Creates the Class D felony of aggravated assault upon a healthcare worker for purposely throwing or transferring saliva, blood, urine, feces or other bodily fluid onto a known healthcare worker, and defines "healthcare worker" to include support staff.

ar:SB437.title: TO CREATE THE ARKANSAS WIND ENERGY DEVELOPMENT ACT.
ar:SB437.summary: Creates the Arkansas Wind Energy Development Act, requiring Public Service Commission permits for wind farms, with turbine setbacks of the greater of 3.5 times turbine height or 2,500 feet from nonparticipating neighbors' property lines, one mile from schools, hospitals, churches and towns, and decommissioning rules.

ar:SB439.title: TO AMEND THE DUTIES OF THE SECRETARY OF THE DEPARTMENT OF LABOR AND LICENSING; AND TO AMEND PORTIONS OF ARKANSAS CODE WHICH RESULTED FROM INITIATED ACT 1 OF 1914.
ar:SB439.summary: Replaces references to the Director of the Division of Labor with the Department of Labor and Licensing or its Secretary throughout state labor, boiler, mining and related laws, shifting those duties and rulemaking powers.

ar:SB440.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING EMBALMERS AND FUNERAL DIRECTORS; TO REGULATE THE USE OF ALKALINE HYDROLYSIS; AND TO REGULATE ALKALINE HYDROLYSIS FACILITIES.
ar:SB440.summary: Creates licensing and facility standards for alkaline hydrolysis of human remains, requires a funeral establishment's full-time manager to live within 50 miles, and changes the public notice and protest steps for crematorium construction permits.

ar:SB441.title: TO CREATE THE JUNK LAWSUIT PREVENTION ACT OF 2025.
ar:SB441.summary: Requires a consumer to give a business 30 days' written notice before suing for damages over non-insurance discount health cards, and bars the suit if the business cures the violation and confirms it in writing. Applies retroactively to January 1, 2021.

ar:SB442.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING HUMAN TRAFFICKING; TO PROVIDE FOR FORFEITURE OF ASSETS USED TO CONDUCT HUMAN TRAFFICKING; AND TO CREATE THE OFFENSE OF HARBORING AN ENDANGERED RUNAWAY CHILD.
ar:SB442.summary: Subjects property used in human trafficking to forfeiture on conviction, creates the offense of harboring an endangered runaway minor for 72 hours or more (Class A misdemeanor, then Class D felony), and sends related fines to the Arkansas Human Trafficking Council Support Fund.

ar:SB445.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE LICENSURE OF ELECTRICAL INSPECTORS.
ar:SB445.summary: Sets who may apply for an electrical inspector license (master or journeyman electricians, or certified inspectors with required experience) and requires newly hired licensed inspectors to attend a two-day state training.

ar:SB446.title: TO AMEND THE AUTOMATIC LICENSE PLATE READER SYSTEM ACT; AND TO PROVIDE FOR THE USE OF AUTOMATIC LICENSE PLATE READERS BY PRIVATE LANDOWNERS, PRIVATE LEASEHOLDER, AND COMMERCIAL BUSINESSES.
ar:SB446.summary: Allows private landowners, leaseholders and commercial businesses to use automatic license plate readers to monitor access to their property, limits their data retention to 60 days, bars selling the data, and requires a subpoena for government to compel its release.

ar:SB447.title: TO REQUIRE PERMITTED COMMON CARRIERS TO SUBMIT REPORTS DETAILING SHIPMENTS OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES INTO THE STATE.
ar:SB447.summary: Requires common carriers that ship alcoholic beverages to Arkansas consumers to submit quarterly shipment reports to the Department of Finance and Administration.

ar:SB448.title: TO AUTHORIZE THE FINANCING OF ENERGY EFFICIENCY IMPROVEMENTS, ALTERNATIVE ENERGY IMPROVEMENTS, BUILDING RESILIENCY IMPROVEMENTS, AND WATER CONSERVATION IMPROVEMENTS.
ar:SB448.summary: Amends the Property Assessed Clean Energy law to let local governments set up direct-financing programs where capital providers fund energy-efficiency, alternative-energy, resiliency and water-conservation improvements on commercial, industrial, agricultural, nonprofit and 5-plus-unit multifamily property, repaid by special assessments.

ar:SB449.title: TO PROVIDE CIVIL IMMUNITY FOR CONFISCATION OF ALTERNATIVE NICOTINE PRODUCTS, VAPOR PRODUCTS, E-LIQUID PRODUCTS, TOBACCO PRODUCTS, AND CIGARETTE PAPERS FROM A MINOR AT A SCHOOL.
ar:SB449.summary: Gives law enforcement officers, school employees and others in authority civil immunity for confiscating nicotine, tobacco, vapor or e-liquid products, or cigarette papers, from anyone under 21 at a school.

ar:SB45.title: TO AUTHORIZE THE CREATION OF THE WOMEN VETERANS SPECIAL LICENSE PLATE; AND TO REPEAL THE PEARL HARBOR SURVIVOR LICENSE PLATE.
ar:SB45.summary: Creates a Women Veterans special license plate for women veterans of the armed forces, with a $15 design-use contribution beyond regular fees, and ends issuance of the Pearl Harbor Survivor plate.

ar:SB450.title: TO REQUIRE THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION TO INCLUDE A HUMAN FETAL GROWTH AND DEVELOPMENT DISCUSSION IN THE RELEVANT STANDARDS DURING THE ARKANSAS ACADEMIC STANDARDS REVISION CYCLE.
ar:SB450.summary: Requires the Department of Education to add a human fetal growth and development lesson, from fertilization to birth and including a high-definition ultrasound, to academic standards in the standards revision cycle, with grade levels set in consultation with the Department of Health.

ar:SB451.title: TO REQUIRE THE DEPARTMENT OF HUMAN SERVICES AND THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION TO ESTABLISH REGIONAL BEHAVIORAL HEALTH PROGRAMS; TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE EDUCATION OF CERTAIN STUDENTS; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB451.summary: Requires the Department of Human Services, with the Department of Education, to set up regional behavioral health programs by January 1, 2026, respond within 48 hours to school requests about students likely to injure themselves or others, develop management plans, and find funding.

ar:SB454.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING UNCLAIMED PROPERTY FUNDS; TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE DEPOSIT AND INVESTMENT OF UNCLAIMED PROPERTY FUNDS; TO CREATE THE UNCLAIMED PROPERTY INTEREST TRUST FUND; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB454.summary: Creates the Unclaimed Property Interest Trust Fund to hold interest earned on invested unclaimed property funds, and uses it first to reimburse the State Central Services Fund for the cost of administering unclaimed property law.

ar:SB457.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE RELEASE FROM PAROLE OR POST-RELEASE SUPERVISION OF CERTAIN PERSONS WHO COMMITTED CRIMES WHEN THEY WERE UNDER THE AGE OF EIGHTEEN.
ar:SB457.summary: Changes early discharge from parole for people who offended as minors: instead of requiring prosecutor consent, the Post-Prison Transfer Board notifies the prosecutor, who has 60 days to object and block the discharge.

ar:SB458.title: TO REQUIRE A COURT TO CONSIDER THE IMPACT OF FACTORS SUCH AS TRAUMA AND INVOLVEMENT WITH THE CHILD WELFARE SYSTEM ON A PERSON WHO COMMITTED A CRIME AS A MINOR DURING A TRANSFER OR SENTENCING HEARING.
ar:SB458.summary: Requires a court in a juvenile transfer or sentencing hearing to consider factors such as trauma and involvement with the child welfare system in the life of a person who committed a crime as a minor.

ar:SB459.title: TO AMEND THE MINIMUM AGE NECESSARY TO ADJUDICATE A JUVENILE DELINQUENT.
ar:SB459.summary: Sets ten years old as the minimum age at which a child can be adjudicated a delinquent juvenile in Arkansas.

ar:SB46.title: TO REFLECT A MERGER BETWEEN THE UNIVERSITY OF ARKANSAS AND EAST ARKANSAS COMMUNITY COLLEGE BY CHANGING THE NAME OF EAST ARKANSAS COMMUNITY COLLEGE TO THE UNIVERSITY OF ARKANSAS EAST ARKANSAS COMMUNITY COLLEGE.
ar:SB46.summary: Renames East Arkansas Community College the University of Arkansas East Arkansas Community College to reflect its merger with the University of Arkansas, repeals the merger statutes, and updates related funding, vehicle, position and procurement provisions.

ar:SB460.title: TO MODIFY THE COMPLIANCE ADVISORY PANEL; TO REPEAL THE MARKETING RECYCLABLES PROGRAM OF THE COMPLIANCE ADVISORY PANEL; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB460.summary: Cuts the Compliance Advisory Panel from nine members to seven and repeals its Marketing Recyclables Program.

ar:SB463.title: TO REQUIRE THE ARKANSAS PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION TO APPROVE OR DENY SETTLEMENT AGREEMENTS CONCERNING CLOSING OR ELIMINATING ELECTRIC GENERATION UNITS OR TRANSMISSION ASSETS.
ar:SB463.summary: Requires Public Service Commission approval before a utility enters a settlement or consent decree to close or decommission an electric generation unit or transmission asset in Arkansas; approval needs clear and convincing evidence of a reasonable legal basis, no above-regulation consumer costs, and prudence.

ar:SB464.title: TO AMEND THE LAWS CONCERNING SALES OF RAW MILK; TO ALLOW SALES OF RAW MILK AND RAW MILK PRODUCTS AT LOCATIONS OTHER THAN THE FARM WHERE THE RAW MILK OR RAW MILK PRODUCT WAS PRODUCED; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB464.summary: Extends the raw milk direct-sales law to raw milk products like cheese and yogurt and to natural food stores, removes the 500-gallon monthly limit, and sets warning-label, refrigeration and signed-acknowledgment rules for off-farm product sales.

ar:SB467.title: TO MODIFY THE DEFINITION OF "HEALTHCARE PROVIDER" REGARDING STUDENT ATHLETE CONCUSSION EDUCATION TO INCLUDE CHIROPRACTORS OR CHIROPRACTIC PHYSICIANS.
ar:SB467.summary: Adds chiropractors and chiropractic physicians to the list of healthcare providers covered by the student athlete concussion education law.

ar:SB468.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING FLUORIDATION OF A PUBLIC WATER SYSTEM; AND TO ALLOWS VOTERS TO ELECT "FOR" OR "AGAINST" WATER FLUORIDATION IN THE COUNTY.
ar:SB468.summary: Lets voters in counties served by a public water system of 5,000 or more people hold a fluoridation election, called by petition of 5% of circuit clerk votes cast or a quorum court vote; if each county's majority votes against, fluoridation ends within 30 days.

ar:SB469.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING COUNTY CAMPAIGN POLITICAL PARTY COMMITTEES; AND TO AMEND PORTIONS OF INITIATED ACT 1 OF 1996.
ar:SB469.summary: Raises from $5,000 to $10,000 the amount a county political party committee may accept from any one person in a calendar year.

ar:SB470.title: TO REQUIRE AN ADULT APPROVED TO OVERSEE THE ADMINISTRATION OF A STATEWIDE STUDENT ASSESSMENT TO CERTAIN STUDENTS IN A VIRTUAL SETTING TO MEET CERTAIN REQUIREMENTS.
ar:SB470.summary: Limits the requirement that an approved adult be physically present for a virtual school student's statewide assessment to grades K-8; for grades 9-12, requires the adult to attest beforehand that testing security protocols will be followed.

ar:SB471.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING CANDIDATES FOR NONPARTISAN ELECTIONS; AND TO ALLOW CERTAIN CANDIDATES FOR NONPARTISAN ELECTIONS TO USE THE TITLE OF THE NONPARTISAN JUDICIAL OFFICE ON THE BALLOT.
ar:SB471.summary: Expands which nonpartisan judicial candidates may use a judicial title on the ballot: appointees serving 12 months in any nonpartisan judicial office, and candidates who previously served in a nonpartisan judicial office.

ar:SB473.title: TO AMEND THE DUTIES OF THE ARKANSAS FIRE PROTECTION SERVICES BOARD; AND TO PROVIDE FOR THE ARKANSAS FIRE PROTECTION SERVICES BOARD TO ADVISE THE ARKANSAS FIRE TRAINING ACADEMY ON CERTAIN MATTERS.
ar:SB473.summary: Changes the Fire Protection Services Board's role from overseeing the Fire Training Academy to advising its director on training, certification and curriculum.

ar:SB475.title: TO ESTABLISH THE PHARMACY SERVICES ADMINISTRATIVE ORGANIZATION ACT; AND TO REGULATE PHARMACY SERVICES ADMINISTRATIVE ORGANIZATIONS.
ar:SB475.summary: Creates a licensing system for pharmacy services administrative organizations under the State Insurance Department, requiring contract and ownership disclosures to pharmacies, payers and the department, and barring required purchases from affiliated drug sellers.

ar:SB478.title: TO CREATE THE ARKANSAS DIESEL ENGINE FREEDOM ACT OF 2025; AND TO PROHIBIT STATE ENFORCEMENT OF FEDERAL REGULATION OF CERTAIN TYPES OF DIESEL ENGINES.
ar:SB478.summary: Declares federal diesel exhaust fluid requirements invalid in Arkansas for diesel engines operated only in the state, bars state agencies and local governments from enforcing them or restricting such engines, and sets civil penalties of up to $5,000 per violation for state entities.

ar:SB479.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING VOTER ASSISTANCE; AND TO REQUIRE A PERSON ASSISTING A VOTER WITH A DISABILITY TO PRESENT IDENTIFICATION.
ar:SB479.summary: Requires identification presented by someone assisting a voter with a disability to meet State Board of Election Commissioners rules, which the Board must adopt, and requires poll workers to list each assistor's name as shown on it.

ar:SB480.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE INVESTMENT OF STATE FUNDS.
ar:SB480.summary: Removes municipal warrants, prerefunded municipal bonds and overnight federal funds sales from securities the State Treasurer may buy with state funds, requires an investment-grade rating from one agency instead of two for corporate obligations, and limits the competitive-procedure rule to sales.

ar:SB481.title: TO CREATE A MORE SUSTAINABLE SYSTEM OF PROPERTY INSURANCE FOR PUBLIC SCHOOLS, STATE-SUPPORTED INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION, AND STATE-OWNED PROPERTY; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB481.summary: Transfers property insurance programs for public schools, state colleges and universities, and state-owned buildings to a State Captive Insurance Program, and directs state agencies to coordinate coverage requirements with it.

ar:SB483.title: TO REPEAL CERTAIN REPORTING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE STATE INSURANCE DEPARTMENT AND THE STATE SECURITIES DEPARTMENT; AND TO REVISE CERTAIN REPORTING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE STATE INSURANCE DEPARTMENT.
ar:SB483.summary: Repeals the State Securities Department's quarterly report to the Legislative Council on court-ordered and settlement funds, and repeals or changes several annual and periodic insurance reporting requirements.

ar:SB484.title: TO ESTABLISH A PROCESS WHEREBY A VACANCY IS FILLED ON A SCHOOL DISTRICT BOARD OF DIRECTORS.
ar:SB484.summary: Changes school board vacancy rules: remaining directors have 90 days, up from 30 or 60, to appoint a qualified resident elector; the county quorum court appoints if they fail or too few remain; districts must post notice 30 days ahead.

ar:SB485.title: TO REDUCE RECIDIVISM; AND TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE SUSPENDED IMPOSITION OF A SENTENCE, PROBATION, PAROLE, AND POST-RELEASE SUPERVISION.
ar:SB485.summary: Requires courts and the parole board to narrowly tailor supervision conditions to rehabilitation, public safety, and risks and needs; changes jail credit against unpaid fines from $40 to $100 a day; and adds rewards to community supervision sanctions.

ar:SB486.title: CONCERNING SAFETY AND PRIVACY IN CERTAIN ENTITIES; AND CONCERNING THE DESIGNATION OF MULTI-OCCUPANCY RESTROOMS, CHANGING ROOMS, AND SLEEPING QUARTERS IN CERTAIN ENTITIES BASED ON AN INDIVIDUAL'S SEX.
ar:SB486.summary: Requires shelters, state and local correctional facilities and public buildings to designate multi-occupancy restrooms, changing rooms and sleeping quarters for males or females only, defined by biological sex, limits use to that sex with exceptions, and lets people sue facilities allowing opposite-sex use.

ar:SB487.title: TO AMEND THE LAW ON THE DESTRUCTION OR EXPUNGEMENT OF JUVENILE DELINQUENCY RECORDS.
ar:SB487.summary: Changes juvenile record expungement: records of delinquency adjudications other than violent felonies are expunged at age 21, no longer including dependency-neglect or families-in-need-of-services records, and "expunge" means seal instead of destroy.

ar:SB488.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING WHEN A JUVENILE IS CONSIDERED TO BE ADJUDICATED DELINQUENT.
ar:SB488.summary: Revises juvenile code definitions of "delinquent juvenile" and "juvenile" to turn on age at the time of the offense, including people under 18 then who have since reached adulthood, and revises related commitment wording.

ar:SB489.title: TO AMEND ARKANSAS LAW CONCERNING THE PLACEMENT OF A MONUMENT ON THE STATE CAPITOL GROUNDS IN RECOGNITION OF THE DESEGREGATION OF THE CHARLESTON AND FAYETTEVILLE SCHOOL DISTRICTS IN 1954.
ar:SB489.summary: Requires the Secretary of State to arrange a monument on State Capitol grounds commemorating the 1954 school desegregation in Charleston and Fayetteville, and creates a trust fund of donations for erecting and maintaining it.

ar:SB490.title: TO ALLOW A COURT TO WAIVE CERTAIN FEES WHEN A JUVENILE IS ORDERED TO REGISTER AS A SEX OFFENDER.
ar:SB490.summary: Lets a circuit court waive the $250 registration fee when a juvenile is ordered to register as a sex offender.

ar:SB491.title: TO REQUIRE A VENDOR THAT CONTRACTS WITH THE EMPLOYEE BENEFITS DIVISION TO SUBMIT DATA FOR VERIFICATION BY AN INDEPENDENT AUDIT; TO IMPOSE A CIVIL PENALTY ON A VENDOR THAT PROVIDES INACCURATE DATA; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB491.summary: Requires the state employee benefits division to contract only with vendors that agree to independent audits of their data; vendors found to have given inaccurate data face civil penalties of $500, then $1,000 per later violation, and possible loss of licensure.

ar:SB495.title: TO AMEND DEFINITIONS USED UNDER THE ARKANSAS TOBACCO PRODUCTS TAX ACT OF 1977; AND TO AMEND THE DEFINITION OF "INVOICE" AND THE DEFINITION OF "INVOICE PRICE" USED UNDER THE ARKANSAS TOBACCO PRODUCTS TAX ACT OF 1977.
ar:SB495.summary: Adds the physical address and permit number of the permitted seller and buyer to the definition of "invoice" under the Tobacco Products Tax Act, and adds a fallback to similar wholesalers' or retailers' prices when setting "invoice price."

ar:SB496.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING PERMITS FOR SPECIAL CARGOES; AND TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE ISSUANCE OF A PERMIT FOR SPECIAL CARGO TRANSPORTED BY A FARM MACHINERY EQUIPMENT HAULER.
ar:SB496.summary: Changes "farm machinery equipment dealer" to "farm machinery equipment hauler" in the special cargo permit law, covering the delivery and repair-pickup exemption and the one-year permit for loads up to 12 feet wide.

ar:SB497.title: TO REQUIRE THE CREATION OF A POSTER REGARDING VETERANS' BENEFITS AND SERVICES; AND TO REQUIRE CERTAIN EMPLOYERS TO DISPLAY THE POSTER.
ar:SB497.summary: Requires the Department of Labor and Licensing to create a veterans' benefits and services poster, which employers with 50 or more full-time-equivalent employees must display in a conspicuous workplace location.

ar:SB498.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING DISCLOSURE OF DRIVER AND VEHICLE RECORDS AND TO PROTECT DRIVER AND VEHICLE RECORDS FROM PUBLIC DISCLOSURE.
ar:SB498.summary: Limits who may receive motor vehicle registration and driver records, such as owners, authorized persons, courts and attorneys, and repeals provisions making these records open to public inspection.

ar:SB5.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH - ARKANSAS TOBACCO SETTLEMENT COMMISSION APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB5.summary: Appropriates money for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, for personal services, operating expenses and grants of the Arkansas Tobacco Settlement Commission to monitor and evaluate spending from the Tobacco Settlement Program Fund.

ar:SB500.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING LEVEE DISTRICTS; AND TO ALLOW A LEVEE DISTRICT CREATED BY AN ACT OF THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY TO ADOPT PROCEDURE CONCERNING THE COLLECTION OF ASSESSMENTS.
ar:SB500.summary: Lets a levee district created by a special act ask the county collector to extend its assessments on the tax books and collect them with property taxes, and removes the Crawford County Levee District's sheriff-collection provision.

ar:SB503.title: TO REDUCE THE NUMBER OF EMPLOYEES AN EMPLOYER MUST HAVE TO BE MANDATED TO FILE AN ANNUAL INCOME TAX WITHHOLDING STATEMENT ELECTRONICALLY; AND TO REQUIRE THE ELECTRONIC FILING OF A WITHHOLDING RETURN FOR CERTAIN EMPLOYERS.
ar:SB503.summary: Lowers from 125 to 75 the number of employees at which an employer must file its annual income tax withholding statement electronically, and requires those employers to also file withholding returns electronically, with hardship waivers available.

ar:SB504.title: TO ESTABLISH THE ARKANSAS RURAL PRECEPTORSHIP PROGRAM ACT.
ar:SB504.summary: Creates the Arkansas Rural Preceptorship Program, administered by the Division of Higher Education, which reimburses participating medical schools at a per diem rate for up to three weeks of a medical student's placement at a rural healthcare facility.

ar:SB505.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING MUNICIPAL PLANNING; AND TO REQUIRE AN ADMINISTRATIVE PROCEDURE FOR CHANGES TO THE ZONING OR DISTRICT DESIGNATION OF PROPERTY IN CERTAIN INSTANCES.
ar:SB505.summary: Lets a city ordinance set an administrative procedure for owner-requested zoning changes that fit the adopted land use plan, skipping the usual public hearing and notice steps. Decisions can be appealed to the planning commission.

ar:SB507.title: TO REQUIRE THE ARKANSAS MEDICAID PROGRAM TO COVER APPLIED BEHAVIOR ANALYSIS SERVICES FOR CERTAIN BENEFICIARIES.
ar:SB507.summary: Requires Arkansas Medicaid to cover applied behavior analysis services, including one-on-one home and community services, for adults over 21 with autism in the Community and Employment Services Waiver who have a physician, psychologist or psychiatrist's medical necessity determination.

ar:SB508.title: TO AMEND THE FREQUENCY OF PAYMENT OF A STIPEND FOR CERTAIN MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC SCHOOL EMPLOYEE HEALTH BENEFIT ADVISORY COMMISSION AND THE STATE EMPLOYEE HEALTH BENEFIT ADVISORY COMMISSION.
ar:SB508.summary: Changes the $100 stipend for non-employee members of the public school and state employee health benefit advisory commissions from monthly to per meeting, plus mileage.

ar:SB51.title: AN ACT FOR THE AUDITOR OF STATE - OPERATIONS AND UNCLAIMED PROPERTY PROGRAM APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB51.summary: Appropriates money for personal services and operating expenses of the Auditor of State - Operations and Unclaimed Property Program for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, and sets its maximum staff positions and salary rates.

ar:SB510.title: TO ALLOW FOR THE CROSS DEPUTIZATION OF MUNICIPAL, COUNTY, STATE, AND TRIBAL LAW ENFORCEMENT ON FEDERALLY-RECOGNIZED TRIBAL LAND WITHIN THE STATE.
ar:SB510.summary: Lets municipalities, counties and the state agree with tribal nations to cross-deputize law enforcement, so officers can enforce tribal, state and local laws on federally recognized tribal land and surrounding jurisdictions.

ar:SB511.title: TO CREATE THE CRIMINAL OFFENSE OF AUTOMATED TELLER MACHINE IMPAIRMENT.
ar:SB511.summary: Creates the Class D felony of automated teller machine impairment, covering purposely removing an ATM or interrupting its use in whole or in part.

ar:SB513.title: TO CREATE THE CRIMINAL OFFENSE OF MAIL THEFT; AND TO CREATE THE CRIMINAL OFFENSE OF THEFT OR UNAUTHORIZED REPRODUCTION OF A MAIL RECEPTACLE KEY OR LOCK.
ar:SB513.summary: Creates the felony of mail theft, and of stealing or unlawfully copying a mail receptacle key or lock, punishable as a Class D felony for a first offense and Class A for later offenses, with restitution.

ar:SB514.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE UNLAWFUL POSSESSION OF A SKIMMER; AND TO INCREASE PENALTIES FOR THE UNLAWFUL POSSESSION OF A SKIMMER FOR REPEAT OFFENDERS.
ar:SB514.summary: Sets a second or later conviction for unlawfully possessing a card skimmer as an unclassified felony with a mandatory fine up to $20,000 and one to ten years in prison.

ar:SB515.title: TO REQUIRE THAT A UNIT DEDICATED TO ARKANSAS VETERANS AND THEIR FAMILIES BE INCLUDED WITHIN EXISTING ARKANSAS HISTORY COURSE CONTENT GUIDELINES.
ar:SB515.summary: Requires the state education division, starting 2025-26, to add a unit on Arkansas veterans and their families to existing Arkansas history course guidelines, developed with veterans' organizations.

ar:SB516.title: TO ALLOW A PERSON FILING AS A CANDIDATE FOR THE OFFICE OF JUSTICE OF THE SUPREME COURT OR JUDGE OF THE COURT OF APPEALS WHO IS AN APPOINTEE IN THAT POSITION TO USE THE TITLE OF THAT POSITION AS A PREFIX WHEN FILING AS A CANDIDATE.
ar:SB516.summary: Adds Supreme Court justices and Court of Appeals judges to the appointed judges who may use their judicial title on the ballot, if they have served in that position at least 12 months.

ar:SB519.title: TO AMEND THE STANDARD NONFORFEITURE LAW FOR LIFE INSURANCE; AND TO REGULATE THE PAYMENT OF INTEREST ON DEFERRED PAYMENT OF ANY CASH SURRENDER VALUE ACCORDING TO THE TERMS OF THE POLICY.
ar:SB519.summary: Keeps the insurer's right to defer paying a life policy's cash surrender value for six months, but from January 1, 2026 requires the death benefit to stay in force and interest if payment is not made within 45 days of demand.

ar:SB520.title: TO PROHIBIT DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION OFFICES, OFFICERS, POLICIES, OR PRACTICES IN LOCAL GOVERNMENT.
ar:SB520.summary: Bars counties, cities and towns from establishing diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives or requiring diversity statements, bars treating people differently by race, ethnicity, sex, color or national origin (with a sex exception), and lets citizens sue if a violation continues 30 days after notice.

ar:SB521.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING LAW ENFORCEMENT TRAINING REIMBURSEMENT; AND TO EXTEND THE TIME PERIOD AFTER COMPLETION OF TRAINING FOR WHICH REIMBURSEMENT IS REQUIRED.
ar:SB521.summary: Extends from 18 to 24 months the period after academy training in which a new employing law enforcement agency must reimburse training costs, with full reimbursement within 12 months and 50% from 12 to 24 months.

ar:SB522.title: TO AMEND THE LAW REGARDING THE ARKANSAS SCHOOL FOR MATHEMATICS, SCIENCES, AND THE ARTS; AND TO AMEND THE LAW RELATED TO THE TUITION AND FEES PAID BY STUDENTS ENROLLED IN THE ONLINE PROGRAMS.
ar:SB522.summary: Limits free tuition, fees, and room and board at the Arkansas School for Mathematics, Sciences, and the Arts to Arkansas-resident students in its residential programs; students in its online programs pay tuition and fees set by the University of Arkansas trustees.

ar:SB523.title: TO AMEND THE LAW REGARDING ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES; AND TO REMOVE THE REQUIREMENT THAT A PRIVATE CLUB BE A NONPROFIT ORGANIZATION.
ar:SB523.summary: Removes the requirement that a private club be a nonprofit, letting corporations, partnerships, LLCs and sole proprietorships hold private club alcohol permits, and repeals permit violations tied to membership books, guestbooks, unauthorized guests and serving nonmembers.

ar:SB525.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING INCORPORATION AND ORGANIZATION OF MUNICIPALITIES; AND TO TRANSFER INCORPORATION DUTIES TO THE SECRETARY OF STATE.
ar:SB525.summary: Moves approval of new city and town incorporations from county courts to the Secretary of State, lowers the petition minimum from 200 to 75 signatures, and has county clerks verify signatures within 30 days and forward verified petitions.

ar:SB527.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS HEALTH AND OPPORTUNITY FOR ME ACT OF 2021; AND TO INCREASE THE MEDICAL-LOSS RATIO IN THE ARKANSAS HEALTH AND OPPORTUNITY FOR ME PROGRAM.
ar:SB527.summary: Extends the Arkansas Health and Opportunity for Me program's sunset to December 31, 2031, raises the required medical-loss ratio for individual plans from 80% to 85% (or insurers rebate the difference), and has the Department of Human Services track pharmacy rebates remitted to the state.

ar:SB529.title: TO AMEND THE INDEPENDENT TAX APPEALS COMMISSION ACT.
ar:SB529.summary: Changes the Tax Appeals Commission law: defines a small claim as under $10,000 in disputed tax with a streamlined process, lets commissioners qualify with five years of Arkansas tax experience, and removes the staff attorney and accountant hiring requirements.

ar:SB530.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS WOOD ENERGY PRODUCTS AND FOREST MAINTENANCE INCOME TAX CREDIT.
ar:SB530.summary: Changes the wood energy products tax credit: lowers it from 30% to 20% of equipment costs, raises required project investment from $50 million to $1 billion and new jobs from 100 to 400, moves the closing-date deadline to June 30, 2028, and covers wood byproducts.

ar:SB533.title: TO PROVIDE FOR THE REGULATION OF CONSUMABLE HEMP PRODUCTS BY THE ARKANSAS TOBACCO CONTROL BOARD; AND TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS LAW TO ALLOW REGULATION AND PURCHASE OF CONSUMABLE HEMP PRODUCTS.
ar:SB533.summary: Has Arkansas Tobacco Control regulate consumable hemp products through annual permits with criminal background checks, denies permits to people convicted of a felony, makes manufacturing, marketing or selling intoxicating hemp products a felony, and revises the industrial hemp definition.

ar:SB534.title: TO ESTABLISH THE ARKANSAS KRATOM CONSUMER PROTECTION ACT; AND TO REMOVE MITRAGYNINE AND 7-HYDROXYMITRAGYNINE, ALSO KNOWN AS KRATOM, FROM THE CONTROLLED SUBSTANCES LIST IN ARKANSAS.
ar:SB534.summary: Creates the Arkansas Kratom Consumer Protection Act: bars processors from selling adulterated or contaminated kratom products, bars processors and retailers from selling to anyone under 18, requires annual product registration with the Department of Agriculture, and sets administrative fines up to $500, then $1,000.

ar:SB535.title: TO CREATE A SALES AND USE TAX EXEMPTION FOR THE ARKANSAS MUSEUM OF FINE ARTS AND THE ARKANSAS MUSEUM OF FINE ARTS FOUNDATION.
ar:SB535.summary: Exempts purchases by the Arkansas Museum of Fine Arts and the Arkansas Museum of Fine Arts Foundation from state sales tax, effective the first day of the calendar quarter after the act takes effect.

ar:SB536.title: TO ABOLISH AND TRANSFER THE ARKANSAS STATE LIBRARY AND THE STATE LIBRARY BOARD; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB536.summary: Abolishes the Arkansas State Library and State Library Board and transfers their powers, staff, property and funds to the Department of Education, with some duties moving to the State Archives.

ar:SB537.title: TO CREATE THE EARNING SAFE REENTRY THROUGH WORK ACT; AND TO CREATE A SENTENCE CREDIT PROGRAM FOR A PERSON ON PROBATION, PAROLE, OR POST-RELEASE SUPERVISION TO EARN TIME CREDITS THROUGH EMPLOYMENT; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB537.summary: Creates work-for-time credits, giving supervised offenders on probation, parole or post-release supervision five days off their sentence for each 30 days of verified employment of at least 130 hours; credits are forfeited on revocation or new conviction.

ar:SB538.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS PROCUREMENT LAW.
ar:SB538.summary: Changes procurement law to let agencies find bids or proposals unrealistically low (or proposals unreasonably high), requires negotiators to be trained and certified, and requires the procurement director to update materials within 120 days of law changes.

ar:SB539.title: TO UPDATE AND CLARIFY CERTAIN PORTIONS OF THE LAW REGARDING THE DIVISION OF COMMUNITY CORRECTION AND THE DIVISION OF CORRECTION; TO CLARIFY REFERENCES TO COMMUNITY CORRECTION CENTERS; AND TO DECLARE AN EMERGENCY.
ar:SB539.summary: Transfers community correction center operations to the Division of Correction and the sex offender community notification section to the Department of Corrections, and updates sentencing, probation and parole laws to match; declares an emergency.

ar:SB540.title: TO LIMIT THE SUSPENSION OR REVOCATION OF A DRIVER'S LICENSE OR IMPOSITION OF RESTRICTIONS ON A DRIVER'S LICENSE OF A PERSON WHO HAS SUFFERED A SEIZURE.
ar:SB540.summary: Limits any suspension, revocation, or restriction of a driver's license by the Office of Driver Services, after an evaluation required because of a seizure, to six months from the person's last seizure, whether or not the person is on medication.

ar:SB544.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS PHARMACY BENEFITS MANAGER LICENSURE ACT.
ar:SB544.summary: Requires pharmacy benefits managers to give pharmacies, on request, claims identification numbers for each network and list them in contracts, give 60 days' notice for opt-out contracts, and pay 12% monthly interest on underpayments; adds probation as a penalty.

ar:SB545.title: TO AMEND THE LAW RELATED TO THE PROPERTY AND FINANCES OF STATE INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION; TO AMEND THE LAW RELATED TO BONDS; AND TO AMEND THE LAW REGARDING RENTS, TOLLS, FEES, AND OTHER CHARGES RELATED TO ATHLETIC CONTESTS.
ar:SB545.summary: Lets six public university boards of trustees acquire technology, leaseholds, infrastructure and other property under the bond-financing law, adds non-tax campus revenues as a bond revenue source, and extends their authority to set rents and fees to that property.

ar:SB546.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE TRUST FUND CONTRIBUTION FEE FOR WATER PERMITS RELATED TO NONMUNICIPAL DOMESTIC SEWAGE TREATMENT WORKS.
ar:SB546.summary: Bars the Division of Environmental Quality from considering new or expanded nonmunicipal sewage treatment permits within five miles of a public sewer collection system unless significant pollution threat or no viable alternative is shown; lowers the initial trust fund fee from 10 to 8 percent.

ar:SB547.title: TO REPEAL THE REQUIREMENT THAT A HOMESCHOOLED STUDENT LIVE WITHIN A CERTAIN RADIUS OF A PRIVATE SCHOOL FOR PURPOSES OF PARTICIPATING IN AN EXTRACURRICULAR ACTIVITY.
ar:SB547.summary: Removes the requirement that a homeschooled student live within 25 miles of a private school to take part in its interscholastic activities, keeping the notice and academic eligibility requirements.

ar:SB55.title: AN ACT FOR THE ARKANSAS SUPREME COURT APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB55.summary: Appropriates money for personal services and operating expenses of the Arkansas Supreme Court for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, and sets its maximum staff positions and salary rates.

ar:SB550.title: TO CHANGE THE NAME OF THE ARKANSAS LIVESTOCK AND POULTRY COMMISSION TO THE ARKANSAS BOARD OF ANIMAL HEALTH.
ar:SB550.summary: Renames the Arkansas Livestock and Poultry Commission the Board of Animal Health within the Department of Agriculture, limits veterinarian members to three, moves some duties such as the State Brand Book to the department, and repeals the equine identification-chip law.

ar:SB551.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING CANVASSING FOR A PETITION FOR A LOCAL OPTION ELECTION.
ar:SB551.summary: Changes local option petition rules: signers must read the ballot title or hear it read, canvassers must disclose that petition fraud is a crime, check photo ID and file affidavits, and clerks may not count signatures from canvassers who broke petition laws.

ar:SB552.title: TO CLARIFY THE DEFINITION OF "PRINCIPAL OFFICE" USED UNDER THE ARKANSAS BUSINESS CORPORATION ACT OF 1987 AND THE UNIFORM LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY ACT.
ar:SB552.summary: Lets a corporation or limited liability company with no principal executive office use its registered agent's address as its principal office, but requires it to give the Secretary of State a physical address for a named officer or director (member or manager, for an LLC).

ar:SB553.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS MUNICIPAL ACCOUNTING LAW; TO AMEND THE DUTIES OF A MUNICIPAL TREASURER; AND TO REQUIRE TRAINING FOR AN INDIVIDUAL CHARGED WITH DUTIES UNDER THE ARKANSAS MUNICIPAL ACCOUNTING LAW.
ar:SB553.summary: Requires municipal treasurers to complete eight hours of Arkansas Municipal League training, new ones within 180 days of taking office, and requires the same training for other employees or private contractors assigned treasurer duties.

ar:SB554.title: TO CREATE THE BEHAVIORAL HEALTH LOAN FORGIVENESS PROGRAM.
ar:SB554.summary: Creates a loan forgiveness program run by the Department of Human Services that pays selected mental health professionals and substance abuse counselors who serve three years in underserved communities 15% of average professional debt per year, up to three years.

ar:SB555.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE OFFENSE OF VIDEO VOYEURISM; TO EXTEND THE STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS FOR THE OFFENSE OF VIDEO VOYEURISM; AND TO MAKE AN ORDER OF PROTECTION AVAILABLE TO A VICTIM OF VIDEO VOYEURISM.
ar:SB555.summary: Allows prosecution for video voyeurism within one year of discovery, bars a romantic relationship as a defense, and includes secret recording in the definition of domestic abuse for orders of protection.

ar:SB559.title: TO AMEND THE ARKANSAS MILITARY CHILD SCHOOL TRANSITIONS ACT OF 2021.
ar:SB559.summary: Requires, rather than allows, receiving school districts to enter academic course requests for incoming military-connected students, and lets a public school seek a State Board of Education waiver to accommodate them.

ar:SB56.title: AN ACT FOR THE AUDITOR OF STATE - CONTINUING EDUCATION OF LOCAL OFFICIALS APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB56.summary: Appropriates money for fiscal 2026-2027 for continuing-education and certification programs for county clerks, circuit clerks, county treasurers and collectors ($75,000 each) and county coroners ($125,000).

ar:SB560.title: TO DECREASE THE BASE CONTRIBUTION RATE; TO INCREASE THE ADMINISTRATIVE ASSESSMENT RATE; TO INCREASE FUNDING FOR THE SKILLED WORKFORCE IN THIS STATE; AND TO AMEND THE DIVISION OF WORKFORCE SERVICES TRAINING TRUST FUND.
ar:SB560.summary: Lowers the base employer unemployment insurance rate from 1.9% to 1.8% from 2026, raises the wage administrative assessment from 0.1% to 0.2%, and sends remaining assessment proceeds to the Workforce Services Training Trust Fund, widening its permitted uses.

ar:SB562.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE OFFICE OF INTERNAL AUDIT; AND TO REPEAL THE REQUIREMENT FOR AN ANNUAL PROJECT REVIEW AND EFFICIENCY STUDY OF THE ARKANSAS DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION.
ar:SB562.summary: Repeals the requirement that the Office of Internal Audit conduct an annual project review and efficiency study of the Arkansas Department of Transportation and report it to the Legislative Council.

ar:SB563.title: TO AUTHORIZE THE ARKANSAS LIVESTOCK AND POULTRY COMMISSION TO IMPOSE A CIVIL PENALTY FOR CERTAIN ACTIONS AGAINST AN EQUINE; AND TO ALLOW A BODY CONDITION SCORE TO BE USED FOR AN EQUINE UNDER THE OFFENSE OF CRUELTY TO ANIMALS.
ar:SB563.summary: Subjects a person who fails to give an equine enough food and water to civil penalties up to $5,000 per violation from the Livestock and Poultry Commission, and allows a veterinarian's body condition score to be used to decide adequacy.

ar:SB564.title: TO AMEND THE DEFINITION OF "BEER" TO CHANGE THE ALLOWABLE ALCOHOLIC CONTENT AND TO INCLUDE MALT BEVERAGES.
ar:SB564.summary: Raises the alcohol limit for beer to 10% by weight and creates a "malt beverage" category of 5% to 21% alcohol by weight, which includes beer and malt beverages up to 10%.

ar:SB567.title: TO AMEND AND MODERNIZE THE LAW CONCERNING THE APPORTIONMENT OF INCOME DERIVED FROM MULTISTATE OPERATIONS; AND TO CHANGE THE METHOD FOR SOURCING OF RECEIPTS FOR SERVICES AND INTANGIBLES.
ar:SB567.summary: Changes sourcing of receipts for services and intangibles to market location and updates multistate apportionment definitions; taxes nonresident corporations or partnerships with no physical presence if Arkansas receipts exceed $250,000 in the current or prior year, from tax year 2026.

ar:SB568.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE TAXES APPLICABLE TO LITHIUM EXTRACTION AND DEVELOPMENT; TO PROVIDE A SALES AND USE TAX EXEMPTION FOR LITHIUM RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT; AND TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING THE SEVERANCE TAX ON LITHIUM.
ar:SB568.summary: Creates a sales and use tax exemption for qualifying lithium, battery and grid-storage facilities with at least $100 million in investment, applies the $2.45 per 1,000 barrels salt water severance tax to lithium production, and changes how its revenue is distributed.

ar:SB569.title: AN AMENDMENT TO THE ARKANSAS CONSTITUTION CONCERNING BALLOT TITLES OF PROPOSED MEASURES; AND AMENDING THE ARKANSAS CONSTITUTION UNDER THE AUTHORITY OF ARKANSAS CONSTITUTION, ARTICLE 5, SECTION 1.
ar:SB569.summary: Amends Article 5, § 1 of the Arkansas Constitution by legislative act, asserting a two-thirds vote suffices, to require petition ballot titles to be readable, clear, concise and at most 500 words, and let the legislature set a readability standard.

ar:SB570.title: TO AMEND ARKANSAS LAW CONCERNING THE MEMBERSHIP OF THE JOINT BUDGET COMMITTEE.
ar:SB570.summary: Adds the Senate President Pro Tempore, the House Speaker, and their immediate predecessors to the Joint Budget Committee, with provisions for appointing replacements when a predecessor is no longer in the chamber.

ar:SB571.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING MUNICIPAL BUILDING AND ZONING REGULATIONS; AND TO PROHIBIT A MUNICIPALITY FROM ENFORCING BUILDINGS AND ZONING REGULATIONS ON COUNTY PROPERTY.
ar:SB571.summary: Bars cities from enforcing municipal building and zoning rules on county-owned property inside city limits that is used for a public purpose; the county must follow its own building and zoning rules there.

ar:SB572.title: TO CREATE THE PUBLIC SCHOOL ACCESS AND TRANSPARENCY ACT; AND TO REQUIRE PUBLIC ACCESS TO LEARNING MATERIALS.
ar:SB572.summary: Adds school learning materials to public records under the Freedom of Information Act and bars schools from denying access on copyright grounds; recipients may not publish or distribute copyrighted materials beyond inspection and limited copies.

ar:SB573.title: TO AMEND THE METHOD OF VALUATION UNDER ARKANSAS CONSTITUTION, ARTICLE 16, § 5, BY DEFINING THE TERMS USED IN THE ESTABLISHED METHODS OF VALUATION FOR PURPOSES OF PROPERTY TAX.
ar:SB573.summary: Defines property-tax valuation terms, including the cost, market, and income approaches and kinds of depreciation and obsolescence, for the valuation methods in the Arkansas Constitution, applying to assessment years beginning January 1, 2025 or later.

ar:SB574.title: TO REQUIRE A MUNICIPALITY THAT OPERATES A WATERWORKS SYSTEM OR SEWAGE SYSTEM TO PROVIDE SERVICE TO COUNTY PROPERTY IN CERTAIN INSTANCES.
ar:SB574.summary: Requires a municipality with a water or sewer system to serve county-owned property inside its boundaries when the county judge asks, with the county paying connection costs and the rates charged to other customers.

ar:SB575.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING INSTALLMENT FEES COLLECTED IN CIRCUIT AND DISTRICT COURTS; TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING DRIVER'S LICENSE REINSTATEMENT FEES; AND TO CREATE THE JUSTICE SYSTEM TASK FORCE.
ar:SB575.summary: Sends driver's license reinstatement fees and some court installment fees to general revenue instead of dedicated funds, ends the $15 court technology fee in criminal and traffic cases, and creates a Justice System Fee Task Force to study fees.

ar:SB577.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING LOCAL SALES AND USE TAXES; AND TO REQUIRE THE DEPARTMENT OF FINANCE AND ADMINISTRATION TO NOTIFY LOCAL GOVERNMENTS CONCERNING SALES AND USE TAXES THAT ARE SET TO EXPIRE.
ar:SB577.summary: Requires the Department of Finance and Administration to notify the county quorum court, city governing body or other levying entity at least 120 days before a local sales and use tax expires, stating the expiration date and requirements for extending it.

ar:SB578.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING EARLY VOTING; AND TO ALLOW A COUNTY BOARD OF ELECTION COMMISSIONERS TO CLOSE CERTAIN EARLY VOTING LOCATIONS DURING INCLEMENT WEATHER.
ar:SB578.summary: Lets a county election board hold an emergency meeting to close early voting locations for inclement weather, requires a unanimous vote, and requires at least one early voting site in the county seat to stay open every early voting day.

ar:SB58.title: AN ACT FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION - DIVISION OF HIGHER EDUCATION APPROPRIATION FOR THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR.
ar:SB58.summary: Appropriates money for personal services and operating expenses of the Department of Education - Division of Higher Education for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, and sets its maximum staff positions and salary rates.

ar:SB580.title: TO EXTEND FINANCING FOR PURCHASES OF VEHICLES AND EQUIPMENT FOR A RURAL FIRE PROTECTION DISTRICT.
ar:SB580.summary: Extends the maximum loan term for rural fire protection district vehicle and equipment purchases from three years to five years.

ar:SB583.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING MAXIMUM ALLOWABLE COST LISTS RELATING TO PHARMACY SERVICES.
ar:SB583.summary: Lets pharmacies and pharmacists sue over violations of maximum allowable cost list rules, with compensatory and punitive damages and attorney's fees, and $10,000 per violation in statutory damages under the Trade Practices Act. Bars suits against government.

ar:SB584.title: TO AMEND THE LAW CONCERNING LOCAL INITIATIVE AND REFERENDUM PETITIONS.
ar:SB584.summary: Applies petition procedures for statewide initiatives and referendums to local ones: sponsors file drafts and canvasser lists with the county clerk, who reviews ballot titles and counts signatures in place of the Attorney General and Secretary of State.

ar:SB585.title: TO REQUIRE CERTAIN RECORDS BE PROVIDED TO AN EMPLOYEE WHO IS A MINOR.
ar:SB585.summary: Requires employers with more than ten employees to give each minor employee an itemized pay statement showing pay basis, rates of pay, gross pay and deductions each time wages are paid.

ar:SB586.title: TO CREATE THE "PROTECT OUR CONSTITUTION ACT"; AND AMENDING A PORTION OF THE ARKANSAS CONSTITUTION AS AUTHORIZED BY ARKANSAS CONSTITUTION, ARTICLE 5, § 1.
