nj:A 2196.summary: Requires outdoor lighting fixtures installed or replaced by or for State agencies, or on projects receiving State funds, to be fully shielded, limited to needed illumination, and use full cutoff fixtures above 1,800 lumens.

nj:A 2199.title: Child abuse reporting hotline-maintain by DCPP, prov info on available resources
nj:A 2199.summary: Requires the child abuse reporting hotline run by the Division of Child Protection and Permanency to give callers information about resources available to victims of child abuse or neglect and their families.

nj:A 2205.title: VCCO-post signs and distribute pamphlets in emergency rooms
nj:A 2205.summary: Requires every hospital emergency department to post signs, produced by the Health Commissioner with the Attorney General, explaining the services, contact information and claim procedures of the Victims of Crime Compensation Office.

nj:A 2208.title: Federal housing choice voucher prog-extend time for tenants after landlord sells
nj:A 2208.summary: As introduced, requires the Department of Community Affairs and other public housing agencies to give households at least 180 days, instead of 60, to find new housing with a federal housing choice voucher after the landlord sells or transfers the property.

nj:A 2240.title: Parolee violates domestic violence restraining order-notify State Parole Board
nj:A 2240.summary: Requires prosecutors or police to notify the State Parole Board when a parolee is charged with violating a domestic violence restraining order, and sets up a data-sharing system between the Board and the courts' domestic violence registry to show parole status.

nj:A 2259.title: Hospital patient w/devel. disability-auth designated caregiver accompany patient
nj:A 2259.summary: Gives a hospital patient with a developmental disability the right to be accompanied by one designated family member, guardian or caregiver, subject to hospital safety, privacy and infection control limits.

nj:A 2265.title: Money Transmitters Act-provides consumer prot; incr reporting/record keeping req
nj:A 2265.summary: Revises the Money Transmitters Act to require licensees to display license information, keep records five years, file quarterly reports, give more consumer disclosures, and pay $200 per day for late reports.

nj:A 2267.title: Affordable housing, for-profit entity-permit join with non-profit, jt insur fund
nj:A 2267.summary: Requires the Housing and Mortgage Finance Agency to run an affordable housing insurance pilot program that helps for-profit affordable housing entities pay insurance premiums, accepting applications for two years, and appropriates $5 million.

nj:A 2268.title: Substance & alcohol use disorder-req cert providers, be assessed for conflicts
nj:A 2268.summary: Requires State, county and municipal entities to assess substance and alcohol use disorder providers for conflicts of interest, including financial ties and ownership, before giving them State funds, licenses or certifications.

nj:A 2279.title: Prospective real estate appraisers-concerns experiential requirements
nj:A 2279.summary: Requires the State Real Estate Appraiser Board to adopt the Appraisal Qualifications Board's PAREA program as an alternative way for prospective appraisers to meet experience requirements for licensure or certification.

nj:A 2280.title: Real estate appraisers & anti-bias training-codify prohibition, discrim practice
nj:A 2280.summary: Bars real estate appraisers from considering race, religion, sex, disability, national origin or other protected traits of owners or neighbors in an appraisal, and requires fair housing and appraisal bias training for continuing education.

nj:A 2288.title: Office of Learning Loss Czar-establish
nj:A 2288.summary: Establishes the Office of Learning Equity and Academic Recovery in the Department of Education to analyze data and coordinate resources on student literacy and learning acceleration, with staff chosen by the Education Commissioner.

nj:A 2294.title: Mortgage payment relief & foreclosure protection-establish, cert homeowners
nj:A 2294.summary: Gives certain homeowners affected by the remnants of Hurricane Ida temporary protection from foreclosure and requires mortgage servicers to temporarily pause their mortgage payment obligations.

nj:A 2296.title: Affordable housing-authorize municipal clerk submit certain written statements
nj:A 2296.summary: Lets a municipality delegate to its clerk, by ordinance, the power to issue written statements supporting or reciting the need for affordable housing programs or projects that conform to its approved plan.

nj:A 2312.title: Sexual exploitation/abuse of children-create separate crime for items depicting
nj:A 2312.summary: Makes child sexual abuse material its own crime, separate from child endangerment, and extends it to computer-generated or manipulated images that appear to show an identifiable child or purported child in a sexual act.

nj:A 2316.title: Speed humps, cert-incr traffic threshold for local installation w/o DOT approval
nj:A 2316.summary: Lets counties and municipalities build speed humps with a flat top of at least 10 feet, such as speed tables, without the transportation commissioner's approval, on residential and some school-area streets with under 4,000 vehicles daily and a posted speed of 30 mph or less.

nj:A 2320.title: Agriculture, community supported-take various actions to publicize & promote
nj:A 2320.summary: Requires the Department of Agriculture to run a publicity and marketing program promoting community supported agriculture, including a dedicated webpage, within 180 days of enactment.

nj:A 2342.title: Veterans History Project-require DMVA promote at Library of Congress
nj:A 2342.summary: Requires the Department of Veterans Affairs to run an informational campaign promoting awareness of the Veterans History Project at the Library of Congress.

nj:A 2375.title: New Jersey Veteran Gravesite Maintenance Grant Program-establish in DVA
nj:A 2375.summary: Creates a grant program in the Department of Veterans Affairs to fund veteran gravesite maintenance by qualified veterans' organizations; implementation depends on a future appropriation.

nj:A 2380.title: License plates for disabled veterans-create, allow to park in spots reserved
nj:A 2380.summary: Requires the Motor Vehicle Commission to issue "Disabled Veteran" license plates, for a $50 one-time fee, to veterans with a service-connected disability rating of at least 70 percent causing a walking impairment, allowing parking in spaces reserved for people with disabilities.

nj:A 2388.title: Historical roadside markers-require Travel & Tourism develop & maintain website
nj:A 2388.summary: Requires the Division of Travel and Tourism to develop and maintain a website on the State's historic sites, historic districts and roadside markers.

nj:A 2390.title: Municipalities, affordable housing obligations-prov cert St. grants & assistance
nj:A 2390.summary: Directs the Department of Community Affairs to give priority consideration for certain State financial assistance to municipalities meeting their affordable housing obligations, with criteria that differ for the first and last five years of a round.

nj:A 2391.title: 250th Anniversary Revolutionary War-authorize creation of license plates
nj:A 2391.summary: Requires the Motor Vehicle Commission to issue 250th Anniversary Revolutionary War license plates once private start-up money and 500 applications are provided; $50 application fee, $10 annual renewal, with net fees supporting heritage tourism sites.

nj:A 2401.title: Scrap metal businesses-establish safety measures
nj:A 2401.summary: Requires scrap metal businesses to install heat detection (on properties over one acre or with shredders), adopt a fire safety plan with a fire official, and keep piles at or below 20 feet; large shredder stockpiles need remotely operated fire suppression.

nj:A 2402.title: Coast Guard-authorize special license plates for members
nj:A 2402.summary: Authorizes the Motor Vehicle Commission to issue U.S. Coast Guard license plates to current and former members and their spouses and parents, with a $50 application fee and $10 annual renewal fee, net proceeds going to the Coast Guard.

nj:A 2403.title: Solar energy generation-estab pilot program on roadside right-of-way areas
nj:A 2403.summary: Directs the Board of Public Utilities to adopt rules adding solar projects on government-owned roadside rights-of-way to its solar incentive programs, with capacity limits, siting restrictions and project criteria.

nj:A 2415.title: Silver Alert Sys, missing person w/dementia-same broadcast alerts as Amber Alert
nj:A 2415.summary: Requires the State Police Missing Persons Unit to develop a procedure for emergency mass notifications about missing people meeting Silver Alert criteria, by text, voice call, email, app notification and social media.

nj:A 2437.title: Menstrual products-requires ingredients be listed on package
nj:A 2437.summary: Requires menstrual product manufacturers to put a label on every package sold in the State listing ingredients in descending order of predominance, with protection for confidential business information.

nj:A 2444.title: Ovarian cancer-require DOH study racial aspects
nj:A 2444.summary: Requires the Department of Health to study strategies to reduce racial and ethnic disparities in ovarian cancer rates, risk factors and outcomes, and report findings and recommendations to the Governor and Legislature within one year after enactment.

nj:A 2457.title: Memory care training-req to include in annual long-term care training program
nj:A 2457.summary: Adds the needs and rights of long-term care residents with Alzheimer's disease and related disorders to the topics the State Long-Term Care Ombudsman's required annual training program must cover.

nj:A 2490.title: Alzheimer's disease public awareness campaign-DOH establish
nj:A 2490.summary: Requires the Department of Human Services, subject to available funds, to run an Alzheimer's disease public awareness and education campaign promoting early detection and information about treatments.

nj:A 2519.title: Soil conservation districts-authorize to have more than five supervisors
nj:A 2519.summary: Lets the State Soil Conservation Committee set a maximum number of supervisors for each soil conservation district, which current law limits to five.

nj:A 2550.title: Children w/ disabilities, 26 or older-req cont, health benf dependent coverage
nj:A 2550.summary: Requires health insurers to offer dependent coverage to adult children 26 or older who cannot support themselves because of a disability that began before the age limit, depend chiefly on the subscriber, and have been continuously insured since before it.

nj:A 2607.title: Paratransit service-modifies definition under various sections of law
nj:A 2607.summary: Allows taxicabs, limousines and transportation network companies to provide paratransit service for two years, after which providers must report ride counts and safety, labor and environmental information to the Department of Transportation.

nj:A 2610.title: Horse racing purse subsidies, annual-extend through State fiscal year 2029
nj:A 2610.summary: Requires $20 million a year for horse racing purse subsidies through fiscal year 2029, split equally between the thoroughbred and standardbred industries.

nj:A 2619.title: Legislative aide-prohibits political contribution greater than $30 per election
nj:A 2619.summary: Bars legislative district office aides from contributing more than $30 to the legislator they work for, and bars the legislator or campaign committee from soliciting or knowingly accepting more; violations are a fourth-degree crime.

nj:A 2623.title: Home Business Jobs Creation Act-concerns use of variances
nj:A 2623.summary: Allows home businesses in residential zones as a permitted accessory use if conditions are met, such as no outside appearance, customary visitor and delivery volume, and no noise, odors or waste beyond normal residential levels.

nj:A 2717.title: Veteran, service-connected disability-proportional property tax exemption
nj:A 2717.summary: As introduced, extends the property tax exemption to veterans with any service-connected disability rated at least 10 percent, in proportion to the rating and capped at $10,000; gives unemployable veterans a full exemption; State reimburses taxing districts.

nj:A 2733.title: Children, mental health crisis-requires emerg dept prov cert info to parents
nj:A 2733.summary: Requires hospital emergency departments to give parents or guardians of a child in a mental health crisis information, including contact details, about nearby county-based care management organizations.

nj:A 2739.title: Social media platform-proh promoting cert practices/features, eating disorders
nj:A 2739.summary: Bars social media platforms from using features they know or should know could cause child users to develop eating disorders, unless they run quarterly internal and annual independent audits and fix issues within 30 days, or earn under $100 million.

nj:A 2757.title: Electric transmission owners-require to join transmission entities
nj:A 2757.summary: Requires electric transmission owners in New Jersey to join a federally approved regional transmission organization and transfer control of their transmission facilities to it.

nj:A 2777.title: New Jersey Online Foreclosure Sale Act-permits online foreclosure sales
nj:A 2777.summary: Allows counties to require foreclosure sales to be held in an online public forum and to contract with vendors to run online sales for sheriffs, with vendors chosen by competitive contracting.

nj:A 2784.title: School election, annual-move to November; submit proposals, addl budget spending
nj:A 2784.summary: Lets a school district that has moved its annual school election to November put separate proposals to voters for additional spending above the tax levy cap for the budget year, the following year, or both.

nj:A 2801.title: Primary Care Practitioner Loan Redemption Prog-renames, extends eligibility;$10M
nj:A 2801.summary: Renames the loan redemption program the Health Care Professional Loan Redemption Program, adds psychiatrists and other fields, and raises the maximum award from $120,000 to $200,000; the Governor's changes narrow automatic site approval and delay most provisions to July 1, 2026.

nj:A 2803.title: Health care professionals, certain-codifies & extends authorization to practice
nj:A 2803.summary: Lets out-of-state licensed health care professionals, such as physicians, nurses, counselors, social workers and psychologists, and recent graduates practice in New Jersey while their license application is pending.

nj:A 2804.title: FamilyCare-concerns enrollment in conjunction with licensure application
nj:A 2804.summary: Requires the Department of Human Services and the State Board of Medical Examiners to create, within 365 days, a process sharing physician license data to speed review of NJ FamilyCare provider applications.

nj:A 2813.title: Social Work Licensure Compact-enter NJ in
nj:A 2813.summary: Enters New Jersey into the Social Work Licensure Compact, a multistate system under which a social worker licensed in one member state can practice in other member states.

nj:A 2818.title: Deceptive audio or visual media, certain-prohibits & imposes criminal penalty
nj:A 2818.summary: Bars knowingly or recklessly distributing, or soliciting creation of, deceptive audio or visual media (deepfakes) to deceive voters within 90 days of an election, unless labeled with a disclaimer. First offense is a fourth-degree crime, later ones third-degree; civil suits allowed.

nj:A 2835.title: Second Chance Program-establish; provide opportunities thru labor organizations
nj:A 2835.summary: Creates a Second Chance Program in the Department of Labor and Workforce Development to provide career opportunities through labor organizations for formerly incarcerated people.

nj:A 2845.title: Crime witness, cert-auth funding to protect; expand Crime Victim's Bill of Right
nj:A 2845.summary: Authorizes the Victims of Crime Compensation Office to pay relocation and safety expenses for cooperating witnesses, and lets the Division of Criminal Justice give Victim and Witness Advocacy Fund grants to victim service providers.

nj:A 2884.title: PFRS-prov for purchase of credit for svc, class 2 spec law enforcement officer
nj:A 2884.summary: Lets Police and Firemen’s Retirement System members buy credit for earlier service as a class two special law enforcement officer, if the break before enrollment was under 365 days; the member pays both member and employer shares.

nj:A 2890.title: Board of Review in the Division of Employment Security-concerns addl members
nj:A 2890.summary: Lets the Labor Commissioner temporarily appoint three additional members to the Employment Security Board of Review, raising it from three to six members and creating two independent panels to decide benefit appeals.

nj:A 2903.title: Barber service-concerns licensure of persons rendering services in another state
nj:A 2903.summary: Lets people who practiced barbering in another state or country that does not license barbers get a 120-day temporary permit under a pilot program in Elizabeth, Passaic, Paterson and Perth Amboy, and extends the pilot three years.

nj:A 2929.title: Lead drinking water hazards-requires disclosure to tenants of residential units
nj:A 2929.summary: Requires landlords to give tenants a lead-in-drinking-water disclosure with leases and renewals, lets tenants end a lease without penalty if a landlord obstructs lead service line replacement, and requires public water systems to test customers' water for lead on request.

nj:A 2940.title: Medicaid & FamilyCare reimb rate-estab min, pediatric spec care nursing facility
nj:A 2940.summary: As introduced, requires a minimum Medicaid and NJ FamilyCare reimbursement rate of $950 per day for pediatric skilled care nursing facilities that comply with licensure, safety and quality laws, and appropriates the necessary funds.

nj:A 2946.title: Person-to-person electronic payment, erroneous-criminalizes failure to return
nj:A 2946.summary: Makes it theft to keep an erroneous person-to-person electronic payment when the recipient knew or should have known it was a mistake. Returning the funds within 30 days of receipt or notice is a defense.

nj:A 2980.title: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis-require health care professionals report cases
nj:A 2980.summary: Requires health care professionals who screen for, diagnose or provide therapeutic services for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis patients to confidentially report all known cases to the Department of Health.

nj:A 2993.title: Nonprofit veterans org-auth local governments to provide voluntary contributions
nj:A 2993.summary: Allows counties and municipalities to give up to $70,000 a year in voluntary contributions to nonprofit veterans' organizations located within them, for needs such as housing, food, mental health, careers and transportation.

nj:A 2998.title: Child counseling-either physically present or heard acts of domestic violence
nj:A 2998.summary: As amended, lets courts order counseling for a child who witnesses or experiences domestic violence in the household and order the abuser to pay for it; presumes legal and physical custody goes to the non-abusive parent after a final restraining order.

nj:A 3007.title: Pediatric long-term care facility-increases maximum age for residents to 26
nj:A 3007.summary: Raises the maximum age for residents of pediatric long-term care facilities from 19 to 26.

nj:A 3008.title: Lactation counselors-require certain health care facilities offer consultations
nj:A 3008.summary: Requires hospitals with inpatient maternity services and licensed birthing centers to offer each patient who gives birth at least one lactation counselor consultation before discharge, in person or remotely by live voice.

nj:A 3016.title: Suicide Hopeline-allows follow-up calls from opertators to at risk minors
nj:A 3016.summary: Allows 988 and other suicide crisis hotline centers to place follow-up calls, texts or chats to minors aged 16 and older identified at high risk of suicide, without parental authorization.

nj:A 3025.title: Unemployment compensation-exempt poll worker wages from affecting
nj:A 3025.summary: Excludes work as a temporary district board of elections poll worker from the definition of employment under the unemployment compensation law, so those wages do not affect unemployment compensation.

nj:A 3033.title: Bumble Bee, Common Eastern-designates as NJ State Native Pollinator
nj:A 3033.summary: Designates the Common Eastern Bumble Bee (Bombus impatiens) as the New Jersey State Native Pollinator.

nj:A 3035.title: Electric vehicle charging location-prohibits non-electric vehicle parking in
nj:A 3035.summary: Prohibits parking in marked electric vehicle charging spaces by non-electric vehicles or plug-in vehicles not actively charging, with fines of $55 for a first offense, $100 for a second and $200 for a third and each later offense.

nj:A 3036.title: Swift Access For Emergency Response Actions Preserv. Program; reroute traffic
nj:A 3036.summary: Lets the Attorney General order navigation apps to reroute traffic causing an ongoing emergency traffic condition, or work out an alternative with the operator; municipalities may request an investigation, and the Attorney General reports on results after two years.

nj:A 3060.title: Special event zone-designate for traffic regulation purpose, certain large event
nj:A 3060.summary: Lets the Transportation Commissioner, counties and municipalities designate special event zones for motor vehicle events approved locally or expected to draw 25 or more people, with fines up to $1,000 for speeding, careless driving or racing there.

nj:A 3064.title: Social media platforms-co-op w/ nonprofit org initiatives, nonconsensual images
nj:A 3064.summary: Requires social media companies to cooperate with nonprofit initiatives to remove nonconsensual intimate images and videos, including deceptive audio or visual media, from their platforms.

nj:A 3094.title: Pollinator-friendly-establishes label for plants
nj:A 3094.summary: Requires the Environmental Protection commissioner to set standards and a "pollinator-friendly" label for native, non-invasive plants that sellers may use, barring such labeling for plants that do not meet the standards.

nj:A 3099.title: Chiropractic medicine-estab option for students, participate in preceptorship
nj:A 3099.summary: Requires the State Board of Chiropractic Examiners to allow students in their final year of a chiropractic program to take part in a preceptorship under a board-approved New Jersey-licensed chiropractor.

nj:A 3108.title: Agriculture, community supported-take various actions to publicize & promote
nj:A 3108.summary: Requires the Department of Agriculture to develop within 180 days a publicity and marketing program for community supported agriculture, including a dedicated webpage on its website.

nj:A 3128.title: Tax credits-authorize HMFA to issue for certain purposes
nj:A 3128.summary: Reallocates $500 million in tax credits from existing economic development programs to the Housing and Mortgage Finance Agency, to be sold at competitive auction to support middle-income workforce housing and low- and moderate-income housing.

nj:A 3157.title: Bereavement Counseling Prog for family/caregivers of certain vet-req DMVA create
nj:A 3157.summary: Requires the Department of Military and Veterans Affairs to create a Bereavement Counseling Program matching family members and volunteer caregivers of veterans who die by suicide with clinicians who donate counseling time, at no charge.

nj:A 3237.title: Property registration fee-exempt from paying, prop subject to automatic stay
nj:A 3237.summary: Exempts certain foreclosing creditors from municipal property registration fees for as long as the property remains subject to the federal bankruptcy automatic stay.

nj:A 3238.title: Income tax assessments-eliminate statute of limitation, refunds induced by fraud
nj:A 3238.summary: Lets the Division of Taxation assess gross income tax at any time when an erroneous refund was induced by a false or fraudulent return filed with intent to evade tax, replacing the current five-year limit for refunds induced by fraud.

nj:A 3240.title: Insurance/interinsurance contracts-concerns between subscribers and attorney
nj:A 3240.summary: Provides that contracts between subscribers and the attorney in fact of a reciprocal insurance exchange, and fees under them, are not related party transactions.

nj:A 3255.title: Insurance fraud-broaden scope of information sharing & civil immunity related
nj:A 3255.summary: Broadens what insurers and related organizations may disclose about suspected insurance fraud to other insurers, anti-fraud entities and law enforcement, and expands civil immunity for those disclosures and reports to causes of action of any nature.

nj:A 3256.title: Mandatory gratuity-req restaurant disclose to patrons, failure unlawful practice
nj:A 3256.summary: Requires restaurants to prominently disclose a mandatory gratuity on the menu, at the entrance, on the bill and on their website, with civil penalties of $1,000, $2,500 and $5,000 for first, second and later violations.

nj:A 3283.title: Unclaimed water utility deposits-dedicate to Statewide nonprofit util. asst. org
nj:A 3283.summary: Directs unclaimed utility deposits in the Unclaimed Utility Deposits Trust Fund to a Statewide nonprofit utility assistance organization designated by the Board of Public Utilities, and dedicates $25 million of societal benefits charge funds to its grants for fiscal year 2026.

nj:A 3318.title: Restaurant reservation-ban unauthorized arrangement, third-party reservation svc
nj:A 3318.summary: Bars third-party reservation services from listing or selling a restaurant's reservations without a written agreement with it; sets civil penalties up to $500 per violation and lets people charged fees, and restaurants, sue for damages.

nj:A 3323.title: TPAF-requires pay for extracurricular activities be included in compensation
nj:A 3323.summary: Includes extra pay for extracurricular duties beyond the regular school day or year in the definition of compensation for the Teachers' Pension and Annuity Fund.

nj:A 3337.title: Projects, supported by affordable housing fees-exempt from property tax
nj:A 3337.summary: Lets a municipality exempt affordable housing units supported by State or municipal affordable housing trust funds from property tax if the sponsor makes payments in lieu of taxes toward municipal services.

nj:A 3340.title: Home instruction-provide documentation to school district of need
nj:A 3340.summary: Allows advanced practice nurses and physician assistants, not only physicians, to give the written documentation a school district requires before providing home instruction for a student's temporary or chronic health condition.

nj:A 3360.title: Municipal homelessness-establish trust funds & adoption of housing plans
nj:A 3360.summary: Lets municipalities create homelessness trust funds by ordinance, fed by fees added to existing fines and penalties, and adopt homeless housing plans. After 5 percent for administration, fund money goes to grants for affordable housing, rental assistance, supportive services and prevention.

nj:A 3361.title: Tenants in modular or manufactured homes-establishes limit on rent increase
nj:A 3361.summary: Limits yearly rent increases on lots for manufactured and modular homes to 3.5 percent unless the Commissioner of Community Affairs approves more on a landlord's petition; sets a $1,000 penalty per violation per unit; keeps local fixed rent limits of 3.5 percent or less.

nj:A 3364.title: County Option Hospital Fee Program Act-clarifies cap on fees imposed
nj:A 3364.summary: Changes the County Option Hospital Fee Program by replacing the commissioner-set cap on the fee with commissioner review and approval, limiting the fee to the federal maximum minus one percent of total net patient revenues.

nj:A 3366.title: Women's Menstrual Health Program-establish, identify and assist patients
nj:A 3366.summary: Creates a Women's Menstrual Health Program in the Department of Health to identify and assist patients with symptoms of endometriosis and PCOS, including education and training for providers and the public and online resources.

nj:A 3392.title: Hazelnut-designate as State nut in New Jersey
nj:A 3392.summary: Designates the hazelnut as New Jersey's State nut.

nj:A 3414.title: Shampoo technicians-regulates individuals seeking employment
nj:A 3414.summary: Sets rules for people seeking shampoo technician jobs: 60 hours of training through a licensed cosmetology school or licensed shop, with shampoo permits available to registered cosmetology, beauty culture or barbering students after 60 course hours.

nj:A 3416.title: Classroom supplies expenses-provides income tax deduction to eligible educators
nj:A 3416.summary: Provides a gross income tax deduction for eligible K-12 educators and paraprofessionals for classroom supply expenses they pay themselves, modeled on the federal educator expense deduction.

nj:A 3424.title: School counselor certification-estab certain program req; outline role & duties
nj:A 3424.summary: Requires school counseling programs at accredited colleges to include a national or State-approved counseling model, defines the role of school counselors, sets professional development requirements, and creates a State School Counselor Liaison in the Department of Education.

nj:A 3434.title: Dialysis Patient Support Person Accommodation Act-create
nj:A 3434.summary: Requires dialysis centers to reasonably allow a patient's designated support person to be present during treatment, subject to infection-control rules, and to adopt posted written policies and train staff; the Health Department enforces.

nj:A 3446.title: Freedom to Read Act-estab req for library material in public school libraries
nj:A 3446.summary: Requires school and public library boards to adopt policies on curating library materials and procedures for challenges to them, bars excluding material because of its origin, background or views, and gives library staff immunity for good-faith compliance.

nj:A 3451.title: Family leave-revise law concerning reinstatement of employee
nj:A 3451.summary: Extends job reinstatement rights after family leave to employees of employers with 15 or more workers, down from 30, and lowers eligibility to three months of employment and 250 hours.

nj:A 3481.title: Homelessness Prevention Program-revises;$300M
nj:A 3481.summary: Revises the Homelessness Prevention Program's eligibility, loan and priority rules, and adds a $75 charge on eviction filings by landlords with more than three units (four if owner-occupied), funding eviction prevention services at the Department of Community Affairs.

nj:A 3496.title: Minority- & women-owned businesses-increase awarding of contracts
nj:A 3496.summary: Directs State agencies to make a good faith effort to raise non-advertised goods and services contracts awarded to certified minority- and women-owned businesses by 30 percent within five years, with regular reports to the State Treasurer.

nj:A 3497.title: Residential dwelling units-proh facilitation, agreement among rental prop owners
nj:A 3497.summary: Makes it an antitrust violation for rental property owners to use a coordinator operating algorithmic rent-pricing software, for coordinators to facilitate agreements restricting competition, or for two or more persons to engage in parallel pricing coordination (the FAIR Act).

nj:A 3505.title: Bereavement leave-concerns for death of child, miscarriage, and stillbirth
nj:A 3505.summary: Lets employees use Family Leave Act leave and family temporary disability benefits to grieve a child’s death, miscarriage, stillbirth, medically indicated pregnancy termination, failed adoption or unsuccessful fertility treatment, up to 21 days (7 if otherwise eligible), without raising maximum leave.

nj:A 3507.title: Rent increases, unconscionable-establish standards for determining
nj:A 3507.summary: Sets factors courts weigh in deciding whether a rent increase is unconscionable, including the size of the increase, landlord expenses, comparable rents, length of tenancy, and property condition; no single factor decides.

nj:A 3508.title: Child abuse reporting hotline-maintain by DCPP, prov info on available resources
nj:A 3508.summary: Requires the child abuse reporting hotline run by the Division of Child Protection and Permanency to give callers information on resources available to victims of abuse or neglect and their families.

nj:A 3518.title: Driver's licenses and identification mobile cards-requires MVC to create
nj:A 3518.summary: Requires the Motor Vehicle Commission to offer digital driver's licenses and digital non-driver ID cards, in addition to printed ones, to people who request them, with safeguards for holders' personal information.

nj:A 3523.title: Educational Facilities Authority-reduce number of members required for quorum
nj:A 3523.summary: Changes appointments to the Educational Facilities Authority: the Governor appoints three citizen members instead of five, plus two more on recommendation of the Assembly Speaker and Senate President.

nj:A 3540.title: Production or dissemination of deceptive audio or visual media-estab penalties
nj:A 3540.summary: Makes it a third-degree crime to create, solicit, disclose or use deceptive audio or visual media (deepfakes) to further a crime, makes knowing or reckless disclosure of such media a fourth-degree crime, and lets victims sue.

nj:A 3541.title: Legislative internship program-establishes; makes appropriation
nj:A 3541.summary: Creates a legislative internship program letting members of the Legislature employ interns, with presiding officer approval, open to undergraduate and graduate students at accredited institutions except juris doctorate and PhD programs.

nj:A 3555.title: Pest infestation-requires inspection prior to certain demolition
nj:A 3555.summary: Requires a pest inspection and certification, filed with the construction official, before a demolition permit issues for buildings within 10 feet of a building on another property, with pest mitigation required if a severe pest presence exists.

nj:A 3558.title: Public humanities programming-provides voluntary contrib. on income tax return
nj:A 3558.summary: Lets taxpayers voluntarily contribute on gross income tax returns to a new fund, whose money the Legislature appropriates to the New Jersey Council for the Humanities for grants supporting humanities programming.

nj:A 3571.title: Economic development partnerships-authorizes establishment of regional
nj:A 3571.summary: Allows county and municipal governments, their agencies and public or private economic development organizations to form regional economic development partnerships for joint planning and economic development or redevelopment strategies.

nj:A 3577.title: Prof & occupational licenses-req issuance of report on processing of application
nj:A 3577.summary: Requires the Division of Consumer Affairs to report to the Governor and Legislature on license application backlogs, incomplete applications and applicant calls, and requires the Attorney General to develop staff training and review outsourcing phone intake.

nj:A 3591.title: Motor vehicle tracking device-makes it a fourth degree crime
nj:A 3591.summary: Makes it a fourth-degree crime to knowingly install an electronic tracking device or app to track another person in order to facilitate an unlawful act; fourth-degree crimes carry up to 18 months in prison.

nj:A 3598.title: Claudia's Law-patient receive notification of abnormality in chest x-ray
nj:A 3598.summary: Requires a chest x-ray report to include, when an abnormality is found, a notice that it may be associated with a risk factor for illness and that the patient should discuss it with a health care provider.

nj:A 3667.title: Dental service corporation-permit to be subsidiaries, nonprofit parent companies
nj:A 3667.summary: Allows dental service corporations to be or become subsidiaries of nonprofit parent companies.

nj:A 3732.title: Domestic violence-estab. third degree crime, cert. trespasses involving violence
nj:A 3732.summary: Makes it a third-degree residential burglary to enter the home of a person protected by a final domestic violence restraining order against the actor, intending to injure or commit a crime. Sets a presumption of intent and no presumption of nonincarceration.

nj:A 3734.title: Domestic viol victim-court order transfer billing responsibility of wireless no.
nj:A 3734.summary: Allows a court, on a domestic violence or stalking victim's request after a final restraining order, to order a wireless provider to transfer billing responsibility and rights for a phone number to the victim, and to order the defendant to reimburse costs.

nj:A 3735.title: Fertility fraud-establishes crime
nj:A 3735.summary: Makes it a third-degree crime, punishable by three to five years, for a health care practitioner to knowingly perform assisted reproduction resulting in pregnancy using their own or another person’s reproductive material without the patient’s written informed consent, and requires permanent license revocation.

nj:A 3739.title: Signal jammers-criminalizes use
nj:A 3739.summary: Makes it a fourth-degree crime to interfere with federally licensed or authorized radio communications, such as with signal jammers, or to use certain cellular-frequency scanning receivers in violation of federal law.

nj:A 3742.title: Farm to School Local Food Procurement Reimbursement Grant Prog;$4.5M
nj:A 3742.summary: Creates a Farm to School Local Food Procurement Reimbursement Grant Program, run by the Secretary of Agriculture, to reimburse eligible school districts for costs of buying more local food for students.

nj:A 3753.title: Rape kits-imposes time constraints on submission and analysis
nj:A 3753.summary: Requires law enforcement to send sexual assault evidence kits to a lab within 10 calendar days of the exam when the victim consents, requires medical facilities to notify police within 24 hours, and requires retaining other kits at least 20 years.

nj:A 3759.title: Lottery tickets-prohibits internet sale by Lottery Commission
nj:A 3759.summary: Prohibits the State Lottery Commission and its contractors from selling lottery tickets directly over the internet. The bill does not affect sales by registered courier services.

nj:A 3765.title: Online parking payment services-require contract between cert governmental units
nj:A 3765.summary: Lets municipalities and parking authorities contract with online parking payment services if the contract bars the provider from charging parking fees when parking is prohibited or free.

nj:A 3772.title: Property tax lien holder-revises process, foreclose right to redeem tax lien
nj:A 3772.summary: Lets owners facing tax lien foreclosure, except on abandoned property, demand a sheriff's judicial sale or online auction, with surplus proceeds claimable by the owner; revises tax sale and in rem foreclosure laws after Tyler v. Hennepin County.

nj:A 378.title: Health insurance carriers-prohibits from disclosing cert identifying information
nj:A 378.summary: Requires health insurers, providers and hospitals to honor reasonable requests to send protected health information, including benefit explanations, by alternative means or to alternative locations when a person is receiving sensitive services or disclosure could endanger them.

nj:A 3781.title: Energy businesses, certain-require BPU develop program to promote
nj:A 3781.summary: Requires the Board of Public Utilities to run a program promoting women-, minority-, veteran- and LGBTQ-owned energy businesses, with a goal of 25 percent of energy procured through licensed agents and aggregators coming from those businesses by the fourth year.

nj:A 3791.title: New Jersey Online Foreclosure Sale Act-permits online foreclosure sales
nj:A 3791.summary: Allows foreclosure sales of real estate to be held in a public online forum, lets counties contract with vendors for online sale services, and changes foreclosure notice requirements.

nj:A 3800.title: Children's products-prohibits sale containing lead, mercury or cadmium
nj:A 3800.summary: Bans selling children's products containing lead, mercury or cadmium above federal Consumer Product Safety Improvement Act limits, enforced through civil penalties under the Consumer Fraud Act.

nj:A 3801.title: Jewelry containing cadmium-prohibits sale, distribution and manufacturing
nj:A 3801.summary: Bans the sale, distribution, import or manufacture of jewelry containing more than 0.03 percent cadmium by weight, requires recalls and removal from stores, and sets penalties of up to $10,000 for a first offense and $20,000 after.

nj:A 3802.title: Legal services, cert-differentiates from traditional insurance products
nj:A 3802.summary: Defines “legal insurance” as a contract to provide or reimburse legal services for a payment, and excludes prepaid plans using contracted attorneys paid fixed amounts, so those plans are not treated as insurance.

nj:A 3810.title: Firefighters, pregnant-requires adoption of policy addressing job-related issues
nj:A 3810.summary: Requires paid and part-paid fire departments to adopt, and update at least annually, a policy within 180 days on pregnant members' job-related issues, including disclosure, medical limits, light-duty assignments, leave and benefits.

nj:A 3853.title: Telemedicine and telehealth-extends cert pay parity for one additional year
nj:A 3853.summary: Extends from December 31, 2024 to July 1, 2026 the requirement that health plans pay for telemedicine and telehealth services at the same rate as equivalent in-person services in New Jersey.

nj:A 3860.title: Medical billing requirements, cert-establish, charges/expenses, health care svcs
nj:A 3860.summary: Requires health care providers to send patients with a balance an itemized statement within 30 days after a carrier adjudicates the claim, and to provide a plain-language version within 10 days of a written request.

nj:A 3861.title: Louisa Carman Medical Debt Relief Act-concerns
nj:A 3861.summary: Bars medical creditors and debt collectors from reporting medical debt for new care to credit agencies, reporting any paid or under-$500 debt, charging over 3 percent interest, or garnishing wages of patients earning under 600 percent of the poverty level.

nj:A 3877.title: Develop housing-estab cert St funding preference, mun that enhance opportunities
nj:A 3877.summary: Creates a program giving municipalities that reexamine and amend their master plans and zoning to allow denser housing development preference in competitively awarded State financial assistance.

nj:A 3879.title: VCCO-post signs and distribute pamphlets in emergency rooms
nj:A 3879.summary: Requires emergency departments and satellite emergency departments to post signs on the Victims of Crime Compensation Office, covering its services, contact information and how to file a claim. Electronic signs are allowed.

nj:A 3881.title: Criminal history background info-prohibits certain dissemination until updated
nj:A 3881.summary: Requires the State Bureau of Identification, when an expungement order has been issued but not yet processed, to answer background check requests without revealing any criminal history record, reference to it, or the expungement order.

nj:A 3882.title: Subsidized sch meal application-post link in prominent place on Internet website
nj:A 3882.summary: Requires public schools to post, in a prominent place on their websites, a link to the subsidized school meals application and a link to at least one informational video from the Office of the Food Security Advocate.

nj:A 3883.title: NJ FamiltyCare & SNAP recipients-concerns certain eligibility requirements
nj:A 3883.summary: Requires the Governor's Office of Volunteerism to expand volunteer resources, including the HELPNJNOW portal, so residents can use volunteering to meet federal Medicaid and SNAP work-requirement rules; appropriates $200,000.

nj:A 3891.title: Barbering-create new level of license & apprenticeships; estab. instruct. limits
nj:A 3891.summary: Creates a general barbering license, allowing shampooing, cutting, styling and shaving or trimming facial hair, plus two-year barbering apprenticeships, and sets limits on instruction hours for certain barbering training.

nj:A 3894.title: Fire safety statute-update lic., equip. req., liability fees, penal. provisions
nj:A 3894.summary: Requires licenses for fire inspectors and fire officials, makes buyers of a property and operators taking over an existing business liable for unpaid fire safety fees and penalties in set cases, and removes portable fire extinguisher requirements for certain structures.

nj:A 3899.title: General Contractor Licensing Act-provides for licensure
nj:A 3899.summary: Creates a State Board of General Contractors to license general contractors and register general contracting businesses; unlicensed people may not offer general contracting services unless supervised by a licensee.

nj:A 3904.title: Transportation projects-requires geotechnical testing and certain monitoring
nj:A 3904.summary: Requires a geotechnical engineer, used by the entity soliciting bids for a State-funded transportation project needing geotechnical testing, to recommend the type and frequency of testing, and requires groundwater testing and monitoring before construction where needed.

nj:A 3909.title: Max's Law-req sch dists provide instruction, dangers of fentanyl & xylazine
nj:A 3909.summary: Requires school districts to teach students in grades 6 to 12 about dangers of the illicit opioid supply, recognizing and responding to opioid poisoning, and where to get naloxone, using resources the Education Commissioner provides.

nj:A 3929.title: Biometric surveillance system-proh use by business entity, certain circumstances
nj:A 3929.summary: Bars businesses from using biometric surveillance on customers on their premises unless they post notice and use it for a lawful purpose; bans selling or profiting from the data and requires explaining any denial of entry.

nj:A 3939.title: Cancer screening examinations-mandates access for professional firefighters
nj:A 3939.summary: Extends the State-reimbursed cancer screening every three years, up to $1,250, to firefighters who waive employer coverage but are eligible for State Health Benefits Program coverage through a participating public employer.

nj:A 3940.title: Funeral arranging-provides for regulation
nj:A 3940.summary: Creates separate licenses for mortuary science (funeral directing only) and mortuary and embalming science under the State Board of Mortuary Science, and updates licensing qualifications, including dropping the New Jersey residency requirement and lowering the minimum age to 18.

nj:A 3941.title: State Investigators in civil service-changes classification
nj:A 3941.summary: Moves State Investigators in the Division of Criminal Justice from the unclassified service to the classified service of civil service, giving them civil service protections.

nj:A 3955.title: Vacant commercial space-requires study for small businesses
nj:A 3955.summary: Requires the Business Action Center in the Department of State to study the impact of vacant commercial real estate and report to the Governor and Legislature within one year, including local tracking and assistance programs.

nj:A 3973.title: Patient referrals, substance use disorder treatment facilities-revises laws
nj:A 3973.summary: Makes it a third-degree crime to pay, solicit or receive kickbacks for referring patients to substance use disorder treatment facilities, recovery residences or clinical laboratories, and adds an automatic $50,000 fine for violations.

nj:A 3974.title: Substance use disorder treatment facilities-proh deceptive marketing practices
nj:A 3974.summary: Bans deceptive marketing by substance use disorder treatment providers and recovery residences, requires plain-language, accurate information on services, location and name in advertising, and makes false statements about network status or identity unlawful.

nj:A 3979.title: Substance & alcohol use disorder-req cert providers, be assessed for conflicts
nj:A 3979.summary: Requires State, county and municipal entities that fund, license or certify substance or alcohol use disorder treatment providers to assess the providers for conflicts of interest before distributing funds or approving licensure.

nj:A 3981.title: Rooming and boarding houses, certain-subjects to municipal land use regulations
nj:A 3981.summary: Subjects rooming and boarding houses to municipal land use regulations, and requires cooperative sober living residence applicants to submit proof of certain local approvals with their State license application.

nj:A 3986.title: Towing companies-accept authorization of vehicle release to third party
nj:A 3986.summary: Requires towing companies to accept electronically sent written authorization from a vehicle owner to release the vehicle or property inside it to a third party, such as an insurer.

nj:A 3992.title: Tobacco and vapor products-increase penalties for certain prohibited sales
nj:A 3992.summary: Raises fines for retailers selling tobacco or vapor products to anyone under 21 to $750 for a first violation, $1,500 for a second and $3,000 for each later violation.

nj:A 4.title: Affordable housing-reforms municipal responsibilities concerning provision;$16M
nj:A 4.summary: Abolishes the Council on Affordable Housing and has municipalities set their own fair share affordable housing obligation using formulas calculated by the Department of Community Affairs, for the round beginning July 1, 2025; appropriates $16 million.

nj:A 4002.title: Sports wagering licensees-adopt & publish rules governing account limitations
nj:A 4002.summary: Requires sports wagering licensees to adopt and publish rules, approved by the Division of Gaming Enforcement, on limits placed on wagering accounts, give written notice when an account is limited, and report annually on limits imposed.

nj:A 4006.title: Public works & prevailing wage contract-permit partnerships & jt ventures to bid
nj:A 4006.summary: Lets partnerships and joint ventures bid on public works contracts for heavy infrastructure projects, such as roads, bridges and utilities, if each party is registered; requires a designated contract manager and joint and several liability for failures to perform.

nj:A 4007.title: Real property-require sellers disclose presence of dams
nj:A 4007.summary: Requires sellers of real property to disclose in writing what they know about dams on the property, adding dam questions to the property condition disclosure statement.

nj:A 4011.title: Transportation Trust Fund Authority Act-revises, calculation of gas tax rate
nj:A 4011.summary: Extends Transportation Trust Fund bonding authority through June 2029 with $15.6 billion capacity and $10.367 billion for the capital program, revises the highway fuel tax rate, and adds an annual fee for zero emission vehicles.

nj:A 4014.title: Social Media Research Center-estab at 4-yr public institution of higher ed
nj:A 4014.summary: Establishes a Social Media Research Center at a public four-year college to study social media's effects, especially on children, recommend policy, and offer free online courses on safe social media use to schools.

nj:A 4015.title: Kid Code Act-adopt Age-Appropriate Design Code for NJ, concerns minors' use
nj:A 4015.summary: Adopts the New Jersey Age-Appropriate Design Code, requiring covered online services to set minors’ default privacy highest, limit use of their data, bar dark patterns and targeted ads for narcotic drugs, tobacco, gambling and alcohol, and unpublish accounts within 10 business days of request.

nj:A 4035.title: Land and improvements in Morris County, cert-require St sell as surplus property
nj:A 4035.summary: Authorizes the Treasury Department to sell the State's interest in the Central Park School property in Morris Township to the Morris County Educational Services Commission for $1.

nj:A 4043.title: Worker contribution from unemployment compensation-concerns
nj:A 4043.summary: Redirects 0.02 percent of workers' wages from the unemployment trust fund (cutting 0.3825 to 0.3625 percent, and 0.0825 to 0.0625 for workers of governmental employers paying in lieu of contributions) to the unemployment administration fund.

nj:A 4046.title: Economic development programs-extend cert accommodations, bus participating
nj:A 4046.summary: Extends a waiver of the 60 percent on-site work rule in Economic Development Authority incentive programs for businesses outside enhanced areas: employees must spend 40 percent of time on site, commitment periods lengthen two years, and businesses pay 10 percent of their maximum credit.

nj:A 4047.title: Unemployment compensation law-revises
nj:A 4047.summary: Counts disabled adult children as dependents in unemployment benefit calculations, stops disqualifying full-time students solely for student status if they remain available for work, and treats approved training-program participation as a basis for eligibility.

nj:A 4048.title: Educational Adequacy Report-include comprehensive review, cert school funding
nj:A 4048.summary: Requires the next Educational Adequacy Report, due September 1, 2025, to be developed in consultation with education stakeholders and school finance experts, including administrators, staff, students and parents.

nj:A 4050.title: Motor vehicle dealer licenses, new-concerns facilities used
nj:A 4050.summary: Lets applicants for a new motor vehicle dealer license establish a place of business for either servicing or displaying vehicles rather than both, and allows service at attached space, separate space on the property, or an off-site facility.

nj:A 4059.title: Budget submissions, certain school districts-concerns
nj:A 4059.summary: Requires the Education Commissioner to let school districts facing State aid cuts larger than their unused tax authority submit budgets after the fiscal 2025 appropriations act is enacted, using a compressed budget calendar.

nj:A 4070.title: Privacy Protection Act-concerns collection & sharing of certain personal info
nj:A 4070.summary: Bars state and local government entities and health care facilities from collecting immigration status, citizenship, birthplace, Social Security or taxpayer ID numbers unless needed to determine eligibility for or administer a requested service, and limits disclosure.

nj:A 4071.title: Strengthening Trust Between Law Enforcement & Immigrant Communities-concerns
nj:A 4071.summary: Codifies the Attorney General's directive limiting immigration enforcement by police: bars stopping, questioning or detaining people solely over immigration status and limits aid to federal civil immigration enforcement, with exceptions.

nj:A 4072.title: Public works contract-establishes minimum qualifications, persons employed
nj:A 4072.summary: Requires public works contractors to certify that each worker has completed a registered apprenticeship or four years of documented craft experience, with exceptions for unionized workers under a collective bargaining agreement.

nj:A 4075.title: International public health-authorize DOH to establish partnerships
nj:A 4075.summary: Authorizes the Department of Health to seek participation in the WHO-coordinated Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network without conferring WHO membership, and requires a report to the Governor and Legislature, subject to available funds.

nj:A 4077.title: Private prisons, operators-impose various taxes and fees
nj:A 4077.summary: Imposes an annual fee of eight percent of gross receipts or contract value on for-profit correctional service businesses, plus a cost-recovery assessment and a three percent corporate surtax; fee revenue goes to a special account.

nj:A 4085.title: Consumer personal data-proh entities from using to set prices, merchandise/svcs
nj:A 4085.summary: Bars using personal data to set or vary grocery prices (effective one year after enactment), with exceptions for cost differences, disclosed discounts and loyalty programs; also sets a one-year moratorium on new electronic shelf labels.

nj:A 4089.title: Certified Medication Aide in Nursing Homes Staffing Support Act-concerns
nj:A 4089.summary: Authorizes Department of Health certified medication aides to give residents medications in licensed nursing homes, as delegated by and under a registered nurse, and sets certification and training requirements.

nj:A 4091.title: Audiologists-select, prescribe, & order hearing aids, certain circumstances
nj:A 4091.summary: Allows audiologists with accredited training to select, prescribe and order hearing aids, in addition to dispensing and fitting them, and lets hearing aid dispensers order and prescribe them.

nj:A 4101.title: Social media companies-estab toll-free number, report fraudulent account actions
nj:A 4101.summary: Requires social media companies to offer 24-hour account support for New Jersey users to report fraud; as revised by the Governor, companies may use digital or AI tools if users can reach a live agent by phone within five days.

nj:A 4103.title: Construction permit-require for certain work involving asbestos
nj:A 4103.summary: Requires a construction permit, in addition to other permits, for applying, enclosing, repairing, removing or encapsulating asbestos-containing material in a single-family home, duplex or townhouse, except projects under 1,000 square feet unless separately required.

nj:A 4106.title: Mortgage loans-clarifies, loan primarily for personal/family/household purposes
nj:A 4106.summary: Changes the definition of "mortgage loan" in New Jersey’s mortgage prepayment law to loans made primarily for personal, family or household purposes secured by one-to-six-unit property; the bill’s statement says this allows prepayment penalty flexibility for commercial mortgage loans.

nj:A 4113.title: Sports wagering partnerships-prohibit at public institutions of higher education
nj:A 4113.summary: Prohibits public colleges and universities from entering sports wagering partnerships with sports wagering operators. Allows affiliated foundations to do so if the partnership includes no direct advertising to students, and exempts academic partnerships with casinos.

nj:A 4121.title: High school graduation proficiency test-eliminates
nj:A 4121.summary: Eliminates the statewide high school graduation proficiency test and bars the State Board of Education from requiring satisfactory performance on it as a graduation standard.

nj:A 4134.title: Homemaker-home health aide/nursing asst cert-tranlate into multiple languages
nj:A 4134.summary: Requires homemaker-home health aide and nursing assistant certification exams to be offered in at least English, Spanish, Haitian Creole and Tagalog.

nj:A 4148.title: Type 1 diabetes-req DOE develop info materials & distribute, parents/guardians
nj:A 4148.summary: Requires the Department of Health, with the Department of Education, to develop type 1 diabetes information materials, post them online, and have school districts make them available to students' parents or guardians.

nj:A 4150.title: Certified nurse aides-permit to be employed as personal care assistants
nj:A 4150.summary: Allows licensed health care facilities to employ certified or conditionally certified nurse aides as personal care assistants.

nj:A 4161.title: Stabilized School Budget Aid Grant Program-establishes;$44.7M
nj:A 4161.summary: Creates a Stabilized School Budget Aid Grant Program giving eligible districts grants equal to 45 percent of their 2024-2025 State school aid reductions, appropriates $44.7 million, and lets some districts exceed the property tax levy limit.

nj:A 4163.title: Biomarker testing-requires health insurers provide coverage
nj:A 4163.summary: Requires health insurers, the State and school employee health plans, and Medicaid to cover biomarker testing for diagnosis, treatment and monitoring of a disease or condition when supported by medical and scientific evidence.

nj:A 4174.title: Photographed/filmed/recorded, sexual manner-not include/imply consent of image
nj:A 4174.summary: Provides that consent to being photographed or recorded in a nude or sexual manner does not imply consent to disclosing the image, and limits any consent to disclosure to the express purpose given.

nj:A 4175.title: Force policy use-require Attorney General review at least every two yrs
nj:A 4175.summary: Requires the Attorney General to review the statewide use-of-force policy every even-numbered year, holding three regional public hearings, to maintain public reporting of use-of-force incidents, and to issue guidelines for law enforcement encounters with barricaded individuals.

nj:A 4178.title: Deed of easement, temp-authorize St Treasurer to grant, Borough of Sea Girt
nj:A 4178.summary: Authorizes the State Treasurer to grant a 30-year temporary easement on 0.5175 acres at the Sea Girt National Training Center to Confluence Networks LLC for a submarine cable system, for a one-time fee of $1,120,230.

nj:A 4182.title: Cannabis workers, certain-concerns conditions of employment
nj:A 4182.summary: Sets union recognition, majority-support certification, collective bargaining and unfair labor practice rules for cannabis-business employees not covered by the National Labor Relations Act, administered by a Division of Private Employment Dispute Settlement.

nj:A 4186.title: Emergency Medical Services Personnel Licensure Interstate Compact-enters NJ in
nj:A 4186.summary: Enters New Jersey into the Recognition of Emergency Medical Services Personnel Licensure Interstate Compact, giving EMTs and paramedics licensed in one member state a privilege to practice in other member states.

nj:A 4191.title: Reproductive technology, assisted-protects rights
nj:A 4191.summary: Adds the right to choose whether to use assisted reproductive technology, including in vitro fertilization, to the state's fundamental reproductive rights.

nj:A 4193.title: Postpartum depression-offer and screen, upon request of pregnant patients
nj:A 4193.summary: Directs the Health Commissioner to add a policy requiring physicians, nurse midwives and other prenatal care providers to offer, and provide on request, postpartum depression screening to pregnant patients with a history of depression.

nj:A 4215.title: Nuclear reactors-directs BPU adopt rules & regulations; incentivize construction
nj:A 4215.summary: Directs the Board of Public Utilities to adopt rules for small modular nuclear reactors of up to 300 megawatts, and lets the Economic Development Authority use Global Warming Solutions Fund money to incentivize building and operating them.

nj:A 4229.title: Farmers, beginning-NJEDA estab loan program to assist in finan capital purchases
nj:A 4229.summary: Requires the Economic Development Authority, with the Department of Agriculture, to run a loan program helping beginning farmers buy agricultural land, improvements or depreciable farm property.

nj:A 4235.title: Private detectives-require to register their foreign employers with State Police
nj:A 4235.summary: Requires licensed private detectives employed by a foreign government or foreign national to notify State Police, which keeps a registry of them available only to the Attorney General and State Police.

nj:A 4236.title: STEM subject, various educational & other programs-designate accounting
nj:A 4236.summary: Designates accounting as a STEM subject in state law, making it count for programs that reference STEM, such as teacher grants, loan redemption, and tuition reimbursement.

nj:A 4248.title: Voter identity proof-certain documentation required to vote
nj:A 4248.summary: As introduced, requires voters, starting with the first election after January 1, 2025, to display a federal- or State-issued photo ID to vote by machine, or get a provisional ballot; exempts voters with a religious objection to being photographed (by affidavit) and voters covered by federal absentee-voting laws.

nj:A 4254.title: Transcript release restrictions-establishes limits at instit of higher education
nj:A 4254.summary: Bars colleges from withholding transcripts over unpaid balances of $2,000 or less in non-mandatory charges for students not paying with aid, but allows requiring a repayment plan for tuition and mandatory fees owed.

nj:A 4262.title: Property registration fee-exempt from paying, prop subject to automatic stay
nj:A 4262.summary: Exempts a foreclosing creditor from the municipal property registration fee while the property is subject to the federal Bankruptcy Code's automatic stay.

nj:A 4275.title: Permits/licenses/certifications, cert-estab online Statewide tracking system
nj:A 4275.summary: Requires the Office of Information Technology to build, within one year, an online Statewide system for tracking permits, licenses, certifications and form applications issued by executive-branch departments, giving each application a unique number.

nj:A 4276.title: Basic Screening Survey-require DOH use to access oral health in children
nj:A 4276.summary: Requires the Department of Health to use the Basic Screening Survey to assess children's oral health, collecting random samples in each county with parental written consent, and to report every two years to the Governor and Legislature.

nj:A 4284.title: Special plates, firefighters & first aid or rescue squad members-eliminates fee
nj:A 4284.summary: Eliminates the $15 fee for special license plates for firefighters and first aid or rescue squad members, whether paid or volunteer.

nj:A 4295.title: New Jersey India Commission-establishes
nj:A 4295.summary: Creates the New Jersey-India Commission, an advisory body of 35 to 45 unpaid members appointed by the Governor, to promote trade, investment and cultural and educational exchange between New Jersey and India.

nj:A 4296.title: Woodchucks, importation-establishes exemption from ban, certain circumstances
nj:A 4296.summary: Allows a county or municipality to import a woodchuck to replace a deceased Groundhog Day groundhog, despite the importation ban, if it first tries to find a replacement in New Jersey or from a state without raccoon rabies.

nj:A 4302.title: Vlogger-requires family member to compensate minor, certain circumstances
nj:A 4302.summary: Requires vloggers, including family members, who earn money from videos featuring a minor to compensate the minor, when the minor appears in at least 30 percent of the content and views meet a compensation threshold or $0.10 per view.

nj:A 4313.title: Historical roadside markers-require Travel & Tourism develop & maintain website
nj:A 4313.summary: Requires the Division of Travel and Tourism to develop and maintain an interactive website on historic sites and districts, including the historical roadside marker program.

nj:A 4328.title: Interstate Physician Assistant Licensure Compact-enters NJ into
nj:A 4328.summary: Enters New Jersey into the Interstate Physician Assistant Licensure Compact, letting qualifying licensed physician assistants practice in other participating states under a compact privilege.

nj:A 4331.title: Cosmetic retail services-establishes licensure
nj:A 4331.summary: Creates a limited license for retail establishments to offer certain skin care services, such as applying cosmetics, facial cleansing and hair removal, performed by a licensed skin care specialist.

nj:A 4360.title: Design Professional Self-Certification Act-estab design self-certification prog
nj:A 4360.summary: Creates a program for the Community Affairs Commissioner to certify architects and engineers as qualified design professionals who may self-certify construction permit applications, which enforcing agencies must accept and issue permits on within one to five days.

nj:A 4362.title: Public Health Institute-provide for designation and establishment in New Jersey
nj:A 4362.summary: Requires the Commissioner of Health to designate one entity as New Jersey's Public Health Institute, under criteria the commissioner sets, to coordinate among national, State and local agencies.

nj:A 4372.title: Educational research & svc corporation-broaden types of contracts may enter into
nj:A 4372.summary: Lets educational research and service corporations act as lead agency for procuring any goods and services, and contract with voting-member higher education institutions for educational technology services under shared-services agreements exempt from public bidding.

nj:A 4374.title: Prevailing Wage Act-establishes criminal penalties, certain violations
nj:A 4374.summary: Makes it a fourth-degree crime for an employer covered by the Prevailing Wage Act to knowingly falsify required records or make a false statement on the public works contractor registration form.

nj:A 4375.title: Electric vehicle parking spaces-concerns
nj:A 4375.summary: Clarifies that electric vehicle parking space credits are capped at a 10 percent reduction in required parking even after rounding fractions up, and are applied during concept plan review.

nj:A 4409.title: Mass Violence Care Fund-establishes; appropriates $10M
nj:A 4409.summary: Creates a Mass Violence Care Fund, run by the Victims of Crime Compensation Office, to pay physical and behavioral health care costs from mass violence events not covered by insurance, and sets up a working group on eligibility.

nj:A 4425.title: Environmental Infrastructure projects-expend cert sums to make loans for FY2025
nj:A 4425.summary: Authorizes the New Jersey Infrastructure Bank to spend up to $2.73 billion on loans to local governments and private water companies for water infrastructure projects in the state fiscal year 2025 Environmental Infrastructure Financing Program.

nj:A 4429.title: Communications, political matters-expand proh concerning req, attend or listen
nj:A 4429.summary: Redefines "political matters" in the law barring employers from requiring employees to attend meetings on them as electioneering communications and joining or supporting political, civic or labor groups; adds exemptions, bars retaliation for refusing, and requires posting a notice of employee rights.

nj:A 4434.title: Office of Disordered Eating Prev & Disordered Eating Prev Research Grant Prog
nj:A 4434.summary: Requires the Human Services and Health departments to study the causes, prevention and reduction of disordered eating and report within 18 months, and creates a three-year Disordered Eating Prevention Research Grant Pilot Program.

nj:A 4436.title: Construction code fees-requires local unit to accept electronic payment
nj:A 4436.summary: Requires local construction contracts to let contractors pay State Uniform Construction Code enforcing agency fees by card or electronic funds transfer, and requires local units to set up those payment systems by resolution.

nj:A 4446.title: Seasonal rental unit-requires notification of pet presence
nj:A 4446.summary: As introduced, requires seasonal rental owners to tell prospective renters before contracting if a pet is regularly present or was present within two weeks; renters not told who promptly leave after moving in get a full refund.

nj:A 4447.title: Health care referrals to pharmacies-made in accordance w/ cert prof standards
nj:A 4447.summary: Allows a health care practitioner to refer patients to a pharmacy in which the practitioner has a financial interest if it is integrated with an oncology practice, dispenses only to that practice's patients, and meets listed requirements.

nj:A 4455.title: Small business stock-income tax deduction from capital gain from sale/exchange
nj:A 4455.summary: Exempts from New Jersey gross income capital gains from selling qualified small business stock held more than five years, to the extent the gains are exempt under section 1202 of the federal tax code.

nj:A 4458.title: Automatic fire sprinkler sys-estab exemptions & revise implementation timeline
nj:A 4458.summary: Exempts new townhouses with permit or development applications filed before the bill's enactment from the sprinkler requirement, and moves the sprinkler requirement date to the 13th month after the original law's enactment.

nj:A 4463.title: Rehabilitative release-provide for certain incarcerated persons
nj:A 4463.summary: Requires the Department of Corrections to issue eligibility certificates for rehabilitative release to incarcerated people aged 60 or older who served 20 years, excluding murder and aggravated sexual assault convictions, who may then petition a court for release.

nj:A 4468.title: Eminent domain cases-replaces certain fixed interest rate award
nj:A 4468.summary: Replaces the fixed 6 percent interest rate on eminent domain compensation awards with interest set by the court after final determination of compensation.

nj:A 4473.title: Income tax assessments-eliminate statute of limitation, refunds induced by fraud
nj:A 4473.summary: Removes the five-year limit on assessing erroneous income tax refunds induced by fraud, so the Division of Taxation may assess at any time when a refund resulted from a false or fraudulent return filed with intent to evade tax.

nj:A 4475.title: Domestic violence offenders-estab standards for court-ordered counseling
nj:A 4475.summary: Sets standards for court-ordered domestic violence counseling programs, requiring risk assessments, education on power and control tactics, attendance reporting to the court, and regular program review by the Department of Children and Families.

nj:A 4478.title: Transportation infrastructure projects-expand cert sums to make loans for FY2025
nj:A 4478.summary: Authorizes the NJ Infrastructure Bank to spend up to $53,883,706 in fiscal year 2025 on low-interest loans to local governments for 14 listed transportation infrastructure projects.

nj:A 4479.title: Social media platforms-co-op w/ nonprofit org initiatives, nonconsensual images
nj:A 4479.summary: Requires social media companies to cooperate with nonprofit initiatives to remove nonconsensual intimate images and videos, including deceptive audio or visual media, from their platforms.

nj:A 4521.title: Pre-trial release-concerns provision of services to defendants
nj:A 4521.summary: Lets counties appoint a pretrial release coordinator to assess defendants on pretrial release and offer voluntary help accessing treatment, services and public benefits.

nj:A 4525.title: Economic Redevelopment & Growth Grant prog-extend deadline, cert projects
nj:A 4525.summary: Extends from June 30, 2028 to June 30, 2032 the deadline to submit a temporary certificate of occupancy for certain residential and mixed-use parking projects in Garden State Growth Zones under the Economic Redevelopment and Growth Grant program.

nj:A 4527.title: Keyless locking mechanisms and burglar's tools-concerns
nj:A 4527.summary: Expands the burglar’s tools law to cover devices or programs that can open keyless locks; manufacturing them or publishing instructions for them is a fourth-degree crime.

nj:A 4528.title: Home Security Systems Anti-Burglary Task Force-establishes
nj:A 4528.summary: Creates a 14-member Home Security Systems Anti-Burglary Task Force in the Department of Law and Public Safety to study home security systems and recommend improvements to manufacturers and installers in a report to the Governor and Legislature.

nj:A 4529.title: Transmission-scale energy storage procurement-modifies cert requirements
nj:A 4529.summary: Extends from June 30 to December 31, 2026 the Board of Public Utilities' deadline to approve incentive awards for at least 1,000 megawatts of transmission-scale energy storage, and modifies Tranche 2 project maturity requirements to widen eligibility.

nj:A 4530.title: Receipt of stolen prop-allows sentencing to extended term, repeat convictions
nj:A 4530.summary: Allows an extended prison term, on prosecutor motion, for persistent offenders with two or more prior convictions for receiving stolen property who reoffend within 10 years of release or of the last such offense.

nj:A 4531.title: Electric vehicle supply equip-estab alternative compliance standards for devel
nj:A 4531.summary: Lets gas station and retail owners on certain highways or near highway exits meet electric vehicle charger and make-ready space requirements by providing minimum total charging capacity, under Statewide standards the Site Improvement Advisory Board sets within 12 months.

nj:A 4532.title: Burglary of residential dwelling-establishes separate crime
nj:A 4532.summary: Creates burglary of a residential dwelling as a separate crime, keeping the same penalties: third degree, or second degree if injury is inflicted or threatened, a weapon is displayed, or a resident is present.

nj:A 4533.title: Financing mechanisms for sch facilities projects-revises cert sections of law
nj:A 4533.summary: Changes financing for school facilities projects in regular operating districts: removes the nominal-rent requirement and bar on charging districts bond costs, requires district lease payments to cover debt service not paid by State aid, and exempts those payments from spending and levy caps.

nj:A 4534.title: Trans infrastructure projects & related debt svc-revise asst fund, include costs
nj:A 4534.summary: Lets Urban Enterprise Zone assistance funds pay for transportation infrastructure improvements within a zone and related debt service, with no more than 75 percent of zone assistance funds used for that debt service.

nj:A 4535.title: Cooperative sober living residences & boarding houses-concerns State regulation
nj:A 4535.summary: Raises the maximum civil penalty for operating an unlicensed rooming or boarding house from $5,000 to $25,000 per building and, for cooperative sober living residences, requires twice-yearly unannounced inspections, a public list of licensed residences, and incident reports.

nj:A 4542.title: Motor vehicle tracking device-makes it a fourth degree crime
nj:A 4542.summary: Makes it a fourth-degree crime to knowingly place an electronic tracking device or tracking app to track another person in order to initiate or facilitate an unlawful act, punishable by up to 18 months in prison.

nj:A 4543.title: February 2019 police sergent exam-concerns Paterson & Newark police
nj:A 4543.summary: Deems conditional promotions of Paterson and Newark police officers made after the February 23, 2019 sergeant exam to be regular appointments as of the original appointment dates.

nj:A 4544.title: Child care asst prog-expand eligibility req, include full-time/post-grad student
nj:A 4544.summary: Expands child care assistance eligibility, subject to appropriations, to full-time graduate and post-graduate students who meet the program's income, asset and residency requirements.

nj:A 4554.title: Special improvement districts-requires DCA survey and report
nj:A 4554.summary: Requires the Department of Community Affairs to survey municipalities within six months, publish a list of all special improvement districts online, and update the list every two years.

nj:A 4562.title: Deferred compensation plans-implement automatic enrollment of employees
