nj:A 4562.summary: Lets the State, counties and municipalities adopt automatic enrollment of public employees in deferred compensation plans, deducting a set percentage of salary unless the employee opts out; terms for union-represented employees are negotiated with their union.

nj:A 4571.title: NJ Infrastructure Bank-make various changes to powers and duties
nj:A 4571.summary: Changes NJ Infrastructure Bank laws: moves the no-new-debt date from June 30, 2033 to 2053, allows onsite wastewater system loans, exempts short-term loans from Treasurer approval in two programs, and directs the Transportation Commissioner to list $5 million for marine projects in fiscal 2026.

nj:A 4572.title: Open space aquisition & park development projects-approp to DEP;$101.696M
nj:A 4572.summary: Appropriates $101,696,535 to the Department of Environmental Protection, including $99.3 million in grants or loans to local governments to acquire or develop recreation and conservation land and $2.41 million for administrative costs.

nj:A 4577.title: Technology upgrades, proposed-req St depart & Office of Technology prov reports
nj:A 4577.summary: Requires State departments and agencies to report annually to the Office of Information Technology on ways to improve digital services and employee remote work; the office sends the Governor and Legislature one summary report with analysis and recommendations.

nj:A 4581.title: Community Hazard Assistance Mitigation Prog projects-expend cert sums, make loan
nj:A 4581.summary: Authorizes the NJ Infrastructure Bank to spend up to $7,198,045 in fiscal year 2025 on low-interest loans to local governments for six hazard mitigation and resilience projects.

nj:A 4587.title: Cosmetology & hairstyling-increase hrs required, obtain licensure as teacher
nj:A 4587.summary: Raises the hours required to be licensed as a cosmetology-hairstyling teacher or massage and bodywork therapist from 500 to 600.

nj:A 4603.title: Farming activity complaints-award farmer, defending against bad faith complaints
nj:A 4603.summary: Lets farmers recover reasonable costs and attorney fees for defending against bad faith complaints about commercial agricultural operations, when a county board or the State Agriculture Development Committee so finds under the Right to Farm Act.

nj:A 4618.title: Official inspection facility-concerns employment following contract renewal
nj:A 4618.summary: Requires existing qualified employees covered by a collective bargaining agreement to be offered jobs first when a contract to run a motor vehicle inspection facility is renewed or newly awarded, with pay and benefits the same as or comparable to that agreement.

nj:A 4619.title: Historic Prop Reinvestment & Brownfields Redevel Incentive Prog-concerns
nj:A 4619.summary: Raises Historic Property Reinvestment Program tax credits (to 60 percent or $12 million in some areas, up from 45 percent or $8 million), makes some facade projects eligible, and revises the Brownfields Redevelopment Incentive Program.

nj:A 4628.title: Continuous glucose monitoring sys-req health coverage, glycogen storage disease
nj:A 4628.summary: Requires health insurers, State and school employee health plans to cover continuous glucose monitoring systems prescribed by a health care practitioner for treating glycogen storage disease.

nj:A 4630.title: Cosmetology Licensure Compact-enter NJ
nj:A 4630.summary: Enters New Jersey into the Cosmetology Licensure Compact, letting a cosmetologist licensed in one member state practice in other member states under the compact's requirements.

nj:A 4636.title: Gift card sales-req notice concerning fraud posted by retail mercantile estab
nj:A 4636.summary: Requires retailers that sell gift cards to display a notice near the cards warning consumers about gift card fraud and what to do if fraud is suspected.

nj:A 4641.title: Rental property insurance-notify company, activity that violates terms of policy
nj:A 4641.summary: Allows municipalities to adopt ordinances letting an official notify a rental property's insurer of observable activity suspected to violate the policy, such as repeated noise violations, dangerous overcrowding, underage drinking, vandalism or violence.

nj:A 4642.title: Agency-after sch care svc hours, unused-use during holiday/weekend hours
nj:A 4642.summary: Requires the Division of Children's System of Care to let families of people up to age 21 with developmental disabilities use unused after-school care hours before school and during school-day closures within the 90-day authorization period.

nj:A 4643.title: Child endangerment via use of social media-creates penalty
nj:A 4643.summary: Makes it child endangerment to use electronic communications, including social media, to knowingly act in a way likely to injure a child's welfare; a second-degree crime for caregivers and a third-degree crime for others.

nj:A 4651.title: Public brawl & disorderly conduct-establish penalties for certain conduct
nj:A 4651.summary: Subjects parents or guardians who showed willful or wanton disregard in supervising a juvenile to a $1,000 fine if the juvenile was adjudicated delinquent for property damage, or to a petty disorderly persons offense (disorderly if repeated) for inciting a public brawl.

nj:A 4652.title: Public brawl-establish offense; upgrade penalty for disorderly conduct
nj:A 4652.summary: Creates the offense of inciting a public brawl, a fourth-degree crime or disorderly persons offense depending on intent, and creates disorderly persons offenses for disrupting a public gathering and for masking one's identity during disorderly conduct.

nj:A 4653.title: Crowd management, cert large gatherings-estab training prog & prov resources
nj:A 4653.summary: Requires the Attorney General to create a training program and provide resources to help local police manage large gatherings of more than 500 people and flash mobs of 50 or more people.

nj:A 4654.title: Family planning & reproductive health care svcs-req health benefits coverage
nj:A 4654.summary: Requires insurers, the State Health Benefits Program and Medicaid to cover family planning and reproductive health services, including abortion, counseling, genetic testing and ultrasound, without cost sharing when in-network; childbirth is excluded.

nj:A 4664.title: Social media platform-proh promoting cert practices/features, eating disorders
nj:A 4664.summary: Bars social media platforms from using designs, algorithms or features they know or should know could cause child users to develop eating disorders; penalty up to $250,000 per violation. Platforms that audit and fix problems, or have under $100 million in revenue, are exempt.

nj:A 4666.title: Movie theater, for-profit-acquire plenary retail consumption license
nj:A 4666.summary: Allows municipalities, with Alcoholic Beverage Control approval, to issue plenary retail consumption licenses to for-profit movie theaters, permitting alcohol sales during the hour before and during showings; initial fee is capped at $250,000.

nj:A 4678.title: Renaissance school projects-clarifies payments, non-resident students enrolled
nj:A 4678.summary: Requires a renaissance school project's host district to pay the per-pupil amount only for resident students, with other students' home districts paying it, and adds the projects to the Charter School Enrollment System.

nj:A 4684.title: Sexual offenses, certain-removes certain limitations on recovery for victims
nj:A 4684.summary: Allows pain-and-suffering damages against a public entity or employee in lawsuits under the existing law lifting immunity for sexual assault, sexual abuse and other sexual crimes, without the $3,600 medical-expense threshold.

nj:A 4687.title: Fire fighting apparatus & equipment-concerns local government acquisition
nj:A 4687.summary: Raises the maximum term for local government contracts to lease fire-fighting vehicles and equipment with a purchase option from 10 to 20 years, and extends the maximum maturity of fire district bond anticipation notes from three to 10 years.

nj:A 4700.title: State budget for fiscal year 2025-State funds $56.635B & federal funds $27.501B
nj:A 4700.summary: Appropriates $56.6 billion in State funds and $27.5 billion in federal funds for the New Jersey budget for fiscal year 2025.

nj:A 4702.title: Sales and use tax exemption-phase out on zero emission vehicles
nj:A 4702.summary: Phases out the sales tax exemption for zero emission vehicles, taxing them at 3.3125% from October 2024 and the full 6.625% from July 2025, and repeals the annual sales tax holiday on certain school supplies and sports equipment.

nj:A 4704.title: Corporate transit fee-impose 2.5%, alloc taxable net income in excess of $10M
nj:A 4704.summary: Imposes a 2.5% surtax, the Corporate Transit Fee, on corporation business tax filers with New Jersey allocated net income over $10 million, for 2024 through 2028. S corporations and public utilities are excluded.

nj:A 4705.title: HMO-increase annual assessment to six percent on net written premiums
nj:A 4705.summary: Raises the annual assessment on health maintenance organizations' net written premiums from five percent to six percent.

nj:A 4706.title: Property tax relief programs, certain-revises statutes implementing
nj:A 4706.summary: Aligns the homestead benefit, homestead reimbursement and Stay NJ credit programs: residency and age 65 measured at December 31, one combined application from February 1 to October 31, set payment months, and the Stay NJ credit reduced by the other two benefits.

nj:A 4707.title: Real property & improvements, certain-sell as surplus, City of Camden
nj:A 4707.summary: Authorizes the State Treasurer to sell the former Riverfront State Prison site in Camden, a surplus 16-acre parcel, splitting it between the New Jersey Economic Development Authority and the City of Camden.

nj:A 4708.title: Cultural Projects-appropriates $5M to the Department of State
nj:A 4708.summary: Appropriates $5 million from the General Fund to the Department of State for cultural projects.

nj:A 4712.title: Office of Veteran Advocate and ombudsman for DMVA-establish; approp funds
nj:A 4712.summary: Establishes an Office of the Veteran Advocate in, but not of, the Department of Military and Veterans Affairs, led by a Governor-appointed Advocate serving up to two five-year terms at a salary of at least $150,000.

nj:A 4714.title: Riot-broaden; enhance penalties, cert crime committed during; creates new crimes
nj:A 4714.summary: As introduced, redefines riot as a violent disturbance by three or more people, creates aggravated riot and inciting a riot crimes, raises penalties for certain crimes committed during a riot, and holds people arrested for riot until a pretrial detention hearing.

nj:A 4745.title: Voting period, early-concerns for regular municipal elections in May
nj:A 4745.summary: Lets municipalities that hold May nonpartisan elections and offer early voting adopt an ordinance starting early voting eight calendar days before the election, instead of the default four.

nj:A 4750.title: Employer reporting requirements-concerns
nj:A 4750.summary: Expands employer new-hire reporting to the Department of Human Services to entities that employ or contract with people for pay, including ride-sharing and delivery platforms and workers paid on Form 1099.

nj:A 4751.title: SPRS-permits purchase of service credit for cert military and police service
nj:A 4751.summary: Lets State Police Retirement System members buy service credit for military service academy enrollment that led to a degree, State Police Academy enrollment that led directly to joining the system, and qualifying prior service as a class two special law enforcement officer.

nj:A 4753.title: Water safety video-req hospital & birthing facilities request new parents watch
nj:A 4753.summary: Directs the Department of Health to give hospitals and birthing facilities a child water safety video and to require them to have new parents watch it before discharge.

nj:A 4757.title: Amusement games licenses-issued to certain non-profit organizations
nj:A 4757.summary: Allows amusement games licenses to be issued to 501(c)(3) charitable organizations to run amusement games at festivals, carnivals or fairs they sponsor or benefit, if other licensing requirements are met.

nj:A 4761.title: Senior/Disab Resident Trans Asst Prog-auth funding, on-demand micro transit prog
nj:A 4761.summary: Makes any county that provides on-demand micro transit service to seniors and people with disabilities eligible for aid under the Senior Citizen and Disabled Resident Transportation Assistance Program.

nj:A 4762.title: Nursing home administrators-revise law related to licensure
nj:A 4762.summary: Writes nursing home administrator licensure rules from Health Department regulations into law, creates an Administrative Intern Training program with preceptor requirements, and requires the department to set up a licensing portal for administrators and trainees.

nj:A 4763.title: Water safety-req devel of educational fact sheet for public & nonpublic schools
nj:A 4763.summary: Requires the Department of Children and Families to develop a water safety fact sheet for parents, which the Department of Education makes available to schools, and requires districts to list locations offering swim lessons that ask to be included.

nj:A 4765.title: Driver education & testing- concerns responsibilities approaching pedestrians
nj:A 4765.summary: Requires driver education materials, classroom courses and the permit test to cover a driver's duties and penalties when passing pedestrians, bicyclists and personal conveyances, and adds roadway-sharing information to the driver's manual.

nj:A 4767.title: Menstrual products-bans regulated perfluoroalkyl & polyfluoroaklyl substances
nj:A 4767.summary: Limits regulated PFAS chemicals in menstrual products, requires the Department of Environmental Protection to set up PFAS testing and approve labs, and makes violations an unlawful practice under the Consumer Fraud Act.

nj:A 4794.title: Tax data, cert-share w/ NJ Innovation Auth. and NJ Secure Choice Savings Bd.
nj:A 4794.summary: Allows the Division of Taxation to share certain confidential tax data with the New Jersey Innovation Authority and the New Jersey Secure Choice Savings Board for specified purposes.

nj:A 4801.title: Large-load addition costomers-establish certain protections against demand
nj:A 4801.summary: Bars electric utilities from passing costs of large new power users (50 MW or more, or a Board-set threshold) to other customers. Puts PJM curtailments and capacity obligations on those users, who must post financial security and give PJM detailed load information.

nj:A 4811.title: Summer tuition and grants-makes FY2025 suppl approp;$20M
nj:A 4811.summary: Makes a $20 million supplemental fiscal year 2025 appropriation for Summer Tuition Aid Grants, funding 75 percent of full grant amounts, with up to 100 percent if surplus funds are transferred.

nj:A 4813.title: Stationary vehicles, certain-imposes conditions on drivers approaching
nj:A 4813.summary: Requires drivers approaching a stationary vehicle displaying flashing or blinking lights to use due caution and either move to a non-adjacent lane or slow down and be ready to stop, extending the existing move-over rule beyond emergency vehicles.

nj:A 4814.title: Tianeptine-establish as Schedule II controlled dangerous substance
nj:A 4814.summary: Classifies tianeptine as a Schedule II opiate, making its manufacture or distribution a second- or third-degree crime depending on quantity, and its possession a third-degree crime.

nj:A 4818.title: Tourist development comm disbursements-reduces & clarifies req for advertising
nj:A 4818.summary: Lowers from 50 to 20 percent the share of revenues municipal tourist development commissions must spend on advertising outside the municipality, and defines that as ads aimed at people who live or work elsewhere.

nj:A 4835.title: Victim's Asst & Survivor Protection Act-permit pretrial detention, contempt viol
nj:A 4835.summary: Lets a prosecutor move for pretrial detention of a defendant charged with contempt of a protective order issued under the Victim's Assistance and Survivor Protection Act, as is already allowed for domestic violence restraining orders.

nj:A 4838.title: Serious mental illness-req prescription drug coverage w/o prior authorization
nj:A 4838.summary: Requires insurers, Medicaid and NJ FamilyCare to cover serious mental illness drugs for adults without prior authorization or step therapy when prescribed by a psychiatrist, or by an obstetrician-gynecologist postpartum. Other prescribers may continue a drug after six stable months.

nj:A 4841.title: Housing & employment-concerns discrimination, including lawful income and age
nj:A 4841.summary: Bars housing discrimination based on source of lawful income used for rent or mortgage payments, including housing vouchers, public assistance and court-ordered payments, by adding it to the Law Against Discrimination and defining the term.

nj:A 4848.title: Lead screening, pregnant persons-perform under certain circumstances
nj:A 4848.summary: Requires licensed health care professionals providing prenatal care to assess pregnant patients for lead exposure risk factors under CDC and ACOG guidelines, and allows referral elsewhere for required lead screening.

nj:A 4852.title: Schedule II controlled dangerous substances-permit prescription via telemedicine
nj:A 4852.summary: Removes the in-person exam requirement for prescribing Schedule II drugs by telemedicine for cancer, hospice and long-term care patients and for substance use disorder treatment, and sets rules for telemedicine stimulant prescriptions to adults.

nj:A 4854.title: Auxiliary and remedial services-modifies method of allocating State aid
nj:A 4854.summary: Directs the Commissioner of Education to set up a process for reimbursing school districts for auxiliary and remedial services to nonpublic school students, within maximum per-service aid amounts set by the commissioner.

nj:A 4857.title: Anti-SLAPP protections-extend complainants, sexual assault, harrassment, discrim
nj:A 4857.summary: Extends the State's anti-SLAPP law, which lets defendants seek quick dismissal of retaliatory lawsuits and recover legal costs, to people who report or complain about sexual assault, harassment or discrimination.

nj:A 4872.title: Residential dwelling units-proh facilitation, agreement among rental prop owners
nj:A 4872.summary: Bars rental property owners from using a coordinator, such as pricing software services, or agreeing among themselves to restrict competition on residential rents or units; violations break the New Jersey Antitrust Act.

nj:A 4877.title: Board of authority commissioners-replaces definition of management committee
nj:A 4877.summary: Renames the "management committee" of a regional rehabilitation and reentry center authority the "board of authority commissioners," requires two or more counties to form the authority by agreement, and changes rules on withdrawal, dissolution, debt service and audits.

nj:A 4881.title: Power NJ Act-estab advanced nuclear energy procurement program in BPU
nj:A 4881.summary: Directs the Board of Public Utilities, with the Economic Development Authority, to set up a program to procure advanced nuclear energy facilities, starting with expressions of interest, and requires electricity suppliers to buy Reliability Capacity Certificates to pay qualified projects.

nj:A 4883.title: Film Trail-require Division of Travel and Tourism to establish
nj:A 4883.summary: Requires the Division of Travel and Tourism to establish a New Jersey Film Trail identifying locations used to film movies and television, excluding private residences, with public site submissions and a website.

nj:A 4897.title: Student id cards, cert-revise law req to contain no, suicide prevention hotline
nj:A 4897.summary: Requires school and college student ID cards to list a phone number for mental health and suicide crisis resources chosen by the Human Services Commissioner, replacing the current Hopeline and crisis text line requirement.

nj:A 4899.title: Application fee-proh resid landlord charging, greater than cost of credit check
nj:A 4899.summary: Bars landlords of most rental units from charging an application fee over $50, adjusted annually for inflation, with penalties of up to $500 for a first offense, $750 for a second and $1,000 for later ones.

nj:A 4913.title: Develop housing-estab cert St funding preference, mun that enhance opportunities
nj:A 4913.summary: Creates a program giving municipalities preference in certain competitively awarded State funding if they reexamine and amend master plans and development rules to allow residential development at greater densities.

nj:A 4928.title: Small business set-aside program-establishes eligibility requirements
nj:A 4928.summary: Clarifies that only businesses with no applicable federal revenue standard must meet a maximum employee count for the State small business set-aside program, and changes the gross revenue definition from three years in business to five.

nj:A 4937.title: Medical cannabis dispensaries-remove proh on establishing satellite locations
nj:A 4937.summary: Allows medical cannabis dispensaries to maintain up to two satellite locations with Cannabis Regulatory Commission approval, and lets a commission member hold local elected office under certain circumstances.

nj:A 4941.title: Educational support professionals-prov seniority service credit for military svc
nj:A 4941.summary: Gives educational support professionals who are eligible for federal veterans' benefits up to four years of seniority credit for prior active military service.

nj:A 4947.title: Real estate licensees-revise continuing education requirements
nj:A 4947.summary: Raises real estate continuing education for biennial license renewal from up to 16 to 18 hours, raises hours for referral-company salespersons moving to full licensure (30 to 36 or 45), and changes how education providers, instructors and courses are regulated.

nj:A 4948.title: City of Perth Amboy, FY2024 St aid approp-allow use, broader pedestrian safety
nj:A 4948.summary: Allows the unspent FY2024 appropriation for the Perth Amboy Convery Boulevard Pedestrian Bridge to be used for pedestrian infrastructure projects in the city.

nj:A 4954.title: Historic preservation planning course-req member, historic preserv comm complete
nj:A 4954.summary: Requires members of historic preservation commissions to complete a Department of Community Affairs course of up to five hours, with exemptions for certified professional planners and those who have taken a more extensive course.

nj:A 4961.title: Transportation infrastructure projects, FY2027-expend cert sums to make loans
nj:A 4961.summary: Authorizes the New Jersey Infrastructure Bank to spend up to $65.55 million in FY2027 on low-interest loans to local governments for 15 listed transportation projects, with up to $100,000 per borrower forgiven on qualifying loans.

nj:A 4966.title: Human trafficking prosecution-elim statute of limitation, extend for civil cases
nj:A 4966.summary: Extends the deadline for human trafficking victims to file civil suits from five years to the latest of 10 years after the conduct, 10 years after turning 18 for minors, or two years after discovering the injury.

nj:A 4968.title: Transportation infrastructure projects-modifies list, eligible to receive loans
nj:A 4968.summary: Changes the list of transportation projects the Infrastructure Bank may fund with loans to local governments in fiscal year 2025, and raises its spending authority from $53,883,706 to $61,400,000.

nj:A 4969.title: Cast ballots-ensure boards, discretion to make initial determination of validity
nj:A 4969.summary: Directs district and county boards of election to use discretion and judgment in deciding whether ballot marks were meant to identify the ballot or show voter intent, and requires the Secretary of State to set uniform guidelines for assessing ballot validity.

nj:A 4971.title: Small businesses-provide grants, affected by St infra and constr projects;$750K
nj:A 4971.summary: Requires the Economic Development Authority to create a Small Business Interruption Grant Program for small businesses with economic loss from extended closures caused by prolonged public construction projects; project entities contribute up to 5 percent of project costs.

nj:A 4973.title: The Manufactured Home Park Protection Act-expands opportunity to purchase
nj:A 4973.summary: Gives manufactured home park residents a chance to buy their park, as a group with 51 percent consent, within 120 days when the landowner plans a sale; as revised by the Governor, applies only to sales with no binding agreement yet.

nj:A 4974.title: Machine gun conversion devices-establish criminal penalties, sale & possession
nj:A 4974.summary: Expands the definition of machine gun to include frames, receivers and conversion parts, and creates crimes for possessing or selling machine gun conversion devices and a third-degree crime for manufacturing, transporting or disposing of them.

nj:A 4975.title: Firearms/firearm components-estab crime, digital instructions to illegally manuf
nj:A 4975.summary: Makes it a fourth-degree crime for an unlicensed person to knowingly possess digital instructions for programming a 3D printer to make a firearm, receiver, magazine or firearm component.

nj:A 4976.title: Reckless discharge of firearm-establish crime
nj:A 4976.summary: Makes recklessly discharging a firearm with live ammunition a disorderly persons offense, then a fourth-degree crime for a second offense and third-degree for a third or later, raised one degree if knowingly within 100 yards of an occupied structure or school.

nj:A 4978.title: Shootings, did not result in bodily injury-require AG report data
nj:A 4978.summary: Requires county prosecutors to give the Attorney General quarterly data for three years on criminal complaints for firearm discharges that caused no bodily injury, and the Attorney General to publish a report afterward.

nj:A 4981.title: Firearms-permit court addl time, consider pretrial release or pretrial detention
nj:A 4981.summary: Lets a court, at the prosecutor's request, take more than the current 48 hours, up to seven days, to decide pretrial release or detention when the charged offense involves a firearm, for ballistic analysis.

nj:A 4982.title: Treatment of eating disorders-proh body weight factor, determining coverage
nj:A 4982.summary: Bars health insurance carriers from using a person's body weight as a factor in deciding coverage for eating disorder treatment.

nj:A 4983.title: Student-athlete eating disorder training prog-req cert trainers/coaches complete
nj:A 4983.summary: Requires certain athletic trainers and coaches of school sports, cheerleading, dance and college sports to complete a student-athlete eating disorder awareness training program developed by the Commissioner of Education.

nj:A 4984.title: Statewide Student Support Svcs prog-expand svc provided, include eating disorder
nj:A 4984.summary: Authorizes the Department of Children and Families to expand the Statewide Student Support Services program to include eating disorder awareness, prevention and counseling for K-12 students, based on community needs assessments by regional hubs.

nj:A 4986.title: Early language instruct-codifies prog for deaf/hard of hearing/deaf-blind child
nj:A 4986.summary: Establishes in law a Department of Human Services program, free of charge, for deaf, hard of hearing and deaf-blind children age five and younger, matching families with trained American Sign Language Deaf Language Associates and a set curriculum.

nj:A 4994.title: Aquaculture-modify definition, include construction of facilities & structures
nj:A 4994.summary: Changes the State aquaculture definition to include, rather than exclude, construction of facilities and structures otherwise regulated by other laws, and applies that definition in Pinelands, marine fisheries and water laws.

nj:A 5000.title: Fertility preservation services-req Medicaid coverage, iatrogenic infertility
nj:A 5000.summary: Requires Medicaid and the Plan First program to cover standard fertility preservation services when medically necessary treatment may cause infertility, limited to one cycle unless the procedure fails.

nj:A 5004.title: Sexual exploitation/abuse of children-create separate crime for items depicting
nj:A 5004.summary: Makes child sexual abuse material a separate crime from child endangerment, expands it to manipulated images appearing to show an identifiable or purported child in a sex act, and revises "child erotica" definitions after a State Supreme Court ruling.

nj:A 5016.title: Employee ownership-establish program in EDA to encourage awareness
nj:A 5016.summary: Requires the Economic Development Authority to create an Employee Ownership Transition Program offering financial assistance and education to businesses exploring employee ownership, and an advisory committee on employee ownership.

nj:A 5017.title: Insurance-support organizations-exempt cert personal information collected
nj:A 5017.summary: Exempts insurance-support organizations, national securities associations, information treated like HIPAA health information, and certain clinical research data from New Jersey's consumer data privacy law, and expands its definition of de-identified data to include HIPAA de-identified data.

nj:A 5018.title: Juvenile defendants-concerns rights, elect to be tried as adults
nj:A 5018.summary: Gives juveniles who voluntarily elect to be tried as adults the same procedural rights as juveniles waived to adult court by a prosecutor, and requires the court to find the election knowing and voluntary.

nj:A 5034.title: Superintendent of State Police-hold rank of Colonel of State Police
nj:A 5034.summary: Makes the Superintendent of State Police hold the rank of Colonel, requiring State Police Academy graduation and a law enforcement license, and lets a State Police retirement system retiree be appointed without reenrolling.

nj:A 5037.title: Election results-revises procedures governing audits
nj:A 5037.summary: Allows post-election audits to be done with an independent third-party electronic machine, separate from the official tabulation system, that is certified by an accredited laboratory and tested with the same test decks used before the election.

nj:A 5042.title: Goods and services-req public entities purchase 5% from Central Nonprofit Agency
nj:A 5042.summary: Changes State agencies’ good-faith goal into a requirement to buy five percent of goods and services through the Central Nonprofit Agency, and has the Division of Purchase and Property set training protocols for purchasing agents.

nj:A 5043.title: Cardiomyopathy-create and disseminate materials and resources;$300K
nj:A 5043.summary: Requires the Department of Health to create cardiomyopathy education materials and a risk assessment, report every five years on cardiomyopathy data and research, and authorizes school CPR and AED grants.

nj:A 5049.title: Retirement or death benefits-remove cert limitations on receipt under PFRS
nj:A 5049.summary: Removes the Police and Firemen's Retirement System board's power to withhold benefits over a member's pending employment-related civil litigation, except while a member challenges a board benefit decision in court; lets it adjust benefits after proceedings end.

nj:A 5051.title: Hemp, intoxicating hemp beverages, and medical cannabis-revise cert restrictions
nj:A 5051.summary: Revises hemp rules: allows 10 mg THC cans or 750 mL bottles up to 200 mg, a 10 percent lab-testing margin, and sales by some packaged-alcohol bars; exempts co-located adult-use shops at medical dispensaries from added municipal review; extends producer deadlines to November 13, 2026.

nj:A 5052.title: Behavioral health issues affecting children-req coverage, screen/prevent/treat
nj:A 5052.summary: Requires health insurers and Medicaid to cover screening, prevention and treatment of behavioral health issues in children, and to accept and pay claims that use an at-risk diagnosis.

nj:A 5059.title: Fertility fraud-establishes crime
nj:A 5059.summary: Makes it a third-degree crime, punishable by three to five years in prison, for a health care practitioner to perform assisted reproduction resulting in pregnancy using their own or another person's reproductive material without the patient's written consent, with permanent license revocation.

nj:A 5062.title: Alzheimer's disease & related disorders-req coverage for testing & treatments
nj:A 5062.summary: Requires health insurers, State and school employee health benefits programs, and Medicaid to cover medically necessary diagnostic tests and FDA-approved treatments prescribed to slow Alzheimer's disease and related disorders, and bars step therapy for those treatments.

nj:A 5064.title: NJT-publish certain performance-related information
nj:A 5064.summary: Requires NJ Transit to publish monthly online: rail cancellations and their causes; on-time performance for rail, light rail, bus (including six named terminals) and Access Link; and mean distance between failure for rail, light rail and bus.

nj:A 5067.title: Peter J. Barnes III Wildlife Preservation Comm-req appointment, alternate member
nj:A 5067.summary: Requires each appointing authority of the Peter J. Barnes III Wildlife Preservation Commission to name a five-year alternate member who votes only when a regular member from the same appointing authority is absent or disabled.

nj:A 5071.title: Lactation rooms-make available at certain PANYNJ airports
nj:A 5071.summary: Requires lactation rooms at Port Authority airports with 1,000,000 or more yearly enplanements, and at smaller ones above 10,000 when a terminal is built or renovated; rooms need a chair and outlet and must be outside restrooms.

nj:A 5076.title: Maternity policy for troopers-require State Police to establish
nj:A 5076.summary: Requires the Superintendent of State Police to create a recovery leave policy giving troopers who present proof of pregnancy at least eight weeks of paid leave after giving birth, not counted as sick leave.

nj:A 5077.title: Student growth objective data-extend statutory pause on collection
nj:A 5077.summary: Extends the pause on collecting student growth objective data until the next readoption of the state teacher-evaluation regulations, and adds a pause on administrator goals data.

nj:A 5086.title: Underage gambling-revises penalty to be civil penalty
nj:A 5086.summary: Changes underage gambling at casinos and simulcasting facilities from a disorderly persons offense to a civil fine of up to $500, $1,000 or $2,000 by offense, with fines going to compulsive gambling programs.

nj:A 5100.title: Town of West New York-re-approp balance of FY2024 approp; Recreation Ctr;$3M
nj:A 5100.summary: Provides a $3 million fiscal year 2025 supplemental appropriation for the Town of West New York and re-appropriates the unspent balance of a FY2024 overpass appropriation to support building a recreation center.

nj:A 5107.title: St's child care assistance prog-req DHS conduct review of reimbursement rates
nj:A 5107.summary: Requires the Department of Human Services to review child care assistance reimbursement rates for providers serving non-traditional hours, such as early morning and late evening, and to seek federal funding if the rates are inadequate.

nj:A 5116.title: Primary election ballots & certain related procedures-make changes to design
nj:A 5116.summary: Requires primary election ballots to be arranged by office block with uniform minimum design features, removes State committee members from the primary process, and requires the Division of Elections to report on primaries.

nj:A 5117.title: Election ballots, certain-modifies no, signatures req to be placed on ballot
nj:A 5117.summary: Raises signature requirements for candidate nominating petitions: statewide primary 1,000 to 2,500, congressional primary 200 to 500, legislative primary 100 to 250, and statewide general election 800 to 2,000; sets population-based tiers for municipal primaries.

nj:A 5118.title: Health care benefits-provide to disabled members of TPAF and PERS
nj:A 5118.summary: Lets certain disabled Teachers' Pension and Public Employees' Retirement System members who receive disability benefits enroll in State or school employees' health benefits at no employee cost, and refunds premiums they paid since January 1, 2024.

nj:A 5121.title: Acquisition of lands, recreational & conservative purposes-appropriate;$49.5M
nj:A 5121.summary: Appropriates $49.5 million from dedicated corporation business tax revenue to the Department of Environmental Protection for the State to acquire land for recreation and conservation, including Blue Acres projects.

nj:A 5130.title: Construction inspection-req enforcing agency conduct in specific time window
nj:A 5130.summary: Requires construction code enforcing agencies to inspect within a two-and-a-half-hour window announced in writing, creates a complaint process on the Department of Community Affairs website, and allows the department to issue penalties.

nj:A 5134.title: Transportation services-certain providers develop and publish route schedules
nj:A 5134.summary: Requires owners or operators of certain fixed-route autobuses and ferries, NJ Transit, the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey and the Delaware River Port Authority to develop and publish route schedules on their websites and at stations and stops.

nj:A 5141.title: Historic distillery license-establish; allow products on/off licensed premises
nj:A 5141.summary: Creates a historic distillery license for premises on the New Jersey Register of Historic Places, allowing the holder to make distilled beverages and sell them at retail for consumption on and off the premises.

nj:A 5146.title: Civil service working test period-remove exception for political subdivision emp
nj:A 5146.summary: Sets the civil service working test period for local government employees at four months, extendable to six, instead of three months.

nj:A 5151.title: Public notices & legal advertisements-allow public bodies, continue newspapers
nj:A 5151.summary: Deems newspapers used for public notices and legal advertisements in 2024 eligible for the same purpose from January 1 to March 1, 2025, caps publication prices at the current-law amount, and bars fees or registration to view electronic notices.

nj:A 5152.title: June 2025 primary election-reschedule date; provide adjustment, cert deadlines
nj:A 5152.summary: Moves the June 3, 2025 primary election to June 10, 2025, to accommodate a period of religious observance. Most pre- and post-primary deadlines follow the new date, but petition, ballot-drawing and mail-ballot deadlines stay tied to June 3.

nj:A 5153.title: School nursing svcs & security svcs, nonpublic-permit unexpended St. aid
nj:A 5153.summary: Requires refunded, unspent State aid for nonpublic school nursing and security services to be used to raise the Statewide maximum per-pupil amount for nonpublic school transportation costs.

nj:A 5154.title: Persistent offenders-require jury, rather than court, to determine
nj:A 5154.summary: Requires a jury, rather than the judge, to decide whether a defendant is a persistent offender eligible for an extended prison term.

nj:A 5155.title: Domestic viol & stalking invest-req expedited compliance w/ cert search warrants
nj:A 5155.summary: Requires social media platforms to respond within 72 hours, and other communications providers within five business days, to search warrants marked "Immediate Response Required" in domestic violence and stalking investigations.

nj:A 516.title: Boil water-public water systems required to provide notice & qual. standard viol
nj:A 516.summary: Requires public water systems to notify affected customers and school administrators within 24 hours of a boil water notice, post notices on their websites and social media, and ask customers for preferred contact methods.

nj:A 5160.title: PERS-prov member & cert retiree same benefits, memb enrolled before July 1, 2007
nj:A 5160.summary: Requires school district employees working over 20 hours a week who are hired after the effective date, and current Defined Contribution Retirement Program participants who meet the criteria, to be enrolled in the Public Employees Retirement System.

nj:A 5169.title: Foreclosure Mediation Asst. Prog.-auth HMFA to make cert reimbursements
nj:A 5169.summary: Expands the Foreclosure Mediation Assistance Program so the Housing and Mortgage Finance Agency can also reimburse qualified counselors for pre-purchase homebuyer counseling.

nj:A 5170.title: Economic Recovery Act of 2020-require State purchase cert unused tax credits
nj:A 5170.summary: Requires the Director of the Division of Taxation to purchase unused Aspire Program and Cultural Arts Incentives Program tax credits at 85 percent of the credit amount, if the certificate was issued at least a year before the application.

nj:A 5174.title: Real estate, planned developments-modifies capital reserve funding requirements
nj:A 5174.summary: Changes capital reserve rules for planned real estate development associations: a 30-year funding plan may take the reserve fund to zero but not below, reserve adequacy is defined, and some inadequacies may be fixed over up to 30 years.

nj:A 5182.title: New Jersey Council of County Colleges-modernize responsibilities
nj:A 5182.summary: Requires the New Jersey Council of County Colleges to submit an annual State-support budget request, and directs that State operational aid to county colleges be distributed through a performance-based formula.

nj:A 5183.title: Industry-valued credential list-direct DOLWD develop and maintain
nj:A 5183.summary: Directs the Department of Labor and Workforce Development to maintain and annually update a public list of industry-valued credentials employers want most; as revised by the Governor, the department may, not must, do so.

nj:A 5188.title: Advanced Grid Technologies Act-req St oversight of suppl transmission projects
nj:A 5188.summary: Requires electric utilities to get Board of Public Utilities approval before building supplemental transmission projects, with a separate review process for projects meeting grid performance benchmarks (the Advanced Grid Technologies Act).

nj:A 5195.title: Firefighting equipt, cert-concerns perfluoroalkyl & polyfluoroalkyl substances
nj:A 5195.summary: Requires producers of firefighting protective equipment containing intentionally added PFAS chemicals to give purchasers written notice, and bars selling, making or distributing such equipment starting two years after the effective date; violations fall under the consumer fraud act.

nj:A 5199.title: Resident & fellow physician, emp by Rutgers-enroll/receive benf first day of emp
nj:A 5199.summary: Makes Rutgers resident and fellow physicians and their dependents eligible to enroll in State Health Benefits Program coverage on their first day of employment.

nj:A 5211.title: New Jersey Pathways to Career Opportunities Initiative Act-establish
nj:A 5211.summary: Establishes in law the New Jersey Pathways to Career Opportunities Initiative, run by the community college workforce consortium, to build career pathway partnerships among county colleges, employers, schools, unions and community organizations.

nj:A 5213.title: New Economy Opportunity Skill System Pilot Program-establish
nj:A 5213.summary: Creates a pilot program in selected local areas in which workforce development boards and community colleges jointly develop training programs, outreach and funding plans, and requires a strategy for scaling it Statewide.

nj:A 5217.title: Health benefits plans-concerns for covered benefits
nj:A 5217.summary: Requires health insurers and pharmacy benefit managers to count third-party discounts and payments, such as manufacturer coupons, toward an insured's copayments, coinsurance, deductibles and other out-of-pocket costs for covered benefits.

nj:A 5223.title: Facilities flexibility, psychiatric bed status-create voluntary pilot program
nj:A 5223.summary: Creates a 24-month voluntary pilot letting licensed inpatient psychiatric facilities temporarily use adult acute psychiatric beds as closed acute beds without Health Department approval, with quarterly public reports from participating facilities.

nj:A 5233.title: Cash transactions-allows rounding
nj:A 5233.summary: Sets rounding rules for merchants that choose to round cash totals to the nearest five cents, and fines merchants $1,000, $2,500, then $5,000 for repeat offenses of rounding up where the rules require rounding down.

nj:A 5236.title: Pediatric psychiatry/behavioral health care svcs-strengthen, children & families
nj:A 5236.summary: Makes the Department of Children and Families responsible for evaluating and overseeing pediatric psychiatry and behavioral health services, and requires hospitals and providers to report standardized data, with penalties of $100 to $500 per day for violations.

nj:A 5240.title: Local unit budget processes and related operations-concerns
nj:A 5240.summary: Extends deadlines for local budget steps, such as adopting the annual budget (to April 30 for counties and calendar-year municipalities) and completing the annual audit (eight months after year end), and sets a 90-day deadline to fill certain budget-related vacancies.

nj:A 5258.title: Wineries, cert-sell products by the glass, consumption in licensed salesrooms
nj:A 5258.summary: Lets plenary and farm winery license holders sell wine by the glass, including wine mixed with non-alcoholic drinks, for drinking in their licensed salesrooms.

nj:A 5260.title: Apparel, added perfluoroalkyl/polyfluoroalkyl-proh sale/manufacture/distribution
nj:A 5260.summary: Bars the sale, manufacture and distribution in New Jersey of apparel containing intentionally added PFAS chemicals, starting two years after the effective date; violations fall under the consumer fraud act.

nj:A 5264.title: Solar energy sys, resid-expedite constr code approval, application to install
nj:A 5264.summary: Requires the Commissioner of Community Affairs to create a State Smart Solar Permitting Platform within one year that automatically reviews applications and instantly issues permits for code-compliant residential solar and battery installations.

nj:A 5265.title: Landscape irrigation law-auth enforce, local enforcing agency & increase penal
nj:A 5265.summary: Lets local construction code enforcing agencies inspect job sites, sue for injunctions, assess civil penalties and shut down work for violations of the Landscape Irrigation Contractor Certification Act, which is now enforced only at the State level, and increases penalties.

nj:A 5267.title: Transmission-scale energy storage-require BPU to procure and incentivize
nj:A 5267.summary: Requires the Board of Public Utilities to run an incentive-award program for transmission-scale energy storage projects, with a procurement goal of 1,000 MW AC.

nj:A 5275.title: New crematory, construction-impose locational restriction
nj:A 5275.summary: Bars the New Jersey Cemetery Board, on and after January 1, 2025, from approving an application to build a crematory within 1,000 feet of a school, a residentially zoned area or a park or recreation area.

nj:A 5277.title: Property tax relief programs, cert-estab public awareness campaign & call center
nj:A 5277.summary: Requires the Division of Taxation to run a public awareness campaign and call center on property tax relief programs such as ANCHOR, Senior Freeze and Stay NJ, with an annual Stay NJ Task Force report.

nj:A 5278.title: Menopause Coverage Act-establish; require insurance coverage, cert treatments
nj:A 5278.summary: Establishes the New Jersey Menopause Coverage Act, requiring health insurers, State and school employee plans and NJ FamilyCare to cover medically necessary perimenopause and menopause treatment, including hormonal therapies.

nj:A 5303.title: Human trafficking-require AG review Statewide policy regarding investigation
nj:A 5303.summary: Requires the Attorney General to review the Statewide human trafficking investigation policy, including whether to record undercover investigations on audio or video, rules for sharing recordings, and early county prosecutor involvement.

nj:A 5305.title: Public awareness signage-broaden to include notices in Chinese & Korean
nj:A 5305.summary: Requires the State's human trafficking hotline public awareness signs to include Chinese and Korean translations.

nj:A 5307.title: Veteran suicide prevention public service announcements-DMVA receive vol contrib
nj:A 5307.summary: Allows the Department of Veterans Affairs to accept voluntary contributions to pay for veteran suicide prevention public service announcements.

nj:A 5308.title: Grant program to enhance local government efficiency-establish;$1.5M
nj:A 5308.summary: Requires the Division of Local Government Services to set up a grant program, funded with $1.5 million, to help local governments hire consultants to review their operations and recommend ways to streamline and cut costs.

nj:A 5309.title: Menopause-permit 1 credit continuing medical education, used for license renewal
nj:A 5309.summary: Requires the Boards of Medical Examiners and Nursing to include up to three optional continuing-education credits on menopause, including perimenopause, among the credits physicians and nurses need for license renewal.

nj:A 5322.title: Corporation business tax-impose temp $1M cap, operating loss deduct, cert period
nj:A 5322.summary: Caps net operating loss deductions under the corporation business tax at $1 million for periods ending from July 31, 2026 to before July 31, 2030, excluding public utilities; unused amounts carry forward.

nj:A 5323.title: Alternative business calculation-modifies eligibility for adjustment allowed
nj:A 5323.summary: Phases out the gross income tax alternative business calculation adjustment: taxpayers with gross income over $500,000 up to $1 million may deduct 25 percent of their business increment instead of 50, and those over $1 million get none.

nj:A 5324.title: Health benefits coverage through St. Medicaid prog-estab fee, cert employers
nj:A 5324.summary: Charges employers with 50 or more employees enrolled in State Medicaid an annual fee per such employee and dependent: $325 if 50 to 249 such employees, $525 if 250 to 499, $725 if 500 or more; exempts certain disabilities.

nj:A 5325.title: Business formation fees-reduce
nj:A 5325.summary: Lowers by $25 the State fee to file original formation papers for corporations, nonprofits, limited partnerships and LLCs, and the fee for out-of-state corporations, nonprofits and limited partnerships to register to do business in New Jersey.

nj:A 5327.title: State budget, fiscal year 2027-State funds $60.743B and federal funds $30.495B
nj:A 5327.summary: Appropriates $60.743 billion in State funds and $30.495 billion in federal funds for State government operations for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027.

nj:A 5328.title: Data brokers, data collectors, collection & dissemination of cert info-regulate
nj:A 5328.summary: Bars data controllers from selling sensitive data, and requires data brokers and data collectors that sell or license consumers' data to register annually with the Division of Consumer Affairs, which keeps a public registry.

nj:A 5330.title: Div. of Pensions & Benefits-initiate temp transfer of funds, cert circumstances
nj:A 5330.summary: Lets the Division of Pensions and Benefits director temporarily transfer funds from the local education retirees' health fund to the active employees' fund when it cannot cover 10 days of payments; repayment is due within 120 days, extendable up to 365 more.

nj:A 5345.title: Firearms & ammunition purchases-require use of merchant category codes
nj:A 5345.summary: Requires merchant acquirers to use the international merchant category code for firearms and ammunition businesses when processing purchases at firearms merchants located in New Jersey.

nj:A 5346.title: Firearm and Ammunition Procurement Act-estab State procurement practices
nj:A 5346.summary: Requires bidders on State contracts to certify that they do not sell unserialized gun build kits or firearm precursor parts, and sets other State procurement practices for firearms, ammunition and accessories.

nj:A 5353.title: Health care professionals-exempt from lic req, prov svcs in 2026 FIFA World Cup
nj:A 5353.summary: Exempts health care professionals licensed in other countries from New Jersey licensing requirements when treating team members and personnel during 2026 FIFA World Cup events.

nj:A 5355.title: Special license plate-auth creation, honoring Phi Beta Sigma & Zeta Phi Beta
nj:A 5355.summary: Authorizes the Motor Vehicle Commission to issue special license plates honoring Phi Beta Sigma Fraternity and Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, for a $50 application fee and $10 annual renewal fee on top of regular registration fees.

nj:A 5358.title: Secure Choice Saving Program-adjust qualification threshold
nj:A 5358.summary: Lowers the employer threshold for required participation in the Secure Choice Savings retirement program from 25 employees to 10, and changes administrative fees and board powers.

nj:A 5362.title: Casino licensees-prohibits from using non-wagering casino games
nj:A 5362.summary: Makes it unlawful for casino licensees to run non-wagering casino games that reward participation in a way that solicits future wagering; casinos may still offer unrelated rewards such as hotel stays or event tickets.

nj:A 5378.title: Cultural Arts Incentives Program-modifies provisions
nj:A 5378.summary: Expands eligibility for Cultural Arts Incentives Program tax credits, lets the Economic Development Authority accept applications on a rolling basis, and revises how credits are awarded.

nj:A 5381.title: Accidental disability retirement allowance, 9/11 World Trade Ctr rescue-concerns
nj:A 5381.summary: Lets PERS, PFRS and SPRS members and retirees show 9/11 World Trade Center accidental disability eligibility with alternative medical exam evidence, removes the filing deadline, and lets retirees denied for filing late petition for reconsideration.

nj:A 5383.title: Ovulation enhancing drugs/medical svc-req Medicaid coverage, cert beneficiaries
nj:A 5383.summary: Requires Medicaid, subject to federal matching funds, to cover ovulation-enhancing drugs and related office visits, ultrasounds and testing for enrollees aged 21 through 44 who have infertility.

nj:A 5395.title: Subscription service-require cancellation option & establish certain standards
nj:A 5395.summary: Requires subscription services to offer cancellation, including an online option with a direct link or button when sign-up is online, and sets standards for automatic-renewal and similar negative option offers.

nj:A 5420.title: Violations, cert-permit 30-calendar day extention, bus. to address & resolve
nj:A 5420.summary: Lets a State agency extend the 60-day cure period for a business's first-time violation by 30 more days when denying the extension would be contrary to equity and good conscience.

nj:A 5421.title: Online tax training-require development for small and micro-businesses
nj:A 5421.summary: Requires the Division of Taxation to develop a free online training on filing and remitting State taxes, designed for small and micro-businesses.

nj:A 5422.title: Regulations & economic incentives-receive info via email that effect business
nj:A 5422.summary: Lets businesses that register with the Division of Revenue and Enterprise Services opt into an electronic service for receiving official notifications from State agencies, such as new regulations and incentives, at an email address on file.

nj:A 5424.title: Residential property, certain-promote availability, impose fee for ownership
nj:A 5424.summary: Imposes a fee of $30,000 per property on institutional investors that hold ownership interests in abandoned or vacant residential properties meeting the bill's definition of a subject property.

nj:A 5426.title: Domestic violence public awareness campaign-add information on coercive control
nj:A 5426.summary: Requires the State's domestic violence public awareness campaign to include, subject to available funds, information on recognizing the indicators of coercive control, and broadens the languages used in the campaign.

nj:A 5432.title: Rent increases, unconscionable-establish standards for determining
nj:A 5432.summary: Writes into law the court test for an unconscionable rent increase, weighing the increase, landlord expenses and profitability, comparable rents and bargaining position, and excludes certain eviction court records from public access.

nj:A 5435.title: Residential utility assistance programs-establish a consolidated application
nj:A 5435.summary: Directs the Department of Community Affairs to create a single online application covering State and nonprofit financial assistance programs for residential utility customers, working with each program's administrator under a memorandum of understanding.

nj:A 5439.title: Working Class Families St Suppl-req portion of funding used, outreach purposes
nj:A 5439.summary: Requires $375,000 (2.5 percent) of the $15 million Working Class Families State Supplement appropriation in the Fiscal Year 2027 budget to go to informational and outreach activities that raise awareness of the program.

nj:A 5442.title: BPU members-require to have certain experience & complete certain training
nj:A 5442.summary: Requires at least two Board of Public Utilities members to have three or more years of experience in fields such as energy policy, utility regulation or telecommunications, and members to complete 12 hours of training annually.

nj:A 5451.title: Family & Internal Medicine Residency Expansion Program-revise language
nj:A 5451.summary: Amends the Fiscal Year 2027 appropriations act to cut the number of new family medicine and internal medicine residency slots funded by the $2 million Residency Expansion Program from 10 to five.

nj:A 5455.title: Commission on Human Trafficking-authorize to exercise powers and duties
nj:A 5455.summary: Changes the Commission on Human Trafficking’s quorum rule so a majority of its members, rather than of its authorized membership, can exercise its powers and duties.

nj:A 5459.title: Health benefits coverage-extend period in which to enroll newborn infants
nj:A 5459.summary: Extends from 60 to 90 days after birth the period during which a newborn is covered under a parent's health benefits coverage.

nj:A 5462.title: Electric public utilities-develop and apply special tariff for data centers
nj:A 5462.summary: Requires electric utilities to file a tariff for customers using over 100 megawatts, such as data centers, assigning related costs to them so other customers do not pay for them, and encouraging energy efficiency.

nj:A 5463.title: Electric public utilities-submit annual report on voting to BPU
nj:A 5463.summary: Requires electric utilities to file an annual report with the Board of Public Utilities listing each vote they or affiliates cast at PJM Interconnection meetings and describing whether it furthers State goals.

nj:A 5466.title: Electricity rates-require BPU to study effects of data centers
nj:A 5466.summary: Requires the Board of Public Utilities to study, within one year, how electricity use by data centers affects electricity costs, including the share of residential rates attributable to data center demand over the next 20 years.

nj:A 5502.title: County College Contracts Law-revise provisions
nj:A 5502.summary: Raises the county college public bidding threshold to $100,000 for contracts not paying prevailing wage, leaves it unchanged for prevailing wage contracts, and exempts more purchases from public bidding, including IT, consulting, banking and transportation services.

nj:A 5503.title: Shellfish aquaculture agritourism-require Dept of Agriculture develop guidance
nj:A 5503.summary: Requires the Department of Agriculture to develop and publish guidance on shellfish aquaculture agritourism for aquatic farmers and shellfish dealers, covering topics such as food safety, workforce, financing and applicable laws.

nj:A 5504.title: Aquaculture Advisory Council-expand and change membership
nj:A 5504.summary: Expands the Aquaculture Advisory Council from 13 to 18 members (15 voting, three non-voting) and restructures membership to include eight voting public members: six aquaculture industry representatives and two appointed by the Governor.

nj:A 551.title: Home improvement contracts-permit consumers 65 & over up to 5 bus days to cancel
nj:A 551.summary: Lets consumers 60 or older, or with an intellectual disability, cancel home improvement contracts within five business days and goods contracts of $500 or more within three; consumers may waive this for emergency restoration services.

nj:A 5510.title: Dementia Services Coordinator-require appointment; appropriate $150K
nj:A 5510.summary: Requires the Commissioner of Human Services to appoint a State Dementia Services Coordinator to develop and coordinate a master plan on Alzheimer's and dementia and coordinate State services, and appropriates $150,000.

nj:A 5517.title: Advanced reactors-direct BPU study feasibility of developing Statewide
nj:A 5517.summary: Directs the Board of Public Utilities to study, and report within 18 months, whether advanced and small modular nuclear reactors could be built in the State, including suitable sites, federal permitting requirements and economic viability.

nj:A 5526.title: Pool and spa service businesses-concerns building and installation
nj:A 5526.summary: Lets a pool and spa service business obtain a permit to act as a general contractor for pool and spa building and installation; subcontractors must work under a licensed builder, installer or service contractor.

nj:A 5533.title: Scrap metals containing propulsion batteries-estab requirements, receipt & purch
nj:A 5533.summary: Requires people selling scrap metal to disclose in writing whether it contains lithium-ion or propulsion batteries, requires scrap metal businesses to inspect scrap declared battery-free, and requires them to keep records for five years.

nj:A 5537.title: Firefighting foam use-concerns perfluoroalkl & polyfluoroalkyl substances
nj:A 5537.summary: Prohibits fire departments from using Class B firefighting foam with intentionally added PFAS beginning January 1, 2027, delaying the existing prohibition by up to one year.

nj:A 5538.title: Fire district water service-prohibit municipal utilities authority from charging
nj:A 5538.summary: Bars municipal utilities authorities from charging fire districts or fire departments water service charges for fire protection systems if the authority also charges those districts' taxpayers.

nj:A 5545.title: Soil conservation districts-authorize to have more than five supervisors
nj:A 5545.summary: Lets the State Soil Conservation Committee set more than the current five supervisors for each soil conservation district.

nj:A 5546.title: Capital City Redevelopment Corporations-authorize to issue grants
nj:A 5546.summary: Authorizes the Capital City Redevelopment Corporation to issue loans and grants for projects in the Capital City District, narrows the money allowed in its fund, and removes the 65 percent repayment requirement.

nj:A 5563.title: Summer Termination Program-establish for certain utility customers
nj:A 5563.summary: Directs Community Affairs and the Board of Public Utilities to run a Summer Termination Program barring electric, sewer or water shutoffs of eligible residential customers June 15 through August 31 and restoring service June 15 for eligible customers shut off earlier for nonpayment.

nj:A 5572.title: Professional licensing entities-establish quorum standards, cert circumstances
nj:A 5572.summary: Sets a quorum of a majority of members present, with as few as two if one is the chair, for licensing boards processing applications without adverse criminal-history findings, when after 90 days they cannot otherwise reach a quorum.

nj:A 5583.title: Public utility meter reading fees-proh charging residents, multi-unit dwellings
nj:A 5583.summary: Bars electric and gas utilities from charging a residential customer in a multi-unit dwelling a meter-reading fee, charged to customers who opt out of smart meters, that exceeds the cost of that customer's usage for the billing cycle.

nj:A 5588.title: Theatrical production-revise child labor laws concerning employment of minor
nj:A 5588.summary: Sets daily work-hour and on-set limits by age for minors in theatrical productions, such as up to 20 minutes for infants, bars work before 5 a.m. or after 10 p.m. before school days, and creates a registration system.

nj:A 5592.title: Source plasma donation centers-establish licensure requirement
nj:A 5592.summary: Requires source plasma donation centers to apply annually for a Department of Health license, with a $25 initial fee for centers already operating, and directs the health commissioner to adopt rules governing plasma donations.

nj:A 5593.title: Constr subcode applicants-electronically submit cert materials for permit review
nj:A 5593.summary: Requires the Department of Community Affairs to accept electronic subcode application submissions from licensed plumbing, electrical and HVAC contractors without a physical seal or signature, and not to require a physical seal on worksite plans if an electronic seal is provided.

nj:A 5595.title: Voluntary nonopioid directives-permit individuals to establish
nj:A 5595.summary: Lets adults, emancipated minors and patients' authorized representatives sign a voluntary nonopioid directive, on a Department of Health form, stating that opioids may not be administered or prescribed to them; opioids deemed medically necessary are not barred.

nj:A 5598.title: Public accountancy-modifies requirements to obtain licensure
nj:A 5598.summary: Changes requirements for a public accountancy license, requiring a bachelor's or higher degree or 150 hours of education from an accredited institution, and changes the standard applied to out-of-state licensees.

nj:A 560.title: Trans network co driver-require educational training course on human trafficking
nj:A 560.summary: Requires transportation network company drivers and applicants to complete an Attorney General-approved anti-human trafficking training course, which the company must provide within 90 days of approval or confirm was completed through another company.

nj:A 5601.title: Business receive cert notices electronically-req St entities offer optional svc
nj:A 5601.summary: Requires State entities that issue legally required notices to businesses to offer an optional electronic delivery service, and to tell businesses about it within 60 days of the effective date.

nj:A 5606.title: Meals on Wheels Program-amend FY2025 annual approp act, clarify distribution
nj:A 5606.summary: Amends the fiscal year 2025 appropriations act so a $500,000 Meals on Wheels grant goes to the Jewish Federation of Northern New Jersey, correcting the organization's name as written in the act.

nj:A 5610.title: Domestic viol-add training concerning coercive control, judges & law enforce off
nj:A 5610.summary: Adds training on coercive control to the domestic violence training required for judges, court personnel and law enforcement officers.

nj:A 5612.title: NJT bus operations & bicycle lanes-concerns parking violations that obstruct
nj:A 5612.summary: Requires NJ Transit to install bus cameras recording vehicles stopped in bus lanes, bus stop zones or bicycle lanes on bus routes, and to issue citations after review by an employee or contracted police agency, with a 180-day public education campaign.

nj:A 5618.title: Consumer debt lawsuits-collect and publish statistical information
nj:A 5618.summary: Requires the Administrative Office of the Courts to publish an annual report with statistics on consumer debt collection lawsuits, including new filings, pending cases, represented defendants, default judgments and other outcomes.

nj:A 5649.title: Open space trust funds-use for remediation of collapsed mine shafts & sinkholes
nj:A 5649.summary: Allows counties and municipalities to use open space trust fund money, without voter approval, to remediate collapsed mine shafts and sinkholes on county- or municipally-owned property.

nj:A 5684.title: Scrap metal businesses-establish safety measures
nj:A 5684.summary: Requires scrap metal businesses to audit records quarterly, keep prohibited items off premises, and, within five years, install a remotely operable fire suppression system and use staff trained in fire suppression.

nj:A 5687.title: Next NJ Manufacturing Program-estab, incentivize manuf investment & job creation
nj:A 5687.summary: Creates the Next New Jersey Manufacturing Program, under which the Economic Development Authority awards tax credits to eligible manufacturers and clean energy product manufacturers that invest in the State and create jobs.

nj:A 5688.title: Hotel occupancies, cert municipalities-impose surcharge, fund fire services
nj:A 5688.summary: Imposes a $3-per-night surcharge on hotel rooms in a first-class city with an international airport, with revenue dedicated to a trust fund for the city's fire services.

nj:A 5712.title: Air Traffic Controller Loan Redemption Program-establish
nj:A 5712.summary: Creates a student loan redemption program for FAA air traffic controllers at New Jersey airports and related facilities: 16, 26, 28 and 30 percent of loans for years one through four, up to $100,000 total. Also appropriates $2.5 million for public college aviation grants.

nj:A 5728.title: NJ Innovation Authority-establish
nj:A 5728.summary: Creates the New Jersey Innovation Authority, a 13-member body placed in, but not part of, the Treasury Department and led by a Chief Innovation Officer, to serve as the State's primary authority on technology innovation and digital delivery of services.

nj:A 5733.title: Utility bill payment asst/energy efficiency prog, cert-prov review, participate
nj:A 5733.summary: Requires State agencies running utility bill payment assistance or energy efficiency programs to review them within one year, seek public comment, and raise income eligibility thresholds if they find an increase appropriate.

nj:A 5735.title: Mandatory gratuity-req restaurant disclose to patrons, failure unlawful practice
nj:A 5735.summary: Requires restaurants to prominently disclose any mandatory gratuity on the menu, at the entrance, on the bill and on their website. Sets civil penalties of $1,000, $2,500 and $5,000 for first, second and later violations.

nj:A 5736.title: Energy Bill Watch program-update certain notification requirements
nj:A 5736.summary: Changes the Energy Bill Watch program so residential smart meter customers can choose to receive usage and cost notifications by text message or email.

nj:A 575.title: Recycled materials-DEP develop guidelines, St & loc government purchase of goods
nj:A 575.summary: Requires the Department of Environmental Protection to develop guidelines for state and local purchasing that encourage buying goods with the highest recycled content, and requires new procurement specifications to reflect them where practical.

nj:A 5751.title: Children's Partial Hospitalization Pilot Program-directs DHS to establish
nj:A 5751.summary: Directs the Department of Human Services to create a pilot program under which NJ FamilyCare reimburses partial hospitalization services for children ages five through 14 at non-hospital locations.

nj:A 5755.title: Municipality's public access plan-include cert info, beach costs & revenues
nj:A 5755.summary: Requires municipalities that charge beach tag fees for municipally owned beaches to include in their public access plan each beach's itemized costs and revenues for the prior season, projected costs, and how any excess revenue will be spent.

nj:A 5756.title: Lambda Theta Phi Latin Fraternity, Inc. license plates-authorize creation
nj:A 5756.summary: Authorizes special Lambda Theta Phi Latin Fraternity license plates, with a $50 application fee and $10 annual renewal fee; after program costs, fee revenue goes to the fraternity's programs.

nj:A 5758.title: Lambda Theta Alpha Sorority, Inc. license plates-authorize creation
nj:A 5758.summary: Authorizes special Lambda Theta Alpha Latin Sorority license plates, with a $50 application fee and $10 annual renewal fee; after program costs, fee revenue goes to the sorority's programs.

nj:A 5764.title: Access Link paratransit vehicle operators-announce stops for passengers
nj:A 5764.summary: Requires Access Link paratransit vehicle operators to announce, or have a recording system announce, every scheduled stop along the vehicle's route.

nj:A 5778.title: Land preservation programs-direct Garden St. Preserv. Trust perform audit;$150K
nj:A 5778.summary: Directs the Garden State Preservation Trust to audit the State's land preservation programs, appropriates $150,000, and lets farmland preservation grant recipients use up to three percent of easement or purchase value for administrative expenses.

nj:A 5785.title: Preventive services, certain-provided on calendar year basis
nj:A 5785.summary: Requires health insurers to cover one annual wellness visit per plan or calendar year for covered members over age three, without a waiting period.

nj:A 5790.title: Lipedema-require health benefits coverage for treatment
nj:A 5790.summary: Requires health insurers and State health benefit plans to cover lipedema treatment, including compression garments, manual lymphatic drainage, nutrition therapy, mental health care and medically necessary lipectomy.

nj:A 5792.title: First responders-prov worker's compensation coverage, cert counseling services
nj:A 5792.summary: Requires employers of first responders, including police, paid firefighters, 9-1-1 dispatchers and paid EMS, to provide up to 12 hours of paid confidential counseling after a critical incident, compensable under workers' compensation; makes law enforcement peer-support communications confidential.

nj:A 5795.title: Innovation Evergreen Act-modifies certain provisions
nj:A 5795.summary: Changes the Innovation Evergreen Program by broadening which businesses count as having principal operations in New Jersey and revising how qualified venture investments are determined.

nj:A 5798.title: Energy assistance programs-require automatic enrollment, certain households
nj:A 5798.summary: Requires state agencies to share public assistance data so households receiving or eligible for programs such as TANF, SNAP or SSI are automatically enrolled, where federal law permits, in utility bill assistance including the Universal Service Fund.

nj:A 5801.title: Debt Defeasance & Prevention Fund-approp $247.128M, estab process for future
nj:A 5801.summary: Appropriates $247.1 million from the Debt Defeasance and Prevention Fund for capital projects, including $222 million for a new correctional facility replacing the Edna Mahan Correctional Facility for Women.

nj:A 5802.title: Longitudinal Data System-establish
nj:A 5802.summary: Establishes a Statewide Longitudinal Data System linking education and workforce data, overseen by a governing body of education, higher education, student aid and labor agencies, which must provide data and may designate a manager such as Rutgers' Heldrich Center.

nj:A 5803.title: Gaming and wagering, online-modifies tax on certain forms
nj:A 5803.summary: Raises the internet casino gaming tax (15 percent), internet sports wagering tax (13 percent) and daily fantasy sports operating fee (10.5 percent) to 19.75 percent each.

nj:A 5804.title: Real property transfers, over $2M-modifies payer of addl fees & taxes imposed
nj:A 5804.summary: Raises additional fees and taxes on real property transfers over $2 million, and makes the seller rather than the buyer pay the additional fee and controlling interest transfer tax on transfers over $1 million.

nj:A 5805.title: Nicotine products, certain-modifies tax rate
nj:A 5805.summary: Raises the cigarette tax from $2.70 to $3.00 per pack, raises the liquid nicotine and e-liquid taxes, and dedicates $2 million of the liquid nicotine and e-liquid tax revenue to the Health Care Subsidy Fund.

nj:A 5807.title: FY2025-make supplemental approp;$142.615M; add various provisions to Approp. Act
nj:A 5807.summary: Adds a net $142.6 million to the Fiscal Year 2025 appropriations, including funds for re-entry services and hospital capital projects, and inserts new language provisions into the Appropriations Act.

nj:A 5809.title: Healthcare Finance Enhancement Act-concerns
nj:A 5809.summary: Lowers the ambulatory care facility gross-receipts assessment from 2.95 to 2.5 percent in fiscal 2026 and extends it to all such facilities from fiscal 2027; raises the hospital per-admission charge from $10 to $12.50.

nj:A 5810.title: Health insurance appeal process-promote equity
nj:A 5810.summary: Eliminates fees for consumer appeals against health insurance carriers under the Independent Health Care Appeals Program.

nj:A 5827.title: Film/digital media production tax credit prog-concerns req and availability
nj:A 5827.summary: Extends the film and digital media production tax credit program to July 2049 and raises the credit for certain New Jersey studio partner production expenses from 35 to 40 percent.

nj:A 583.title: Marriages-permit duty clerk to perform
nj:A 583.summary: Adds deputy county clerks and municipal clerks to the public officials who may perform marriage and civil union ceremonies.

nj:A 5847.title: School district's annual audit, 2024-2025 sch yr-extend deadline for completion
nj:A 5847.summary: Extends the deadline for school districts to complete and file their annual audit for the 2024-2025 school year beyond the current five months after the school year ends.

nj:A 5851.title: Scrap tire storage, collection, & disposal-estab hauler license & site permit
nj:A 5851.summary: Requires a Department of Environmental Protection license to collect scrap tires and a permit for scrap tire storage or disposal sites, with financial assurance of at least $150,000 per hauler and a tracking system.

nj:A 5852.title: Scrap metal facilities-require DEP regulate as recycling facilities
nj:A 5852.summary: Requires scrap metal facilities to register with the Department of Environmental Protection and comply with new requirements, and ends their exemption from regulation as recycling centers, replacing the term scrap processing facility.

nj:A 5854.title: Motor vehicle franchisors, cert-sell, lease, or assign vehicles to employees
nj:A 5854.summary: Allows motor vehicle franchisors to lease or assign vehicles to their employees, and franchisors headquartered in New Jersey to lend up to 50 plated vehicles for promotional or testing use and to service those vehicles.

nj:A 5857.title: Land & improvements, City of Trenton & Twp of Lawrence-sell as surplus property
nj:A 5857.summary: Authorizes the State Treasurer to sell to Mercer County a 1.3-acre parcel in Trenton and a 26.3-acre parcel in Lawrence Township, including the county fire academy training center, as surplus property for public use.

nj:A 5867.title: Professional barbering svcs-concerns licensure, prov in another state or country
