nc:HB 811|cc firearm safety instruction.summary: Requires every community college to offer a firearm safety course each semester to people 18 and older, using a curriculum set by the State Board of Community Colleges, and provides $1 million a year to set up the courses.

nc:HB 850|interbasin transfer moratorium.title: Interbasin Transfer Moratorium/Study.
nc:HB 850|interbasin transfer moratorium.summary: Bars state approval of new interbasin water transfers, or increases to existing ones, totaling more than 15 million gallons per day until March 1, 2027, and directs the N.C. Collaboratory to study the transfer approval process and report to lawmakers.

nc:HB 693|interstate massage compact.title: Interstate Massage Compact.
nc:HB 693|interstate massage compact.summary: Enters North Carolina into the Interstate Massage Compact, creating a multistate license that lets massage therapists licensed in one member state practice in others, once at least seven states have joined.

nc:HB 768|clarify emergency communicatio.title: Clarify Emergency Communication Exemptions/Fire Code.
nc:HB 768|clarify emergency communicatio.summary: Exempts certain buildings, including smaller wood-frame apartment buildings, two-story apartments and motels with outside exits, houses, and buildings under 12,000 square feet without basements, from fire code requirements for in-building emergency radio coverage systems.

nc:SJR 773|confirm governor s appointmen.title: Confirm Governor's Appointment/Investment Authority.
nc:SJR 773|confirm governor s appointmen.summary: Confirms the Governor's appointment of Sallie Shuping-Russell to the North Carolina Investment Authority Board of Directors, as state law requires the legislature to approve such appointments by joint resolution.

nc:HB 406|clarify motor vehicle dealer l.title: Clarify Motor Vehicle Dealer Laws.
nc:HB 406|clarify motor vehicle dealer l.summary: Changes rules between car manufacturers and their franchised dealers, covering dealership transfers and terminations, succession when a dealer retires, payments for over-the-air software sales and loaner cars, and bars forcing dealers to accept unfinished vehicles.

nc:SB 809|satellite annexation cap rural.title: Satellite Annexation Cap/Rural Hall Fire District.
nc:SB 809|satellite annexation cap rural.summary: Exempts Dunn, King, Cleveland, Coats, Erwin and Spruce Pine from the cap on how much noncontiguous land a town may annex, and removes Rural Hall from Forsyth County's countywide fire service tax district starting July 2026.

nc:HB 894|gun dealer door lock exemption.title: Gun Dealer Door Lock Exemption.
nc:HB 894|gun dealer door lock exemption.summary: Lets licensed gun dealers that mainly sell firearms or ammunition get a $500 fire code permit to keep doors locked from the inside when closed, if their sales floor is one story of no more than 15,000 square feet, with alarms and warning signs.

nc:HB 909|state infrastructure bank boar.title: State Infrastructure Bank Board.
nc:HB 909|state infrastructure bank boar.summary: Creates a State Infrastructure Bank Board, housed in the State Treasurer's department but acting independently, and moves the existing transportation infrastructure bank to it; the board may lend to local governments for transportation, water, sewer and other infrastructure projects.

nc:HB 266|adopt women veterans day.title: Adopt Women Veterans Day.
nc:HB 266|adopt women veterans day.summary: Designates the first day of May each year as Women Veterans Day in North Carolina, adding the designation to the state's general statutes when the act becomes law.

nc:HB 1123|unc omnibus capital contracti.title: UNC Omnibus & Capital Contracting Law Changes.
nc:HB 1123|unc omnibus capital contracti.summary: Authorizes UNC building projects financed with non-tax money such as bonds, aligns School of Science and Mathematics residency rules with in-state tuition rules, raises capital project cost thresholds, and bars state capital funds for public-private partnerships without legislative approval.

nc:SB 695|incentive development finance.title: Incentive Development Finance District Funding.
nc:SB 695|incentive development finance.summary: Creates a property tax break for land and new, unoccupied construction held for sale by builders in local-government-approved incentive districts, excluding 90% of its value for up to ten years or until sale; districts may cover at most 5% of a locality's area.

nc:HB 283|small business investment gran.title: Small Business Investment Grant Program.
nc:HB 283|small business investment gran.summary: Creates a Small Business Investment Grant account of up to $10 million within the One North Carolina Fund, giving competitive grants of up to $500,000 a year to small businesses investing $10–30 million to open or expand facilities in the state.

nc:HB 356|permitted trade practices insu.title: Permitted Trade Practices/Insurance Rebates.
nc:HB 356|permitted trade practices insu.summary: Lets insurers and agents offer customers certain risk-reducing or wellness products and services at no or reduced cost, noncash gifts worth up to $250 per policy term, and free drawings, without these counting as illegal rebates; bars advertising insurance as "free."

nc:HB 602|coach safely act.title: Coach Safely Act.
nc:HB 602|coach safely act.summary: Requires youth sports coaches and athletics staff using public property to complete free, state-approved injury-prevention training each year, covering topics such as concussions, heat illness, CPR and cardiac risks, and shields trained coaches who follow it from injury lawsuits.

nc:HB 854|require licensure of education.title: Require Licensure of Educational Interpreters.
nc:HB 854|require licensure of education.summary: Ends the exemption that lets interpreters and transliterators for deaf students in schools and colleges work without a state license, sets testing standards for their licenses, and lets their licensing continuing education count toward required school training, starting October 1, 2026.

nc:HB 565|check yes save lives.title: Check Yes, Save Lives.
nc:HB 565|check yes save lives.summary: Adds an optional check box to state income tax returns, starting with 2027 tax years, letting taxpayers sign up as organ and tissue donors, and allows the Department of Revenue to share those choices with the DMV and donor registries.

nc:HB 485|adult care home medicaid perso.title: Adult Care Home Medicaid Personal Care Services Coverage.
nc:HB 485|adult care home medicaid perso.summary: Requires the state Medicaid agency to seek federal approval to cover personal care services for adult care home residents with incomes up to 180% of the poverty level, and special care unit residents up to 200%, only if costs are offset by savings.

nc:HB 886|aeds and cpr in public schools.title: AEDs and CPR in Public Schools.
nc:HB 886|aeds and cpr in public schools.summary: Requires the State Board of Education to set rules for placing at least one defibrillator (AED) in every public school's athletic area and training school staff in AED use and CPR, with schools adopting matching policies starting in the 2025–2026 school year.

nc:HB 681|update opioid abatement treatm.title: Update Opioid Abatement Treatment Program Rules.
nc:HB 681|update opioid abatement treatm.summary: Directs the state commission overseeing outpatient opioid treatment programs to revise its rules to better match federal rules, including easing take-home medication criteria, dropping fixed counseling schedules, reducing drug tests and requiring discharge policy reviews, and to publish proposed rules by January 1, 2026.

nc:HB 212|condemnation service on spouse.title: Condemnation/Service on Spouses Not Required.
nc:HB 212|condemnation service on spouse.summary: Provides that a surviving spouse cannot claim a partial life estate in land the Department of Transportation began condemning before the other spouse died, and that the Department need not notify or join people whose only stake is that possible claim.

nc:HB 17|various local election changes.title: Various Local Election Changes.
nc:HB 17|various local election changes.summary: Lengthens the Madison mayor's term from two to four years, and moves municipal elections in Faith and China Grove to even-numbered years starting in 2026, canceling their 2025 elections, extending current terms, and giving Faith aldermen four-year terms.

nc:HB 297|breast cancer prevention imagi.title: Breast Cancer Prevention Imaging Parity.
nc:HB 297|breast cancer prevention imagi.summary: Requires health plans that cover diagnostic or supplemental breast cancer exams, such as breast MRIs and ultrasounds, to charge patients no more than for screening mammograms, and requires out-of-network providers to accept in-network rates as full payment for these services.

nc:HB 515|north carolina economic abuse.title: North Carolina Economic Abuse Prevention Act.
nc:HB 515|north carolina economic abuse.summary: Lets victims of domestic violence or abuse and current or former foster children challenge debts they were forced into, requiring creditors to pause collection and report the debt as disputed while they review, and making the person who coerced the debt liable for it.

nc:HB 2|entry fees for interscholastic s.title: Entry Fees for Interscholastic Sports Events.
nc:HB 2|entry fees for interscholastic s.summary: Requires public schools to accept cash for admission to middle and high school sports events starting in the 2025–2026 school year, and lets school boards allow that cash to be deposited the next business day.

nc:HB 373|unc tuition discounts for cert.title: UNC Tuition Discounts for Certain Students.
nc:HB 373|unc tuition discounts for cert.summary: Lets University of North Carolina campuses discount tuition for in-state students receiving military tuition assistance, and for students in board-approved employer-sponsored programs, up to the gap between that aid and tuition, with yearly reports to legislators.

nc:HB 53|increase accident thresholds sa.title: Increase Accident Thresholds/Safe Driver Plan.
nc:HB 53|increase accident thresholds sa.summary: Raises the property damage amounts that define minor, intermediate and major car accidents under the state's insurance points system, so a minor accident becomes up to $3,570 instead of $2,300, for accidents on or after October 1, 2025.

nc:HB 185|transylvania rural development.title: Transylvania Rural Development Authority.
nc:HB 185|transylvania rural development.summary: Creates a Transylvania County Rural Development Authority with nine members appointed by the Transylvania Economic Alliance, which also operates it, and gives it power to borrow, issue bonds, and acquire, build and run development projects.

nc:HB 250|annual report due date deploye.title: Annual Report Due Date/Deployed Servicemembers.
nc:HB 250|annual report due date deploye.summary: Delays the annual report deadline for corporations, LLCs and limited liability partnerships majority-owned by deployed military members until 90 days after deployment ends, if they file a free affidavit of deployment, and limits their administrative dissolution for late reports.

nc:HB 298|local governments system devel.title: Local Governments/System Development Fees.
nc:HB 298|local governments system devel.summary: Lets new nonresidential developments adding 325 to 2,500 gallons a day of water or sewer demand pay local system development fees in installments over up to three years, with interest capped at the state's overpayment interest rate.

nc:HB 382|elk permit auction raffle.title: Elk Permit Auction/Raffle.
nc:HB 382|elk permit auction raffle.summary: Directs the Wildlife Resources Commission to issue two elk hunting permits for 2026, one by $20-per-ticket raffle for residents and one by nonprofit auction, with proceeds funding elk management, and lets it continue the program in later years.

nc:HB 184|promote north carolina sawmill.title: Promote North Carolina Sawmills.
nc:HB 184|promote north carolina sawmill.summary: Directs state building code councils to allow lumber without a grade stamp in one- and two-family homes and certain other residential buildings when sold directly by a certified sawmill operator, and creates a state lumber grader training and certification program.

nc:HB 44|general statutes commission ele.title: General Statutes Commission Electronic Signatures.
nc:HB 44|general statutes commission ele.summary: Clarifies that business contracts with reciprocal attorneys' fee provisions may be signed by hand or electronically, and that notary applicants must sign initial applications in pen and ink while the Secretary of State may accept other signatures electronically.

nc:HJR 157|state of the state invitation.title: State of the State Invitation.
nc:HJR 157|state of the state invitation.summary: Invites the Governor to deliver an address to a joint session of the House and Senate at 7:00 p.m. on March 12, 2025, and invites the cabinet, Council of State, Supreme Court justices and Court of Appeals judges to attend.

nc:HB 189|red light camera delay interva.title: Red Light Camera Delay Interval.
nc:HB 189|red light camera delay interva.summary: Provides that red light cameras may record a violation only when a vehicle enters an intersection after the light turns red and the all-red clearance interval has expired, and that signal timing must meet sealed traffic plans and federal standards.

nc:HB 1012|disaster recovery act of 2025.title: Disaster Recovery Act of 2025 - Part II.
nc:HB 1012|disaster recovery act of 2025.summary: Creates Hurricane Helene recovery programs, including grants for local government capital repairs, flood mitigation, damaged airports and dams, and a disaster help portal; directs about $686 million in federal funds to water and sewer repairs; and extends the state of emergency to October 1, 2025.

nc:HB 1003|board of funeral service modi.title: Board of Funeral Service Modifications.
nc:HB 1003|board of funeral service modi.summary: Revises funeral and cremation rules: lets one manager oversee several sites within 50 miles, creates a business permit for transporting bodies, splits Funeral Service Board appointments evenly between two trade groups, eases licensing and trainee rules, and lets the board freeze preneed funeral funds.

nc:HB 210|perpetual care of certain ceme.title: Perpetual Care of Certain Cemeteries.
nc:HB 210|perpetual care of certain ceme.summary: Requires the Cemetery Commission to set minimum care and maintenance standards for licensed cemeteries, allowing license suspension or a $50-a-day penalty after 10 days' notice for violations, and requires cemetery companies to report their maintenance work annually.

nc:HB 546|medicaid modernization.title: Medicaid Modernization.
nc:HB 546|medicaid modernization.summary: Makes permanent 12-month postpartum Medicaid coverage, lets licensed telehealth providers without an in-state office enroll in Medicaid, adds authority to carry out federally approved work requirements, suspends rather than ends coverage during incarceration, and extends extra Medicaid payments to psychiatric hospitals.

nc:SB 118|military and veteran support a.title: Military and Veteran Support Act.
nc:SB 118|military and veteran support a.summary: Lowers concealed handgun permit fees for honorably discharged veterans, lets military children enroll in school before proof of residency, bars UNC campuses from denying admission over military service, regulates paid help with veterans' benefit claims, and eases remote license renewal for service members.

nc:SB 387|brownfields property reuse act.title: Brownfields Property Reuse Act Revisions.
nc:SB 387|brownfields property reuse act.summary: Expands the property tax break for redeveloped brownfields to improvements made after the state confirms eligibility and to later additions, changes how state brownfields fees are paid, and adds a fee for owners who fail to follow required property notice rules.

nc:HB 433|sfrf ncpro revisions.title: SFRF/NCPRO Revisions.
nc:HB 433|sfrf ncpro revisions.summary: Adjusts how the state spends remaining federal pandemic recovery funds, allowing reallocation among water, sewer and broadband projects, letting interest pay recovery-office costs, extending the recovery office through May 1, 2027, and changing how Burke County megasite water funds may be used.

nc:SB 599|state teacher employee pay loc.title: State Teacher/Employee Pay & Local LEO Bonus.
nc:SB 599|state teacher employee pay loc.summary: Raises pay for teachers and other school employees, gives most state employees 2.5% and sworn state law enforcement officers 13%, gives retirees one-time 1% and 2% payments, and gives local sworn officers $1,750 yearly bonuses, all contingent on enactment of a 2025-26 state budget.

nc:SB 664|jmac flexibility abclaws megas.title: JMAC Flexibility/ABCLaws/Megasite/Selectsite.
nc:SB 664|jmac flexibility abclaws megas.summary: Replaces proportional cuts to major employers' job-retention grants for staffing shortfalls with 1% cuts per employee beyond a 100-employee shortfall, lets host breweries also hold winery and distillery permits, requires more Helene-area site evaluations, loosens megasite and selectsite rules, and extends a pause on certain job-grant rules.

nc:SB 77|school contracted health servic.title: School Contracted Health Services.
nc:SB 77|school contracted health servic.summary: Requires school districts to contract with a parent's chosen nurse for a child with disabilities whose education plan requires nursing, if the nurse previously served the child, works for a qualified agency, and costs no more than other contracted nurses.

nc:SB 125|various education changes.title: Various Education Changes.
nc:SB 125|various education changes.summary: Reorganizes state community college laws, expands high school students' access to community college career pathways and programs, lets certain private schools obtain residency licenses for special education teachers, and extends the deadline to spend school safety grants.

nc:SB 477|dncr agency bill ab.title: DNCR Agency Bill.-AB
nc:SB 477|dncr agency bill ab.summary: Makes changes requested by the Department of Natural and Cultural Resources, including letting it withhold rare species locations, set visitor conduct rules without formal rulemaking, sign leases of up to 50 years at three lake recreation areas, and requiring free regular admission for school groups.

nc:HB 477|retirement death benefits rewr.title: Retirement Death Benefits Rewrite.
nc:HB 477|retirement death benefits rewr.summary: Rewrites and standardizes death benefit laws for state, local, judicial and legislative retirement systems without changing benefits, and lets the retirement board set aside part of state contributions in a separate fund for line-of-duty death benefits.

nc:HB 97|support firefighters fighting c.title: Support Firefighters Fighting Cancer.
nc:HB 97|support firefighters fighting c.summary: Adds stomach, prostate and colon cancer to the cancers presumed to cause a firefighter's line-of-duty death, making survivors eligible for state death benefits for deaths on or after July 1, 2025.

nc:SB 266|historic flood event bldg code.title: Historic Flood Event Bldg. Code Exemption.
nc:SB 266|historic flood event bldg code.summary: Lets owners rebuild buildings damaged by 200-year or greater floods in floodplains to their previous size regardless of newer rules, pending FEMA approval, and in Helene-affected counties waives certain state permits and fire code limits for turning vegetative storm debris into mulch or compost.

nc:SB 675|charitable organizations priva.title: Charitable Organizations Privacy Protection Act.
nc:SB 675|charitable organizations priva.summary: Sets an affidavit process for charities named as beneficiaries of accounts or property passing outside probate to claim the assets, bars holders from demanding personal information about charity staff, protects holders acting in good faith, and lets charities sue after 60 days.

nc:HB 240|davidson charter consolidation.title: Davidson Charter Consolidation.
nc:HB 240|davidson charter consolidation.summary: Replaces the Town of Davidson's charter with an updated, consolidated charter that keeps its council-manager government, nonpartisan odd-year elections, a two-year mayoral term, staggered four-year council terms, and repeals outdated local laws.

nc:HB 1114|general statutes commission t.title: General Statutes Commission Technical Corrections 2026.
nc:HB 1114|general statutes commission t.summary: Makes technical corrections to state laws recommended by the General Statutes Commission, including repealing obsolete provisions describing the 1971 and later reorganizations of state agencies and moving still-needed provisions elsewhere in the law.

nc:HB 117|ocean isle beach sunset beach.title: Ocean Isle Beach/Sunset Beach/Topsail Beach/Parking Fees.
nc:HB 117|ocean isle beach sunset beach.summary: Lets Ocean Isle Beach and Topsail Beach use money from on-street parking fees for any public purpose, rather than only for enforcing and administering parking and traffic rules.

nc:SB 403|additional medicaid funds and.title: Additional Medicaid Funds and Requirements.
nc:SB 403|additional medicaid funds and.summary: Adds about $690 million a year for Medicaid cost growth plus administrative funds, ends Medicaid coverage of GLP-1 weight-loss drugs, cuts vacant state positions, building reserves and capital fund transfers, and orders audits of county Medicaid and SNAP eligibility decisions.

nc:SJR 768|confirm appointment to indust.title: Confirm Appointment to Industrial Commission.
nc:SJR 768|confirm appointment to indust.summary: Confirms the Governor's reappointment of Kenneth L. Goodman of Richmond County to the North Carolina Industrial Commission for a term running from May 1, 2025, to April 30, 2031.

nc:HB 620|administrative office of the c.title: Administrative Office of the Courts Agency Requests.
nc:HB 620|administrative office of the c.summary: Makes many changes requested by the state court system, including ending courthouse notice for name changes, limiting public access to court reporters' audio recordings, regulating juror training materials, changing judges' mandatory retirement rules and updating estate and guardianship procedures.

nc:HB 576|department of health and human.title: Department of Health and Human Services Revisions.
nc:HB 576|department of health and human.summary: Makes changes to health and human services laws, including extending federal marketplace Medicaid eligibility decisions to 2028, allowing inspections of suspected unlicensed assisted living facilities with felony penalties, and letting magistrates handle after-hours emergency orders for disabled adults.

nc:HB 819|dit agency bill.title: DIT Agency Bill.
nc:HB 819|dit agency bill.summary: Changes state technology and broadband laws, exempting the Highway Patrol from central IT control, repealing two broadband grant programs, and allowing funds, including up to $50 million in emergency money, for Helene-related satellite internet and broadband repairs.

nc:SB 307|information rights of estate d.title: Information Rights of Estate/Death of Limited Liability Company Member.
nc:SB 307|information rights of estate d.summary: Gives the estate of a deceased LLC member, or a member declared incompetent, rights to company information and, unless the operating agreement waives it, to seek court dissolution, in addition to the member's financial interest, starting October 1, 2025.

nc:SB 706|county waste management nonbet.title: County Waste Management/Nonbetterment Costs.
nc:SB 706|county waste management nonbet.summary: Redirects 30% of the scrap tire tax from the General Fund to a revived state account for local tire disposal grants, recycled tire material grants and nuisance tire site cleanups, with balances over $300,000 going to the Highway Fund, starting October 1, 2025.

nc:HB 67|healthcare workforce reforms.title: Healthcare Workforce Reforms.
nc:HB 67|healthcare workforce reforms.summary: Joins interstate licensing compacts for physicians and physician assistants, licenses internationally trained doctors, lets pharmacists test and treat flu, lets some physician assistants and psychological associates practice without supervision, and sets surgical smoke rules for hospitals.

nc:HB 537|alena s law and office of vita.title: Alena's Law and Office of Vital Records Changes.
nc:HB 537|alena s law and office of vita.summary: Creates a rebuttable presumption of death in court proceedings over the property of people missing at least 90 days during a declared disaster, requires processing birth and death certificate amendments within 30 days, and generally bars state vital records employees from teleworking.

nc:HB 378|various ed law tax acct nil ch.title: Various Ed Law/Tax Acct/NIL Changes.
nc:HB 378|various ed law tax acct nil ch.summary: Gives parents access to community college records of minor students, expands high school career pathways, bars UNC from rejecting applicants for military service, shields 529 and ABLE accounts from creditors, and allows agents and records exemptions for athlete endorsement contracts.

nc:SB 321|accounting workforce developme.title: Accounting Workforce Development Act.
nc:SB 321|accounting workforce developme.summary: Creates an alternative path to becoming a certified public accountant: a bachelor's degree with an accounting concentration plus two years of supervised experience, instead of 150 credit hours and one year, starting January 1, 2026.

nc:SB 710|dps agency changes ab.title: DPS Agency Changes.-AB
nc:SB 710|dps agency changes ab.summary: Updates public safety agency laws, renaming alarm system licensing as security system licensing, expanding licensing boards' criminal record checks, requiring review of five years of personnel files for law enforcement applicants, and changing ABC permit and National Guard judge rules.

nc:HB 40|various gsc recommendations.title: Various GSC Recommendations.
nc:HB 40|various gsc recommendations.summary: Enacts General Statutes Commission recommendations, including technical corrections and new or updated uniform laws on child abduction prevention, unregulated custody transfers, community property at death, electronic signatures, emerging technologies in commercial law, and special bank deposits.

nc:HB 91|define armed forces religious p.title: Define Armed Forces/Religious Prop. Tax Excl.
nc:HB 91|define armed forces religious p.summary: Adds the Space Force to references to the armed forces in state law, and lets local governments forgive unpaid property taxes from the past five years on qualifying religious property if the owner applies late for the exemption.

nc:HB 247|underground safety revisions.title: Underground Safety Revisions.
nc:HB 247|underground safety revisions.summary: Revises rules for locating and marking underground utilities before digging, changing notice periods and extending notices to 28 days, setting operator response times, presuming excavators used due care in certain cases, and changing the damage prevention review board.

nc:SB 400|adult protection multidiscipli.title: Adult Protection Multidisciplinary Teams.
nc:SB 400|adult protection multidiscipli.summary: Lets counties create teams of social services, law enforcement and health professionals to review active adult protective services cases involving disabled and older adults and recommend fixes to county commissioners, starting October 1, 2025.

nc:HB 169|haywood cherokee leland occ ta.title: Haywood/Cherokee/Leland Occ. Tax. Mods.
nc:HB 169|haywood cherokee leland occ ta.summary: Lets Haywood County raise its hotel occupancy tax from 4% to 6% and shrinks its tourism board, changes Cherokee County's tourism board membership, and lets Leland spend occupancy tax money on lifeguards and event police and fire overtime.

nc:SB 248|birth certificates for persons.title: Birth Certificates for Persons Adopted.
nc:SB 248|birth certificates for persons.summary: Requires the State Registrar to give county registers of deeds electronic access to adoptee birth certificates so counties can issue certified copies to adoptees and close relatives, with undigitized certificates digitized within two business days of a county request, starting January 1, 2026.

nc:HB 834|sportsman s voter act.title: Sportsman's Voter Act.
nc:HB 834|sportsman s voter act.summary: Requires that people applying for state hunting or fishing licenses be offered a voter registration form and the chance to join the organ donor registry, with forms mailed to online applicants who ask, while stating it does not authorize online voter registration.

nc:HB 146|remote license renewal active.title: Remote License Renewal/Active Duty Military.
nc:HB 146|remote license renewal active.summary: Lets active-duty and reserve military members stationed outside North Carolina, and their spouses and dependent children, remotely renew a driver's license a second consecutive time if the license is not, or is being converted to one that is not, REAL ID-compliant, starting October 1, 2025.

nc:HB 797|residential property wholesali.title: Residential Property Wholesaling Protection.
nc:HB 797|residential property wholesali.summary: Treats residential property wholesaling, including soliciting homeowners to sign purchase contracts or assigning such contracts to others, as licensed real estate broker activity, and lets homeowners cancel these contracts without penalty until midnight of the 30th day after signing, or deed conveyance if sooner.

nc:HB 390|medicaid prepaid health plan p.title: Medicaid Prepaid Health Plan Practices.
nc:HB 390|medicaid prepaid health plan p.summary: Bars the state health department, unless federal law requires otherwise, from stopping Medicaid managed care plans from aligning claims processing with national coding standards or from shifting inpatient hospital and inpatient lab services to outpatient settings where appropriate, under standards the department may set.

nc:HJR 1007|adjournment resolution to da.title: Adjournment Resolution to Date Certain.
nc:HJR 1007|adjournment resolution to da.summary: Adjourns the General Assembly when it adjourns on Thursday, April 17, 2025, until it reconvenes at noon on Monday, April 28, 2025.

nc:HB 258|utility worker protection act.title: Utility Worker Protection Act.
nc:HB 258|utility worker protection act.summary: Makes assaulting an on-duty, identifiable utility or communications worker a Class A1 misdemeanor, and makes assaulting a public transit operator or ride-hailing driver a Class I felony, for offenses on or after December 1, 2025.

nc:HB 389|continuing budget operations p.title: Continuing Budget Operations Part III.
nc:HB 389|continuing budget operations p.summary: Makes additional state budget adjustments, funding items such as Medicaid's Healthy Opportunities pilot, health records at state-run facilities, school safety grants, the state emergency radio network and state parks, and creating a program to reimburse manufacturers for some water and sewer project costs.

nc:HB 231|social work interstate licensu.title: Social Work Interstate Licensure Compact.
nc:HB 231|social work interstate licensu.summary: Joins North Carolina to the interstate Social Work Licensure Compact, letting social workers with a multistate license practice in other member states, subject to background checks, continuing education and the laws of the state where the client is located.

nc:SJR 2|adjourn 2025 organizational ses.title: Adjourn 2025 Organizational Session.
nc:SJR 2|adjourn 2025 organizational ses.summary: Adjourns the General Assembly at the end of its January 8, 2025, organizational meeting until the regular session reconvenes at noon on Wednesday, January 29, 2025.

nc:SB 801|address confidentiality study.title: Address Confidentiality/Study & DL.
nc:SB 801|address confidentiality study.summary: Creates a task force to study expanding address-confidentiality protections for military members, officials and others, and lets certified special operations service members get overseas-use licenses listing their duty station instead of home address and, where agencies find it feasible, have personal data removed from public online databases.

nc:SR 1083|daniel johnson senate transpo.title: Daniel Johnson (Senate; Transportation).
nc:SR 1083|daniel johnson senate transpo.summary: Confirms Daniel Johnson as Secretary of the Department of Transportation by vote of the state Senate.

nc:SR 814|nathaniel denny nc dept i t.title: Nathaniel Denny; NC Dept I.T.
nc:SR 814|nathaniel denny nc dept i t.summary: Confirms Nathaniel Denny as Secretary of the Department of Information Technology by vote of the state Senate.

nc:SR 767|confirm secretary of adult cor.title: Confirm Secretary of Adult Correction.
nc:SR 767|confirm secretary of adult cor.summary: Confirms Leslie Cooley Dismukes as Secretary of the Department of Adult Correction by vote of the state Senate.

nc:SR 762|confirm sec dmva.title: Confirm Sec. DMVA.
nc:SR 762|confirm sec dmva.summary: Confirms Jocelyn Mitnaul Mallette as Secretary of the Department of Military and Veterans Affairs by vote of the state Senate.

nc:SR 766|confirm secretary of deq.title: Confirm Secretary of DEQ.
nc:SR 766|confirm secretary of deq.summary: Confirms D. Reid Wilson as Secretary of the Department of Environmental Quality by vote of the state Senate.

nc:SR 761|confirm cio.title: Confirm CIO.
nc:SR 761|confirm cio.summary: Confirms Teena Piccione as the State Chief Information Officer and Secretary of the Department of Information Technology by vote of the state Senate.

nc:SB 408|no high risk apps gov t networ.title: No High Risk Apps/Gov't Networks and Devices.
nc:SB 408|no high risk apps gov t networ.summary: Bans TikTok, WeChat and their successor apps on state and local government devices and networks, requiring removal within 30 days, with exceptions for law enforcement, prosecutors, auditors and prison-related investigations.

nc:SB 587|clarify nonconforming uses.title: Clarify Nonconforming Uses.
nc:SB 587|clarify nonconforming uses.summary: Bars applying new development rules to lots, structures and uses that were legal when established unless the owner consents, allows repair or rebuilding without expansion, ends protection after 24 months of voluntary discontinuance, and lets local governments initiate down-zoning without owner consent, retroactive to December 2024.

nc:SB 697|lake norman marine commission.title: Lake Norman Marine Commission.
nc:SB 697|lake norman marine commission.summary: Rewrites the law governing the Lake Norman Marine Commission, expanding its board from five to nine unpaid members, adding ethics and conflict-of-interest limits, letting it require boating courses for some operators and charge certain fees, and providing for the counties to reconstitute it.

nc:SB 402|allow lottery winners to be co.title: Allow Lottery Winners To Be Confidential.
nc:SB 402|allow lottery winners to be co.summary: Lets state lottery winners of $5 million or more keep their identifying information confidential indefinitely on request, lowered from $50 million and 90 days, except as needed for tax authorities, debt collection or a court order.

nc:SB 648|aoc agency requests ab.title: AOC Agency Requests.-AB
nc:SB 648|aoc agency requests ab.summary: Makes a package of court-system changes requested by the Administrative Office of the Courts, including ending courthouse notice before name changes and revising guardianship, estate, juvenile custody, mediation, business court and court-spending rules, plus changes to litigation costs landlords may charge tenants.

nc:SR 372|confirm mckinley wooten sec of.title: Confirm McKinley Wooten, Sec. of Rev.
nc:SR 372|confirm mckinley wooten sec of.summary: Confirms McKinley Wooten, Jr., as Secretary of the Department of Revenue by vote of the state Senate.

nc:SR 760|confirm lee lilley sec of comm.title: Confirm Lee Lilley, Sec. of Commerce.
nc:SR 760|confirm lee lilley sec of comm.summary: Confirms Lee Lilley as Secretary of the Department of Commerce by vote of the state Senate.

nc:SB 177|add psychiatric hospitals to m.title: Add Psychiatric Hospitals to Medicaid HASP.
nc:SB 177|add psychiatric hospitals to m.summary: Makes privately run freestanding psychiatric hospitals eligible for increased Medicaid payments under the hospital access and stabilization program, funded by new assessments on those hospitals, contingent on federal approval.

nc:SB 528|child care regulatory reforms.title: Child Care Regulatory Reforms and Flexibilities.
nc:SB 528|child care regulatory reforms.summary: Changes child care rules, raising maximum infant group sizes from 10 to 15 and young toddler groups from 12 to 18, letting five years of classroom experience substitute for the lead-teacher credential, easing licensing for after-school programs in schools, and creating a facility-rules workgroup.

nc:SB 335|pharmacists test and treat inf.title: Pharmacists/Test and Treat/Influenza and Strep.
nc:SB 335|pharmacists test and treat inf.summary: Lets licensed pharmacists test for and treat flu and strep under a State Health Director standing order and rules from the medical and pharmacy boards, and requires insurers to cover services pharmacists lawfully provide when they would be covered if another provider gave them.

nc:SR 224|gabriel esparza secretary of d.title: Gabriel Esparza/Secretary of DOA.
nc:SR 224|gabriel esparza secretary of d.summary: Confirms Gabriel J. Esparza as Secretary of the Department of Administration by vote of the state Senate.

nc:SR 260|confirm dr devdutta sangvai dh.title: Confirm Dr. Devdutta Sangvai/DHHS.
nc:SR 260|confirm dr devdutta sangvai dh.summary: Confirms Dr. Devdutta Sangvai as secretary of the state Department of Health and Human Services, through a Senate resolution that takes effect upon adoption.

nc:SR 221|confirm pam cashwell sec n and.title: Confirm Pam Cashwell/Sec. N and CR.
nc:SR 221|confirm pam cashwell sec n and.summary: Confirms Pamela Brewington Cashwell as secretary of the state Department of Natural and Cultural Resources, through a Senate resolution that takes effect upon adoption.

nc:SR 225|eddie buffaloe secretary of dp.title: Eddie Buffaloe/Secretary of DPS.
nc:SR 225|eddie buffaloe secretary of dp.summary: Confirms Eddie M. Buffaloe Jr. as secretary of the state Department of Public Safety, through a Senate resolution that takes effect upon adoption.

nc:SR 150|confirm joey hopkins sec of do.title: Confirm Joey Hopkins/Sec. of DOT.
nc:SR 150|confirm joey hopkins sec of do.summary: Confirms Joey R. Hopkins as secretary of the state Department of Transportation, through a Senate resolution that takes effect upon adoption.

nc:SJR 1088|appoint floyd mckissick nc u.title: Appoint Floyd McKissick NC Utilities.
nc:SJR 1088|appoint floyd mckissick nc u.summary: Confirms the governor's appointment of Floyd McKissick to the North Carolina Utilities Commission to fill an unexpired term ending June 30, 2029.

nc:SJR 1089|appoint melanie bush divisio.title: Appoint Melanie Bush Division of Health Benefit.
nc:SJR 1089|appoint melanie bush divisio.summary: Confirms the governor's appointment of Melanie Bush as director of the Division of Health Benefits in the Department of Health and Human Services, for a term ending June 30, 2029.

nc:SJR 1090|appoint john gajda utility c.title: Appoint John Gajda Utility Commission.
nc:SJR 1090|appoint john gajda utility c.summary: Confirms the governor's appointment of John Gajda of Wake County to fill a vacancy on the North Carolina Utilities Commission for a term ending June 30, 2027.

nc:HB 1215|garner town manager settle cl.title: Garner Town Manager/Settle Claims.
nc:HB 1215|garner town manager settle cl.summary: Lets the Garner town council authorize the town manager, with town attorney approval, to settle personal injury and property damage claims up to $10,000 (up from $100), town debt claims up to $10,000, and town eminent domain claims within the budgeted acquisition amount.

nc:SB 355|support the department of adul.title: Support the Department of Adult Correction.
nc:SB 355|support the department of adul.summary: Makes several changes for the Department of Adult Correction, including tuition waivers for survivors of probation officers killed or disabled on duty, a higher cap on purchases from Correction Enterprises, and revised post-release supervision and electronic monitoring rules.

nc:SB 857|general statutes commission up.title: General Statutes Commission Update Funeral Board and DOI Licensing.
nc:SB 857|general statutes commission up.summary: Reorganizes and updates the laws governing the Board of Funeral Service and revises several Department of Insurance licensing programs, including those for out-of-state insurers, bail bondsmen and professional employer organizations, as recommended by the General Statutes Commission.

nc:HB 1115|general statutes commission a.title: General Statutes Commission Advance Health Care Planning Documents.
nc:HB 1115|general statutes commission a.summary: Lets a health care power of attorney or living will be signed before either two qualified witnesses or a notary instead of both, allows combining advance health care planning documents, and makes related changes, starting January 1, 2027.

nc:HB 1109|ncdot strategic transportatio.title: NCDOT Strategic Transportation Investments Study Recommendation.
nc:HB 1109|ncdot strategic transportatio.summary: Directs the state Department of Transportation to study how well projects ranked under the state's transportation investment formula are delivered, consider funding alternatives, and recommend law changes in a report due by November 1, 2026.

nc:HB 1218|navigable waters pine knoll s.title: Navigable Waters/Pine Knoll Shores.
nc:HB 1218|navigable waters pine knoll s.summary: Lets the Town of Pine Knoll Shores adopt and enforce ordinances placing navigation, channel and anchoring markers in canals and Bogue Sound within its limits, after giving the Coast Guard and Army Corps of Engineers six weeks' notice.

nc:HB 1042|affordable housing exemption.title: Affordable Housing Exemption Modifications.
nc:HB 1042|affordable housing exemption.summary: Moves nonprofit rental housing to a new property tax exemption requiring more than half of units be rent-limited for households earning up to 80% of area median income, requires currently exempt owners to reapply by December 31, 2026, and cuts future-site tax deferral from 10 to five years.

nc:HB 1019|mike clampitt 1st responder t.title: Mike Clampitt 1st Responder Tax Fairness Act.
nc:HB 1019|mike clampitt 1st responder t.summary: Removes the two-paid-employee limit and the vehicle-type list from the highway use tax exemption for volunteer fire departments and rescue squads, so any vehicle titled to a qualifying group is exempt starting July 1, 2026.

nc:HB 1220|amend stedman charter.title: Amend Stedman Charter.
nc:HB 1220|amend stedman charter.summary: As introduced, repeals a provision of the Town of Stedman's charter concerning the sale of alcoholic beverages.

nc:HB 1034|town of stanley charter amend.title: Town of Stanley Charter Amendment/Manager.
nc:HB 1034|town of stanley charter amend.summary: Amends the Town of Stanley charter so the town manager hires, suspends and removes all town employees except the town attorney, ending the previous exceptions for the town clerk and tax collector.

nc:HB 1035|even year elections pink hill.title: Even-Year Elections/Pink Hill.
nc:HB 1035|even year elections pink hill.summary: Moves Pink Hill's town elections to even-numbered years starting in 2028, cancels the 2027 election, and extends current mayor and commissioner terms by one year while keeping staggered four-year terms.

nc:HB 491|medicaid rebase funding.title: Medicaid Rebase Funding.
nc:HB 491|medicaid rebase funding.summary: Appropriates $190 million from the Medicaid Contingency Reserve for the 2025-26 fiscal year to cover projected Medicaid enrollment and cost changes, and requires regional behavioral health plans to transfer about $18 million to the state each year in 2025-26 and 2026-27.

nc:SB 405|healthcare investment act.title: Healthcare Investment Act.
nc:SB 405|healthcare investment act.summary: Raises yearly Medicaid funding from $600 million to $690 million, adds $49.2 million a year for managed care contracts, deepens a mental health services funding cut from $18.6 million to $30 million, orders about $34 million in health department vacant-position cuts, and trims building reserves $42 million yearly.

nc:HB 8|nc managing environmental waste.title: NC Managing Environmental Waste Act of 2025.
nc:HB 8|nc managing environmental waste.summary: Requires state agencies, community colleges and school districts to buy compostable or recyclable food service supplies where economically practicable and report yearly, orders a UNC study of single-use food ware, directs reductions at the legislature and five state cultural sites, and creates state approvals for reusing nonhazardous solid waste.

nc:HB 480|medical board licensing effici.title: Medical Board Licensing Efficiency Act.
nc:HB 480|medical board licensing effici.summary: Lets the Medical Board license physicians, physician assistants and anesthesiologist assistants who have held a full license in another state for at least five years and have a North Carolina job offer, sets application fees up to $500, and lets the State Auditor see board records.

nc:HB 369|parking lot reform and moderni.title: Parking Lot Reform and Modernization Act.
nc:HB 369|parking lot reform and moderni.summary: Bars local governments from requiring a minimum number of off-street parking spaces, and lets local governments with federal stormwater permits require redeveloped properties to control up to half of existing stormwater runoff, exempting small residential projects.

nc:HB 697|nc genetic counselors workforc.title: NC Genetic Counselors Workforce Act.
nc:HB 697|nc genetic counselors workforc.summary: Creates a five-member Genetic Counselors Licensure Board and, starting October 1, 2026, requires a state license to practice as or use the title of genetic counselor, with rules on qualifications, fees, scope of practice and background checks.

nc:SB 101|protect tax advantaged account.title: Protect Tax-Advantaged Accounts and Living Donors.
nc:SB 101|protect tax advantaged account.summary: Shields college savings and ABLE disability accounts used for qualifying purposes from creditors, bars insurers from discriminating against living organ donors, and gives state, school and community college employees up to 30 days of paid leave to donate an organ and seven for bone marrow.

nc:HB 590|patient safety med imaging rad.title: Patient Safety/Med. Imaging/Radiation Therapy.
nc:HB 590|patient safety med imaging rad.summary: Creates a Medical Imaging and Radiation Therapy Board of Examiners and, starting January 1, 2026, requires a state license to perform X-ray, other imaging or radiation therapy procedures on patients, with exemptions and a transition for current workers.

nc:HB 762|modernize nc secure and fair e.title: Modernize NC Secure and Fair Enforcement (S.A.F.E.) Act/Second Mortgage Fe
nc:HB 762|modernize nc secure and fair e.summary: Rewrites the state's mortgage licensing law, effective October 1, 2025, and lets certain lenders exceed the 2% fee cap on second-mortgage loans if total points and fees stay within the lesser of federal qualified-mortgage limits or 3% of the loan.

nc:SB 344|pooled trust transfers public.title: Pooled Trust Transfers/Public Benefits Eligibility.
nc:SB 344|pooled trust transfers public.summary: Requires state health officials, where federal law allows, to treat transfers by people 65 or older into pooled special needs trusts as fair-market-value transfers that do not affect Medicaid or Special Assistance eligibility, when the funds will pay for the person's care within their life expectancy.

nc:SB 133|nc community colleges system l.title: NC Community Colleges System Learning Management System/NC Longitudinal Da
nc:SB 133|nc community colleges system l.summary: Requires community colleges' state board to seek bids by December 31, 2025, for one learning management system for all colleges, with the switch done by 2027; exempts the system office from state IT purchasing rules and revises the state longitudinal data system.

nc:HB 357|continuing care retirement com.title: Continuing Care Retirement Communities Act.
nc:HB 357|continuing care retirement com.summary: Replaces the state's law on continuing care retirement communities with a new act overseen by the Insurance Commissioner, setting permit, certificate and license steps and fees, escrow rules for entrance fees and deposits, required resident disclosure statements, contract terms, audits and notice requirements.

nc:HB 435|modify board of engineers and.title: Modify Board of Engineers and Surveyors.
nc:HB 435|modify board of engineers and.summary: Updates the state's engineering and land surveying licensing law, including allowing multiyear license renewals, restores land surveyor intern certification, moves licensed surveyors' limited right to enter private property into the criminal trespass laws, and gives the licensing board rulemaking power to carry out the changes.

nc:SB 171|practitioner transparency reag.title: Practitioner Transparency/Reagan's Law/Sam's Law.
nc:SB 171|practitioner transparency reag.summary: Requires health care ads to state providers' license types and bars non-physicians from using physician specialty titles; requires health plans to cover prosthetic and orthotic devices covered under Medicare Part B; and requires state-set student medical emergency plans and a first-aid-trained employee in each school.

nc:HR 1013|support for israel.title: Support for Israel.
nc:HR 1013|support for israel.summary: Urges Congress to take all necessary steps to criminalize and prohibit acts that harm members of the Jewish faith and supporters of Israel, and to seek justice for people taken hostage by Hamas, citing a June 2025 attack in Colorado.

nc:SJR 764|confirm chris ayers executive.title: Confirm Chris Ayers/Executive Director Utilities Commission Public Staff.
nc:SJR 764|confirm chris ayers executive.summary: Confirms the Governor's reappointment of Christopher J. Ayers as executive director of the Utilities Commission's Public Staff for a term running July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2031.

nc:SJR 765|confirm regina adams board of.title: Confirm Regina Adams/Board of Review.
nc:SJR 765|confirm regina adams board of.summary: Confirms the Governor's appointment of Regina Smith Adams of Durham County to the Board of Review as the member representing employees, for a term running July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2029.

nc:HB 4|sam s law.title: Sam's Law.
nc:HB 4|sam s law.summary: Requires the State Board of Education to set a standard medical condition action plan for students at risk of medical emergencies and a medical emergency response plan for schools, and requires each school to have at least one person trained in first aid and lifesaving techniques.

nc:HB 94|disabled veteran homestead excl.title: Disabled Veteran Homestead Exclusion Prequalification.
nc:HB 94|disabled veteran homestead excl.summary: Lets disabled veterans, and their surviving spouses who have not remarried, get advance confirmation from the county tax assessor that they qualify for the disabled veteran property tax exclusion before buying a home; the assessor must respond within 30 days.

nc:HB 520|abuse and deception by telemar.title: Abuse and Deception by Telemarketers.
nc:HB 520|abuse and deception by telemar.summary: Bars telemarketers and their agents from altering caller ID to disguise where a call comes from, lets people who receive such calls sue for $10,000 per call, and bars phone carriers from knowingly providing subscriber numbers to violators, starting December 1, 2025.

nc:HB 535|title fraud prevention act.title: Title Fraud Prevention Act.
nc:HB 535|title fraud prevention act.summary: Makes knowingly recording a false deed a felony, requires photo ID from filers other than attorneys, title insurers and lenders, bars registers of deeds from accepting suspicious documents, and creates a court process for property owners to void fraudulent filings.

nc:HB 552|agricultural manufacturing eco.title: Agricultural Manufacturing Economic Development.
nc:HB 552|agricultural manufacturing eco.summary: Creates an Agricultural Manufacturing Investment Grant program within the One North Carolina Fund, allowing up to $5 million for competitive grants to agricultural manufacturers, capped at $100,000 per year and $500,000 total per recipient, with performance requirements.

nc:HB 727|marriage family therapy modifi.title: Marriage/Family Therapy Modifications.
nc:HB 727|marriage family therapy modifi.summary: Eases licensing for marriage and family therapists licensed in other states by cutting the required years of practice from five to two and accepting California's licensing exam in place of the national exam, starting October 1, 2025.

nc:HB 851|hospital police officer author.title: Hospital Police Officer/Authority/Info Access.
nc:HB 851|hospital police officer author.summary: Defines hospital police officers as a separate type of company police, lets hospitals sign mutual aid agreements with local law enforcement, gives hospital police access to state criminal justice databases, and makes them eligible for community college training fee waivers.

nc:HB 795|increased access for youth in.title: Increased Access for Youth in Foster Families.
nc:HB 795|increased access for youth in.summary: Creates state guardianship assistance programs that let social services pay relatives or legal guardians who take guardianship of children leaving foster care at foster care room and board rates, plus up to $2,000 toward the cost of obtaining guardianship.

nc:HB 896|jesse s law.title: Jesse's Law.
nc:HB 896|jesse s law.summary: Creates a study committee on whether to require statewide domestic violence and child abuse training for judges, mediators, guardians ad litem and others involved in child custody cases, with interim and final reports to lawmakers.

nc:HB 953|study committee on assistant d.title: Study Committee on Assistant District Attorney/Assistant Public Defender/P
nc:HB 953|study committee on assistant d.summary: Creates a 12-member study committee on pay for assistant district attorneys, assistant public defenders and court-appointed private lawyers, comparing urban, suburban and rural rates and other states, with reports due March 1, 2026, and March 1, 2027.

nc:HB 150|expedite surplus property.title: Expedite Surplus Property.
nc:HB 150|expedite surplus property.summary: Lets nonprofit educational organizations and state agencies obtain surplus and decommissioned federal property directly from the federal government, without going through the state Department of Administration, for educational or public safety use.

nc:HB 188|automatic renewal of contracts.title: Automatic Renewal of Contracts.
nc:HB 188|automatic renewal of contracts.summary: Tightens rules for contracts that renew automatically for terms over one month, requiring clear disclosures and consumer consent before renewal charges, and notice 15 to 60 days before renewal of contracts of six months or more, for contracts entered on or after January 1, 2026.

nc:HB 597|adopt osprey as state raptor.title: Adopt Osprey as State Raptor.
nc:HB 597|adopt osprey as state raptor.summary: Designates the osprey as North Carolina's official state raptor.

nc:HB 701|adopt lafayette day.title: Adopt Lafayette Day.
nc:HB 701|adopt lafayette day.summary: Designates May 17 of each year as Lafayette Day in North Carolina.

nc:HB 754|fin exploit prevention savings.title: Fin. Exploit. Prevention/Savings Bank Updates.
nc:HB 754|fin exploit prevention savings.summary: Lets banks delay or refuse transactions from accounts of older or disabled adults for up to 30 days, extendable 30 more, when they suspect financial exploitation, and updates state savings bank rules on branches, public notice and confidentiality of regulator records.

nc:HB 818|birth certificates for persons.title: Birth Certificates for Persons Adopted.
nc:HB 818|birth certificates for persons.summary: Lets the register of deeds in an adoptee's birth county issue certified copies of the adoptee's new birth certificate to the adoptee and certain relatives through the state electronic system, keeps those records out of county files and public inspection, and requires privacy training.

nc:HB 981|local schools open enrollment.title: Local Schools Open Enrollment Study.
nc:HB 981|local schools open enrollment.summary: Directs the Department of Public Instruction to study how school districts could let students attend any school in their home district instead of their assigned school, including mandatory open enrollment options, and report to lawmakers by April 15, 2026.

nc:HB 346|central carolina community col.title: Central Carolina Community College Multicampus Center Full-Time Equivalent
nc:HB 346|central carolina community col.summary: Requires the State Board of Community Colleges to count enrollment at Central Carolina Community College's health sciences centers toward its Harnett and Chatham main campuses when deciding multicampus center status for funding.

nc:HB 489|insurance coverage emergency a.title: Insurance Coverage Emergency Ambulance Transportation.
nc:HB 489|insurance coverage emergency a.summary: Requires health insurers to cover emergency ambulance transport, including by out-of-network providers, at in-network cost sharing, and sets a minimum out-of-network payment based on county franchise rates or, if none, the lesser of 400% of Medicare or the provider's charge.

nc:HB 572|veterans electroencephalogram.title: Veterans/Electroencephalogram Combined Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation P
nc:HB 572|veterans electroencephalogram.summary: Requires the Department of Military and Veterans Affairs to select a provider for a statewide pilot program offering a brain stimulation treatment (eTMS) to veterans, first responders and their families for conditions including PTSD, substance use and brain injuries.

nc:HB 615|enrollment stability for milit.title: Enrollment Stability for Military Students.
nc:HB 615|enrollment stability for milit.summary: Lets children of military families living in temporary housing enroll and attend school in the district where they expect to live without proof of residency, for up to a year or through the school year, and through graduation for high school juniors and seniors.

nc:HB 652|transportation goods unit pric.title: Transportation Goods Unit Pricing Cost.
nc:HB 652|transportation goods unit pric.summary: Changes how the Department of Transportation sets baseline unit prices for its cost-reporting program, using a rolling average of the three previous fiscal years instead of fiscal year 2015-16, starting July 1, 2025.

nc:HB 741|veterans registration plate mo.title: Veterans Registration Plate Modifications.
nc:HB 741|veterans registration plate mo.summary: Lets the state issue Military Veteran special license plates on a full-color background and specifies where design elements appear on the plate.

nc:HB 772|north carolina student lifelin.title: North Carolina Student Lifeline Act.
nc:HB 772|north carolina student lifelin.summary: Requires public and private K-12 schools, community colleges and UNC campuses to give students the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline and NC Peer Warmline numbers, printing them on new student IDs for grades 6-12, websites, school-issued devices and calendars.

nc:HB 782|civic club registration plate.title: Civic Club Registration Plate Clarification.
nc:HB 782|civic club registration plate.summary: Lets a nationally recognized civic organization obtain a civic club special license plate for a vehicle registered in the organization's own name, not only for vehicles owned by its members.

nc:HB 841|shellfish leasing study.title: Shellfish Leasing Study.
nc:HB 841|shellfish leasing study.summary: Directs the North Carolina Collaboratory to study shellfish farming lease rules and moratoriums and recommend a statewide framework, with an interim report due December 1, 2025, and a final report by May 1, 2026.

nc:HB 847|off road motorcycle registrati.title: Off-Road Motorcycle Registration Eligibility.
nc:HB 847|off road motorcycle registrati.summary: Lets certain off-road motorcycles fitted with highway equipment be assigned a state vehicle identification number, registered and driven on roads with speed limits of 55 mph or less, subject to insurance and motorcycle licensing rules.

nc:HB 906|reagan s law.title: Reagan's Law.
nc:HB 906|reagan s law.summary: Requires health insurance plans to cover prosthetic and orthotic devices, including custom devices and replacements, that Medicare must cover, bars denying claims for people with limb loss when comparable care would be covered for others, and requires insurers to report claims data to the state.

nc:HB 57|adopt state veterans museum.title: Adopt State Veterans Museum.
nc:HB 57|adopt state veterans museum.summary: Designates the Veterans History Museum of the Carolinas in Transylvania County as the official Veterans History Museum of North Carolina.

nc:HB 472|commercial vehicle and cargo p.title: Commercial Vehicle and Cargo Protection.
nc:HB 472|commercial vehicle and cargo p.summary: Bans booting or otherwise immobilizing commercial trucks for parking enforcement, making it a misdemeanor, and requires towing companies to promptly return commercial cargo from towed trucks to its owner on request.

nc:HB 578|the jason flatt act of north c.title: The Jason Flatt Act of North Carolina.
nc:HB 578|the jason flatt act of north c.summary: Requires public school employees to complete one hour of suicide prevention training each year, has the state provide training materials free, and shields schools and staff from civil liability for carrying out the training except for wanton conduct, gross negligence or intentional wrongdoing.

nc:HB 832|revise school safety grant pro.title: Revise School Safety Grant Program.
nc:HB 832|revise school safety grant pro.summary: Adds violence prevention, suicide prevention, character education and personal-skills training for students and school employees to the uses allowed for state school safety grants.

nc:HB 866|automatic order equitable dist.title: Automatic Order/Equitable Distribution Claim.
nc:HB 866|automatic order equitable dist.summary: Requires courts to enter an automatic order when a divorcing spouse files a property-division claim, barring both spouses from wasting or hiding assets, running up debt, or dropping the other spouse or children from insurance, while allowing normal household expenses.

nc:HB 908|modify civil commitment hearin.title: Modify Civil Commitment Hearing Procedures.
nc:HB 908|modify civil commitment hearin.summary: Requires notice to the district attorney when a defendant found unfit for trial on a violent charge faces a civil commitment hearing or release, and lets the prosecutor ask to hold the hearing in the county where the charges were filed.

nc:HB 971|career development adjustment.title: Career Development Adjustment.
nc:HB 971|career development adjustment.summary: Creates a pilot program in 12 schools requiring students entering seventh grade in 2025-26 and 2026-27 to review and update their career development plans every year through graduation, with counselor help and financial aid information.

nc:HB 140|authorize gullah geechee herit.title: Authorize Gullah Geechee Heritage Trail.
nc:HB 140|authorize gullah geechee herit.summary: Authorizes the Gullah Geechee Heritage Trail in Brunswick County and directs the state to support creating trail segments on state park and other lands, without adding the trail to the State Parks System.

nc:HB 156|increase access for small empl.title: Increase Access for Small Employers/Insurance.
nc:HB 156|increase access for small empl.summary: Lets insurers sell stop-loss, catastrophic and reinsurance coverage to small employers with five or more eligible employees, down from 12, for contracts issued or renewed starting October 1, 2025.

nc:HB 254|adopt tuskegee airmen day.title: Adopt Tuskegee Airmen Day.
nc:HB 254|adopt tuskegee airmen day.summary: Designates the fourth Thursday of March each year as Tuskegee Airmen Commemoration Day in North Carolina.

nc:HB 512|emergency care animals veterin.title: Emergency Care/Animals/Veterinary Practice.
nc:HB 512|emergency care animals veterin.summary: Lets emergency medical services workers, other than dispatchers, treat and transport injured police dogs and certified search-and-rescue dogs at emergency scenes without a veterinary license, and bars their prosecution for acting in good faith, except for gross negligence, wanton conduct or intentional wrongdoing.

nc:HB 614|the michael mitchke fire invol.title: The Michael Mitchke Fire Involvement Necessitates Examination (F.I.N.E.) L
nc:HB 614|the michael mitchke fire invol.summary: Requires an autopsy in every case connected to a fire in which human remains are found, starting October 1, 2025.

nc:HB 720|insurance guaranty association.title: Insurance Guaranty Association Act Revisions.
nc:HB 720|insurance guaranty association.summary: Revises the state insurance guaranty fund law, capping its payments on cybersecurity insurance claims at $500,000 per event, covering certain claims on policies transferred to insurers that later fail, and letting the fund contest pre-insolvency settlements and judgments.

nc:HB 107|adopt sudden unexpected death.title: Adopt Sudden Unexpected Death in Epilepsy (SUDEP) Awareness Week.
nc:HB 107|adopt sudden unexpected death.summary: Designates the week beginning the second Sunday of November each year as Sudden Unexpected Death in Epilepsy Awareness Week and encourages local school boards to provide seizure awareness training for school staff.

nc:HB 126|revise voluntary agricultural.title: Revise Voluntary Agricultural District Laws.
nc:HB 126|revise voluntary agricultural.summary: Requires local farmland-district ordinances to make government agencies seek a public hearing before condemning or rezoning qualifying farmland, extends the hearing deadline from 30 to 45 days, and bars starting such actions until 120 days after the board's findings.

nc:HB 288|pow mia flag state buildings a.title: POW/MIA Flag/State Buildings and Schools.
nc:HB 288|pow mia flag state buildings a.summary: Requires the POW/MIA flag to be flown at all state-owned buildings and public school buildings whenever the U.S. flag is flown, if it can fit on an existing flagpole, with the state and school boards supplying flags.

nc:HB 368|revise child passenger restrai.title: Revise Child Passenger Restraint System Law.
nc:HB 368|revise child passenger restrai.summary: Changes child car seat rules so children under 8 and under 57 inches tall, rather than under 80 pounds, must use a car seat or booster, and sets rules on rear seating, rear-facing seats and proper seat belt fit.

nc:HB 570|responsible firefighting foam.title: Responsible Firefighting Foam Management Act.
nc:HB 570|responsible firefighting foam.summary: Bars using firefighting foam with added PFAS chemicals for training or practice, and for testing unless required by law at contained facilities, requiring PFAS-free training foams starting December 1, 2025.

nc:HB 649|county tier designation study.title: County Tier Designation Study Bill.
nc:HB 649|county tier designation study.summary: Directs the North Carolina Collaboratory to study three possible changes to how counties are ranked into economic development tiers, with a preliminary report due by December 31, 2025, and a final report by December 1, 2026.

nc:HB 694|water wastewater regionalizati.title: Water/Wastewater Regionalization/Study.
nc:HB 694|water wastewater regionalizati.summary: Directs the UNC School of Government's Environmental Finance Center to study the costs, benefits and obstacles of combining water and sewer systems regionally and report recommendations to legislative committees by April 1, 2026.

nc:HB 822|moped regulation.title: Moped Regulation.
nc:HB 822|moped regulation.summary: Presumes mopeds are built for one rider unless the manufacturer says otherwise, and requires mopeds on roads with speed limits above 35 mph to stay in the right side of the right lane except when turning left.

nc:HB 328|ban delta 8 and delta 9 on sch.title: Ban Delta-8 and Delta-9 on School Grounds.
nc:HB 328|ban delta 8 and delta 9 on sch.summary: Requires public schools, charter schools and certain private schools to adopt policies banning hemp-derived products such as delta-8 and delta-9 THC in school buildings, on grounds and at school events, and adds vaping products to existing school tobacco bans.

nc:HB 329|tobacco and hemp on nonpublic.title: Tobacco and Hemp on Nonpublic School Grounds.
nc:HB 329|tobacco and hemp on nonpublic.summary: Encourages private church schools, religious charter schools and other private schools to adopt policies banning tobacco and hemp-derived products on school grounds.

nc:HB 432|property tax relief study.title: Property Tax Relief Study.
nc:HB 432|property tax relief study.summary: Directs a legislative study committee to examine existing homeowner property tax relief programs and options to expand relief, including limits on yearly tax increases and possible constitutional changes, and report to the 2026 legislative session.

nc:HB 592|toxic free medical devices act.title: Toxic-Free Medical Devices Act of 2025.
nc:HB 592|toxic free medical devices act.summary: Bans making or selling IV fluid bags made with the chemical DEHP starting in 2030 and IV tubing made with it starting in 2035, with some extensions and exemptions for blood collection bags.

nc:HB 610|year round school study.title: Year-Round School/Study.
nc:HB 610|year round school study.summary: Requires the state Department of Public Instruction to study the feasibility of requiring each school district to have at least one year-round school for every grade level, including costs, transportation, barriers and likely enrollment, and to report by January 15, 2027.

nc:HB 734|modernize debt settlement proh.title: Modernize Debt Settlement Prohibition.
nc:HB 734|modernize debt settlement proh.summary: Moves the ban on for-fee debt adjusting and debt settlement from criminal law into consumer protection law, keeping it a misdemeanor, voiding such contracts, counting affiliates' conduct and fees whenever paid, and letting consumers and the Attorney General sue.

nc:HB 69|military and veterans education.title: Military and Veterans Educational Promise Act.
nc:HB 69|military and veterans education.summary: Bars University of North Carolina campuses from denying admission solely because an applicant serves or plans to serve in the military, requires enrollment deferrals for service members and spouses, and grants in-state tuition to certain honorably discharged veterans.

nc:HB 213|post nc veterans benefits.title: Post NC Veterans' Benefits.
nc:HB 213|post nc veterans benefits.summary: Requires the state labor-law notice that employers must post to also cover state veterans' benefits, with QR codes linking to state labor and veterans' affairs webpages, and lets the notice be provided in digital form, starting January 1, 2026.

nc:HB 218|emergency information on dmv a.title: Emergency Information on DMV Applications.
nc:HB 218|emergency information on dmv a.summary: Requires applications for driver's licenses, learner's permits, state ID cards and license renewals to let applicants optionally list emergency contact information, starting October 1, 2026.

nc:HB 246|liam s law.title: Liam's Law.
nc:HB 246|liam s law.summary: Raises penalties for reckless driving and street racing that cause serious injury or death, requires longer or permanent license revocations for street racing and for hit-and-runs causing serious injury or death, and requires tougher sentencing for fatal hit-and-runs.

nc:HB 272|the sergeant mickey hutchens a.title: The Sergeant Mickey Hutchens Act.
nc:HB 272|the sergeant mickey hutchens a.summary: Lets law enforcement, probation, parole and correctional officers with advanced certificates and at least five years in state or local retirement systems buy up to four years of extra service credit at full cost, which employers may help pay.

nc:HB 349|update requirements advance he.title: Update Requirements/Advance Health Care Directives.
nc:HB 349|update requirements advance he.summary: Lets people sign a health care power of attorney or living will before either two qualified witnesses or a notary, and requires the state's advance directive registry to accept electronic and unnotarized filings and HIPAA waivers.

nc:HB 479|town of burgaw property transf.title: Town of Burgaw Property Transfer.
nc:HB 479|town of burgaw property transf.summary: Requires the state to convey about 11 acres of land to the Town of Burgaw for $1 for public use, with the land reverting to the state if that use ends and the town paying conveyance costs.

nc:HB 377|changes to estates and trusts.title: Changes to Estates and Trusts Statutes.
nc:HB 377|changes to estates and trusts.summary: Updates estate and trust laws by allowing electronic wills starting January 1, 2026, clarifying how a surviving spouse claims an elective share, clarifying what trustees may do during trust contests, and revising year's allowance rules for surviving spouses and children.

nc:HB 397|use of epinephrine nasal spray.title: Use of Epinephrine Nasal Spray.
nc:HB 397|use of epinephrine nasal spray.summary: Expands state rules on emergency epinephrine to cover nasal sprays as well as auto-injectors, so schools must stock and students may carry either, and camps, colleges, restaurants and other authorized entities may keep both.

nc:HB 481|general statutes commission te.title: General Statutes Commission Technical Corrections 2025 Part 2.
nc:HB 481|general statutes commission te.summary: Makes technical and wording corrections throughout state statutes and session laws recommended by the General Statutes Commission, such as standardizing terms like "email," "website" and "rulemaking."

nc:HB 160|joel h crisp sudden unexpected.title: Joel H. Crisp Sudden Unexpected Death in Epilepsy (SUDEP) Awareness Law.
nc:HB 160|joel h crisp sudden unexpected.summary: Directs the state's Area Health Education Centers to gather, with medical and health groups, evidence-based information on sudden unexpected death in epilepsy for health care practitioners, post it online, and report to lawmakers by September 1, 2025.

nc:HB 227|u s and n c flags made in usa.title: U.S. and N.C. Flags/Made In USA.
nc:HB 227|u s and n c flags made in usa.summary: Bars state agencies and local governments from using public funds to buy U.S. or North Carolina flags unless they are made entirely in the United States from U.S.-grown and U.S.-made materials, starting October 1, 2025.

nc:HB 141|the joe john remembrance act.title: The Joe John Remembrance Act.
nc:HB 141|the joe john remembrance act.summary: Eliminates the extra registration fee for the Fire Department or Rescue Squad Member special license plate for plates issued or renewed starting July 1, 2025; the regular vehicle registration fee still applies.

nc:HB 206|modify gun retrieval domestic.title: Modify Gun Retrieval - Domestic Violence Protective Orders/Juvenile 911 Ca
nc:HB 206|modify gun retrieval domestic.summary: Lets sheriffs return guns surrendered under emergency domestic violence protective orders without a court order when no final order is entered and a background check clears, revises third-party claim and disposal rules, and makes 911 calls by minors non-public.

nc:HB 352|modify water and sewage projec.title: Modify Water and Sewage Project Bid Requirements.
nc:HB 352|modify water and sewage projec.summary: Lets state and local governments award water and sewer construction contracts of $500,000 or more after receiving two bids instead of three, or one bid if a project is rebid, for contracts entered through 2030.

nc:HB 50|law enforcement officers specia.title: Law Enforcement Officers Special Separation Allowance Options.
nc:HB 50|law enforcement officers specia.summary: Lets state and local law enforcement officers who complete 30 years of service before age 62 choose an alternative separation allowance after retiring, paid for a limited period tied to their age at 30 years, for retirements starting July 1, 2025.

nc:HB 295|require dot to install propert.title: Require DOT to Install Property Corner Markers.
nc:HB 295|require dot to install propert.summary: Requires the Department of Transportation to show property boundary corner markers on its plans for right-of-way and easement acquisitions and to install those markers once new projects needing such land are completed.

nc:HB 331|adopt official state rice fest.title: Adopt Official State Rice Festival.
nc:HB 331|adopt official state rice fest.summary: Designates the North Carolina Rice Festival, held the first weekend of March at the Brunswick Town State Historic Site in Winnabow, as the official state rice festival.

nc:HB 355|office of state fire marshal t.title: Office of State Fire Marshal to Study Future of Rural Firefighting.
nc:HB 355|office of state fire marshal t.summary: Directs the Office of State Fire Marshal to study rural firefighting, including volunteer recruitment, funding, equipment, mutual aid and firefighter health, hold at least three regional public hearings and a 90-day comment period, and report by March 1, 2027.

nc:HB 370|general statutes commission un.title: General Statutes Commission Uniform Acts Regarding Children.
nc:HB 370|general statutes commission un.summary: Adopts a uniform law letting courts order measures to prevent child abduction in custody cases, and requires adoption agencies to give prospective parents of certain children, including foster and international adoptees, information meant to prevent unlawful custody transfers.

nc:HB 275|failure to yield penalties.title: Failure to Yield Penalties.
nc:HB 275|failure to yield penalties.summary: Makes failing to yield the right-of-way and causing serious bodily injury a misdemeanor instead of an infraction, keeping the $500 fine and 90-day license revocation, and states that failing to yield to a blind pedestrian is a misdemeanor, from December 1, 2025.

nc:HB 162|local government applicants cr.title: Local Government Applicants/Criminal History Check.
nc:HB 162|local government applicants cr.summary: Requires counties and cities to have the State Bureau of Investigation run criminal history checks on job applicants for positions that involve working with children, for applications starting October 1, 2025.

nc:HB 330|controlled substances act upda.title: Controlled Substances Act - Updates.
nc:HB 330|controlled substances act upda.summary: Updates the state's list of Schedule I controlled substances, adding dozens of opioid compounds, nitazenes, bromazolam and new classes of synthetic cannabinoids and stimulants, and renaming certain listed drugs.

nc:HB 198|amend law on notice of abc vio.title: Amend Law on Notice of ABC Violation.
